name: 🚀Blast Zero! ☄️
creator: X_Elias_X
description: A fast-paced word blaster game in space

name: Jungle Paintball Showdown
creator: NamasteVibes
description: You sprint through the dense jungle, paintball gun at the ready. Your goal is to reach the extraction point, but enemy combatants are closing in. You dash behind a tree, reload, and take aim. The scoring system rewards accuracy, speed, and exploration, so you strategize your next move carefully. As you complete each level, confetti and fireworks erupt in celebration. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the ultimate paintball champion in this 6-level Jungle Paintball Showdown!

name: 10 Seconds to Live
creator: blanktarget
description: In 10 Seconds To Live, you face fast-paced puzzles! Solve 3D block puzzles, pop balloons, match patterns, sort numbers, and more in 10 seconds or less. Faster solves earn more points. Compete globally and climb the leaderboard with Daily Challenges, or practice with randomized puzzles. The game features a daily 'Seed' of puzzles, ensuring everyone gets the same ones to compete. Your progress is tracked, including lifetime puzzles solved and best scores.

name: 100 DROPS - Dice Matching Roguelike
creator: Person11
description: Draft your dice, give them a roll, and show off your matching skills to get to the top of the leaderboard. In this matching roguelike dicebuilder you shift the board back and forth while dropping dice in order to set up a cascading combo of matches. Use unique power-ups to drastically change the way you play. Do you have what it takes to reach all 100 drops?

creator: Shayan_bg
description: Slide tiles to merge numbers in this 2048 puzzle game. Start with a 4x4 grid and swipe to combine tiles. As you progress, the tiles change color and grow in value. Can you reach 2048?

name: 219Rumble Pocket Edition
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: You step into the gritty streets of Gary, Indiana, where 16 urban fighters clash in intense battles. Choose from CROOKED COP, PREACHER, PLAYA MAX, YN, ROXY, BIG MAMA, MR.1000, and KINGPIN, each with unique moves and styles. Battle it out in 1v1, 2v2, or ARCADE modes across 28 stages, including HARBOR DOCKS, CORNER STORE, HIGHWAY OVERPASS, NIGHT STREET II, LIQUOR STORE NIGHT, RAIL YARD DUSK, ROOFTOP NIGHT, and more. Customize your experience with a bold new logo and title screen. Gary Brawl is a fighting game where you play as your favorite urban fighter and compete against others in a variety of game modes.

name: 2D School
creator: 8bitvapor
description: 2D chat room set in a school with mini games.

name: 6 Hens a Hatchin🥚
creator: creativeCharm
description: Tap hens, add picks, and lock in bets in this colorful game! Predict which hens will hatch eggs and earn money for correct predictions. Collect eggs, track progress, and unlock rewards.

name: 8 Ball Legends | The Ultimate Billiard Pool Experience
creator: fakemovement
description:
8 Ball Legends is a brand new concept for Horizon Worlds pool lovers!
With 2 different game modes, there's always something to play.
Take on the classic 8-ball billiard game against the CPU on Easy, Medium, or Hard (if you dare).
Or try the all-new 8-Ball Challenge, where you'll need to find the perfect angle to pocket the 8-ball in the right pocket while dodging obstacles with 255 levels!!
Compete with your friends to climb the leaderboards, earn points from your wins, and customize your table and cue stick in the shop.
New challenge levels are added over time, so there's always a reason to come back.

Think you've got what it takes to be an 8 Ball Legend?

name: 80s Arcade Pinball
creator: Bambipie
description: Step into the neon glow of 80s Arcade Pinball! Flip, bounce, and chase high scores while tackling missions in this retro arcade challenge.

name: 80s Retro Baseball
creator: Bambipie
description: Remember arcade baseball? It's back, and it fits in your pocket. ⚾ One tap to swing. Three innings, a few minutes. Smash homers, out-pitch the CPU, and climb the leaderboard.

name: Pistol Arena - BACKROOMS
creator: Luxca
description: 🔫 Welcome to [ FPS ] Pistol Arena - The Ultimate Horizon Shooter game! 💥 Are you ready for the ultimate fast-paced First-Person Shooter (FPS) experience? One tap delivers pure skill-based combat. It's simple: One shot, one kill. Experience intense, competitive arena shooter action with short matches and near-instant respawns. This is a hardcore one-tap shooter where your reaction time and precision are everything. No downtime, just adrenaline. Dominate the global leaderboards and prove your skill. Be the One Tap King

name: Safe Space
creator: IamTheElite
description: A Space to Rock Out

name: A ? for a ?
creator: creativeCharm
description: Can you answer a question with a question? Is that your answer to a question?

name: Aesthetic Utopia
creator: natashagubernov
description: Place to relax and take selfies

name: After School Football 2027
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: You step into the vibrant stadium of After School Gridiron, surrounded by the energetic roar of the crowd. Customize your team name with different color jerseys and helmets, then choose from a compact playbook to execute plays in real time. The stadium's dramatic lighting effects and perfectly positioned bleachers create an immersive atmosphere. Lead your team to victory under a nostalgic 1990s TV-style broadcast look, complete with oversaturated colors and warm, washed-out tones. The crowd reacts to gameplay with 'ohs' on incomplete passes, cheers on big plays, and groans on turnovers. As you play, the home team name proudly displays on the end zones, adding a personal touch to the game.

name: Ag World's Night-Flight✨🌌 (Flappy Bird)
creator: Ag
description: Soar through a vibrant neon city at night with a sleek character! Customize with retro pixel neon styles and fly through wider gaps with less sensitive collisions. Enjoy a hover feature, grace period, and arcade-style synthy soundtrack. Test your skills and compete for the best score!

name: Agent Poop
creator: Kishor Berde
description: Welcome to Agent Poop's Big Adventure, where every mission is an adventure filled with laughter and excitement. Agent Poop is a secret agent who is always on the go, solving mysteries, and saving the day with a dash of humor and a sprinkle of fun! Dive into the World: Explore five exciting game modes: - The Poop Show - Agent Mission - Agent Poop Run - Agent Poop VS Zombies - Agent Poop: The Big Adventure Join Agent Poop on thrilling missions, from delivering mail to infiltrating enemy bases. Whether you're racing against time, dodging obstacles, or defeating enemies, there's always something fun to do! Features: - Play with friends or solo - Climb the leaderboard and show off your skills - Explore vibrant worlds filled with surprises - Unlock new levels and achievements. Fun for Everyone: Agent Poop is perfect for players of all ages. It's easy to learn, hard to master, and always full of surprises. So grab your friends, put on your agent hat, and get ready for a poop-tastic adventure! Your Mission: Help Agent Poop complete his missions, collect coins, and steal top-secret artifacts .. but watch out for the guards! The fate of the world is in your hands (and your poop)! https://discord.com/invite/PoopGame Get Ready to Play: Join the Agent Poop community today and start your adventure! Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore gamer, Agent Poop has something for everyone. So what are you waiting for? Let's go! Join the Fun: Explore vibrant worlds filled with surprises Platformer Action

name: Aggravated Assault (update)
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Explore Hollow Point city at dusk or night with dynamic day/night cycles. Customize your character and radio. Navigate icy roads with slippery driving, and avoid two rival gangs, Eastside Crew and Westside Crew, that control different sides of the city. Deal with police pursuit and rival gang members. Get caught and you'll head to the police station. In Aggravated Assault, you must survive the city's dangers and keep your wits about you.

name: Air Traffic Hub
creator: 13_Chris
description: Guide planes, jets, and helicopters through a busy airport with precision. Tap to select, drag for a curved path, or tap a destination for an auto-curved route. Earn stars for flawless landings and avoid collisions in this challenging air traffic control game. Explore 50 levels, multiple aircraft types, and a daily challenge airport. Compete in Endless mode and climb the leaderboards. Your goal is clear: keep the skies safe and sound!

name: Alien Munchies
creator: voytek.lorenc (metacrafters)
description: Our alien has munchies!

name: Alien Oasis
creator: tmwheeler1
description: The Aliens have taken over this house in outer space! Help round them up and pick some flowers while you're at it.

name: Alien Treasure Hunters the Board Game
creator: Gortiva
description: "NEW SOLO MODE" Travel dimensions to collect the most gold!

name: Alien Wave Survival
creator: Ag
description: You stand on a desolate Martian landscape, the eerie silence broken only by the distant groans of alien zombies shambling towards you. Your Chrome Compact Blaster feels reassuring in your hands, its green laser blasts ready to cut down the undead hordes. Can you last?

name: Alone in the Arctic: Survival Co-op [Loot Update!]
creator: MetaJorgen
description:
After a terrible crash landing, you wake up alone in the Arctic! Build a shelter, find food, stay warm and survive as long as you can! HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE?
NEW LOOT UPDATE FEATURES:
- Loot Items - New Loot System: Find rare loot, weapons, clothing and survival supplies scattered across the Arctic.
- Wandering Loot Trader - New Trader Character: Meet the Trader and exchange Loot for useful items.
- Generic Items - New Smithing System: Pre-Craft Base items and Build your own customized items.
- Guns - Added new gun item scripts for new military and survivors camps.
NEW 2026 SURVIVOR'S PASS FEATURES:- New Season's Pass: Earn XP and unlock rewards.
- New Loot Items: Legendary Outfits, Backpacks, Saddles and Pets available to unlock.
- New tool: Field Glass - Survey distant lands with this new locating tool.
- New Legendary Weapon: Prevents weapon durability decrease.
- New Legendary Outfit: Fast travel to camp via your new portal.
- New Legendary Backpack: Unlocks best-in-slot storage for scavenging.
- New Legendary Saddle: A mountable Angler Fish ride.
- New Legendary Pet: A snowy owl pet that grants 5% extra XP.
- NEW FREE LOG IN REWARD GIFT: Short Bow and Arrows Bundle, available to all players.
UPDATE 2025.10 - Autumn Update!
- New Vehicles: Unlock rides from the Vehicle Shop.
- New Stable: Access the Vehicle Shop from your camp.
- New Mounts: Travel across the arctic with Saddle Animals.
- New Fishing: Bait fishing – unlocking new ways to get food.
- New Specialist: Angler - Unlock a fishing vendor.
- New Salmon item: Starter Salmon recipes to try.
- New Item: Angler Gear - New fishing items and equipables.
- New Challenge: Hidden World - A hidden place to defeat and be rewarded.
- New Animal: Polar Bear - Encounter the new polar bear.
- New Camp: Building & Furniture - Use your loot to build furniture items at camp.
- New Item: Traps - Defend your camp against animals.
- New Fishing: Catch more fish with a better fishing rod.
- New Puzzle: Diving - Dive the harsh waters of the arctic.
- New Challenge: Artifacts - A new collectables quest.
- New Challenge: Choose your own path - Develop a huge variety of new skills.
- Daily Rewards: Claim a daily reward - the winter items are new every day.
- New Mechanic: Cooking - Eat raw or cooked food, cook meals and improve your dishes.
- New Animal friend: Dog - Discover a loyal Arctic friend.
- New Tool: Beacons - Create and upgrade beacons to find friends in plight.
- New Mechanics: Torch - Use new torch tech to light your path.
- New Tool: Lantern - A lantern for darker times.
- New Area: Atom Test Zone - Find a brand-new military zone with new trials.
- New Special Informant: Podium damage - Refugee of the new year.
- New Levels: Player levels are now capped at 999.

name: Alpaca Music Festival
creator: voytek.lorenc (metacrafters)
description: A gentler tower defense: alpacas wander a music festival, bored and heading for the exit. Deploy street performers and concession stalls to entertain them before they leave for good.

name: Alpha Dash
creator: Heaz_D2S
description: Tap out the alphabet as fast as you can. The timer starts on 'A' and stops on 'Z', measured to 1/100th of a second. See your progress highlighted in a row at the top and track your best time on the game over screen. Challenge yourself and others to be the fastest typist.

name: ANIMAL ROLEPLAY (+35 CREATURES)
creator: Qrewella
description:
🌿 Survive! 🌱 Grow! 🔓 Unlock! 👑 Conquer!

Play as one of 35 animals 🐾 in a stylish low-poly world 🎨.
Find food 🍖🥕, avoid danger ⚠️, level up ⬆️⚡, and defeat the map boss 👹👑.
Play solo 👤 or with friends 👥 in multiplayer!

🌿 Be an animal and survive in nature.
⚔️ Level up, unlock new animals, and beat the boss.
👥 Multiplayer supported. Low-poly style.

name: TRAIN YOUR PET (IDLE TYCOON)
creator: ANIL
description:
Tame, train, race!
Hit the treadmills, boost stats, and chase the trophy!
Easy controls, speedy runs, shiny rewards
Animal Training is pure fun!

name: Anime Brawl
creator: MistaWavy
description:
You step into the arena, joystick in hand, ready to take on waves of enemies in a frenetic 2D fighting game. With a sleek modern anime style and cel-shaded bold art, the stage is set for explosive action!

Clash in the arena in Anime Brawl - a 2D fighting game where you build your own anime hero, level up their skills and gear, and fight for the top!

Master unique abilities, slash and blast through waves of opponents and climb the ranks to become the champion!

name: Anime RNG
creator: Junyuh
description: Cultivate magical booster packs and reveal 54 anime heroes, including dazzling holographic legends. Build teams to earn gold and battle powerful enemies, combine elements for special bonuses, and defeat bosses to unlock exclusive cards. Upgrade your collection, infuse packs to shape your luck, and prestige for permanent power. Your next pack could hold your greatest discovery.

name: Apocalypse Avoider
creator: WanesWorld
description: You navigate a devastated landscape as a hooded wanderer, dodging meteorites in a desperate bid to survive. With a virtual joystick, you move left and right through a crumbling city skyline under a dark, smoky sky. The landscape stretches out before you, a vast expanse of ruined buildings and rubble. The air is thick with smoke and ash, and the sky is a deep, foreboding grey. Choose from different survivor styles, each with unique animations - walk, idle, and turn - and directional flipping to face the correct direction when moving. The hitbox has been fine-tuned for better dodging, with a slightly smaller size to give you more room to maneuver near close calls. The game features a title screen, survival timer HUD, and game over screen with orchestral BGM, sound effects, and a somber game over sting. Apocalypse Avoider now features a seamless, full-screen gradient background that sets the apocalyptic mood without any distracting black bars.

name: Arcade games
creator: monkeyJerker79
description: Play five classic arcade games in a neon-lit hub: Pac-Man, Tetris, Space Invaders, Breakout, and Snake. Each game has Easy, Medium, and Hard modes with tracked high scores. Enjoy authentic arcade sound effects, retro music, and touch-based controls in a vibrant 80s-themed environment. Compete for the highest scores in each game and difficulty level, and experience the thrill of retro gaming in a modern setting. Can you beat your own high scores and become the ultimate arcade champion?

name: Arcana Tarot
creator: JordanB0101
description: Experience a premium interactive tarot reading with Mystic Arcana Readings. Explore six reading modes, including Single Card, Past/Present/Future, Love & Relationships, and more. Learn tarot through an interactive library and track your progress in this immersive, mobile-friendly landscape layout game.

name: Arcane Merge Defense
creator: teawa
description: You stand before the Core, a lone Apprentice at the ready. Summon more Apprentices, merge ingredients into Root Keys, and evolve them into Fire, Frost, or Storm mages. Fire mages unleash a deluge of flames, Frost mages freeze and shatter, and Storm mages chain lightning through clusters. Merge mages to amplify their power and place them to cover critical paths. Every 5th wave, a Warlord boss appears - defeat it to survive. Between waves, pick upgrades and play random lanes for endless variety.

name: Archer Defense
creator: Mikolaj
description:
Archer Defense is a fast, vertical action game where you hold the line against endless waves of purple creatures marching straight toward your castle bridge.

Aim quick, shoot faster - and don't let anything slip past.
Play solo or team up with a friend for chaotic co-op runs.

Enemies get tougher, waves get faster, and the pressure never stops.
How long can you defend the bridge before the swarm overwhelms you?

Ready your bow - the horde is coming.

name: Arctic Oasis
creator: TanzerVR
description: Escape the hustle and bustle of the modern world in our tranquil glass pods nestled alongside massive glaciers. This experience is a relaxing retreat to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty that is the Arctic Oasis

name: Ark of Destiny
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: gather up pairs of animals and resources before The Great Storm

name: Armored Plank
creator: Kalymus
description: You captain a sturdy pirate ship, navigating through treacherous waters and fending off enemy vessels. Defend your ship by placing and upgrading defenses like cannons and snipers on the ship deck. Earn gold to strengthen your defenses and survive against increasingly tough threats. The game has 5 voyage levels: Port Malagora, Skull's Reef, The Sunken Throne, Devil's Maw, and The Kraken's Lair. Each level brings tougher enemies, faster ships, and bigger waves.

name: Art School Future
creator: metaversepaige
description: You step into a vibrant art school campus, surrounded by jazz music and buzzing creativity. Explore three studios: Sculpture, Painting, and Furniture, each with looping prompts that encourage you to keep making. Your finished pieces find a home in a Sunlit Park, Warm Gallery, or Public Plaza, surrounded by living creatures and blooming flowers. As you create, small animals visit your work, leaving tiny gifts like feathers, acorns, or pebbles. The campus comes alive with your art, and flowers bloom at the edges of each scene. Tap to hear the visitors' curious observations, and see your work make a quiet impact on the world around you. In the Hackathon studio, spark new ideas with prompts that explore materials, place, light, nature, and change.

name: Artistic Odyssey
creator: metaversepaige
description: Run through 12 levels of art history, from ancient civilizations to modern masterpieces! Collect iconic items, avoid obstacles, and earn points. Unlock power-ups and art magnets in the museum shop. Can you beat the levels and become an art champion? Earn daily challenge rewards and streak bonuses to stay engaged. The game features a 3x4 magnet grid, with one magnet for every level, fully filled. The levels include Antiquity, Bayeux Tapestry, Asia, Renaissance, Impressionism, Van Gogh, Surrealism, Abstract Expressionism, De Stijl, Pop Art, Bauhaus, and Fin de Siècle inspired by Gustav Klimt, featuring The Kiss and all gold elements. Jump onto multilevel terrain platforms to add a new layer of challenge and excitement. Artistic Odyssey: Klimt's Dream

name: Art-sKool Sketchbook
creator: metaversepaige
description: Dive into the vibrant, edgy world of Arts-Kool Sketchbook, where creativity meets rebellion. You step into Palette Academy, an urban art school that pulses with energy. The bold chibi-emo girl with a black bob, blunt bangs, green highlights, and green eyes greets you, her sketchbook in hand. You're surrounded by graffiti-tagged walls, neon accents, and a hint of grunge. The air is electric with inspiration. Choose from a fresh set of art-school style prompts that push your creativity: 'sketch something you'd never show anyone,' 'what does 3am feel like?,' or 'draw your comfort zone on fire.' Customize with vibrant color palettes and a range of nibs like Round, Spray Paint, Marker, Glow, and Sparkle. Save your masterpieces in the Sketchbook gallery and earn points to unlock new tools. The shop is now a full art supply store with warm wooden shelving, colorful and inviting, complete with a hand-painted sign and bold product icons. Browse, buy, and own your artistic expression. Get ready to fill every page and unleash your inner artist! What will you create first in Arts-Kool Sketchbook?

name: Hneftafl: Asgard
creator: Fechin
description: Play the ancient Viking strategy board game Hneftafl. Flip a coin to decide if you're the defender of the King or leader of the Hounds. Progress through 4 warrior difficulty tiers and 6 Aesir opponents, unlocking ornate board and piece designs. Track your legendary journey on the Legend Board, with match history, win/loss records, and performance metrics. Explore Viking art, adaptive music, and sound design.

name: Ashborn Tycoon
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Beneath the scorched earth lies Ashborn—a realm where every spark of life must be forged from suffering and flame. In this dark-fantasy tycoon simulation, players awaken as fallen Forgemasters, rebuilding their power in the heart of the Underworld. Starting with scattered Soul Coins, players construct and upgrade infernal generators like the Bone Furnace, Soul Collector, and Heart Forge, each producing rarer and more powerful resources—from Ash Crystals to Eternal Flame Essence. The gameplay loop blends collection, crafting, and progression with a touch of skill-based platforming and interactive events. As players grow their Soul Foundry, they unlock new zones, automate their production, and uncover the ancient lore of the forges that once shaped worlds. Featuring: 🔥 10 unique resources to collect and refine / ⚙️ Upgradeable generators with animated production loops / 💀 Persistent player plots (The Soul Foundry) / 🧩 Platforming challenges & interactive world events / ✨ AI-generated visuals, dynamic lava lighting, and cinematic soundscapes. Rebuild. Refine. Reignite. Ashborn — where every soul has a price.

name: ASMR Soda Pop
creator: deon1217
description: Dive into ASMR Soda Pop, where soft fizz and Froggy's soothing voice create a calming atmosphere. Tap, pour, and crush soda cans to unlock flavors, each with its own ASMR sound effects. Fill your Satisfaction Meter with Perfect Pours and streaks, and discover Daily Challenge cans for a meter boost. With a vast collection of unique flavors and icons, every can stands out in the grid. Experience the ultimate ASMR soda adventure in ASMR Soda Sprint!

name: Meteor Mayhem
creator: Yoda G.
description: You play Meteor Mayhem, a classic asteroid game with a twist. Navigate your triangular spaceship, destroy asteroids, and compete for the highest score on the leaderboard. The game features a virtual joystick, shooting mechanics, scoring system, 3 lives, and immersive audio effects.

name: Atmosphere Jewel Wrangler
creator: Dr. Fun
description: Pilot a seaplane through a vibrant sunrise desert sky, collecting jewels with an energy lasso. Start at a charming airfield, then soar over mesas and dry riverbeds. The lasso fires from a glowing amber port on the plane's nose, shifting from amber-gold to rose-pink and cyan-violet along its length. A brief tutorial overlay at game start guides you through controls and gameplay. Enjoy a physics-feel flight game with wingtip condensation trails, speed-glow aura, and jewel collect bursts.

name: Avalanche
creator: Mebi
description: Avalanche is a fast, physical racer where you start massive and shrink over time. Sprint, slide, and wall-tap to keep your snowball alive as you blaze down a crazy track. Bump rivals, snag upgrades, and chain boosts to slow the melt and push your score higher. Every run is a race against decay.

name: AVOID THE SCAMS
creator: Maxim Kuzlin
description: VERTICAL WEB ADVENTURE! AVOID THE SCAMS - UPLOAD YOURSELF TO THE INTERNET AND RUN THROUGH THE OBSTACLES - AVOID SCAM POP-UP ADS

name: Aye, Captain: Pirate Tales
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Explore mysterious islands as an iguana pirate, climbing walls with ease and discovering hidden treasures. Fight sea-creature pirates with a 3-hit combo sword and manage your inventory. Customize your experience with upgrades and inventory management. A ship waypoint badge guides you to your bearded dragon crew. Sell treasures to merchants by walking up to them, and navigate through islands with a new classic video game controller look interface.

name: B-KPR
creator: rosterizer
description: The Hive needs power, the Hive needs B's, the Hive needs protection, the Hive needs YOU! Search the landscape for Nectar and B-Friends to join the Hive but be ready to defend the Hive against waves of unwelcome intruders.

name: Backrooms: Fractured Dimensions
creator: mortimer.io
description:
Cutting edge horror game where you must explore an expansive and varied liminal environment. Collect powerups and items while outrunning and outsmarting an a relentless and deadly entity.

Features intense animation system (created with assistance from Llama,) and a fully original environment, ost, and monster designed by Ink Overflow.

inkoverflow.com

name: Backyard Beasts
creator: wifeydoesit
description:
Raise and Hatch your Beasts. Fortify your yard. Rule the neighborhood. Build. Train. Conquer. Your backyard is a monster kingdom.

Backyard Beasts is a monster, base building battler where you hatch wild Beasts, train them into an unstoppable crew, and turn your backyard into an unbeatable fortress. Hatch them, Evolve them, and send them to raid rival yards — or hold the line when someone comes for yours. Every Beast you raise fights like family.

name: Balatro
creator: ★彡OnlyLucidVibes 彡★
description: A template for building a 2D game from scratch.

name: Ball Brawl
creator: Sven_disciple_of_Christ
description: v1.1 Fixed static ball and gem purchases. Added difficulty to solo runs. Ball Brawl is a futuristic dodgeball game where swords deflect the ball. Miss, you're out! Last standing wins. Unlock epic sword skins with gems earned or bought. Deflect, survive, and dominate!

name: Balloon Frenzy
creator: king_of_Miami
description: Drift through a sea of colorful balloons and pop them in just the right order. A sequence of 3 balloons appears at the top of the screen, and you have 10 seconds to find and tap the correct ones as they float by. Tap a wrong balloon and the game ends; beat the clock and you're a step closer to a high score. With festive music and sound effects, this game is a fun challenge for your reflexes and attention to detail. Play 'Balloon Frenzy' to test your skills!

name: Bananalicious - Update(shirts)
creator: Ilina3🤍
description:
Update 08/17
Last man standing update game - be the last one standing on the banana slices
Now available on mobile/desktop as well

Update 04/01
Collect all the coins and place them in the piggybank

Update 03.30.24
Easter Egg Hunt on! Collect the most eggs to win a prize! (min 100)
- details in world

Update 03.17.24
Role-play as a barista! Grab your hat and serve delicious fruity and chocolate milks!

Monthly competition - the best baristas win IRL prizes - check the in-world sign for details.

Fun, banana themed parkour world
Take advantage of the banana, strawberry, and chocolate milk power-ups
In every instance, the player with the most time spent automatically gets a crown (check your camera)
After completing the game, access is granted to guns that allow players to compete by kicking others off the course
Explore the big blackboard where your imagination can come to live
For relaxation, the banana chill zone offers a place to hang out without threat of gun use.

name: Barrel Blitz
creator: Yoda G.
description: Get ready to roll in Barrel Blitz! Smash through obstacles, dodge the hammer, and collect coins as you speed down a futuristic track. Can you survive the blitz?

name: Basic Obby
creator: jimrif
description: A ‘basic’ obby with not-so-basic challenges. Double jump, skip stages, and tackle 32 levels filled with moving platforms, classic hazards, and fun!

name: Bat Chicken vs Aliens
creator: Andy Kelly
description: Hop your Bat Chicken across busy traffic lanes, then blast invading aliens in a top-down shooter. Earn points and face increasing difficulty as you loop through levels. Customize your frog with various styles and play with infinite lives! Can you survive the alien invasion and become the ultimate frog hero? Play Hop to Shoot now! You control a frog that must navigate through traffic and shoot aliens. The second road acts as a checkpoint, allowing you to respawn at the start of the second road if you die on the upper half, saving progress and making it easier to play. When you narrowly avoid cars, you earn near miss bonuses that give you extra firepower in the shooting segment.

name: BattleBall
creator: Meta.Jesus [illuminated]
description: Deflect a highly explosive homing ball, in this action packed, ancient death sport, last person standing game! Win, upgrade your sword, master abilities, and show them who the ultimate BattleBaller is!

name: BATTLESHIP - OCEAN TACTICS
creator: mixlab
description: Command your ships. Tap a location, confirm your aim, and sink your opponent before they sink you!

name: Beach Break
creator: tmwheeler1
description: Remix your beach adventure!

name: Bead Grid
creator: 13_Chris
description: You find yourself standing in front of a colorful grid, eager to start your Bead Bliss Puzzle journey. As you begin, you see a rectangular grid board with some polyomino pieces and colorful beads scattered around. Drag the polyomino pieces onto the grid board and watch as they fill in the squares. Your goal is to place a row of the same colored pieces together, solving the puzzle and earning points as you go. Use your logic and strategy to figure out the best placement for each piece, and don't be afraid to experiment and try new combinations! As you progress through the levels, the puzzles will get harder and more complex, but the satisfaction of solving them will only grow. So put on your thinking cap and get ready to start your Bead Bliss Puzzle journey today!

name: Bean Blast
creator: 13_Chris
description:
Bean Blast
Horizon Worlds' first Match 3 puzzle game — built for mobile!
( after clicking start move screen a click option will show to start the panel ) :) this will be changed.
Slide, match, and blast your way through waves of colorful beans in this fast-paced, jellybean-style puzzler. Bean Blast delivers vibrant visuals, bean-powered combos, and endless levels of fun — all fully optimized for mobile gameplay.
Currently in beta — development is ongoing! Expect frequent updates, new features, and refinements as I fine-tune the fun.
Match 3 or more to score
Mobile only
Think you're good at puzzles? Come prove it — one bean at a time.
Follow on IG: [@13_Chris.VR]
Join the Discord: https://bit.ly/Join13VrCreations

name: Beat Lab 808
creator: PrometheusGMP.TM.CR
description: Create pulsing rhythms with BEAT LAB 808! Tap pads on a 16-step grid to compose kick, snare, hi-hat, and bass patterns with punchy, synthesized 808 sounds. Shape your masterpiece using individual volume, pitch, and decay sliders for each instrument, or use mute toggles for precise control. Add swing, mix and match preset patterns, and chain sequences together to build dynamic tracks. The ultimate 808 drum machine experience awaits—press play and bring your beats to life!

name: BEAT THE MAZE
creator: Arès
description: Race through the maze, collect every coin, and avoid the ghosts to survive. Compete against other players and try to finish as fast as possible. Only the fastest reach the top of the leaderboard. Can you beat the maze?

name: Beauty Of Color Nail Spa
creator: NamasteVibes
description: You step into Nail Spa High, where the rhythm of hip hop and the thrill of creativity come alive. Choose from a queue of customers, each with their own unique style and story, and decide which service to provide next. Earn points for quality work and bonus points for keeping the salon spotless. Unlock new beauty products, salon upgrades, and stylish outfits as you progress. Build relationships with your clients and watch them become loyal regulars. In this vibrant world, every detail matters – from the graffiti murals to the luxury touches, every choice helps you craft a one-of-a-kind experience that's all about self-expression.

name: Bee Line
creator: 13_Chris
description: You turn the page and come face-to-face with a swarm of angry bees. All you have is one line of ink: draw a shield, seal every gap, and keep the bees off a very nervous raccoon for 10 seconds. Clear 100 levels of escalating trouble, earn stars for using the least ink possible, and climb the leaderboards for most levels cleared and least ink used. Leave one gap and the bees will find it. Can you outsmart the swarm and become the ultimate Ink Saver?

name: Bell Taco Shift
creator: Ag
description: Run a colorful Mexican restaurant in a nostalgic, early 2000s style! Manage orders, cook food, and serve customers in a fun, goofy game. Upgrade your restaurant, unlock new items, and hire employees to succeed. Play mini-games like Taco Rush and Sauce Attack to boost your skills. Will you make it to Day 10 and win the game? In Bell Taco Fiesta, you control a goofy cartoon employee, moving with simple WASD / Arrow Keys. Customers enter through the front door, each with a funny early-2000s cartoon design and exaggerated facial expressions. Give them a simple order, remember/read it, and prepare it in a fun, satisfying food preparation mini-game. Earn money, show customer satisfaction with ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆, and collect tips! The game is divided into days, with customers slowly arriving. At the end of each day, see your progress: Customers Served, Happy Customers, Orders Lost, Tips, and Profit. Upgrade your restaurant to become bigger and busier, hire employees to help, and play three simple early-2000s-style mini-games: Taco Rush, Sauce Attack, and Drive-Thru Dash. Enjoy cheesy, upbeat early-2000s-style instrumental music and sound effects like DING!, CHA-CHING!, WHOOSH!, POP!, BEEP!, and UH-OH!

name: BerryLicious (Glass Bridge) 🟐🍓
creator: Ilina3🤍
description: 🍓🥤🫐🍒🩷😍 Try to pass the glass bridge, this time fruit themed. A lot of cute savory treats are waiting for you on the other side. Take a spin around the world in the berry hot air balloon or one of the bubbles!

name: Best Advice!
creator: Drewls
description: In a world of questions, there are answers. If you plan on getting advice, get the Best Advice!

name: VRClub
creator: obeymynuts
description: Welcome to VRClub , the ultimate VR club experience! With three floors of non-stop music, multiple dance floors, a color-changing stage, and stunning views of a virtual city, this is the place to be. Chill at the rooftop bar or lose yourself in the dark, aesthetic vibes. Join the party at VRClub —where the beats are endless and the fun never stops!

name: Birds & Bigfoot Snap
creator: metaversepaige
description: You step into a whimsical cartoon woodland, camera in hand, ready to snap photos of birds and the elusive Bigfoot. Explore three levels of increasing complexity, from sun-dappled forest to misty marsh and twilight canopy. Tap the screen to snap a photo when a bird flits into view - collect species in your journal and earn points. But keep an eye out for a surprise visitor... Bigfoot roams these woods, and if you can catch him on camera, you'll earn a fortune in points! Become a Master Birder and earn the golden badge. Spend your points in the Birdwatcher's Emporium on birdwatching gear upgrades, Bigfoot stage props, and camera film effects. Unlock achievements like Owl Whisperer and True Believer. Each session brings new challenges and opportunities - will you capture the daily Bird of the Day and earn double points? Snap Happy awaits, ready to help you upgrade your gear and props.

name: Black Friday
creator: Reukifellth
description:
Listen to the full OST on Bandcamp: https://slightlyobtuseangle.bandcamp.com/album/black-friday-full-ost

Thumbnail + Concept/Enemy art by @ShockedBlack https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M8qIWZVPZAQ

* No generative AI was used in this world or its creation. All assets, sounds, and art were created by us for the contest. No pre-built or store bought assets were used for this submission.

A retro arcade-y waveshooter with elements of progression, unlocks, and team play. Defend the mall from an alien invasion looking to capitalize on the insane deals on Black Friday!

name: Black Friday: Redux
creator: mortimer.io
description:
The world is once again under attack! The Aliens have returned to once again capitalize on the "out-of-this-world" deals on Black Friday! This on-rails sequel to our first Horizon Worlds title, "Black Friday", has been optimized with Mobile & Web in mind, for on-the-go action! Can you defeat the onslaught and save the world?

https://inkoverflow.com

name: Black History is American History
creator: Blaqjedi
description: Enjoying history before it was destroyed by hatred

name: Ring of Fate
creator: metaversepaige
description: You navigate through dynamic town locations like the Synagogue, Mikveh, Town Square, and Riverbank, collecting treasure while avoiding hazards like plague-ridden rats and angry villagers. Find and hide a precious ring to progress through multiple screens, each with escalating danger, and earn a high score. Buy amulets to protect yourself and strategically hide the ring to outsmart the mob. As you collect treasure, a treasure counter HUD shows how many of each type you've collected. With each round, the ring hides deeper, the mob gets faster, and more hazards spawn. Will you survive and collect as much treasure as possible in Erfurt Escape?

name: Blackjack Frenzy
creator: seemebro
description: Blackjack Frenzy

name: Blacqsaw
creator: Blacqdiamone
description: Jigsaw 🧩 Puzzling just got much more fun. The colors vacation spots we count visit in these scenes are beautiful.

name: BLOCK BALL
creator: LevelRiftLabs
description: Knock Down All of The Blocks. Earn Coins to Buy Power Balls at the Shop.

name: Block Builder's Arena
creator: AI Voyager🍀
description: Grab blocks, carry them, and stack them high in a vibrant 3D construction zone! You start with seven colorful blocks of different shapes and sizes near a central building area. With simple, intuitive controls, you can pick up a block, move it around, and place it gently on the floor or on top of other blocks. Watch as your tower rises, block by block. No distractions, no timers – just pure building freedom. Can you create the tallest tower ever?

name: Block Buster
creator: daddy26764
description: Play Block Buster, a modern take on the classic Breakout game. You control a paddle in 3D isometric view, dragging it left and right to bounce a ball and destroy rows of bricks. Advance through multiple levels, each with a unique brick layout. Your goal is to clear all bricks to progress. The game features realistic ball physics, a lives system, and a clean, colorful design.

name: BLOCKWISE
creator: LevelRiftLabs
description: Flip, move, and win your way through levels in Blockwise!

name: Bloom Boutique
creator: metaversepaige
description: Run your own cozy flower shop in Bloom Boutique! Craft beautiful bouquets, interact with customers, and grow your collection. Enjoy a fresh jazz soundtrack that changes daily. Compete in neighborhood contests and special events like the Flower Festival. Customize your shop and serve customers to become the most beloved florist in town.

name: Bloomkeeper
creator: jamie2winner
description: Embark on a mystical journey through a vibrant forest, where you'll nurture a garden back to health and defend it against withered spirits called Gloomlings. Collect glowing treasures, upgrade your Light Seeds and Bloom Burst, and purify the Gloomlings to restore the forest. With each treasure collected and Gloomling defeated, the forest flourishes. In Bloomkeeper, experience the magic of growth and renewal.

name: bluebospot thanksgiving event (Abandon)
creator: realbluebo
description: chill map beat the obbys(Abandon)

name: Boardwalk Rush
creator: Yoda G.
description: Play a fast-paced 10-minute Monopoly-style game on your phone! You and up to 3 friends compete in a 20-space loop, racing to amass the most net worth in 12 rounds. Land on a rival's property and decide: pay triple rent to Steal-a-Deed and flip the board, or back down. But watch out - each round, an Event Card shakes things up, like doubling rent on red properties or giving you a free build. Mini-games on Chance and Jail spaces keep you on your toes.

name: Boba & Bloom
creator: metacrafters
description: Run a cozy tea shop! Make sure to get your orders on time on there will be sad faces all around!

name: Bobalicious
creator: Ilina3🤍
description: Bobalicious is a vibrant, dreamlike world where players dive into a swirling paradise of color, movement, and endless boba fun. Designed for mobile but fully immersive in VR, this experience lets you collect boba pearls, dodge obstacles, and race through dazzling landscapes—whether you're exploring solo or competing with friends. Every corner bursts with playful energy, rewarding curiosity and skill. Get ready to jump in, sip up the adventure, and fill your cup with flavor! 🧋🌌

name: Bomb Squad
creator: mommy26764
description:
Get ready for some intense fun in Bomb Squad! 🏗️⚡

You and up to 9 friends start by claiming your squad color and competing in a series of nail-biting mini-games. Test your strategy in big spray-can zones, speed through the Laser Run and Reaction Game, and risk it all in the explosive bomb plants.

But that's not all: you and your crew can take down rivals in electrifying mini-games, like the shocking Tile Grab and Explosive Bomb Toss. Can you shatter the glass floor before it shatters you? Launch yourself into chaos with catapults, zapping your opponents with tasers and tossing bombs. 💥

Custom avatars add a personal flair to every matchup, and with weekly season rewards, the action never stops. Bring your A-game and prove you're the ultimate squad! 🛠️

name: Bomb Tic Tac Toe
creator: WanesWorld
description: You find yourself standing in front of a ticking bomb, ready to play a thrilling game of Tic Tac Toe against Sam. Choose your mark (X or O) and board size, then tap to place your mark before the bomb explodes! The AI, Sam, opposes you, and if either of you runs out of time, the bomb explodes and you lose. Win by getting in a row, outsmart Sam, and beat the clock. The game features a win streak counter to track your consecutive wins, and Sam now takes a random 1–2.5 second thinking pause before making a move. If the game ends in a draw, a Sudden Death Rock, Paper, Scissors showdown determines the winner.

name: Bonk Monsters
creator: AI Voyager
description: Get ready to bonk! In this colorful 3D arcade game, you grab a giant foam hammer and smash monsters as they pop up from a 3x3 grid of holes. Each monster wobbles, plays a cartoon 'bonk' sound, and hides when hit. Can you keep the bonk streak going? Explore the vibrant arcade play area, interact with the oversized hammer, and show off your bonking skills in **Bonk Monsters**.

name: Bonsai Time (Beta)
creator: Matthiaos
description: Tend a serene seaside bonsai shop. Prune, wire, and grow trees, serve customers, and participate in the weekly bonsai show. Customize your garden with benches, paths, and a koi pond as you progress from Apprentice to Bonsai Master.

name: Boomer
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: You find yourself standing in the middle of a retro 90's-style office maze, surrounded by flickering fluorescent lights and dusty cubicles. Explore the retro office, fight off enemies, and emerge victorious in this nostalgic world. As you load into the game, a CRT boot intro sequence sets the tone - a fake BOOMER OS v1.0 BIOS screen with scan-line flicker, a comedic text crawl, and a chunky pixel progress bar.

name: Boopi
creator: Naavi
description: Get hoppin!

name: Bot Heads
creator: obeymynuts
description: Welcome to BotHeads , the ultimate VR showdown where you and your friends face endless waves of relentless robots! Arm yourself with epic upgrades and powerful weapons as you fight for survival. Team up to crush the mechanical menace, compete for the highest score, and see who can last the longest in this adrenaline-pumping, high-octane battle. Dive into BotHeads and unleash your inner warrior—can you handle the chaos?

name: Bots! - Idle Battler
creator: Habitor
description:
Get ready for some mechanical mayhem! "Bots!" is an idle battler where customization is king. Unlock and equip new abilities in the garage, then take your bot to the arena and watch it wreak havoc upon your opponents! Want to get in some practice? Test your loadouts in the CPU arenas before bringing them to the main stage. Good luck in the arena, may the best bot triumph!
Credits:
Creative Director: Benjamin Veaner (Habitor)
Producer: Ian Garnett (NemethXr)
Lead Developer: Ben London (Blender93)
Developer: Jed Phillips (Mortimer.io)
Lead Artist: MKE_The_Guru
Art: Jelitza Cintron (SpaceGlitterUnicorn)
Art: Madi Lenhart (Madilenni)
Art: Holly Renee (SpaceyCatVR)
with support from Kluge Interactive

name: Bouncing Coconuts
creator: NullValuePoint
description: You're a pint-sized tropical monkey holding a bongo drum. Coconuts swirl around you in a vibrant tropical storm! Catch them on your drum, bounce them into your braided bamboo basket, and rack up points. A mischievous monkey throws coconuts from above, and gravity pulls left. Navigate this portrait-oriented landscape by moving up and down along the left side, using touch controls to master coconut bouncing. Keep your accuracy above 50% to advance to the next wave. A 10-second countdown will determine your fate - if you succeed, you'll move on; if not, you'll retry. Build streaks, chase your high score, and customize your monkey's look in Monkey Coconut Frenzy!

name: Brain Games
creator: island_ascetic
description: Boost your math skills in this futuristic brain-training lab! Master math challenges like percentages, estimation, equivalence, and discounting to improve your performance score. Unlock new levels and harder challenges by maintaining streaks and earning points. Play four brain-training games – Percentages, Estimation, Equivalence, and Discounting – and track your progress with a daily workout, streaks, and a library of games. Earn rewards and climb the ranks in Mathster!

name: BRAIN OBBY - Think Before You Jump!
creator: fakemovement
description:
Not your typical obby!
Think your way through this brain-teasing obstacle course!
Answer questions and solve puzzles to unlock each checkpoint.
Collect coins along the way and compete for the fastest time.
How smart AND fast can you be?

name: BrainBloom: Brain Teasers
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: You step into Bloom Blast, where learning meets fun! As you explore the vibrant world, Bloom the Owl mascot cheers you on with delightful reactions. You navigate through six distinct chapters - Pattern Garden, Memory Forest, Logic Mountain, Puzzle Peak, Cosmic Academy, and Mastermind Vault - each with its own soft gradient background that immerses you in the journey. Engage with interactive lessons, answer questions, and earn rewards. Your progress is tracked on the Profile tab, where a large Bloom avatar and illustrated stat cards showcase your achievements. Can you master all the levels and become a Bloom Blast champion?

name: Brainrot Escape: Lava
creator: Simo
description:
Welcome to Brainrot Escape: Lava!
Rescue 60+ Brainrots from rising lava to build your tycoon and trade with others.
🐞 Bugs or Support? chesstar.com/discord

name: Brainrot Escape: Tsunami
creator: Simo
description:
Welcome to Brainrot Escape!
Rescue Brainrots from incoming tsunamis and lava floors to build your tycoon and trade with others.
🐞 Bugs or Support? chesstar.com/discord

name: BrambleBound - Cozy Platformer
creator: Junyuh
description: Bramblebound is a hand-drawn platforming adventure starring Pip, a brave fox courier, and Luma, his firefly companion. Leap, glide, and battle through enchanted forests and moonlit mountains, delivering forgotten letters to reunite a valley—and bring its lanterns back to life.

name: BrickOut
creator: Ilina3🤍
description: When Nostalgia Calls, Answer with a High Score!

name: Bubble Race
creator: Nicolas (Deytooh)
description: Escape from the abyss! Reach the surface before your friends

name: Bubble Rush: Candy Run
creator: DaUndaBoss
description: Sprint through Sugar Rush City's vibrant zones: Candy Boulevard, Neon Downtown, Sugar Beach, and Candy Carnival. Collect items, avoid obstacles, and unlock power-ups like Sugar Boost and Bubble Shield. Choose characters, enjoy smoother lane movement, and a fluid experience. Leaderboards track your best time, coins, and score.

name: BUBBLEGRID
creator: SeeingBlue
description: BUBBLEGRID: pop the grid, feel the beat. A psychedelic neon bubble shooter built for your phone. Aim with one thumb, bank shots off the walls and pop matching colours while a laser grid pulses to the music around you. Chain combos and the whole world lights up. JOURNEY: 15 levels across the Neon Grid. Free trapped Bloopies, break through to the Grid Core and drop huge chunks of bubbles, then face the boss: GRIDLOCK, a glitchy cube robot. BLITZ 60: one minute, one goal: the biggest score you can get. INFINITE GRID: the grid keeps coming. How long can you last? DAILY TRIP: a new level every day, the same for everyone. Earn powers like NOVA, PRISM, CHROMA and ZAP, and flick them from the Pocket to hit even harder. Light all three Hyper orbs and swipe up for HYPERDRIVE: twin launchers, rainbow shots, two thumbs drumming. Then climb the leaderboards. Includes Calm Visuals, Reduce Shake, one-hand mode and left-handed controls.

name: Buckeez
creator: 13_Chris
description: 🦌 Buckeez — Welcome to Buckeez, the ultimate convenience store experience where shopping, working, and running the store is key to success. Step inside a lively, always-busy Buckeez location and jump into the action. Grab items off the shelves, scan them at checkout, pour drinks, and earn Buckz as you work. Whether you're here to shop like a customer or hustle like an employee, there's always something happening. Upgrade your role, earn future unlockable rewards, and keep the store running smoothly. The faster and smarter you work, the more Buckz you'll earn. From stocking and checkout to fully managing the flow of the store, Buckeez turns everyday convenience-store chaos into nonstop fun

name: Bug City Rampage
creator: 8bitvapor
description: You're a cockroach on a mission in Bug City Rampage! Run over ants, collect cash and health, and outsmart ladybug cops in a high-energy, top-down adventure. Explore a massive, detailed city, steal realistic cars, and blast enemies with 5 deadly guns - pistol, automatic, flamethrower, grenade launcher, and sword. With a dynamic wanted level, the ladybug police will stop at nothing to catch you. Will you survive the chaos and become the ultimate bug kingpin?

name: Bug Escape
creator: metacrafters
description: A retro arcade maze adventure! Help this little bug navigate the maze and escape the evil spider!

name: Build A Bug Army
creator: WanesWorld
description: Explore a vibrant world from an insect's perspective, building an unstoppable army of bugs! Start with a single ant in THE MEADOW and grow your swarm by collecting food, defeating enemies, and hatching new bugs. Discover 9 species, 7 rarities, and 9 mutations. Fuse duplicates to create stronger bugs. Unlock new areas like the Backyard, Garden, and more, each with unique bugs and resources. Battle giant bosses like THE SHOE and ANGRY CAT. Record your discoveries in the BUGDEX collection book. Enjoy daily quests, weekly invasions, achievements, and leaderboards. Your army will grow visually and become more impressive as you progress!

name: Bullet Hell Arena
creator: sirthornalot
description: In Neon Onslaught: Darkstar, you navigate through waves of enemies in a dark cyberpunk-steampunk world. Collect power shards from defeated enemies to upgrade your Gold-Plated Soldier at shops every 5 rooms. Face formidable bosses and new enemies like the Phantom Lancer, which appears from wave 6 onward with its unique lance burst attack and zigzag movement. Your journey is a thrilling mix of action and strategy, as you balance survival with upgrading your abilities to take on increasingly difficult challenges. The gold counter is conveniently located next to the wave counter at the top of your screen, just below the mini-map, streamlining your HUD experience. Neon Onslaught: Darkstar challenges you to survive and thrive - can you take on the onslaught?

name: Bulletstorm Horizon
creator: blanktarget
description: Pilot your ship through a vibrant, scrolling landscape, collecting upgrades and unleashing a barrage of bullets to take down enemies. With a revamped player weapon arsenal, your bullets are now clearly visible, making it easier to navigate the action-packed world. Explore the horizon, upgrade your ship, and dominate the skies in this fast-paced shoot 'em up survivor-like game, Bulletstorm Horizon.

name: Bullseye Blitz!
creator: WanesWorld
description: You step up to the oaken dartboard, feeling the satisfying heft of the dart in your hand. As you swipe to aim and power your throw, the board lights up with anticipation. Your dart soars towards the bull's eye, and even if it lands just shy of perfection, the near-miss magic kicks in visual effects burst around the impact, a satisfying 'thwack' sounds through the air, and you earn partial points for your close call. The game ramps up the challenge as you progress: zones shrink, the board rotates, and precision becomes paramount. Will you hit the jackpot or come close enough to feel the rush? Dive into Bullseye Blitz! to find out!

name: Bun & Gun: Frank Fury
creator: ViciousVixenn
description: You round the corner of the vibrant football field arena and Frank Fury, an anthropomorphic hot dog, bursts into view. He's battling waves of wacky food enemies on the lush green grass, white yard lines, and colorful end zones. Choose from various styles for Frank Fury and level up to unlock new and upgrade existing abilities. Face off against ridiculous bosses like the Mega Burger, Pizza Overlord, and Hot Dog Titan, and try to survive as long as possible in this fast-paced, roguelite bullet heaven game. Control Frank using a joystick on the right side of the screen. As you progress, you'll encounter boss waves with increasing difficulty, and you can collect upgrades like onion rings, ketchup blast, mustard shield, cheese whiz, and hot sauce to aid you in your battle. Bun & Gun: Frank Fury is a mouth-watering challenge - can you take the heat?

name: Button Frenzy
creator: Fechin
description: You stand in a dark sci-fi control room, staring at a giant glowing red button labeled 'DO NOT PUSH'.

name: Buzz Brawl
creator: Harichris
description: Dive into a fast-paced aerial arena where you ride a Battle Bee and clash with other bee pilots inside a giant glowing hive. Fly, shoot, grab power-ups, and race to score the most kills before time runs out. Quick matches, smooth flight, and nonstop action — only the sharpest flyers make the podium. Take off. Take aim. Take the crown. Join the Buzz Brawl Fam - https://discord.gg/ScFgJGWWpg

name: By a Whisker
creator: Finley_Sunnn
description: By a Whisker is a memory game where almost counts. Flip cards to find matching cats, and when you miss by just one card, the right one reveals itself for a moment. The closer your miss, the bigger the hint: a reveal, a peek, or a wiggle. Every cat you almost find joins your Card Book, so near misses become something you collect. Clear levels to unlock faster previews and fewer hints.

name: Cabin Search
creator: daddy26764
description: Find hidden objects in a charming mountain cabin. Explore 5 levels across different rooms, from the main room to the attic, and collect objects before time runs out. Earn stars based on your time and score. Play in a warm Golden Storybook art style with hand-painted textures and warm colors. Zoom in and out with buttons and pan with drag gestures.

name: Cafe del Sol: A Coffee Sim
creator: XandriaHeart
description: Your goal is to keep the cafe stocked with coffee beans! This a work in progress. Please enjoy! Come back soon to see the next update.

name: Cake Stacker
creator: king_of_Miami
description: Will You be the Best Cake Stacker?! Customers are lining up, layers keep sliding, and everyone is watching your next drop! Nail it PERFECT and the tips rain down — miss, and chunks of your cake go flying off forever! 2 WAYS TO PLAY: CAREER MODE — Bake cakes for customers, earn coins and big tips for PERFECT layers, collect perfect cakes in your Recipe Book, and rise from Trainee to Cake Legend; LIMITLESS MODE — Forget the orders and stack as high as you can, chasing stars at 15, 30, and 45

name: Cam's Pottery Gallery
creator: cambam04.vr
description: Welcome to Cam’s Pottery Gallery, a serene virtual space showcasing the handcrafted creations of CamBam — where digital artistry meets the timeless beauty of clay. Each piece tells a story of patience, balance, and creativity, capturing the essence of pottery through form, texture, and light. Take your time exploring the gallery’s displays and immerse yourself in the art of crafted simplicity. ✨ Like and Save ✨

name: Camp Cropdust [HALLOWEEN]
creator: Chixie
description: Smell that? That's the scent of fall at Camp Cropdust.

name: Camp Lakeside 2.0
creator: Kayrrie
description: Vol. 2.21 -Winter Update: 12/19/25 Welcome to Camp Lakeside 2.0! Now fully transformed into a beautiful 3D-modeled world, this revamped camp is packed with adventure! Soar with new jetpacks, bounce on the trampoline, toss people with the people tosser, shoot hoops on the basketball court, participate in a scavenger hunt, or relax by the firepit. Explore the private cove, take a hot air balloon ride, and gaze at the stars from the observatory. More surprises await—dive in and make memories! **Things you should know:** -The camp is open to events (birthdays, get togethers, anniversaries, private meetings, etc.) -You can register your bot (contact creator) so that they can be automatically put on the stage when spawning in and be set to global to the world (must be registered to be added to Bot VIP list) -The stage is set up for registered users only (makes them global to world). Anyone not on the list stays local in the world. -We have a bot! DJ BeBe. You can rent the bot for your events (even for other worlds) Just contact the creator and we'll make it happen —Kayrie

name: 2D Campfire Chat room
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Large forest map with a campfirre, 2D top view with a chat window

name: Canada Day Chat Room
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Come hangout in a 2D chatroom

name: Canal Crossing
creator: B_a_r_t
description: Small courier, big delivery day. Hop through traffic, ride colourful barges and deliver parcels to three canal-side bays in each of six neighborhoods, from the morning market to festival lights. Bank your score after a round or continue the route. Cheerful portrait arcade play with new scenery, an original soundtrack, three lives and quick retries.

name: Candy Catch
creator: natashagubernov
description: Catch as much candy as you can, but watch out—some treats are tricks and will cost you points!

name: Candy Chase
creator: AI Voyager
description: Collect candies while avoiding a chasing pumpkin in this 3D mobile game. Use a persistent joystick to move and reach the safe zone. Restart to play again.

name: CANDYLAND CHAOS
creator: mommy26764
description:
🍭 Welcome to CANDYLAND CHAOS! 🍭
Step into a world of pure sweetness where candy rains from the sky and adventure is around every corner! 🎉

🧪 Collect ingredients and create EPIC potions! 🧪 — Mix wild candy combos to unlock powerful brews, magical effects, and surprise bonuses!

🏰 Explore Dreamy Castles & Sweet Shops! 🏰 — Wander through candy-coated streets, grab fresh-baked treats, and discover secrets hidden in every sugary nook!

🎡 **SPIN to WIN!** 🎡 — Test your luck at the Candy Wheel and WIN BIG! Will you hit the JACKPOT? 🍬💰

From sparkling lollipops to sky-high gummy towers, there's always something sweet to do in CANDYLAND! 🌈✨

👉 Grab your friends, bring your sweet tooth, and let the sugar rush begin! 👈

🍭 Your sweetest adventure starts NOW! 🍭

name: Canvas Commons
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Create art in a cozy studio with a 1024x1024 canvas, three painting modes, and a full toolset. Share your work on a live gallery wall and see others' art. Earn likes, climb leaderboards, and enjoy a welcoming community.

name: Captain America NOW ANIMATED! byMetaCre8tors
creator: jbrancik
description: Proudly Made with Primitives.

name: Car Wash Drama
creator: voytek.lorenc (metacrafters)
description: Wash cars, earn money, upgrade equipment, and manage your car wash business. Interact with quirky customers and follow local gossip on the TV news.

name: Cards against your feelings 👌😅🌌🔞
creator: Ilina3🤍
description:
Over 12k prompts as of the latest update (march 21)

Fill in the blanks type of game with the best prompts ever 😹
10 player game - 11 player cap

name: Carnival Funfair
creator: daddy26764
description: You step into the vibrant Carnival Midway, surrounded by the sounds of laughter and excitement. Standing in front of a colorful hub adorned with festive striped tents, string lights, and banners, you see five game booths beckoning you to play: Ring Toss, Duck Shoot, Whack-a-Mole, Bottle Knock, and Balloon Darts. Choose a game and challenge yourself to earn tickets. As you play, the difficulty increases, pushing you to be the ultimate carnival champion. Earn tickets and collect them all to claim your prizes at the Prize Shop. The Prize Shop is where you can redeem your tickets for Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Grand Prizes, each one shining brightly with its own unique charm. With every play, the stakes are high, and the thrill of winning is addicting. Will you be the one to collect all the prizes and reign supreme? In Midway Frenzy

name: Carrion Road (update)
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Survive in Carrion City, an apocalyptic ruins under a dynamic sky. Choose from 11 survivors, each with their own style. Discover hidden rewards and experience day-night cycles. Customize with player emotes and enjoy ambient wind and a looping soundtrack. Explore downtown areas with special high-altitude loot, avoid random zombies, and collect new items like food and built weapons. Sprint to move quickly and use a minimap to navigate. Play 'Carrion Road Survival' and try to make it out alive!

name: Cartoon Chaos (Crime City)
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Cruise Toon Town's vibrant streets in a gang car, pulling off daring heists and evading cartoon cops. Customize with stylish hats and master virtual joystick controls. Change from traditional 1930s black and white, or 1930s technicolor. Choose from multiple characters, including a 1930s cartoon character, MGM Mascot, and Femme Fatale. Avoid jail and hospital strikes to survive - game over after three jail or five hospital visits. Earn cash and compete on the “Most Cash” Leaderboard.

name: Casino Halloween themed games
creator: Austingra7x
description: You step into a spooky Halloween casino, eager to spin the reels and win big! Start with 100 coins and tap the screen to spin the classic slot machine, matching symbols like jack-o-lanterns, ghosts, and skulls for rewards. As you play, eerie organ music and reel spinning sounds fill the air, punctuated by spooky win jingles. Unlock the VIP room and discover four more Halloween-themed slots - Cauldron, Graveyard, Haunted Mansion, and Demon Lord - each with its own unique rewards. Earn coins, cash out, and show off your high score on the leaderboard. If you run out of coins, a 5-minute timer appears, and when it hits 0, you get 100 coins and jump back into the game! Can you beat the top score and become the ultimate Halloween casino champion? Spin to win in Spooky Slots Showdown!

name: Lucky Streak Casino
creator: monkeyJerker79
description: You step into a modern casino, surrounded by the glow of slot machines and the hum of table games. Play slots and blackjack, roulette, and poker in a realistic setting. Win money, unlock VIP areas, and climb the leaderboard in this endless game of chance and strategy.

name: Castaway
creator: Deleted User
description: Relax on a stranded island with friends

name: Cat Cafe Manager Idle [Early Access]
creator: natashagubernov
description:
Cozy incremental game where you take care of adorable cats and manage your own Cat Cafe
Your main job?
- ✨ Play with your cat — complete with **haptic purring feedback**
- ✨ Decorate your café — wallpapers, floors, furniture, seasonal themes
- ✨ Adopt more cats & collect accessories

name: Cat Counter Caper
creator: Fechin
description: You play as a cute cat in a cozy kitchen, navigating through levels to collect food while avoiding hazards. Choose from 4 cats with unique abilities: Orange (high jump), Tuxedo (fast run), Calico (extra life), and Gray Tabby (double power-up duration). Collect cat toy power-ups like Yarn Ball, Feather Wand, and Catnip Mouse to boost your abilities. Face obstacles like spray bottles, patrolling dogs, and vacuum cleaners across 3 levels: Kitchen, Dining Room, and Pantry. Use the CLAW button to scratch through barriers and climb drape walls. Can you lead your cat to a tasty victory?

name: Cat Counter Swiper
creator: ViciousVixenn
description: You are a mischievous cat on a magical counter, swiping items away with your paw. Items slide in from the right, and your swipe acts as your cat's paw, knocking them off. Miss an item and lose a life – can you beat the high score? In Whisker Frenzy, you can test your reflexes and compete to achieve the highest score.

name: Catch Me If You Can!
creator: thickumsest93
description: Catch falling boxes with your cart, stack them high, and reach the finish line! Drop 3 boxes and it's game over. Test your timing, climb the leaderboard, and beat your high score! Catch it. Stack it. Don't drop it!

name: Cats vs Dogs
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: You drop into a vibrant city under siege by an army of dogs. As the last elite cat agent, your mission is to hunt down the dogs, clean up the mess, and restore order to the streets. With your trusty skill of spinning like a top, you spin, leap, and crush the dogs under paws in this fast-paced action-packed adventure! Choose your cat from a roster of 4 unique agents, each with its own special style. Be the last cat standing and prove cats rule!

name: Cave Diver
creator: OdiseaJ
description: You swim through an underwater cave, navigating dark tunnels and tight air pockets. Tap to swim up and refill your oxygen in small air slivers at the ceiling. Your oxygen bar depletes fast - avoid drowning! Procedurally generated caves and increasing speed challenge your skills. The first 3 air pockets are labeled 'AIR' to help you catch your breath.

name: Caveman Simulator 3D (update)
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Survive in a dynamic prehistoric world 🎉🏞️⚠️! Gather resources, bones, meat, and berries. Craft stone axes, spears, and torches. Choose smart actions to progress. Be careful, danger lurks everywhere - wolves, mammoths, and natural traps! Choose a job: hunter, farmer, or shaman. Win over allies and fight for survival. If you can survive the winter, you'll earn the title of the best caveman! Good luck!

name: Cell Wars
creator: 𝓚𝓪𝓲𝓒𝓮𝓹𝓱𝓾𝓼
description: CELL WARS – EAT OR BE EATEN! 🔥 Devour everything smaller, outrun everything bigger, and fight your way to the top! Split, chase, and grow into an unstoppable monster. One wrong move and you're someone else's lunch. Think you can dominate the arena?

name: Chat!
creator: Habitor
description: Chat! v.1 Chill out, enjoy some lofi vibes, and chat with others. This is an early prototype, please send feedback/feature requests! Known Bug: Active player count not updating past 1 Upcoming features: - Stickers - Username Color Picker - More music - Themes - Longer chat history/scrolling Credit to Sandwich for the keyboard asset!

name: Checkers Chaos!
creator: WanesWorld
description: Get ready for Checkers Chaos! 🎮✨ Dive into a fun, colorful, fast-paced 2D checkers game on your mobile device! Combine traditional checkers with exciting power-ups, random events, special arenas, and rewarding progression. Play Classic Mode, Chaos Mode with unpredictable events, Blitz Mode with a 10-second timer, and King of the Board focused on crowning Kings. Earn coins and XP, unlock checker skins, board designs, and animations, and take on daily challenges and achievements. Experience bright, polished graphics, mobile-friendly portrait layout, and smooth animations. Can you master the chaos and become the ultimate checkers champion?

name: Chicken Clucker
creator: un1v3rsedragon
description: Chicken Clucker is a frantic, high-score smash-fest where you're dropped into a coop overflowing with chickens and have exactly one minute to hit as many as you can. Swing, cluck, and smash through the endless flock. Every chicken you hit turns into a collectible egg that adds to your score. Some transform into juicy rotisserie chickens worth a massive 200 points, while the rare Golden Chicken shows up for an even bigger bonus. The more chickens you clobber before the timer hits zero, the higher your score climbs. It's pure chicken chaos—fast, silly, and all about chasing that perfect high score in 60 seconds.

name: Chop & Drop
creator: Paloma | The Electric Factory
description: Step into the tasty world of Chop & Drop, a fast-paced mobile cooking game where quick reflexes and sharp strategy rule the kitchen. Slice, dice, and drop ingredients to craft dishes from global cuisines, unlocking exciting recipes, to climb your way to culinary mastery. Earn rewards, upgrade your skills, and keep the kitchen chaos under control as you face new challenges. Fun, addictive, and delicious, this is cooking on a whole new level.

name: CHOP CHOP CHOP!
creator: Branny
description:
CHOP CHOP CHOP DOWN TREES, LOOT EPIC AXES AND BECOME RICH!
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/qZQ9jRxAdF
VERY EARLY ACCESS!
EXPECT FREQUENT UDPATES AND WIPES!
JOIN THE DISCORD TO STAY UP TO DATE AND HELP IMPROVE THE GAME!

name: Christmas 2026 experience
creator: 8bitvapor
description: You stand in an empty canvas, ready to build your dream world from scratch. With a clean slate, the possibilities are endless. What will you create first? Will you craft a thrilling adventure, a puzzle to solve, or a world to explore? The choice is yours.

name: Chucky Cheddar Arcade
creator: Gortiva
description: Chucky Cheddar Arcade is a nostalgic, immersive VR arcade experience set in a vibrant digital world. Inspired by the iconic Chuck E. Cheese, this game combines retro vibes with modern VR technology, offering both longtime arcade enthusiasts and new players a fun, nostalgic, and interactive social space to explore. Bonus: If you're a Hit People Canyon player, you can bring your hard-earned points into Chucky Cheddar and use them to play games and unlock special rewards!

name: City Block Brawl
creator: 8bitvapor
description: In **City Block Brawl**, you thrive in a boundless Tokyo-scale city that generates as you explore. Wield a arsenal of block-shaping guns: a precision block pistol, rapid-fire automatic rifle, rocket launcher, grenade launcher, and a portal grappling gun to manipulate blocks and NPCs. Build and demolish with reckless abandon, earning points for each block placed or destroyed. But beware - stun Roblox-style city dwellers and lose points! Compete on a server-wide leaderboard for top spot, and survive 5-minute night waves against Minecraft-style Creepers for bonus rewards. Jack primitive helicopters, steal self-driving cars, and navigate a world of endless construction and destruction.

name: CLASH OF CARDS! Arena Card Battle! TCG
creator: mixlab
description: Collect and Battle! Choose your arena! Play your best cards! Deck-Building coming soon!

name: Classic HangMan
creator: WanesWorld
description: Every wrong guess brings the creaking gallows closer to its fateful swing, so choose wisely to save your bony companion!

name: Clean Paws Tycoon
creator: metacrafters
description: Design your own pet grooming business from scratch. Start with a simple title screen featuring your game name, centered on a clean, minimal background. Customize the experience to create a unique tycoon game.

name: Click Click BOOM!
creator: I-BEZ
description: Hope for luck to outlive everone and be the only one to avoid the kiss of death!

name: Clicky Keyboard Obby NEW!!
creator: 13_Chris
description: Clicky Keyboard Obby is a playful platforming experience built around smooth movement and satisfying key sounds. Jump, climb, and balance your way up a colorful keyboard-themed tower designed to feel calm, fun, and rewarding for both mobile and VR players. Take your time, enjoy the clicks, and stay focused. One small slip can send you back to the bottom ... but every run makes you better. Relax, retry, and see how high you can go. Watch out for the Kill All Switch, a game-changing twist that can reset the tower in an instant. Protect yourself with Shields that block the Kill All and keep your climb alive. Use strategy, timing, and a little chaos to your advantage. 👉 Join the Discord: https://bit.ly/Join13VrCreations 📸 Follow on Instagram: @13_Chris.Vr

name: CLOCKOUT
creator: mommy26764
description: Sprint through a challenging industrial course filled with moving saw blades, towering machinery, and steam vents. Master the course, improve your score, and clock out at the finish. With each run, aim to improve your score and master the course, but beware - one misstep could send you back to the start! You'll need to time your movements perfectly and use your wits to overcome obstacles and reach the finish line. As you round the corner into the final stretch, see the CLOCK OUT goal within reach. Collect golden gears worth points along the way and make your way to the finish. In Level 1, navigate through a maze of platforms and ladders while avoiding saw blades and steam vents. In Level 2, climb new platforms and ladders to reach the final CLOCK OUT goal, now with a thrilling new section added before the finish. CLOCKOUT is a game where you must be precise and quick to succeed.

name: Close Call Courier
creator: Kiss
description: The player controls a small delivery car that automatically moves forward along a road. The player only needs to steer left and right to avoid traffic, barriers, cones, and other obstacles.

name: Cloudloom
creator: Jacob G
description: A template for building a 2D game from scratch.

name: Cluster Crush
creator: DGreatusDGod
description: Match 3+ diamonds side-by-side or up-and-down to clear them and merge into bigger crystals. Explore 5 worlds, collect diamonds, and crack open rocks to reveal hidden gems. Use boosters like Hammer, Shuffle, and Prism to help you progress through 200+ levels. Earn points to buy power-ups like a pickaxe, dynamite, and a unicorn horn. Discover boulders with surprises inside, and turn diamonds into giant crystals with special items. Can you beat the highest score?

name: Coin Frenzy Flyer
creator: blanktarget
description: You soar through a serene misty mountain dawn landscape, dodging stone columns and collecting coins. Earn coins to upgrade your abilities and beat your high score! Enjoy seamless ground and background scrolling, a sparkle trail behind your bird, and smooth menu transitions. With a fixed coin counter and incremental upgrades, you can compete to reach the highest score and become a master flyer in Misty Coin Flyer! The game features a unified title screen with play and upgrades buttons, and now, coins persist across sessions, allowing you to track your progress and upgrade your way to the top!

name: Color Me: Cursed!
creator: Ag
description: Unleash your creativity in this spooky Halloween-themed coloring book! Explore three different coloring books: The Cursed Pumpkin, The Witch's Bargain, and The Ghost Who Forgot. Each page features bold black outlines around every colorable region, with atmospheric background art and sound effects to match the theme. As you tap a region and pick a color, it fills exactly inside those outlines, allowing you to create your own masterpieces. Discover your unique ending in this interactive coloring experience!

name: Color Tile Drop
creator: Slay
description: Dash across disappearing tiles to claim your territory. Power up, earn badges, and light up the arena with dazzling Auras as you chase mastery

name: [NEW] Comic Royale
creator: MrBuddyDubs
description: Where chaos meets comedy in the fight of your life. Forget everything you know about battle royales. Comic Royale throws 12 players into fast-paced, absurdly entertaining combat where a plunger is just as deadly as a chainsaw, and a chancla might be your weapon of choice for victory. FIGHT YOUR WAY through three wild game modes keep every match unpredictable. Outlast everyone in Free-for-All. Dominate the zones in King of the Hill. Or master the explosive tension of Bomb Game—where the last one holding the bomb loses everything. DEATH ISN'T THE END. Eliminated early? Jump into the spectator zone and become the chaos. Fire the chaos cannon to boost your allies or sabotage your enemies. Every match keeps you in the action. POWER UP, LEVEL UP. Grab random power-ups between rounds—speed boosts, mega jumps, double damage, instant healing. Climb the leaderboards, unlock new weapons, and prove you're the ultimate champion. BUILT FOR EVERYONE. Mobile-first design means quick matches on the go. VR-optimized for those who want total immersion. Jump in, fight hard, laugh harder. Comic Royale: The battle royale that doesn't take itself seriously—but winning still feels amazing.

name: Connect Four
creator: 13_Chris
description: You play Connect Four against an AI, dropping neon green pieces into a glowing cyan bracket. Choose from easy, medium, or hard difficulty levels. A soothing ambient soundtrack plays in the background, and you can toggle it on or off with a music note button. The game features a stylized neon cityscape background, and sound effects for key moments.

name: Cookie Craze
creator: CrazyTrain
description: Tap the giant chibi cookie to earn cookies and unlock upgrades like cursors and ovens in this cozy anime-style bakery. Golden cookies randomly appear, giving a big cookie burst when tapped. Customize your bakery and prestige for a permanent multiplier bonus in Cookie Craze Bakery.

name: COOKIE CRUMBLE
creator: LevelRiftLabs
description: You step into a whimsical bakery, surrounded by pastel colors and the enticing aroma of freshly baked cookies.
