Your goal is to create the ultimate giant cookie by dropping matching cookies into a jar, merging them into bigger treats. Watch as crumbs burst, chocolate chips bounce, and sprinkles pop with every merge. Can you reach the legendary ULTIMATE CRUMBLE? As you play, you'll unlock power-ups like Milk Drops and Rainbow Sprinkles to aid your cookie-crafting journey. The bakery comes alive with animated cupcakes, milk cartons, and gummy decorations, making every match a delightful experience. Will you master the art of cookie merging and become the ultimate Cookie Crumble champion?

name: Cookie Tapper
creator: Junyuh
description: Tap, bake, and build your cookie empire! Unlock powerful upgrades, collect magical cookie styles, and transform your cozy bakery into a celestial kingdom.

name: Cori Meadows: Lava Runner
creator: Fechin
description: Navigate through a post-apocalyptic cityscape on a solar surfer, avoiding lava and grinding on rails. Experience a thrilling ride with a short intro cutscene and challenging platforming sections. You start with a single jump, but can upgrade to a double jump to tackle wider gaps.

name: Cornhole-Tac-Toe
creator: SeeingBlue
description: Flick your 'X' bean bags with your thumb and try to win Cornhole-Tac-Toe! Stand before a rustic, stand-up Cornhole-Tac-Toe board with 9 square holes in a 3x3 grid. Hit a hole, and the bean bag goes through, claiming the cell with your mark - red for you, blue for the AI. Miss, and it bounces off with a 'MISSED!' message, ending your turn. Win rounds to earn coins, then redeem them to change the environment. Can you beat the AI and collect them all? Cornhole-Tac-Toe is the perfect blend of challenge and fun. Play Cornhole-Tac-Toe now and show off your skills!

name: Cosmic Carnival Shooters
creator: Shameless
description: Explore the Cosmic Carnival, a vibrant midway on a distant purple crater planet. Play five electrifying shooter attractions: Quick Draw Duel, Alien Gallery Shooter, Star Shooter, Balloon Pop, and Alien Figurine Shoot. Earn medals, compete for top shooter honors, and unlock pathways under the Purple Nebula Moons skybox.

name: COSMIC CHROME SLOTS (Ag World Casino)🎰 ✨
creator: Ag
description: Step into a vibrant cosmic lounge, surrounded by neon-lit slot machines under a twilight sky. Spin the reels and aim for rare symbol multipliers! Ag Beats Playlist Added! Progressive bonus Added!

name: Cosmic Pinball
creator: Pickwick
description: Blast off into a vibrant space-themed pinball adventure. Hit UFO saucers, asteroids, and targets to unlock features like multiball mode and special pop bumpers. Explore different modes, compete for high scores, and enjoy smooth 60fps physics in a low gravity environment. Discover Saturn as a jackpot hole and more, all within a vertical 9:16 portrait layout with neon blue walls. As you play, FEVER MODE triggers for extra scoring, and asteroids return on a new ball. Cosmic Launchpad offers an immersive experience with various modes and challenges. Your high score will be displayed on the game over screen and title screen for all to see in the top 3 scores. Play on a clean and redesigned title screen, launch your mission with a sleek hold-to-charge bar, and experience the thrill of space pinball in Galactic Pinball Odyssey.

name: Cosmocorp
creator: Mayank Mittal
description: CosmoCorp is your gateway to building a galactic empire; one planet at a time. Start from a lone cosmic outpost and grow into a hyper-efficient interstellar corporation as you mine rare minerals, automate production, and expand across the stars. Every new world you unlock is a living, glowing playground packed with resources, upgrades, and secrets waiting to be discovered. Whether you're optimizing your planetary economy, raiding rivals for extra loot, or simply watching your bots work while you're offline, CosmoCorp delivers a perfect blend of chill idle progression and strategic decision-making. Build smarter, expand faster, and rise through the cosmic ranks, because in the far reaches of space, only the most ambitious corporations thrive.

name: COSTUME CITY CHRISTMAS (by DRIP)
creator: TanzerVR
description: Dress up for the Holday Season in your most Festive Outfits! Costume City now has its Holiday Location!

name: COSTUME CITY (by DRIP)
creator: TanzerVR
description: All kinds of costumes for dress up, roleplay, or Halloween!

name: COSTUME CITY Part2 (by DRIP)
creator: TanzerVR
description: More Top Quality Costumes!

name: COUNTING SHEEP
creator: Shant
description: It's a peaceful night in the meadow. Your job? Help the sheep jump the fences, one leap at a time. 🌙 The fences keep coming, and the pace picks up, but the goal stays simple: keep the sheep moving. Every jump matters. How far can you go before the night catches up? 🌾🐑

name: Cover Story
creator: Fechin
description: Get ready to rock! Start as a bedroom musician and rise to stardom. Play rhythm mini-games for gigs, manage your band and gear, and make key decisions to grow your fame. Unlock new venues and phases, from garage jams to arena shows. Choose your path: Singer/Songwriter or Arena Rocket. Your ultimate goal? Land your picture on the cover of Rolling Stone! Will you make it to the top?

name: Cozy Bakery Tycoon
creator: RiccioArancio
description:
Run your dream bakery: gather ingredients, craft delicious sweets, fulfill orders, and grow your cozy dessert empire in this charming tycoon game!

A special thanks for these assets to:
Haystack by Poly by Google [CC-BY] via Poly Pizza
Hot air balloon by Poly by Google [CC-BY] via Poly Pizza
Wooden fence by Frank Lynam [CC-BY] via Poly Pizza

name: Cozy Cottage
creator: tmwheeler1
description: A cozy Cottage remix where you can add furniture, flowers, animals or plants. Make it your own and have fun.

name: Cozy Carpet Cleaning
creator: AbductM3
description: You step into a cozy cleaning world, where your mission is to scrub, wash, and rinse carpets back to their former glory. You start with a classic pizza carpet, but as you progress, you unlock exciting themes like Persian Garden, Retro Diner, Jungle Adventure, and Space Galaxy. With each carpet, you'll use four specialized tools - a power washer, scrubbing brush, squeegee, and rinse to tackle mud, stains, water films, and residue. Will you master the art of carpet cleaning and unlock them all?!

name: Cozy Sudoku
creator: PigeonNo12
description: Cozy Sudoku. Choose from Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty levels on the cozy landing screen. Enjoy cozy lo-fi background music and satisfying sound effects.

name: Vault Breaker
creator: Bambipie
description:
For everyone whose morning starts with the daily word: this one's for you.

VAULTBREAKER is a 5-letter code-cracking game with a heist twist. Guess the code before your attempts run out. Tiles flip gold when a letter locks in, amber when you're close, steel when it's dead.

Play your way, from a forgiving 7 tries down to a brutal 4, and climb the leaderboard. The DAILY HEIST serves one code a day, same for everyone, worth double points, with your streak on the line. Spend your winnings on hints, skips, and a Streak Freeze that saves your run when a code beats you.

Full stats, guess distribution, shareable result grids, and thief ranks from JUST MADE IT to MASTER THIEF. Punchy haptics, clean table, no clutter.

How long can you keep the streak alive?

name: Craft Food
creator: ANIL
description:
Welcome to Craft Food!

-How to Play:
🥕 Purchase ingredients
💭 Combine them to discover new recipes
🧇 Place your food to sell
💰 Earn profit and grow

🍔 Unlock 150+ unique recipes
🔁 Trade low-value food for better ingredients

-👍 Enjoy the game and join the community!

name: CRAFTED
creator: Greasy.Gaming
description: due to strange background builds and .doc files recording crafted is now starting over from scratch. changing everything so it will work properly again and hopefully resetting the links that continued to cause issues for the games development. good thing I know how to build it and make things work. hopefully this makes everyone have to start from scratch that took pieces and mechanics from the game I taught the AI to generate.

name: CreativBeats Mobile Beatmaker Plus
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: the first music maker on Horizon Wolds!!

name: Cringe Face Match Maker
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: Create outrageous faces by dragging eyes, eyebrows, lips, and other facial features. Resize features to earn Aura points and match target expressions to score higher. Unlock new facial features and characters as you progress.

name: Crumbly Delights
creator: AndrewMoney10
description: You navigate a charming picnic scene, guiding ants to ingredients and back to the oven to craft delicious treats within a ticking clock.

name: Crystal Rush
creator: sir.sandman
description: Fly through a dark crystal cave that pulses to the music. Swipe to throw balls like in Pokemon GO, and smash the glass walls and crystal clusters in your path. Hit a pane off-centre and it cracks and falls apart from that side. Smash several crystals with one ball to build a chain for bonus points. Gold crystals give you a shield. If you leave crystal in your way, you crash into it and lose one of your five lives. Every 30 seconds the cave speeds up and the walls get fuller. How far can you go?

name: Cup Clash
creator: 13_Chris
description: You stand in a vibrant backyard, string lights twinkling above. The air is filled with the sound of laughter and music. You're about to play a thrilling cup toss game against the computer. Drag to aim, release for power, and try to clear all 10 of your opponent's cups before they clear yours. With realistic physics, colorful graphics, and a lively party atmosphere, you'll be on the edge of your seat. Choose from three difficulty levels: Casual, Skilled, and Sharp Shooter. If you miss, watch as the ball ricochets off the cup in a flash. Can you outthrow your opponent and claim victory? Dive into Crimson Cup Showdown and find out!

name: Cutting Ties
creator: creativeCharm
description: In Cutting Ties, you're tasked with severing specific connections in a network of people without causing chaos. Swipe to cut red ropes near the knots, repair mistakes with glue, and win by cutting required ties without wrong people falling. Each level introduces new challenges, from simple pairs to complex networks. Can you master the art of strategic relationship decisions in these 7 levels?

name: CYBER DASH
creator: JordanB0101
description: Sprint through a neon-drenched cyberpunk city, dodging laser beams and electric barriers while collecting energy cores. Your speed and agility are put to the test as you navigate through increasingly challenging levels. Earn points based on your speed and combos, and compete with other players on the leaderboard to see who can achieve the highest score and collect the most cores in CYBER DASH. The game now features a new main menu hero image, with your character as a dark silhouette outlined in.

name: Dam Busters
creator: Scott (Trashbyrd)
description: Dam Busters is a simple 2D side-scroller inspired by Sopwith where you shoot and bomb enemies and fuel tanks. Destroy the dam and fly off into the sunset!

name: Dash
creator: seemebro
description: Play as a chibi football character in a fast-paced vertical football runner. Swipe left and right to dodge defenders, collect coins, and score points. Earn rewards for distance traveled, dodges, and touchdowns. Customize your character with virtual coins and climb the leaderboards in this vibrant anime/chibi art style game.

name: Dead Draw Survival
creator: MetaNewby
description: DEAD DRAW SURVIVAL 🃏💀 Draw. Survive. Outplay. Think you can survive the deck? Enter the table, build your hand, play your cards, and manipulate the deck to keep yourself alive. But every draw could be your last! 🤖 BOTS FILL EMPTY SEATS — No waiting for a full lobby. Jump straight into the action. 🎉 PLAY YOUR CARDS — Peek, shuffle, steal, skip, force opponents to draw, and more. 💀 AVOID THE DEAD CARD — Draw it without protection and you're eliminated. 🛡️ USE STRATEGY — Luck matters, but knowing when to play your cards can make the difference between surviving and getting eliminated. 🏆 BE THE LAST ONE STANDING — Outlast everyone at the table and claim the victory. 📈 CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD — Track your wins, eliminations, survival time, and more. Every draw is a decision. Every card could change the game.

name: Dead Hamster ☠️
creator: xX_Jazzie_Xx
description: Keep your baby hamsters alive! Collect food, avoid traps, keep them safe. Watch out for Spiders and Mouse Traps! 🕷️ Gather items to TOP the Leaderboard ✨🏆 More updates coming!

name: Deep Fried Defense
creator: 8bitvapor
description: A tower defense game protect a bucket of chicken against pests, collect coins shop for better weapons

name: Deep Sea Dash
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: You dash through a vibrant ocean reef as a clownfish, weaving past coral columns and swaying seaweed. A three-layer parallax environment shimmers in shades of aquamarine and coral as you speed along. Track your distance in real-time on a HUD panel and enjoy bubble animations, an upbeat soundtrack, and satisfying tap effects. Customize your experience in this lively underwater world, compete in a local leaderboard to beat your friends' scores, and explore the reef's varied zones, now teeming with animated seaweed and ambient sea creatures.

name: Deep Sea Sort
creator: JoyReign
description: Sort falling sea creatures into their homes while avoiding a hungry predator fish! Earn points, level up, and compete for the top score on the global leaderboard. Customize your username and see how you rank against other players. Watch out for the Barracuda Hunt - it gets faster and more frequent as you progress! Hit levels, collect points, and survive to beat your high score!

name: Delivery Dash
creator: Chinnaaa.2023
description: Deliver spooky pizzas, monster burgers, and pumpkin cupcakes through a vibrant purple twilight town filled with glowing jack-o-lanterns, orange autumn trees, and friendly ghost decorations. Ride a red scooter, follow the yellow dotted route, and deliver orders before freshness expires. Earn coins, unlock garage upgrades, and customize your scooter with cosmetic colors as you progress through 15 campaign levels across three neighborhoods: Pumpkin Lane, Moonlit Downtown, and Ghostlight Waterfront. Then, unlock Endless Mode for 3-minute rounds with rising quotas and traffic.

name: Descent Masters
creator: WanesWorld
description: You materialize on a mysterious platform high above the underground, 100 floors down. Your goal is clear: descend floor by floor, dodging deadly traps and collecting coins. Each floor presents a new challenge - dodge lasers, escape rising lava, outrun falling objects, or defeat enemies. As you progress, challenges intensify and stakes grow higher. Will you make it to the bottom alive? In Descent Masters, navigate treacherous floors, upgrade your skills, and compete to reach the deepest floor. Every run is unique, with randomized floors and modifiers that keep the game exciting and unpredictable.

name: Desert Zombie Shooter
creator: Briandoesit
description: Blast zombies in a frantic 2D shooter! Tap to shoot, earn coins, and upgrade your arsenal to survive the undead onslaught across 5 levels. Face various zombie types and navigate daily challenges. Compete for the top score and show off your skills on our persistent leaderboard.

name: Diamond Pop Mania
creator: Blacqdiamone
description: You dive into Diamond Pop Mania, and the game loads up in front of you. You see the vibrant landscape layout and hear the sound effects suite come to life. Your goal is to match gems to score big! Swipe to swap adjacent gems, creating combinations of three or more to score points and unlock rewards. The round lasts 5 minutes, and your goal is to rack up the highest score possible. Match four gems to create a bomb that explodes after 1 second, clearing surrounding gems. Make a match-3 in the center zone to get a Lightning Diamond, which clears an entire row and column for a massive score boost. You can compete against AI opponents in Diamond Battle mode or challenge friends in multiplayer. Earn rewards and collect items in the Prize Shop with 18 collectible items across 2 pages. You can also claim your daily Diamond Coin bonus of 25 free coins, available once per day. As you play, you'll encounter 5-tier combo messages from 'Nice!' to 'DIAMOND GOD!!' The game features 40 Adventure Mode levels with escalating score targets and sequential unlocks. Diamond Pop Mania is fully loaded with 6 gem types, including Bomb, Rainbow, Striped, and Lightning Diamond specials, and a full SFX suite with a mute toggle.

name: Dice & Deeds
creator: daddy26764
description: Buy property, Build hotels and beat the bot.

name: DICE 10,000 mobile
creator: mommy26764
description: Compete in a thrilling dice game of skill and chance! Roll dice, select scoring combinations, and outsmart your opponent to reach 10,000 points first. Master the rules with an animated tutorial and claim the top spot on the leaderboard. Will you emerge victorious? In this game, you roll dice and try to score points by forming certain combinations. The game features a realistic adult opponent, a casino environment, and a leaderboard to track your progress.

name: Diner Rush
creator: Cyklone
description: Run a bustling burger joint in 3D! Master the stacking mechanic, unlock upgrades, and hire help to meet daily goals. Explore the vibrant diner, complete orders, and collect cash to progress through the days. Can you keep up with the demand? The diner features a night sky with half moon and light clouds, and you can customize your experience with various upgrades and staff hires.

name: Dolphin Cannon
creator: mfStarboy_
description: Shoot a dolphin from cannon to cannon until you reach the green hoop!

name: Domino Forest
creator: Bambipie
description: In Domino Forest, you match tiles to reveal a magical forest, progressing through levels and unlocking new areas. Earn coins, compete on the leaderboard, and take on a daily challenge. As you advance, the forest transforms with you - from enchanted nights to vibrant cherry blossom springs. Collect coins, unlock new levels, and showcase your progress in the gallery. Can you become the ultimate Domino Forest master? Domino Forest is a game where you match tiles to clear a pile, revealing a beautiful illustrated forest as you progress through levels.

name: Don't Touch Red
creator: WanesWorld
description: Survive in a vibrant arena where tiles turn deadly red and disappear! Earn coins, track your streak, and outrun danger. Simple controls, frantic gameplay. Rounds become progressively faster and more chaotic.

name: Don't Wake My Pet: Draw the Symbols
creator: Mikolaj
description: You are your pet’s Sleep Guardian - draw the symbols you see on crawling spiders to send them away and keep your pet asleep. It’s simple and relaxing: ✏️ Draw symbols with your finger to repel spiders 🐾 Protect your sleeping pet in gentle, dreamy worlds 💖 Unlock adorable pets and collect PetCoins 🗺️ Explore multiple themed maps with unique vibes 🏆 Compete on leaderboards and complete daily quests 🤍 Play solo or in cozy 2-player co-op Cute on the outside. Addictive at heart. How long can you keep the dream alive? 💤

name: Don't Wake the Witch
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: You scurry through a witch's house, avoiding waking her from sleep. Choose from a goblin or mouse, and navigate four themed rooms to collect ingredients for a recipe. Every action makes a noise, filling the Noise Meter. Keep it below 100 to succeed! The witch's house has a fixed layout, but ingredients shuffle each run. Your goal is to collect a specific recipe's ingredients without waking the witch. If you fail, the witch's comedic reaction will play out. Sneak Witch House is a stealthy, funny, and highly replayable game of strategy and skill.

name: Dont Wake Mom 🛏️
creator: WanesWorld
description: You sneak through a cozy house at night, completing wacky missions like stealing cookies or rescuing the dog without waking Mom. Earn allowance, unlock equipment, and prank your sibling in this chaotic stealth-comedy game. Can you outsmart Mom and make it back to bed without getting caught? Explore a house with six side-by-side rooms, from the Kids' Bedroom to the Parents' Bedroom. Complete randomized missions and manage your Wake Meter to stay stealthy. Collect toys, costumes, and decorations to customize your experience in Dont Wake Mom.

name: Donut Chomper
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Collect pink donuts avoid the black and green ones

name: DonutZo 🍩
creator: xX_Jazzie_Xx
description: Catch the flying donuts, dodge the veggies -- How long can you keep your alien fed?

name: Don’t Drop!
creator: AceTheBass
description: Tap balls to keep them alive and score points! A fast-paced arcade game where you must tap falling balls to bounce them up and earn points. If a ball hits the bottom, it's out. Can you beat your high score?

name: Dot Dash
creator: ComicSean
description: Play in a charming papercraft world, drawing lines through numbered dots in a grid. Fill every cell in ascending order to progress. The grid grows and dots increase as you beat levels. Compete for the highest level reached on the Best Level leaderboard. A How to Play screen guides you through the rules. You can return to the title screen at any time, ending your streak. The game saves your highest level reached immediately when you complete a level or exit to the menu. Enjoy a whimsical soundtrack and sound effects, with a papercraft-themed UI.

name: Dr Meta
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Get rid of the germs by matching 3 color pills to match the germ

name: Dragon Bingo
creator: un1v3rsedragon
description: Play Dragon Bingo in Daily Challenges, or duel rivals in Speed Run, Corner Crusher, and more! Tap numbers as they're called, mark them with a fiery explosion, and complete lines to summon a majestic dragon. Choose from power-ups like Flame Breath, Wing Gust, Scale Shield, and play in Standard or Inferno mode. Earn XP, rank up your dragon, and compete against Frostwing, Thunderjaw, or Aurelion. Unlock new dragons and customize your bingo card with daily challenges and rewards.

name: Draw Bridge
creator: 13_Chris
description: Drag your finger to draw awesome bridges and race across crazy gaps! Can you beat each fun puzzle and make it to the finish? More exciting levels are coming soon! 👉 Join the community: https://bit.ly/Join13VrCreations

name: Draw This (Pictionary)
creator: Ilina3🤍
description: Play Pictionary with friends

name: drawBattle
creator: hyperjoule
description:
drawBattle 👽 is a fun-filled VR and Mobile cross-play experience where crayons are your weapons and creativity is your edge! Sketch, doodle, and compete for artistic glory! Quick, fun, and packed with cosmic charm—can your art outshine the rest?

2024 MHCP Competition submission

Scripting: hyperjoule
Art and Design: Purple Wren

name: Dream Delivery
creator: SpaceGlitterUnicorn
description: When night falls, the villagers drift into sleep and they rely on you to help guide their dreams. Visit each window to discover the dream they’re hoping to experience, then soar into the starlit sky to gather shimmering dream dust drifting above the town. Combine the dust to craft radiant dream orbs, and deliver them to the sleepers to unveil the heartfelt stories unfolding in their minds. As you complete dream deliveries, you’ll earn enchanted XP that boosts your flying and jumping abilities, and collect stars that can be spent on customizing your avatar with clothing, and new wings.

name: Drift Runner
creator: izukingz
description: Drift Runner is an exciting car game where you drive along elevated tracks, master sharp turns, and drift to travel as far as possible. Stay on the track, beat your distance records, and become the ultimate drift master!

name: Duck Attack!
creator: metacrafters
description: You navigate a maze as a small hatching duck egg, outrunning a terrifying evil duck on tank treads. The duck rocks side to side, speeding up when it lunges. Can you escape alive? You have 3 hearts to keep you alive. Your goal is to survive as many floors as possible. A floor counter appears in the HUD while playing, and your best score is tracked and displayed on the game over screen. You must move fast as a countdown timer adds tension – each floor has a time limit. If you don't reach the exit in time, the duck gets a big speed boost. The egg now has a solid white, smaller appearance. The HUD shows just the 3 heart icons in a simple rounded dark background. The game now shows a floor number and best score display. A countdown timer per floor adds extra pressure, with a warning quack and a speed boost for the duck when time runs out. You can grab batteries hidden in the maze for a short speed boost to escape the duck. The batteries give you a 2.2x speed boost for 2 seconds.

name: Dueling Banjos
creator: Fechin
description:
You play as an Appalachian hillbilly, launching rotten fruit at an AI-controlled rival in a turn-based artillery battle. Choose your angle and power level, then let the good times roll! You’ll face off in a scenic rural setting, with 3 screens and 6 audio assets adding to the fun. Can you emerge victorious, or will your opponent splatter you with a juicy tomato?

Now featuring local multi-player support.

name: Dungeon Quest
creator: JERZEMAN
description: You stand at the edge of a vast, vibrant overworld, teeming with secrets and hidden dangers. Explore diverse regions like the grassy plains, dark forest, desert ruins, snowy peaks, and cliffside coast. Discover hidden secrets, such as bombable caves, fake trees, and underground passages. As you journey through the overworld, stumble upon a quaint starting village, where locals whisper hints of ancient treasures and hidden paths. The village is home to various NPCs with side quests, including Elder Bramble, Farmer Mila, Blacksmith Gordo, Witch Sylvara, and Lost Child Pip. Completing their quests rewards you with valuable items like the Ancient Map, Seed Pouch, sword upgrades, Magic Potion, and Lucky Charm. Venture into seven dungeons with multiple rooms and fearsome bosses. Master a variety of weapons, including the hookshot, ice rod, fire gauntlet, thunder rod, and shadow mirror. Unlock new abilities and face off against formidable foes in an epic adventure in Secret Quest Realms.

name: Dungeon Delvers
creator: gausroth
description: Dungeon Delvers is a multiplayer action platformer where web and mobile fighters battle undead up close while VR archers strike from afar. Compete in PvPvE and climb the leaderboards to prove your skill.

name: DUNGEON DWELLER
creator: LevelRiftLabs
description:
Explore dangerous dungeons filled with deadly enemies, hidden secrets, and valuable loot. Battle terrifying creatures, collect treasure, and grow stronger as you venture deeper into the darkness.

How far can you make it before the dungeon claims you?

name: Dungeon Explorer
creator: Jacob G
description: Explore ancient dungeons, survive traps and puzzles, and uncover secrets. Navigate four distinct layers: Antechamber, Flooded Halls, Forge, and Arcane Sanctum. Atmospheric 3D adventure.

name: Earthbound | Cosmic Tropical Beach, Floating Island Update
creator: RexRod
description: A serene cosmic beach, with distance galaxy and earthly worlds. Relax and take in the scenery with friends. Find the hidden floating island!

name: Eat these marbles
creator: hyperjoule
description: I am just trying to see if this will publish

name: Echoes of the Novanthe
creator: jimrif
description:
A shared voyage told through the crew’s social feed — where every scroll from every player brings the Novanthe closer to its next mission.

---

Echoes of the Novanthe is a narrative-driven sci-fi experience set aboard the deep-space vessel “The Novanthe.”

Explore the story through the ship’s internal social feed, where crew members share posts, reflections, and fragments of life between the stars. Interact with Nyra, the ship’s computer and AI — an integral part of the Novanthe, insightful and deeply knowledgeable about the vastness of space.

But this voyage isn’t experienced alone. Every scroll from every player across the world contributes to a shared total — a single heartbeat that drives the Novanthe’s progress. As global scrolls accumulate, new missions unlock for everyone aboard, driving the story forward.

name: ECHOES PLAZA
creator: jimpuddin
description: shop

name: EdgeBreak: Tactics
creator: Runtime_Renegade
description:
In the dark of night, a 5x5 grid arena beckons. Unlock new cards as you crush campaign levels, then put your skills to the test in live 1v1 multiplayer battles. Master the art of outmaneuvering your opponents and claim victory. Will you rise to the top and become the ultimate champion?

Inspired by FFVIII Triple Triad Card Game

name: Egg Dash Ranch
creator: WanesWorld
description: You manage a ranch where pets lay eggs. Sneak past playful chasers, grab eggs, and sprint them home. Train on the treadmill to run faster. Hatch eggs to grow your pet collection and expand your ranch. Sell duplicates for coins to upgrade. Compete for the rarest pets and eggs.

name: Element Bubble Battle
creator: emorgul
description: Epic elemental combat goes mobile! Pop earth, water, fire, and air orbs to unleash awesome element attacks against your opponents. (Credits: Artwork by Julz Creative. Programming by Ink Overflow. Production by HabitXr)

name: Elimination Arena
creator: daniccacity
description: In Darkout, you compete in a deadly elimination game set in a ruined post-apocalyptic city consumed by an evil alternate dimension. Gather in a lobby with up to three other players or AI-controlled bots, then enter the central arena surrounded by collapsed skyscrapers and burning buildings. A random selection wheel chooses an attacker, who picks a target and a fatality card. The target must then dodge the attack by selecting a safe direction. If the attack hits, the target is eliminated and moved to a spectator area. The last player standing wins. You can spectate ongoing rounds and rejoin as an active contestant when the next round begins. The game features a dark, ominous atmosphere with stylized horror elements, and a simple yet engaging gameplay mechanic.

name: Emu Frenzy
creator: 8bitvapor
description: You sprint across the sun-baked Australian outback as a chunky, blue-scarf chibi emu, dodging rocks and tumbleweeds on a winding pseudo-3D road. Steer with a virtual joystick on the left, feeling the rush as your speed climbs and the landscape blurs by. Can you outrun the competition and become the ultimate champion in Blue Scarf Runner?

name: Erik's Par for Glory
creator: Yoda G.
description: You play a realistic golf game with a campaign mode. Tap and drag to aim, adjust power, and watch your ball fly through the air. Navigate 18 holes with unique challenges, obstacles like trees and water hazards, and earn rewards like different golf ball designs and club styles. Master obstacles, unlock new courses, and find your rhythm.

name: Escape Boarding School - Mike's Escape Room
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: 🏫 Escape Boarding School. Can you outsmart your teachers and escape the school? What the game includes: - Multiple Puzzles - A lively School Atmosphere - A fun story with a classic escape room experience Find the keys, find the locks, clear the puzzles, escape the school! 🗝️⏰🎲 Could you escape the school? Our group (Mike's Escape Rooms) will always add updates along the way, we take any feedback from the players! This game was developed by: Michael Gregory II.

name: Escape From Alcatraz (Obby Run)
creator: zubin
description: "Escape From Alcatraz" is a fast-paced, stealth puzzle game set in a stylized prison. Gather in a social cell block and initiate escape runs through various paths.

name: Escape From Hollowstone!
creator: TheRealMadCat😺
description: Explore Hollowstone, a ravaged landscape with a towering castle. Gather resources like flint, mushrooms, gold, wood, berries and bones and fortify perimeter fences to build a safe refuge. Befriend a wolf companion and collect materials to build defences. As night falls, the King's Ghost Knights patrol the castle, goblin minions, wolves & a dragon guard its treasure. Your goal is clear: gather allies, craft weapons, raid the castle, defeat the King, then escape on the magical Karva boat!

name: Escape Home Alone - Mike's Escape Room
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: "Escape Home Alone" brings you into an environment where you need to escape out of the house before the intruder comes for you. Follow the chore list and try to get out. And whatever you do, don't let the lights turn off. Or he'll come for you. Interested in joining VR Escape Rooms Discord group? Look us up on discord search "VR Escape Rooms" OR Follow the link below: http://bit.ly/vrescaperooms

name: Escape Manor of the Undead - Mike's Escape Room
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Step into the fog-drenched ruins of Blackthorn Manor, where echoes of a once-great family still linger — and so do their mistakes. When a mysterious radio signal promises a cure for the undead plague, you and your team of survivors venture to the outskirts of Raven Hollow. The manor gates creak open, and the whispers begin. But beware — the undead are not the only things restless here. The serum that could end death may also end humanity. In the final test, you must choose: will you cleanse the curse and destroy the manor, or evolve and inherit its power? Every decision matters. Every puzzle uncovers another truth. And every shadow still remembers you.

name: Escape The Pizzeria (pizza) 🍕- Mike's Escape Room
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: In "Escape Pietro's Pizzeria," players step into the shoes of the pizzeria's manager, embarking on a chilling quest to uncover the fate of five missing employees. Amidst the task of escaping the eerie confines of the pizzeria, they must navigate a series of puzzles and clues that hint at a sinister turn of events. The investigation takes a darker twist with the presence of Jack, the pizzeria's new mascot, whose bizarre and unsettling behavior suggests he may be more than just a creepy figurehead. As players delve deeper into the mystery, they must tread carefully, for Jack's unpredictable nature could mean he's behind the disappearances, posing a potential threat to anyone who dares to uncover the truth. Will you solve the puzzle of the missing employees, or will you become the next piece in Jack's disturbing game? Need help in an Escape Room or stay updated on future Escape Rooms? Look us up on discord search "VR Escape Rooms" OR Follow the link below: http://bit.ly/vrescaperooms Follow me on Instagram: michaelgregoryii.vr | vrescaperoomgames

name: Escape Portals: Pocket Escape Rooms
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Escape Portals is a sci-fi puzzle adventure. Think. Reflect. Connect. Escape. Navigate 40 levels across 6 chapters, solving laser, mirror, and portal puzzles. Collect rewards, unlock cosmetics, and compete on leaderboards.

name: Escape Room Remix
creator: 13_Chris
description: Escape Room Remix A fully remixable escape room template designed for creators of all skill levels. Drop in ready-to-use puzzles like riddles, color sequences, and item collection panels—each customizable through properties with no scripting required. Build your own immersive challenges by swapping textures, clues, items, or win behaviors. Whether you want a quick plug-and-play experience or a foundation to expand into a full escape adventure, this world makes creation fast, fun, and intuitive. Perfect for VR, mobile, and desktop players alike.

name: Escape Salem Witch Trials - Mike's Escape Rooms
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: "Escape the Salem Witch Trials" is an immersive escape room experience set in the late 1600s during the height of the infamous Salem witch trials. Players must navigate a series of historically-inspired puzzles and challenges to prove their innocence and escape from the town of Salem within an hour.

name: Escape School OBBY
creator: Meta.Jesus [illuminated]
description: 🎒🏫 Escape School! 🏫🎒 The bell rang… but you’re still trapped in school! 😱 Run, jump, and climb through a crazy obby full of obstacles as you try to escape classrooms, hallways, and dangerous traps! Watch your step or you might fall! 😵 ✅ Hit checkpoints to save your progress ⚠️ Avoid tricky jumps and obstacles ⏱️ Race to finish as fast as you can At the end, you’ll get a Report Card 📋 based on your time and total deaths. Will you earn an A+ escape 🎓, or fail the class? 😈 👉 Play again to beat your best score!

name: Escape Shift: Pocket Escape Rooms
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Explore mysterious dungeons, solve puzzles, and overcome obstacles to reach the exit. Customize your character from four unique classes, each with polished sprites. Navigate through levels, earn stars for completing levels with precision and speed, and unlock new challenges. Discover hidden relics and master the art of shifting and walking. With a richly detailed world, environmental props, improved visuals, and enhanced movement feedback, get ready to explore and conquer!

name: Escape the Grid
creator: kory2000pr
description: You sprint down a dimly lit prison corridor, the walls blurring past in a gritty anime style. Your goal is simple: run, dodge, and survive. A virtual joystick guides your feet left and right, while a tap of the jump button sends you soaring over guards and electric fences. With double-jump at your disposal, you can clear taller obstacles or chain over gaps. Collect keys for bonus points as the corridor speeds up and obstacles close in. With only three lives, every leap and dodge counts.

name: Escape the Last Harvest - Mike's Escape Room
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: The harvest moon rises… and so does he. In Escape the Last Harvest, you and your friends awaken in a cursed cornfield where an ancient scarecrow hunts those who disturb the final harvest. As night falls, you must scavenge for tools, solve eerie farmstead puzzles, and survive the scarecrow’s relentless pursuit. Each night grows deadlier. Each escape, shorter. The fields shift, the relics move, and the curse deepens. Can you complete the ritual before dawn — or will you become part of the scarecrow’s next harvest? Face your fears, light your lanterns, and don’t look back. The last harvest has begun.

name: Escape the Orphanage - Mike's Escape Room
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: You and your team are paranormal investigators sent to verify rumors of supernatural activity at the abandoned Whitlock Orphanage Center, a facility shut down in the 1920s after a tragic boiler incident. The orphanage has been off-limits for decades, but unexplained lights, sounds, and disappearances of trespassers have drawn national attention—and you’ve been sent to uncover the truth. When the doors seal behind you, your investigation becomes more than a ghost hunt—it becomes a desperate search to survive the night and uncover what really happened to the lost children of Whitlock.

name: Escape the Phantom's Last Hour - Mike's Escape Room
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: A Sherlock Holmes–inspired Victorian mystery escape experience. Step into the fog-drenched world of Novera Manor, where time stands still and secrets refuse to stay buried. In Escape the Phantom's Hour, you and your team of detectives are summoned to investigate a decades-old disappearance that shattered a once-powerful family. But the closer you get to the truth, the more the manor itself seems to resist you. Uncover telegrams, decode timelines, and navigate through ritual chambers, haunted studies, and hidden vaults as you unravel the mystery of Julian Novera — the vanished heir whose final message warns of a ticking clock... and a phantom hour yet to come. Will you expose the lies of haunts this Manor, confront the truth behind the Hollow Order, and stop the Phantom before the hour strikes again?

name: Escape Tiles: Pocket Escape Rooms
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: You find yourself standing in a creepy, abandoned manor, surrounded by eerie silence. As you round the corner, a glint of gold catches your eye – a key hidden behind a tattered curtain. Unlock secrets by collecting keys, navigating floor switches, and overcoming one-way doors. Earn gold badges for quick completions and compete in survival mode with a burning candle timer. Compare your slide counts and strive to be the best.

name: Escape Turkey Heist [ Mobile ]- Mike's Escape Room
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Step into the daring world of Escape Turkey Heist, where you and your team must infiltrate the notorious Bandit's Bank to reclaim the stolen Thanksgiving turkey! The Turkey Thieves have hidden the prized bird deep within their high-security bank, protected by cunning puzzles, locked doors, and tricky traps. Your mission is to outsmart the bandits, solve Thanksgiving-themed challenges, and retrieve the turkey before the holiday feast is ruined. From cracking the color-coded vaults to uncovering secrets in the break room and lounge, every room presents a new challenge that brings you closer to saving Thanksgiving. Do you have what it takes to break in, solve the puzzles, and escape with the turkey in time? The clock is ticking—let the heist begin!

name: Eureka Academy Volume 1
creator: MistaWavy
description: You're Aiden Lazarus. The Leader of The Unified Unit. You're task it to recruit you're units through floor levels and defeat the boss at the end of it.

name: Everyone's Fruit Mountain
creator: bangsang_savan
description: Big merges, bigger scores—chase combos and feel the rush. Step into a colorful 3D orchard where fruits fly, bump, and grow. Toss a fruit toward its match—when they meet, they merge into something bigger and even more satisfying. Keep going and you might just see the biggest fruit of all: the watermelon! Play with up to three friends or new players, taking turns to create fun chains and exciting combos. The bigger the fruit you merge, the more points you'll collect. Just be careful—if a fruit bounces out of the bowl, it's time to start fresh!

name: Exercise Your Demons! - Infernal Gym
creator: SOL
description: The Infernal Gym is your first step into Exercise Your Demons! Feel the fire, meet the madness, and get ready to sweat your soul clean. If you enjoy the world, check out Exercise Your Demons! on the Horizon Store for the full experience.

name: EZ Flip Obby (FREE T-SHIRT)
creator: imdoldoli
description: 🌠🌠Complete 20 levels of fun obstacles!!🌠🌠 Update: New free FlipObby T-Shirt as a reward for completing the obby! Don't forget to claim them before you exit the Worlds Get Exclusive FlipObby items!! 🌀 Press Jump key and see what happens! 🌀 Do a speed run and Top the Leaderboards!

name: Fall Brew
creator: creativeCharm
description: Manage a cozy autumn café, serving coffee and food to happy customers. Unlock new recipes, upgrade equipment, and grow your business across 50 levels. Compete for high scores and leaderboard rankings.

name: Fall Brew Cafe
creator: Chinnaaa.2023
description: Manage a busy cafe, serving customers and making drinks in a fun 2D game with a Flat Cartoon style. Create drinks, serve customers, and keep the cafe running smoothly. Compete for high scores and challenge friends. Customize your cafe and grow your business.

name: Fall Down Stairs Simulator: Great Meme Reset
creator: emorgul
description: Fall down stairs for money. Reclaim classic memes to save the Internet.

name: Falling Cubes
creator: HISOKAN
description: Falling Cubes is a fast-paced mobile game where you guide a cube in free fall, dodge obstacles, collect coins, unlock new cubes, and compete with players worldwide. Features: Control the cube by dragging your finger across the screen 🎮 Avoid walls, traps, and moving obstacles ⚡ Collect coins during your run 💰 Unlock cubes with a fun gacha system 🎁 View all unlocked cubes in your gallery 🖼️ Compete on global leaderboards 🏆 Enjoy smooth mobile controls and dynamic gameplay 📱

name: Fantasy Garden
creator: GausRoth
description:
Grow a little patch of dirt into a thriving garden in a cozy medieval fantasy world!

Pick a seed from your tray, tap a square to plant it, and water it to help it grow. Every watering moves your plant to its next stage, from seed to sprout to mature, until it's ripe and ready to harvest for gold. Each plant grows at its own pace, so plan your garden and keep that watering can busy.

But watch out: hungry bugs crawl in from the grass looking for a snack! The bigger your garden gets, the more pests show up. Tap bugs to squash them before they nibble your crops. If a plant takes too much damage, repair it quickly or it will wither away.

Spend your harvest gold to grow your garden. Unlock new seeds with seed packets, each with bigger rewards and longer growing times. Upgrade your Watering Can to water several plants with one tap, and upgrade your Hoe to harvest, repair, and clear plants across a wider area. When the bugs get out of hand, buy lawn sprays to slow them down, hurt them, or stop them for a short time.

Your garden is saved, so watered plants keep growing while you're away. Come back to collect your harvest!

Climb the leaderboard by earning the most gold of all time. Can you grow the greatest garden in the land?

name: Farm Inc.
creator: ERIC
description:
🌱Howdy! Welcome to Farm Inc.🌱

🪴 Plant seeds and watch them grow!
🏗️ Upgrade your buildings!
⛰️ Explore the environment!
🪑 Hang you with your friends!

Join your friends in a beautiful golden hour valley and farm to your hearts content! We've got over 15+ plants for you to progress towards.

And don't worry you can come back any time because your crops grow offline 🌾

name: Farmers Market Frenzy
creator: metaversepaige
description: Explore the vibrant Minneapolis Farmers Market! Meet 5 Hmong vendors and Zoe, the local artisan soap maker. Find items on your shopping list, browse stalls up close, and buy fresh produce before time runs out. Enjoy personalized greetings, interactive shopping, and a lively market atmosphere. Walk up to each vendor and tap their stall for a close-up view, then add items to your basket. The market is set under a corrugated metal canopy with a concrete floor and Minneapolis skyline in the background.

name: Farming [Halloween Event!]
creator: GameDevBear
description: See who can fill their pumpkin with the most candy! Earn another permenant trophy for your farm!

name: Farmstead Island: Grow Together
creator: MetaJorgen
description:
Nov 13 Update!
Levels now provide bonus upon return!
More music!
Grow crops, raise animals, and work with friends to build your perfect island farm! We're taking the best of cozy, casual harvesting games and making it even better with upcoming updates!
🌾 6 different levels of crops
🐓 4 different farm animals to raise.
👩‍🌾 1-4 farmers, play in mobile and VR.
🌳 Expand your farm!
💰 How much profit can YOU make in your play session?
Gameplay tips:
+ Make sure crops are watered at all times or plants will not grow.
+ Sell your harvest at the market.
+ Explore the map and look for new plots.
+ Can you reach the top of the leaderboard?
+ Press F to open inventory if you play in browser.
+ https://discord.gg/WEFpp3QCUr

name: Fashion Atlas - Wear Your Country
creator: fakemovement
description:
Explore fashion from 25 countries where Meta Horizon is available in an immersive cultural shopping experience. Each country booth is designed as a mini-museum celebrating its unique style and heritage.

Shop, Learn & Show Off:
Browse over 100 authentic avatar items across all countries, try them on in dedicated dressing rooms, and showcase your style on the central runway. New countries unlock monthly, keeping the world fresh and expanding.

With the 100 items, you get over 15,000 possible combination!

Compete & Connect:
Test your geography knowledge with interactive quiz games covering maps, flags, and city photos. Climb the leaderboards, capture your best looks in the photo booth, and vote on which country gets added next.

This isn't just dress-up, it's cultural education meets social fashion competition. Players learn about global cultures while expressing themselves, creating a meaningful experience that celebrates diversity and style. Whether you're collecting pieces from every continent or mastering geography challenges, Fashion Atlas makes fashion discovery fun, competitive, and endlessly replayable.

Navigate the world of style. Represent your heritage. Discover new cultures.

name: Fashion Dash
creator: Ilina3🤍
description:
Step into the luxurious world of Fashion Dash, a fashion-glamour dress-up and runway competition game!

👗 DRESS UP WITH FASHIONISTA STYLES!
Choose from an extensive wardrobe filled with luxurious dresses, stunning skirts, elegant blouses, dazzling heels, stylish boots, sparkling jewelry, and glamorous accessories. Mix and match pieces to create your perfect look and express your unique fashion sense.

🎭EXPERIENCE A NEW THEME EVERY TIME!
Every round brings a fresh fashion theme to challenge your creativity. Adapt your style to match themes like Elegant Evening, Street Chic, Royal Gala, and many more. The runway is your canvas, and the theme is your inspiration!

🏆 COMPETE FOR THE WIN!
Showcase your fashion in front of the judges and earn points based on your creativity, theme match, and overall style. The top scorers win the round. Can you climb the leaderboard and claim the crown as a true Fashionista?

name: Fashion Frenzy Bingo
creator: Shamerelove89
description: You step into the glamorous world of House of SL89, where fashion meets fun! You find yourself on the home screen, surrounded by a softly blurred runway background. Tap 'PLAY' to start a new game of Fashion Bingo, where you'll mark fashionable items on your 5x5 bingo card. As you play, a 'NOW CALLING' panel shows a fashionable item and its name. Your task is to find the item on your card and tap it to mark it. Get five marked items in a row and tap the large pink 'BINGO!' button to win. Earn coins, collect fashion items, and enjoy the glamour of the runway in Runway Royalty!

name: Felted Fusion
creator: Steph
description: Play Felt Fusion, a vibrant 5x5 grid puzzle game where you swipe to merge colorful, patterned felt tiles into new creations. Enjoy tactile audio, handmade visuals, and a cozy atmosphere as you aim to reach the ultimate tile.

name: Fever Meme
creator: 13_Chris
description:
🌀 FEVER MEME 🌀
Welcome to Fever Meme — a wild, wacky, chaotic brain-rot adventure inspired by iconic fever dream memes!
Think you can out-meme the maze and escape the Fever? 😵‍💫🔥
👉 Join now to enter a maze where maps will appear at random! There is more than one map, each with its own obstacles from brainrot meme characters. The maps and obstacles are completely random, so there's always something new to explore.

name: Fingerling Fashion
creator: creativeCharm
description: Play dress up with your fingers! The thumb has gifted you with tons of fashionable options to style you from head to..toe? Dress up one or more fingers and unlocks cool finger names like Posh and Peace Fingers.

name: The Ellis International Demo World
creator: Ellis International
description:
Get ready to immerse yourself in the future of aquatics at our exclusive Ellis International Demo World! Step into an immersive virtual playground featuring interactive lifeguard chairs, rescue tubes you can grab and use, and exclusive gear—including EllisXR hats and Ellis branded glasses. This limited hands-on preview invites you to explore new features, share your feedback, snap photos, and record videos as you help shape tomorrow’s aquatic innovations.

Join now and be among the first to make waves in this groundbreaking experience!

name: Fish Frenzy: Cast & Cash
creator: thickumsest93
description: Dive into Fish Frenzy: Cast & Cash! Tap to cast, hook, and reel in sea creatures in an underwater arcade adventure. Compete in Classic Mode, 3-Minute Score Challenges, and face off against giant Boss Fish. Customize your fishing table and rod, and climb leaderboards with daily rewards.

name: Fish Market Tycoon
creator: Junyuh
description: A cozy and addictive 2D fishing tycoon game where players spend the day catching fish and the night running a bustling seafood market. Cast your line, discover rare and legendary fish through a luck-based fishing system, build massive themed collections, and maximize profits during fast-paced night market sales. Upgrade your gear, expand your market, survive world events like Blood Moons and Storm Surges, and grow your tiny fish stand into the ultimate fishing empire. Featuring premium mobile-style UI, hundreds of collectible fish, relaxing ocean vibes, dynamic customer AI, progression systems, and colorful event-driven gameplay.

name: Fishing Frenzy
creator: MaybeYourDestiny
description: You find yourself standing by one of three serene fishing spots: Sunny Lake, Ocean Shore, or mystical Magical Pond. Tap the water to cast your line and watch as your bobber bobs on the surface. Below, an underwater world comes alive with 3–5 animated fish swimming in sine-wave paths, light rays shimmering down, and bubbles floating up. Wait for a fish to bite — the bobber will dip dramatically and 'TAP NOW!' will flash. Tap again to start reeling in your catch. A slider bar appears, and you must tap when the yellow indicator is in the green target zone to catch the fish. See your chibi character's reactions! You've got a rare Mermaid Seahorse! Your collection book updates with a beautiful watercolor illustration. Keep fishing and see what other treasures you can discover

name: Realm Fishing
creator: Gortiva
description: Explore 8 magical biomes, from serene mountain streams to deep ocean trenches, and catch legendary fish. Earn coins, unlock gear, and progress through quests. Discover new fish species and decorate your personal aquarium with catches from each biome. The game features a daily quest reset at midnight, a daily streak system with milestone bonuses, and a new day banner notification.

name: Fishing Simulator
creator: michaelgregoryii
description:
🎣 Fishing Simulator: Hooked on Adventure

v1.34

Dive into the ultimate fishing adventure! Cast your line, reel in wondrous catches, and earn coins to upgrade your gear. Explore the tranquil lakes and mysterious stormy waters as you chase after legendary fish. Unlock new rods, baits, and boats to boost your skills. Connect with friends, compete in tournaments, and become one of the best fisher in Horizon. Start casting today and hook into the adventure!

name: Fishy Frenzy Aquarium
creator: Blacqdiamone
description: Dive into Fishy Frenzy, a vibrant underwater adventure! You grow from a tiny Minnow into a mighty Killer Whale, chomping through five stages, snatching pearls from oysters, and outsmarting enemies. Compete on a leaderboard, explore hidden disco coral reefs bursting with black pearls, and savor crunchy, pitch-shifting eat sounds. With a How to Play guide, daily quests, and breezy calypso rhythms, can you become the Fishy Frenzy champion?

name: Flagasso
creator: izukingz
description: How well do you know countries flags? Test your skills with Flagasso where you color in different country flags and get rated on how close you are on the actual colors. Happy painting! 🚩

name: Flappy Pelican
creator: Scott (Trashbyrd)
description: Dive into Flappy Pelican, where you tap to flap and dive through obstacles, catching fish and avoiding crows in a stunning NYC skyline backdrop. Earn points, progress through levels, and compete for the top spot on our leaderboards. Your goal is to become the ultimate pelican champion! Enjoy a chill lofi soundtrack, sailboats drifting lazily across the water, and a thrilling freefall when you hit a wall or die. Can you beat your high score and rise to the top?

name: Flappy Rocket Roadster
creator: dislikeall420
description: You play as a rocket car that auto-scrolls rightward, dodging obstacles like buildings, airplanes, helicopters, and road cars. Tap the ROCKET button to fire upward bursts, or hold it for sustained flight. Double tap rocket and you can kickflip!

name: Flipping Frenzy
creator: Domeoc
description: Flipping Frenzy: flick to flip everything from a water bottle to a rocket! Land a perfect flip, unlock new things, and take them into six wild mini games.

name: ~ Float on Love ~ Valentine's Delight
creator: MellyMeow
description: Float. Fly. Know that you are loved.

name: Fluff Balls!
creator: Clinton - Moo Duck Games
description: Roll through crazy levels with your friends to help Nibbler get back home!

name: Infinite Trees
creator: metaversepaige
description:
Take a walk that never ends. 🌳✨

In Infinite Trees, the forest stretches endlessly—perfect for long walks, quiet talks, and sharing discoveries with friends. This world has been exhibited at BitBasel during Miami Art Week (2024), and presented at MIT Reality Hackathon (2025) and AWE.

Here, you can sponsor or mint a tree, bringing new life into the forest, and unlock a custom AI bird companion to join your journey. Together, we're growing a living, breathing community among the trees.

Walk. Connect. Belong.
Invite a friend, and let the forest grow with you. 🌲🕊️

name: FNAF: Stage Fright! (Win Free Clothes)
creator: TanzerVR
description: You have been hired for late night security at an abandoned Freddy's Pizzeria. Complete tasks but be on the lookout for dangers from within. Can you survive the night?

name: Food Truck Feeding Frenzy
creator: WanesWorld
description: Run a bustling food truck business in Food Truck Feeding Frenzy! Choose from three trucks: Taco Truck, Burger Bus, and Wing Stop. Customers line up with orders, assemble them correctly to earn tips and 5-star ratings. Manage your queue, serve quickly, and avoid mistakes to succeed. A big centered order popup shows new orders. Tips and ratings depend on your speed and accuracy. Hit the ground running and serve up a storm in Food Truck Feeding Frenzy!

name: 𝙁𝙊𝙊𝘿 𝙏𝙍𝙐𝘾𝙆 𝙈𝘼𝙉𝙄𝘼
creator: Chinnaaa.2023
description: Run a busy Halloween food truck! Take orders, cook up a storm, and serve customers to earn coins and combos. Play through themed environments, unlock new foods and upgrades, and manage your truck as it gets increasingly fast and chaotic. Experience premium 2D visuals, real cooking mechanics, and a dynamic customer patience system in Food Truck Mania.

name: Football Flick Frenzy
creator: AbductM3
description: You step into Flick Frenzy Showdown Pro, a modern American football flicking game! Drag to aim and flick the ball to score field goals in a pro stadium. Navigate moving goal posts and increasing wind effects as you advance through levels. Compete to become a flicking master! The game features power-ups like Super Kick and Freeze Wind, and a clean, modern UI. You have 3 chances to miss before the game ends, and the goal posts move and wind gets stronger as you progress. Miss indicators are shown as football icons for clarity. Flick Frenzy Showdown Pro is in your hands - play now!

name: Food Frenzy
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Tap food on the conveyor belt to grab and toss it into the big head's mouth. Craveings change fast - be quick for points! Earn more for quality foods, combos, and speed.

name: FORTRESS - Strategic Tower Defense!
creator: mixlab
description: Greetings, Castle Defender! 🏰🏰🏰🏰🏰🏰 Defend your medieval fortress from endless waves in this strategic tower defense adventure! Command an arsenal of powerful defenses! **Strategic Depth:** **Dynamic Combat:** **Rise to the Challenge!** >EARLYBIRD RELEASE! Your feedback is appreciated!

name: Fortune or Failure
creator: mommy26764
description:
💵 Pick a Case. Beat the Banker. Win a Fortune!

🎉 Do you have what it takes to walk away with $1,000,000?

Welcome to FORTUNE OR FAILURE, the ultimate game of luck, strategy, and nerve!

💼 20 MYSTERY BRIEFCASES! Each contains a hidden cash prize ranging from just $1 to a whopping $1,000,000!

🎯 CHOOSE YOUR LUCKY CASE! Pick one briefcase to keep, then start eliminating the others to discover which fortunes are still in play.

☎️ THE BANKER IS CALLING! As the stakes rise, the mysterious banker will tempt you with cash offers. Will you take the guaranteed money or risk everything for a bigger payday?

💰 DEAL OR NO DEAL? Every decision could bring you closer to becoming a millionaire— or leave you wishing you’d taken the money!

🏆 CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD! Compete against other players for the biggest winnings and ultimate bragging rights!

✨ Dramatic reveals, suspenseful decisions, and million-dollar possibilities await!

🔥 Will you trust your instincts, take the deal, or gamble it all?

name: FOXSTAR
creator: Runtime_Renegade
description:
The Gloam Armada has come for Meridia. Raider warships and biomechanical sea beasts are tearing up the coast, and only FoxStar Squadron stands in their way.

Fly the Starlance SX-7 as squad leader Rhys Ember in a full-throttle, on-rails dogfight. Weave through Port Halcyon's glass towers, thread stone arches over a turquoise lagoon, dive into a waterfall gorge and storm a sea fortress in a lightning squall.

• Boost, brake, barrel-roll to deflect fire, and charge lock-on shots
• Drop bombs, fly through rings and power up your lasers
• Wingmen Sable, Barn and Nix will call for help. Save them or fly the rest without them
• Take down the Harrow Spider, then face UNDERTOW, a three–phase leviathan rising from the bay

Protect your squad, chase the high score, and bring everyone home.

name: Freshwater
creator: SeeingBlue
description:
A little world. All yours.
Build a freshwater aquarium that feels alive. Choose colorful guppies and platies, arrange lush plants and decorations, and get to know the fish in your care.
Feed your fish, test the water, and discover how small choices shape your tank. Life continues while you're away, with plants growing and fish breeding in real biological time.
Propagate healthy plants, sell surplus fish, and reinvest in your aquarium.
Explore hands-on practice activities as you learn—or settle in and enjoy watching your underwater world.
What will you grow in Freshwater?

name: FRIGHT NIGHT
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: You find yourself standing alone on a dimly lit suburban street at night. Your goal is to survive for 5 minutes while evading a terrifying killer. use your flashlight to navigate and find crucial items like a glowing brass keyring for your car, a rolled parchment scroll with the gate code, and an industrial lever as a fuse box handle. If caught, select another character until all are used. Hide to disappear and evade the killer Fright Night is a thrilling experience where you must stay alert

name: Frog vs Toad: Ultimate Speed Checkers
creator: kortalian

name: Frogger Frenzy
creator: Yoda G.
description: Navigate through a 13x13 grid, crossing 5 road and 5 river lanes as a tiny frog. Use large D-pad controls to hop around, filling 5 home slots to complete a level. Earn points for hops, homes, and levels, with a time bonus. Enjoy retro arcade-style pixel art sprites and chiptune music. You have 3 lives and a 30s timer. As you progress, the game speeds up. Can you beat the levels and become the ultimate Frog Frenzy champion in this nostalgic arcade experience?

name: Frostprint
creator: Jacob G
description: Guide a penguin across ice that cracks behind you and refreezes after two moves. Collect three flags on each of three puzzle boards while avoiding open water. Plan your route, revisit restored ice, and replay to complete the rescue in fewer moves.

name: Fruit Frenzy Pro: Fruit Breaker
creator: Dooley
description: You play through levels, aiming to beat your high score. When you complete a level, the game pauses to show your score. Tap CONTINUE to proceed. Your progress and highest score are tracked and displayed at the top in gold text: **BEST: #####**. You can pick up where you left off, striving to beat your high scores and conquer the levels in Score Masters.

name: Galactic Defenders
creator: Gortiva
description: Galactic defenders

name: Galactic Gauntlet
creator: GalacticVictoria
description: You pilot your spaceship through a scrolling dark starfield, dodging asteroids and blasting alien enemies. Destroy asteroids for gems to upgrade your ship's firepower or loot drops. Collect coins to upgrade your ship's firepower and shields between waves. Face off against elite enemies and mini-bosses, and claim bonus rewards for surviving the toughest challenges. With a retro pixel-art style and retro arcade sound effects!

name: Galactic Odyssey
creator: Yoda G.
description: In Rune Wanderer, you play as a young adult wizard in a star-map cloak, hopping across floating runic stone worlds. Gravity pulls you toward each planet's surface, creating unique spatial puzzles. Use your spell-cast attack, blink teleport, and stone armor power-ups to navigate. Explore mystical realms, overcome obstacles, and have fun in this fantasy-meets-cosmos gravity platformer, set in a midnight blue, gold, and ember orange art style.

name: Galactic Pinball
creator: tmwheeler1
description: A template for building a 2D game from scratch.

name: Galactic Strawberry Dash
creator: metaversepaige
description: Embark on a cosmic journey through 10 themed levels, from Crystal Cave to Rainbow Rift. Collect strawberries while avoiding black holes, and interact with them to glimpse surreal dimensions and quirky one-liners. Customize your character with a black bob and green ombre hair, and equip a strawberry rocket jetpack with a neon particle trail. As you progress, levels change with bigger, more colorful black holes and strawberries. Your journey culminates in a grand finale, set to smooth lounge jazz. Collect strawberries to trigger a cinematic pie-baking celebration, complete with a pie counter and strawberry shower. Play through with randomized level order and varied challenges in Galactic Strawberry Dash.

name: Game Share Hub
creator: 8bitvapor
description: A cozy 2D hub where you can share and discover games from other creators. Browse games by genre, search for your favorites, and share your own creations with the community. Earn ratings and reviews on your games, and explore what others have made.

name: Garden of Masters – Magical pets
creator: metacrafters
description: In a serene magical garden, hatch a chibi creature inspired by master painters like Van Gogh, Picasso, or Monet. As you care for your new pet, its health, happiness, and hunger levels grow. Feed, play with, and upgrade your companion with a tap, and watch as delightful emojis float up in response. Embark on interactive adventures through Cubist mazes, misty ponds, and starry nightscapes, earning coins and XP. Shop for upgrades and expand your game play. With a soothing soundtrack and delightful sound effects, Painter's Journey combines art, nurturing, and exploration in a charming experience. Make story choices during adventures and see different outcomes based on your pet's painter style. Explore winding corridors, hidden faces, sunny scenes, or glowing doors, and unlock new adventures or areas with every step. Painter's Journey offers a unique blend of creativity, simulation, and adventure, making it a must-play experience.

name: Garden Slither
creator: llBasilll
description: Slither through a vibrant garden as a chubby, sparkly-eyed snake in Garden Slither! Swipe or tap to move, eating food to grow and score. Unlock skins, themes, and accessories as you progress through Classic, Wrap-Around, Obstacle Garden, and Daily Challenge modes.

name: Gem Burrow
creator: B_a_r_t
description: Dig smart, collect the gems and watch the rocks above your head. Explore twelve jewel-lit caves across four chapters, solve falling-rock puzzles and light the golden exits. Earn cave medals, replay unlocked puzzles and chase a campaign score with gem points and time bonuses. Portrait touch controls, quick cave restarts and an original soundtrack.

name: Ghost Arena
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Watch four AI bots duke it out in a deathmatch arena as a ghost spectator. Fly around, switch views, and track stats in this fast-paced, retro-style shooter simulator.

name: Ghost Office - Possessed
creator: metacrafters
description: You haunt a massive 5-room office as a ghost! Use powers like Flicker Lights, Appear, Toss Object, and Possess to scare night shift workers out while dodging the security guard. Master your abilities to create ultimate scare combos and get all workers to flee. Explore the expanded office, from the conference room to the server room, and rack up a score by scaring workers with ability combos. Your goal is to scare all workers out; if the guard catches you, the run ends. Compete for the top spot on the high score board and become the office's most feared ghost! The office now has 12 desks, 10 workers, and a bigger floor to cause chaos on. Scare sound effects and worker reaction speech bubbles make each scare feel punchy. Possess ability lets you briefly control a worker to scare their coworkers.

name: Ghost Stealth
creator: creativeCharm
description: You suddenly find yourself standing in a sleek, high-tech facility. As you navigate through increasingly challenging levels, you must avoid the flickering security cameras, lasers and guards to escape undetected. Earn bonuses for passing through camera sweetspots and compete on the stealth leaderboard by completing the course with the fewest alerts, fastest time, and most bonuses.

name: Giggle Grove — Early Access —
creator: B_a_r_t
description: Keep the Joyfire glowing in a living woodland full of anxious little friends and mischievous Gloom. Gather supplies, rescue helpers and build playful defenses before dusk. Survive the night, welcome the dawn and carry a small gift into tomorrow.

name: Globe Quest
creator: creativeCharm
description: Walk on a 3D globe, exploring countries and learning fun facts. Choose from topics like staple foods, celebrity hometowns, native birds, native flowers, car brands, and climates. A Reference Book provides detailed information on each country, complete with flags and fun facts. Compete for high scores and track your progress on the leaderboard, ranked by average seconds per correct answer. See your own progress and compare it with others on the leaderboard.

name: Go Far
creator: Tim, CEO @ Mindway Studios
description: 🚀 Go Far is a fast orbit racer that challenges your reflexes, precision, and timing. Pilot through 3 huge maps—Moonbase, The Rings, and Subnet—flowing through tunnels, boosting through rings, and chasing records. Race solo in time trials—or challenge your friends in ranked multiplayer. Take flight, and go far! 🌌🚀

name: Goblin Wrangler (POWERS UPDATE)
creator: emorgul
description: POWERS UPDATE: Use freeze, slow, unbreakable walls, and extra heart powers to supercharge your wrangling. HORDE UPDATE: Manage your own goblin horde and send them on missions to earn powerful loot. Goblins are running amok! As dungeon master, it's your job to wrangle them back into their cells. Use simple and intuitive swipe controls to place walls and capture every goblin on each increasingly challenging level. Don't let the goblins escape! (Credits: Artwork by Julz Creative. Programming by Ink Overflow. Production by HabitXr)

name: GOBLIN'S RUN
creator: Exo Guid
description: Traverse through the treacherous Templar's Tomb to reach the Goblin's treasury. Avoid getting pierced, squished and roasted alive in this action packed obstacle course.

name: Godslayer
creator: 8bitvapor
description: You stand tall as an ancient Egyptian god, your contra-style gun at the ready. The skies darken as UFOs descend, their alien occupants hell-bent on destruction. You auto-fire your way through waves of scout saucers, motherships, and Annunaki cruisers, while occasionally taking down ground-dwelling aliens. Unlock new gods, each with unique stats, and swap between plasma cannons, ankh blasters, and scarab launchers. Health pickups drop from defeated foes, and a lives system with score multiplier amps up the challenge. Compete for the top spot on the high score leaderboard and save your progress to come back stronger. The battle rages on in a stunning Afrofuturist world of Egyptian monuments, Mayan and Aztec pyramids, set against a cosmic backdrop.

name: Golden Rayz
creator: island_ascetic
description: In Golden Rayz, you navigate levels, interacting with shapes to create a harmonious ricochet. Earn rewards as they turn gold. Use hints to reveal level solutions, with a daily limit of 3 hints. The game features a new main menu with Play, Tutorial, and Options buttons. The tutorial guides you through aiming, firing, and hitting targets with your ray. Master the ricochet and become a champion in Golden Shot!

name: Good Migrations
creator: Gungangoose
description: Honk if you love chaos. Cruise the skies, coast over highways, and stir up just enough trouble to keep things interesting. You're a Canada goose on the ultimate cross-country joyride to the Golden Coast. Enjoy splatting from the skies, snacking in the wetlands, and chasing that high score like it's a summer hit single. Smooth flying, good snacks, light mischief. Feel those Good Migrations.

name: Gopher Grid
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: Tap tiles to reveal them, navigating a colorful grid and avoiding gophers' wrath. Earn points for safe tiles and a bonus for winning, with your score persisting across rounds in a HUD. Lose with a gopher's sassy taunt. Choose your difficulty and test skills in Gopher Grid Game! The grid stays visible on loss with a semi-transparent overlay, and unrevealed tiles show bright green grass on top of rich brown dirt. Gopher Grid Game offers a fun puzzle experience where you must carefully uncover tiles to succeed.

name: 104 Days of Summer
creator: Fechin
description: Run a lemonade stand for 104 days, balancing profits and upgrades while ducks drop by for grapes. Start simple, grow into a gourmet dream, and thrive in this hybrid active/idle game. Weather, events, and rival stands challenge your business skills. Unlock new products, from lemonade to lemon sorbet, and attract special customers from Phineas & Ferb. Make smart pricing decisions, manage stock, and grow your stand into a summer sensation!

name: Graveyard Showdown
creator: NamasteVibes
description: Step into the eerie glow of the graveyard and get ready for a fast-paced battle against waves of zombies in Graveyard Showdown! Choose your weapon, take aim, and fight to win. This game will test your accuracy and reflexes as you face off against the undead. 🏆🌟

name: Gravity Flip
creator: teawa
description: Tap to flip gravity. That's the only control, and it's harder than it sounds. You're a little android sprinting through a space station with something big and clawed right behind you. Tap and you fall up to the ceiling. Tap again and you drop back down. Walls block one side, holes open up in the other, and soon the station closes in until you're threading gaps barely taller than you. Grab orbs, push into new sectors and put your best run on the global leaderboard. Just don't stop moving.

name: Gravity Well
creator: emorgul
description: Launch your spaceship from orbit to orbit, collecting stars, navigating asteroid fields, and avoiding black holes.

name: Greedy Dice
creator: Teri Valentine
description: Greedy Dice is a fast-paced multiplayer dice game where players roll, score, and decide whether to keep pushing their luck or bank their points. Keep rolling to build a bigger score, but if you roll with no scoring dice, you Farkle and lose the points from that turn. Watch out, because your third Farkle resets your bank to zero. Play solo to earn persistent reward points based on how efficiently you reach the goal, or compete in multiplayer where players contribute points to a shared bucket and the winner takes it all.

name: GRID NEXUS
creator: 𝓙𝓸𝓻𝓭𝓪𝓷𝓑0101
description: In Grid Fusion, you fit blocks to clear lines and boost your score on a sleek, high-tech board. The game starts with a tutorial, then block shapes get complex, requiring sharp thinking. View your score and rank on the leaderboard, competing for the top spot. Your score appears instantly after each game. Explore a pure black background with a glowing white perspective grid, and interact with semi-transparent buttons that have a white outer glow. The main menu features a glowing GRID FUSION logo and a clean, centered column of buttons. Play a game, then tap LEADERBOARD to see your score. Leaderboard data is saved between sessions, so you can track your progress over time.

name: GRIDIRON '88
creator: Yoda G.
description: You enter a nostalgic retro 1980s football stadium with a lush green field and low concrete stands. The field has seamless grass texture with alternating light-green and dark-green mowing stripes. The home end zone is solid blue with 'HOME' in white block letters, and the away end zone is solid red with 'AWAY'. A retro blocky football player stands near the home sideline.

name: Maine's Gridiron Mayhem
creator: Yoda G.
description: You play Maine's Gridiron Mayhem, a mobile football game that’s a real blitz! Choose from three plays: HB DIVE, SLANT PASS, and GO ROUTE. As you run, throw, spin, and dive to score touchdowns, the AI defense tries to stop you, with linemen rushing, linebackers filling gaps, and DBs shadowing receivers. Keep track of the score, down, distance, and game clock.

name: Grizzly Chaos
creator: 8bitvapor
description: In Grizzly Chaos, you play as a grizzly bear in a humorous 2.5D sandbox game set across four biomes: wilderness, campground, city, and mountains. Manage your hunger and thirst as you forage for berries, fish, and scavenge for food. Scare off humans, fight predators like wolves and cougars, and compete on global leaderboards. Interact with dynamic NPCs that have daily routines and chat bubbles. Explore a world with day/night cycles, seasons, and weather that change NPC behavior and food availability. Collect food in the wilderness like salmon, berries, and fruit from trees. In the campground, scare off humans and look for trash and tents. In the city, raid houses and trash cans. Avoid hunters and wildlife patrols while making sure to drink water from lakes, rivers, and campsites. The game features a 2.5D Paper Mario art style with sprite-based characters, hand-painted backgrounds, and adaptive audio. Your goal is to survive and thrive in this endless sandbox world, all while causing humorous chaos.

name: Grocery Kingdom
creator: llock
description: Ever wonder what it's like to run a grocery store? Step into the shoes of a shop employee and build the most prosperous business in this amazing simulation game! Play with friends and family. Grate game to help you focus and train memory witch competitive elements. Upgrade your avatar and have Fun. Warning!!! This game it is addictive !

name: Groove Tapper Template
creator: Tom Sharpe (Gossamer)
description: A groundbreaking remix-ready rhythm game framework built for Horizon Worlds that lets creators drop in their own music and charts to make custom beat tapping gameplay. With modular gameplay, stunning visuals, and multiplayer support, it's the ultimate starting point for building unique rhythm game experiences.

name: Grow Your Horizon Garden [Volcanic Eruption]
creator: Blenchik
