description:
🌱 Grow, create, and design your dream garden! Plant seeds anywhere, shape the land, paint your plants, and build a garden that's truly your own. Play with friends, show off your creations, and watch your world come to life.
🌋 Volcanic Eruption Event The volcano has finally woken up and torn an island loose from the smoke! Ride the launch pad up and meet the Monolith, an ancient keeper of seeds unlike anything found on earth. Collect magma from every eruption and complete its quests to earn exclusive seeds and unlock the legendary Passion Flower Seed.
✨ New in the latest update: Décor & Housing! 🏡 You can now decorate your garden with beautiful new items and even build your very own home. Customize your space, craft cozy interiors, and bring even more personality to your garden.

name: GrubGuesserXL
creator: creativeCharm
description: You play Food Frenzy, a fast-paced food trivia game. A dish appears before you, shrouded in jellyfish tendrils. As it zooms out, quickly identify the food from four large buttons. The faster you guess, the more points you earn, with a streak multiplier for consecutive correct answers. Compete on the leaderboard by your average correct-guess time. Choose from five level packs: Glow & Guess Classics, California Dishes, Ice Cream Flavors, Candy, and Classic Sandwiches. Play in 35+ languages. Food Frenzy is in a dark, mysterious setting, surrounded by glowing jellyfish tendrils.

name: GTA: Grand Thief Attack
creator: llock
description:
New events and more prizes coming soon!
Grand Thief Attack is a fast-paced co-op heist game where every second matters. Pick one tool ⚒️ with unique abilities - and limitations. You can't do everything alone. Teamwork wins the loot 💰.
Face traps ⚠️, locked containers 🔐, and dynamic loot spawns 🎒. Learn the map, refine your strategy, and pull off the perfect heist 🎯.
Join our Discord community and follow our social media to stay up to date! 💬

name: Guardian's Grove
creator: 8bitvapor
description: In Fae Frenzy, you play as a kawaii magical guardian defending an enchanted grove from endless waves of fantasy creatures. The game features a procedural wave system with modifiers like Swarming, Giant, Cursed, and Boss, making each run unpredictable. You can collect crystals, choose from random upgrade cards, and cast spells like Magic Bolt, Sparkle Burst, and Gravity Vortex. Explore the enchanted grove, battle ground crawlers like goblins and slimes, and aerial flyers like pixie swarms and cursed bats. With a kawaii fantasy art direction, whimsical soundtrack, and mobile-first HUD, Fae Frenzy offers a chaotic and exciting 2.5D wave-survival experience.

name: Guess The Word
creator: fakemovement
description: You play Guess the Word, a puzzle game where you guess a 5-letter word in as few attempts as possible. As you tap letters, the keyboard keys fade to green, yellow, or gray, giving you hints about your next move. Earn points for winning and unlock new backgrounds from a library, including Cherry Blossom Garden, Volcanic Lava World, Candy Kingdom, and Cosmic Galaxy. View your stats, check the leaderboard, and play the Word of the Day. With haptic feedback on key taps, smoother animations, and milestone messages, the experience just got a whole lot better. You round the corner and find yourself in a world of wordplay, where every correct guess brings you closer to victory. The game tracks your games played, win percentage, streaks, and guess distribution, and you can see where you stand on the leaderboard. Your phone vibrates with every key tap, and the sounds of letter flips, whether gray, yellow, or green, guide you through the game.

name: GUESS THE WORD - Multilingual | English | Spanish | French
creator: fakemovement
description:
Guess the 5-letter word in 6 tries!
Play daily challenges in English, French, or Spanish.
Build streaks, earn points, collect beautiful backgrounds, and compete on leaderboards.
How many words can you guess?

name: Gut Punch Street Boxing
creator: NickteaVR
description:
You can now remix this world!!
StreetBoxing clothes now available! 🥊👕
Grab a glove to change your outfit!! 💪
Multiplayer Mobile Play! Smash, punch, and level up in a world of non-stop action ⚔️💥.
Epic brawls 🥊, daring bosses 👊, and explosive level-ups 🚀 await
- Update 2.3: StreetBoxing clothes now available! 👕
- Grab a glove to change your outfit 🥊
- Update 2.2: Players have more health ❤️.
- Update 2.1: More powerful hits that push NPC's back 💥.
- Update 2.0: NPC's now attack when getting close to them 🚨.

name: H2’S WHACK-A-BOOS
creator: Yoda G.
description: Play a fun 2D whack-a-mole game on a colorful carnival canvas. Tap moles as they pop up from 9 dirt holes, earning points and beating your high score. Experience a lively atmosphere with music, sound effects, and exciting gameplay.

name: Halloween Checkers
creator: dislikeall420
description: Jump, capture, and get crowned on a haunted checkers board! Play as spooky-cute ghosts against pumpkins in this Halloween twist on the classic game — easy to learn, tricky to master. Can you outsmart the pumpkins?

name: Halloween Hangout
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Join Jack in his spooky-cool 90s basement for a Halloween hangout! Explore the cozy space, grab candy, play a TV mini-game, and scare Jack for laughs. Dance, emote, and chat with Jack - who's always up to something goofy!

name: Halloween Haunted Race
creator: dislikeall420
description: Speed through 10 spooky kart tracks with cute chibi drivers and 8 themed vehicles. Collect stars and avoid monsters.

name: Halloween Mini Games
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Play 16 Halloween-themed mini games in a spooky carnival. Earn points and compete on a leaderboard. Games include Pumpkin Bowling, Hoops, and a NES-style platformer. Each game has selectable difficulty and lasts about 1 minute.

name: Halloween's Candy Guard Tower Defense
creator: dislikeall420
description: In this thrilling tower defense game, you stand guard on a spooky porch, tasked with defending a glowing candy bowl from waves of cute-spooky monsters. Tap to place defenders like the Witch, Black Cat, and Scarecrow along the winding path. Defenders attack automatically, and defeated monsters pop into candy corn.

name: Halloween's Pumpkin Bowling
creator: creativeCharm
description: You step into a spooky graveyard bowling alley for a game of Halloween's Pumpkin Bowling. Drag a glowing pumpkin ball into position and swipe up to roll it or pull back for a curved shot. Compete in 1 Player, 2 Players, or Vs Computer modes across 3 or 10 frames. Earn strikes with well-aimed shots and enjoy realistic physics and sound effects. Customize your game with four unique pumpkin ball styles and track your progress on a realistic bowling alley scorecard. Tap the pumpkin ball to reposition it before rolling, and adjust your shot for the perfect strike. Can you get a strike in Pumpkin Strike?

name: Happy Little Accidents
creator: mommy26764
description: Unleash your creativity in Happy Little Accidents, a serene digital painting experience. Begin with a blank canvas and use your fingers to paint across it, gradually revealing a beautiful, professionally illustrated landscape. Choose from six stunning paintings, including Mountain Retreat, Sunset Paradise, Enchanted Forest, Country Charm, Autumn Escape, and Moonlight Magic. Select from small, medium, or large brushes and use the hint-free experience to guide your artistic expression. As you fill in the canvas, the progress bar updates, and when you're complete, a celebration screen appears with your masterpiece on display.

name: Harry Porker
creator: David (RiftMixer)
description: Help Harry Porker defeat the Evil Pig Wizards! Grab your wand and step into the arena to join the fight!

name: Harvest Hunt
creator: 8bitvapor
description: You find yourself standing at the edge of a spooky autumn mountain as the harvest moon casts an eerie glow over the landscape. As you look around, you notice a variety of creepy creatures lurking in the shadows - skeletons, witches, goblins, and zombies. Your goal is to click on them to banish them before they can harm you. With a health bar that drains on contact and a timer ticking down, you must eliminate as many creatures as possible to earn a high score. The mountainous terrain is complete with amber-gold grass, fall-foliage trees, and a Halloween twilight skybox with silhouetted bats. The air is filled with a playful bouncy Halloween orchestral loop, and each creature has its own distinct sound signature. As you play, you'll encounter primitive image-textured props like jack-o'-lanterns, tombstones, and hay bales, adding to the festive atmosphere. Can you survive the round and become the ultimate Moonlit Mischief champion?

name: Harvest to Hearth
creator: gausroth
description: Harvest, mill, prep and bake your way to become the riches wheat farmer in the land.

name: Haunted Escape
creator: 𝓙𝓸𝓻𝓭𝓪𝓷𝓑0101
description: Explore a creepy Victorian mansion, find 3 hidden keys, and escape the terrifying creature! Collect Whisper orbs to track progress and earn Echoes for useful items. Daily goals challenge you to collect Whispers, survive creature chases, or escape quickly.

name: Haunted Heights Obby
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Climb a spiral of haunted towers, graveyards, and rooftops in this Halloween-themed parkour obstacle course. Use three types of jumps—JUMP, SUPER, and LONG—to navigate 600 platforms across 10 zones, from a pumpkin-patch street to a moonlit summit. Collect candy, avoid falls, and race with AI partners who learn from their mistakes. No lives, no game over—just fun, challenging gameplay.

name: 🎃 Haunted Hidden Objects 🎃
creator: thickumsest93
description: Explore 20 spooky levels, finding objects like skulls, black cats, and candles. Tap each object to mark it as found, and a green checkmark will appear. Enjoy a dark, moody color palette and eerie ambient music. Cursed Object Hunt is a challenging and fun hidden object game for players of all ages.

name: Heaven Obby
creator: Meta.Jesus [illuminated]
description: ✨ Heaven Obby ✨ Do you have what it takes to ascend to the Golden Gates of Heaven? ☁️👼 Jump, climb, and survive your way through a divine obstacle course filled with floating platforms and soft heavenly clouds! ☁️✨ 🏆 Reach the top and be rewarded! Earn your very own Halo 😇 and Angel Wings 🪽 as proof you made it to paradise! 💫 Simple… but not easy. 💫 One mistake could send you falling back down… Will you rise… or fall? 👀 ✨ Begin your journey to Heaven now! ✨

name: Helix Jump
creator: teawa
description: Spin a colorful tower to guide a cute robot up a winding path of ledges! Earn points, unlock skins, and reach new heights in this vibrant, arcade-style game. You stand on a bright, saturated cartoon tower in a clear blue sky with big puffy white clouds. Drag left or right to rotate the tower and align a higher ledge for your landing. Earn points for reaching new heights, displayed as a pink score and current height on the screen. Unlock robot skins and accessories with coins earned during climbs

name: HELLO! My name is ...
creator: creativeCharm
description: Wanna know why people really run from crowds? Step into a world where saying Hi just got a whole lot more interesting. As you navigate through levels, you mingle with others. that's not so bad. just walk up and say hi.. what's the worst that could happen. Oh yeah, I know, YOU COULD FORGET THEIR NAME!!! The longer you stay the more you will meet. The more you must remember.

name: hex and harvest
creator: blanktarget
description: In a magical farm, defend against cute cube animal enemies as a witch. Choose from three witch characters - Star Witch, Storm Witch, and Nature Witch - each with unique abilities and starting special balls. Explore a vibrant dirt field with trees, rocks, and bushes outside. Collect gems to level up and enjoy a folk music soundtrack.

name: Hexa Sort Puzzle
creator: Emporium of Wonders
description: Sort hex blocks by color.

name: HexaLink Showdown
creator: Yoda G.
description: You tap an empty cell on the 19-cell hexagonal grid and place your token, trying to outmaneuver your opponent. Will you form a line of four in a row or create a tight triangle? The game starts with a title screen showing the logo, rules, and a Start Game button. As Player 2, you can swap colors with Player 1 on your first turn with the Pie Rule. You also get a double move on your first turn, marking each token with '1 of 2 / 2 of 2'. Bridges lock the middle cell for one turn, marked with a red

name: HIDE OR ELSE
creator: jacktionman
description: PROP HUNT IN HORIZON! BECOME PIANO. HIDE BEHIND BANANAS. LAUGH AT HUNTER. HE CANNOT FIND ME. GET SHOT. HE FOUND ME.

name: Highway Bike Rider
creator: Chandu_Flyingcaps
description: Get ready for the thrill of the highway in Highway Bike Rider, a fast, smooth, and immersive first-person bike racing game built exclusively for Meta Horizon Worlds Mobile. Your mission is simple: ride fast, avoid collisions, and keep overtaking to boost your score. Unlock new motorcycles with better handling and speed as you continue to master the road. Three unique themes are already available: 🌃 City, 🏜️ Desert, and 🌲 Forest, each delivering endless racing with different traffic patterns and visual atmosphere. Every run is a new chance to set a record and climb the achievements ladder. Designed with polished controls, clean UI, and optimized performance, Highway Bike Rider ensures a top-quality gameplay experience on mobile. Whether you're chasing high scores or just looking for an exciting, quick ride, the highway is always open! ⚡🏍️

name: Hip Hop Hero (CreativBeats Update)
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: More custom Beats coming Soon!!! You step into the spotlight as a rising hip-hop star, tapping notes in sync with pulsating beats. Navigate a vibrant 4-lane note highway, feeling the rhythm of the music as you play. Your score multiplier builds with consecutive hits, and a health bar depletes with misses. Explore the title screen, song select screen, gameplay screen, and results screen, all set in a bold, urban anime/chibi art style. The game features five demo songs — "Street Cypher", "Neon Bounce", "Block Party", "Mic Check", and "Trap God" — with challenging note charts that feel like real hip-hop rhythms. Upload your own hip-hop tracks to play as background music and compete for the highest score in a fun and challenging experience. View global leaderboards to see your rank and compete with others worldwide. Hip-Hop Hero

Customize your game with four unique pumpkin ball styles and track your progress on a realistic bowling alley scorecard that scrolls left and right. Moonlit Pin Smash has a spooky atmosphere with bats flying around and a creepy bowling alley under a Graveyard Full Moon skybox, adding to the ambiance.

name: HOLY DUMPLINGS!
creator: mommy26764
description: Run a charming dumpling restaurant in a kawaii-inspired 2D world. Choose from adorable dumpling characters, cook and serve customers, earn coins, and unlock new characters and upgrades. Explore a colorful village hub with interactive locations like the marketplace, trading post, and mystery baskets. Collect ingredients, prepare orders, and manage your restaurant to build your dumpling fortune. Enjoy a balanced gameplay experience with moderate pace, varied progression, and optional challenges.

name: Honeycomb Tycoon - VR & Mobile
creator: AlexRusty2012
description: A tycoon game, can you bee-lieve it? Collect bees, make honey, convert them to comb and buy upgrades. Interact with pets, compete with your friends, and become the richest player in Honey Forest.

name: HOOKRISE

name: Horizon Block Party! (Phone Compatable)
creator: Bonetoy
description: Do you have quick feet? Get to the safe tiles before the timer runs out and you fall to your doom!

name: 🐐HORIZON HUNTER🐅
creator: BigSmoke214
description: It's open season hunt as many animals/players as possible to become the Top Hunter.But watch you step get to close and you will spook the animals.

name: Horizons Donut v1.2
creator: PablosCorner
description: A port of donut.c, originally programmed by Andy Sloane, to Meta Horizon Worlds! Ported by PablosCorner, Kaceymon, and FailedToRender.

name: Hot Word
creator: Matthiaos
description: Get ready for Hot Word Showdown! Play a daily word-guessing game where you try to discover the secret word. Type any word to see how semantically close it is to the secret word, with a hot-or-cold system ranking your guesses from Freezing (icy blue) to FOUND IT! (gold). Your previous guesses appear in a ranked list, with the hottest guesses at the top. Challenge your vocabulary and lateral thinking skills every day! Compete with others on the public leaderboard, ranking players by fewest guesses to solve the daily word. Dive into Hot Word Showdown now and show off your word skills!

name: House of Cards
creator: creativeCharm
description: Build a House of cards using a timed claw machine!

name: House of Hands
creator: un1v3rsedragon
description: Welcome to House of Hands, a mystery game where every choice could be your last. Trapped inside a mysterious mansion, you must navigate deadly rooms and choose wisely. Every wrong decision unleashes horrifying hand creatures and unique death sequences. Uncover forgotten memories and fight to escape. The House is watching. The Hands are waiting. Three choices. One way out. Will you survive?

name: House Renovator
creator: Cyklone
description: Clean and restore houses to earn enough money to flip and renovate your own houses to make a profitable business.

name: Hue Haven
creator: Gello
description: Explore three enchanting scenes: a whimsical cat in a lush garden with a golden collar, a vibrant underwater scene with a playful clownfish and treasure chest, and a mystical forest with a beautiful fairy on a red spotted mushroom. Each page offers clean, paint-by-number style illustrations with bold outlines and simple tappable regions that come to life with satisfying sound effects as you color. Your progress is saved when you hit the back button, and you can reset all pages with a single button tap. Preview thumbnails show your filled regions in color, so you can see how far along each page is at a glance. Vibrant Pages is the perfect place to express your creativity and relax.

name: Human Tower
creator: metabigchief
description: Human Tower is a fun, addictive 2D physics-based stacking game where players drop hilarious cartoon characters on top of one another to build the tallest tower possible! Time each drop perfectly, maintain your balance, and watch out as your tower becomes increasingly unstable. One wrong move sends everyone tumbling! Beat your high score, unlock unique characters, and conquer daily challenges in this easy-to-play, hard-to-master arcade game.

creator: Simo
description:
🏹 Dive into a fast-paced 1–4 player co-op archery adventure with random skill builds, simple one-finger controls, stylish cosmetics, 15 difficulty tiers, team-based strategies, talent progression, and 100+ handcrafted stages filled with powerful bosses.
💬 Stay updated — join our Discord community:🔗 https://discord.gg/htCKvdbB8v

name: hyperBreak
creator: hyperjoule
description: Smash colorful blocks with a bouncing Neon Plasma ball in HyperBreak! Drag your finger to control the paddle and tap to launch the ball. Hit normal blocks for 10pts, tough blocks for 25pts, and gold blocks for 50pts (and a power-up!). Power-ups like a wider paddle, slower ball, or extra paddles will aid your quest. Clear all blocks to advance through levels with increasing speed and new layouts. Can you beat your high score? In hyperbreak, you will find a neon world with a dark navy background, neon-glowing blocks in pink, purple, cyan, and gold, and a rainbow-colored fading trail on the ball. V7

name: I am a delight! - Frenzy feast
creator: metacrafters
description: In a vibrant watercolor backyard, help a hungry opossum feast on scattered food items before the timer runs out. Tap on strawberries, grapes, pizza slices, and more to feed it. Watch it grow each time it gobbles up a treat, with a heart burst and ' LOVE!' floating up. Feed it quickly because the food disappears fast! But don't tap on bugs or it will go ' FRESH!' and lose points. Get as many points as you can.

name: I Can Flap
creator: imdoldoli
description: Flap all the way

name: I Know What You Need
creator: creativeCharm
description: Offer a helping hand!

name: Farmstead Empire
creator: Teri Valentine
description: Farmstead Empire is a cozy farming adventure where every seed, fence, animal, and upgrade helps you grow from a small homestead into a thriving farm business. Start with simple tasks like gathering wood, planting crops, building fences, and caring for animals. As your farm grows, you will unlock chicken coops, barns, crop fields, tools, upgrades, and new land to develop. Raise animals for eggs, milk, meat, and profit. Grow crops, complete orders, expand your property, and turn your little farm into a full farming empire. With charming pixel-art visuals, fun progression, cute animals, and strategic farm-building choices, Farmstead Empire gives players the satisfaction of building something from the ground up. The more you grow, the more land you unlock, and the closer you get to becoming a true farming legend. Grow crops. Raise animals. Build your farm. Create your empire.

name: I Spy: Christmas Edition 🎄🎁
creator: Ag
description: Find hidden objects in six festive Christmas levels: Santa's Workshop, Snowy Village, Christmas Kitchen, Christmas Market, Christmas Living Room, and Winter Forest. Tap on objects when you see 'I SPY...' and watch them glow with an orange light. Can you find all five objects in each level and unlock the next one? Enjoy Christmas music and a holiday-themed interface throughout.

name: Ice Pirate City (Ice Colors Update!)
creator: Captain.Jack.Sparrow
description: Welcome to the frozen edge of the world — a lawless city carved from ice and steel, where pirate crews battle for control of ancient secrets buried beneath the frost. Skate on trails of ice at breakneck speed, launch icy assaults with elemental power, and rule the frozen underworld... or be buried in it. Trust no one, arm yourself, and stake your claim in the last cold stronghold of the pirate age.

name: Indianimals Mobile (Multiplayer update)
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: wreak havoc until the cops catch you... You only got one life to live lets live it

name: Indianimals Turf Wars (beta)

description: Multiplayer Madness!! Up to 70+ players in one map.. Choose an animal squad and take control of the streets! Beat up Rivals, run from the 👮s or everybody can get along and roleplay

creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Draw to escape in this charming puzzle game. Guide Blot through magical sketchbook levels filled with obstacles and puzzles. Create bridges, ramps, and pathways to help Blot navigate and earn stars. Unlock levels, cosmetic accessories, and journal pages as you progress.

description: Cosmic run adventure

creator: 𝓙𝓸𝓻𝓭𝓪𝓷𝓑0101
description: Leap into a cozy Italian kitchen and navigate a 30-landing obstacle course. Climb through warm wood and dark green cabinets guided by glowing arrows. Collect pizza slices for double jumps and compete for the fastest times on the local leaderboard. Reach the top while avoiding moving platforms and disappearing books.

name: Jailbreak Jesters
creator: metabigchief
description: You build and explore in a vibrant 3D playground, optimized for Landscape mode. Craft your own unique experience with tools at hand, earn stars, and track your progress on the leaderboard. Test your skills and compete to achieve the best streak in Landscape Playground!

name: JEDI: SHADOWFALL
creator: Ag
description: Infiltrate a colossal orbital fortress as a guardian, battling enemies with a glowing energy blade. Explore industrial corridors, overcome elite warriors, and destroy the experimental superweapon. Customize your saber and face off against formidable foes in a richly detailed, Star Wars-style environment. The fortress falls. The Order endures.

name: Jetpack Jackie
creator: un1v3rsedragon
description: Jetpack Jackie is a simple mobile flight game where you launch through neon city tunnels and building openings, collect coins and diamonds, hit boost zones for sudden speed, and shoot attacking robots with a shoulder gun. One-finger controls keep it easy and fast—short runs, high scores, and nonstop flying.

name: Jetpack Jumpers
creator: Meta.Jesus [illuminated]
description: More atmospheric / immersive — ⚠️ WELCOME TO THE JUMP TEST FACILITY ⚠️ — This once cutting-edge industrial testing complex has been left to rust... but the conveyor belts still move, the machines still grind, and someone left the jetpacks online. — Strap in and survive an endless gauntlet of pipes, machinery, and deadly obstacles in this fast-paced arcade challenge. — 🚀 Simple controls, addictive gameplay — ⚡ Dodge incoming hazards with precise jetpack control — 🏭 Explore a crumbling retro-futuristic factory — 🏆 Compete for the top score — Just don't ask what happened to the test subjects.

name: K.G.'s 1990's SnakieZ
creator: Yoda G.
description: You navigate a hungry snake through a grid, eating food to grow while avoiding walls. Tap the large pixel-art D-pad buttons at the bottom of the screen to steer. Compete on the global leaderboard, pause and save your progress, and resume where you left off. Can you beat your high score in K.G.'s SnakieZ?

name: 💥 KABOOM 💥
creator: thickumsest93
description:
Put your brain to the ultimate test in KABOOM!, an explosive puzzle game inspired by the classic Minesweeper!

Tap your way through a grid filled with hidden bombs, use number clues to uncover safe spaces, and avoid setting off a massive explosion!

Every move counts as the puzzles get trickier and the pressure builds. Can you clear the board without going BOOM?

name: Karaoke Nite
creator: creativeCharm
description: Pick a stage name, pick a song and don't forget the lyrics in this karaoke quiz game! The game designer of this game is also a song writer and the game features her songs in the library.

name: Kart Clash
creator: Meta.Jesus [illuminated]
description:
🏎️💥 KART CLASH. The Ultimate Arena Kart Brawler!

Dive into chaotic, physics-filled mayhem where every match is wild, unpredictable, and meme worthy! Customize your kart, blast your rivals, and become the ultimate kart clasher.

🔥 FEATURES

⚔️ Arena Kart Battles. Smash, drift, and blast your way through action packed arenas!

😂 Meme Worthy Moments. Hilarious ragdolls, goofy chaos, and clips you have to share.

🔫 Crazy Weapons. Outplay opponents with a loadout of wacky, high impact tools.

🎨 Full Customization. Build your style with unique kart skins, driver outfits, and more.

🎮 Solo or Squad Up. Jump in alone or dominate the arena with friends.

💣 Pure Physics Mayhem. Every collision, explosion, and swerve is driven by real chaos physics.

🥇 Jump In & Cause Chaos!

Every match is unpredictable. Every moment is hilarious.
Welcome to Kart Clash, where anything can happen! 🏁💨

name: GO KART SPLASH MANIA ( UPDATE )
creator: Darren29
description: Race go karts. ride jet skis. watch the sea life. play games with your friends

name: Kawaii Frenzy
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Blast your way through Candy Castle! You wield a Kawaii Uzi, a pink sparkle auto machine gun that fires 8 shots/second. Explore a textured raycaster world with candy-stripe walls, pastel floors, and a pink sky ceiling. Fight cute Onigiri Samurai enemies that patrol, chase, and wobble when hit. Use multi-touch controls to move, strafe, and shoot. Survive waves of enemies and rack up a high score!

name: Kawaii Frenzy 3D Showdown
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Play as a kawaii blaster in a 3D first-person wave shooter! Shoot cute enemies that burst into hearts and sparkles. Collect power-ups, unlock cosmetics, and compete on leaderboards in 15+ game modes across 35 levels. Explore Candy Castle, Tokyo Neon, and more. Earn stars, trophies, and quests to unlock new arenas and Uzis. Friendly, fun, and fast-paced action for all!

name: Kawaii's Foodie Friend-zy (EARLY ACCESS)
creator: Kawaii.Creator
description: Jump into the kitchen and start your Foodie Friendzy! This cozy cooking and friendship sim lets you run your own food stalls, serve adorable dishes, and bond with a cast of lovable NPCs. Earn tips, unlock decorations, and collect the cutest tip jar buddies while customizing your space. Built for mobile and VR, Foodie Friendzy is the perfect mix of creativity, chill vibes, and shared fun with friends. Let's get cookin'!

name: Merge Kitties! by Kawaii
creator: Kawaii.Creator
description:
😺Merge to discover 50+ adorable hand drawn kitties, earn cute accessories, and decorate your very own kitty room with your favorite feline friends and cozy décor across two different game modes. Relax, enjoy, and see how many kitties you can add to your tower💕

Merge Kitties lets players merge through 20+ hand-drawn kitties—each with two unlockable accessories, custom beds, and playful personalities.

Update 8.25.25: COZY UPDATE! Adds an all new customizable Kitty Room you can decorate with your choice of shelf decor and kitties, new merging logic that prevents broken merges and increases merge efficiency, all new hand-drawn UI elements, leaderboard interactivity and the ability to purchase high-level kitties using Gems. General optimizations and bug fixes.

Update 7.12.25: Removed leaderboards that were causing UI to be slow and unresponsive, rendering the game unplayable in some cases.
Update 5.31.25: Fixed bug causing UI to show at 50% scale, Fixed bug causing applied wallpapers to not save when leaving the world, Fixed bug causing shop prices to reset when leaving and re-entering the world, Added a welcome back screen and offline revenue.
Start with six tower slots and unlock more as you level up. Kitties spawn passively from your carrier, but tapping speeds things up. Use coins to purchase higher-level cats, or use Gems to unlock stylish wallpapers and earn surprise accessories and decorations through the gachapon.
Track your progress in the Purr-o-pedia, decorate your board to match your style, and climb the leaderboard as you race to complete your collection. With satisfying sound design, sparkly visuals, and a relaxing gameplay loop, Merge Kitties is built for quick sessions—or cozy, long-haul play.

name: Kawaii's Playroom Tower Defense
creator: Kawaii.Creator
description: In this fun, fast-paced multiplayer party game, you and your friends team up to defend the Cardboard Keep from an endless invasion of Angry Toyz. Use teamwork, strategy, and quick thinking to build and upgrade towers, unlock new backpacks, and fend off wave after wave of over 20 different classic toy-inspired enemies! But watch out, powerful minibosses such as the tower-disabling Monkey Mechanic or the studs-hungry Piggy Banker spawn every few waves, so be sure to stay prepared!

name: 💘️ Kawaii's Sweetheart Daycare 💘️ – Valentine's Update!
creator: Kawaii.Creator
description:
Welcome to the cutest daycare on the block!! Take care of babies, decorate the nursery, and build your dream daycare with your friends! 👶💗

Enjoy Quality Time with Adorable Babies:
Feed babies their bottles, change diapers, play, and rock them to sleep – all from your cozy little nursery!

Oh No! The Babies Are Crying…Again!
Now, it's up to you to make sure your little bundles of joy are happy. Rock them in their cribs, feed them snacks from the fridge, change their diapers in the Nursery, and play in the Playroom together! Keep cuddling them and calm them down before the trouble begins!

🏠 Customize Your Dream Daycare: decorate the nursery with everything you love – soft pastels, cute decals, and cozy napping spots for every little one.

🌈 Care for Unique Babies: Over 30+ adorable babies to discover, each with its very own personality, mood, and needs – some cute, some silly and a few totally wild! Buy new babies with Babysitter Bucks, which you earn by taking care of babies, letting the babies nap or by AFK Bucks earned while away from the keyboards!

Earn, Spend and Unlock:
🎀 Decorate the nursery with 100+ cute outfits, decals, and more!
🏡 Buy adorable babies to care for and complete your collection!
👶 Interactive furniture: bouncy houses, ball pits, hoop courts, and so much more! Invite friends over for playdates or host a cutie-packed event!

New & Exciting Valentine's Day Content:
💖 Awesome new themed decorations: 12 super cute Valentine's Day decals!
💕 10 Valentine's Babies! Meet Baby Cupid! 💕
💗Jump into Kawaii's Sweetheart Daycare and take care of 30+ surprise babies, decorate with exclusive Valentines décor, and earn Babysitter Bucks as you climb the ranks. Become the manager to unlock idle Bucks and watch your earnings grow while you work. 💗

🎀 Current Update: v1.11.26: Valentine's Day Update! 10 returning Cupid Babies, and a full Valentines Day retheme!
v11.25.25: Holiday Update! 20+ returning holiday babies and a new Holiday theme!

v6.30.25: Fixed issue where in some cases, a user that purchased Floatie Friends VIP access could not grab the VIP babies.
v6.18.25: Summer Splash Daycare! New VIP area and 10 new VIP babies, 6 new summer themed manager babies, and a seashell collection system and leaderboard!
v4.16.25:
Replaced popups with an all new HUD notification system, added new tracked variables, general bug fixes and UI optimization.
📝 Version History:
v3.9.25:
Added an all new HUD for MR, Mobile and Web players, Recreated baby need stations on Mobile to increase stability and replaced text-based baby bed labels with new gradient UI. General bug fixes and optimizations.
v2.1.25
New Valentine's update! 10 Cupid's Cradle exclusive babies with charming wings. Wearable wings! Match your babies in style.

v12.2.24 – Winter Update! Full winter retheme with 20+ new surprise babies. Added a temporary holiday VIP room with 10 exclusive pastel holiday-themed babies.
v8.11.24 – Full graphics & interaction overhaul! Redesigned babies, environment, and all game mechanics.
v6.13.24 – VR-friendly updates to the Nurse's Station and changing table, fixed Luna manager baby spawn.

name: KHL KOUDAH'S Card Lounge
creator: Queentrueelle
description: You enter the luxurious KHL Royal Card Lounge, surrounded by smooth R&B beats. A gold crown icon and 'WELCOME TO KHL CARD LOUNGE' in bold gold letters greet you, with a pulsing glow. You can play Spades, Poker, and Blackjack against Marcus, Sofia, and Yuki. Master your skills, claim prizes, and spin the daily reward wheel to climb the VIP ranks from Newcomer to Lounge Royalty. Your cards are now bigger and easier to read, and a punchy 2-second brass stinger plays when you enter.

name: Soccer Kick A Brain Rot
creator: NickteaVR
description:
⚽️ Get ready for the ultimate Soccer challenge! 🎮 Kick a Rot: Can you kick the Rot the farthest? 🏆 Join the leaderboard and compete with friends in this epic sports game! 🧀 Show off your skills and beat your high score! 🚀

Compete in multiplayer action, climb the ranks, and become the ultimate Kick a Rot champion! 🏆 💪 More awesome features are coming soon! 😍 We want to hear from you - share your feedback and help us make the game even more lit! 🔥

name: KICKBALL: NO MERCY‼️
creator: Ag
description: ⚾🔥 Kickball Showdown! 🔥⚾ Get ready to hit the field and kick your way to victory! 🏆 Pick your game mode, master different kick types, and challenge AI opponents who get tougher as you level up. With auto ball pickup and auto switch to the closest defender, you only need to select which base to throw to. Will you go for the championship or just have fun? 🧢💨

name: Kill Box
creator: Gortiva
description: Welcome to Kill Box, a psychological thriller inspired by a journey through hell. Try to survive the Kill Box in 3 different modes, Time, Survival and Killer mode where you can be in control of the weapons and eliminate the players. If you start a new instance you can also experience the 40 Minute Audio Experience in full.

name: Kingdom Board Game
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Explore an 8x8 tile grid world where your rank determines your kingdom size. Climb the leaderboard by beating rivals in 3-minute score battles to grow your territory. The #1 player owns the castle and wears a golden crown. Seasons reset the map every 2 weeks.

name: Idle Kingdom Tycoon
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Fantasy Kingdom is a tycoon game where players build and expand their own magical realm inside a shared kingdom. Earn coins, gold, crystals and gems from your resource buildings and upgrade them to grow your economy. Explore themed neighborhoods such as the tavern, library, garden, and even magical tavern with goblins. Complete quests for rewards and level up to unlock new buildings. Team up with friends to build, grow and expand your realm to earn more rewards. Build. Earn. Upgrade. Level Up. Idle Kingdom Tycoon is waiting for you.

name: Kitty Key
creator: MellyMeow
description: Escape into a feline oasis... when you need an escape right meow.

name: Kitty Search - The Purrfect Word Search
creator: dislikeall420
description: Get ready for the ultimate word search adventure! Explore a vibrant world of crosswords, uncover hidden words in a colorful grid, and compete to beat your completion time. Tap and drag to highlight words, and watch them light up in green as you complete the list. With satisfying sound effects and cute pastel backgrounds, climb the leaderboards and become the ultimate word search champion!

name: Klondike Solitaire
creator: Hardy World
description: You dive into a modern solitaire showdown, where you can customize your experience with various card backs. Participate in the Daily Challenge, track your moves and mistakes, and compete in leaderboards to test your skills. Enjoy a full Klondike Solitaire playfield with 7 tableau columns, 4 foundations, and stock/waste piles. Your progress is saved across sessions, including games played, won, best time, and achievements. Solitaire Showdown is now permanently styled with Anton font, All Caps, Wide letter spacing, and Large font size.

name: KO Kickoff: Punch & Score ⚽🥊
creator: Mikolaj
description: Dive into the wildest soccer brawler on Horizon Worlds - where chaos, goals, and knockouts collide. Throw on your boxing gloves, punch the ball (and your rivals), and score stunning goals in a canyon arena made for arcade action. KO Kickoff is fast, fun, and built for highlight moments with friends! NEW IN THE POWER-UP UPDATE ⚡ Level up and unlock epic new gloves - like the Fire Fist and Bull Horns 📈 Track your progress with the brand-new Level Leaderboard 🏆 Get rewarded with MVP highlights after every match 🧤 Style your player with powerful, glowing gloves 🎥 Enjoy smoother gameplay with improved cameras and cinematic angles It's more than just scoring goals - every match earns you XP, unlocks new gear, and tells your story. Play now and climb the ranks in KO Kickoff! Only on Meta Horizon Worlds.

name: Konbini Days
creator: ammersivelabs
description: Run a small Japanese convenience store by tapping to move the owner. Restock shelves, check out customers, and expand your store between 7-day runs.

description: Welcome to the wild and wonderful world, Big Ears, a bigger heart, and a nose for fun! in laBubu Adventure you will Help Collect sparkly Treasures,Visit the Ice Cream Parlor, Shop and make friends! enjoy the nice Beach and Jump as High as you can! enjoy LABUBU Adventure Remember to Like & Save

name: Lance
creator: emorgul
description: Flap, dive, and zap in this classic 2-D PvP game. It's all about strategy and timing!

name: Lantern Isles 2D
creator: April_Renee
description: Embark on a magical journey through the Wonder Isles, a 2D side-scrolling puzzle adventure. Guide Duchess and Spark as they restore five glowing lanterns to a mystical world. Solve puzzles, unlock new areas, and discover hidden Starseeds in this enchanting mobile experience. Can you awaken the sleeping sky? Explore five chapters, from Starlight Landing to Crownlight Canopy, each with a unique puzzle and environmental transformation. Collect fragments, solve puzzles, and unlock the secret ending by finding all fifteen Starseeds. With Relaxed mode, hints, and replay clues, you'll have everything you need to succeed. Dive into the Wonder Isles and bring light back to the world!

name: Lantern Keeper
creator: mfStarboy_
description:
Guide Ember, Leaf, Dew, and Moon spirits to their matching lanterns, restore fading light, and fend off corruption. Chain matches to unleash Harmony Rush.

Journey through 20 handcrafted Night Watch stages with shifting winds, moving lanterns, and powerful bosses—or chase your best score in Endless Night.

Earn Spirit Merit, browse Hinata's charming Spirit Shop, and collect costumes to customize your adorable spirits. A magical world of music, mystery, and light awaits.

name: Laser Chess
creator: NullValuePoint
description: Play Laser Chess with friends or AI! Make strategic moves as a laser bounces off mirrored pieces on an Egyptian-themed board. Choose silver or gold and compete in leaderboards to track wins against Easy, Medium, and Hard AI levels.

name: Last Light
creator: hyperjoule
description: You guard a lantern in a small arena as shadow creatures creep in from every side. The twist: creatures only move while the light is dim or flickering — at full brightness, everything freezes. Managing the light meter against incoming waves creates a push/retreat rhythm that's the heart of the game. This is the systems-heaviest of the three sprint games, which is exactly why it's paired with disciplined phased building.

name: Buckshot Roulette: The Last Shell
creator: thickumsest93
description: Outsmart Ol' Deadeye in a tense game of Western-style shotgun roulette! You sit at a worn wooden table in a dusty, abandoned saloon, with Ol' Deadeye across from you. Use the pocket watch to reveal the next shell and strategize your shots to outsmart Ol' Deadeye. Win the duel and claim the top spot on the Quick Draw leaderboard with your fastest draw time!

name: Lava Escape
creator: Deleted User
description: Lava Escape is a fast-paced game concept designed to test players agility and quick decision-making.Players must navigate through a challenging environment, or series of platforms, while being pursued by rising lava. The goal is to escape to safety while avoiding the molten hot lava.

name: Lawn Legend
creator: seemebro
description: Lawn Legend

name: Leap of Faith
creator: Meta.Jesus [illuminated]
description:
Leap of Faith is a rhythm dash through a glowing cathedral. You're a leather-bound Bible, and every jump lands on the beat of a Gregorian-chant electronic soundtrack.

Tap to leap over thorns. Tap inside golden halos to jump again mid-air. Hit jump pads, then fly through dove gates, where every tap is a wingbeat. One touch, perfect timing, no second chances... unless you turn on Practice mode and light candles as checkpoints.

Five passages, from easy to insane:
Genesis: In the beginning was the beat.
Exodus: Let my people go.
Psalms: Make a joyful noise.
Jericho: Shout, and the walls come down.
Revelation: Behold, I make all things new.

Clear a passage and the pearly gates open to a choir's Hallelujah. Earn up to three stars, beat your best, or turn on Autoplay to watch a perfect run first.

name: Legends of the Hidden Temple
creator: Hessvacio
description:
Deep within the untouched jungles of a world forgotten by time lies the Legends of the Hidden Temple. This hallowed ground whispers tales of yore, where the bravest souls venture into the heart of mystery to prove their worth against the trials of the ancients.

Chosen ones, step forward! You will navigate the winding corridors and enigmatic chambers of the Hidden Temple, where each puzzle guards secrets and every challenge tests your mettle. As you embark upon this sacred quest, remember that the spirits of ancient heroes watch over these hallowed halls.

Up to three spectral advisers, echoes of the sanctuary's storied past, shall gaze upon your journey. They may lend their ancient wisdom to guide your steps towards enlightenment or conjure obstacles as ephemeral as the mists that shroud these ruins, challenging your resolve and your ingenuity.

Confront the riddles that have silenced many a whispered legend, demonstrate your agility in the face of daunting trials, and decode the cryptic echoes left by the architects of this mystical domain. The spirit of adventure courses through your veins, urging you onwards through each enigma and peril.

Will you uncover the hidden truths buried within the Legends of the Hidden Temple, or will its secrets remain ensconced in shadow, known only to the stones that have stood silent witness through the ages? The path to glory is perilous, but it is yours to tread—the legend beckons.

name: Less Mess Match 3D
creator: Deniwell
description:
👆 TAP - COLLECT - MATCH! ✨
🌸 Dive into Less Mess – the 3D puzzle game that's both calming and challenging.
🧩 Match & Clear: Find triplets of 3D objects to tidy up the clutter.
🌟 Relax & Challenge: Easy to start, tricky to master – perfect balance of calm and brain-teasing.
🚀 Boosters: Powerful tools to help you overcome tough levels.
🎨 Beautiful 3D Design: Hundreds of cute, realistic items to discover.
🧠 Train Your Brain: Improve memory, focus, and quick thinking while having fun.
🥳 Celebrate in Style: Show off victories with your meta avatar.

name: Let Me Cook!
creator: Ashes2Ashes2
description:
The recipe for success: Cooking with friends! Fun's on the menu in Let Me Cook! Ready to chop, mix, and make great meals? [Prove your skills in the kitchen and claim rewards!]

Afterwards, show off your status as a top chef! You can proudly display your status with some seriously sweet chef's hats and aprons, available to wear in the Let Me Cook! kitchen.

🍳WHAT'S COOKING 👩‍🍳
12.15.2025 Winter Update!
New Winter Season Decor!
New ingredient: Beef!
+ new recipes!

10.15.2025 Spooky Season Treats!
NEW seasonal kitchen brew interaction!
Grab ingredients and cook up some spooky gear

FIXED
Bug Fix – bread recipes are now completable

name: Liar's Party - Liar's Deck (New Update)
creator: Harwin
description:
BLUFF • DEDUCE • SURVIVE • LAUGH
Join the Liar's Crew: https://discord.gg/Z2vSHNwY

Step into an atmospheric bar where trust is scarce and lies are currency. Liar's Party captures the energy of real-life party games, transforming rounds of bluffing and strategy into memorable moments with friends. It's not just about the cards you're dealt —it's about the lies you can sell.

🎇 BLUFF your way through intense rounds of card strategy.
👀 DEDUCE the truth, challenge claims, and catch your friends lying.
🎉 SOCIALIZE in an immersive bar setting designed for laughter and suspense.
💥 SURVIVE the pressure! One wrong move means immediate elimination.

Can you outwit the table and be the last one seated?

name: LifeLoop
creator: ♥ Shinabina ♥
description:
Live a thousand lives. Die a thousand deaths. Loop again.

Step into a short, cinematic adventure where every time you die, the loop restarts. Your memories fade, your time runs out and the world reloops (can you hold it together?).

The hunt is closing in. The loop's creator is watching and he's not coming to help. A reign of machines is upon us, and you are their prey.

Play to find out what really happened to Project: LifeLoop and how it got to you.
Your fate = our responsibility.

*Note there are still some things missing from the game and will be updated frequently. Please let us know what else you would like to see while playing and how we can improve the game. We hope you enjoy playing!

name: Light Rush
creator: OvenRoasted
description:
Race through an infinite procedurally generated retro arcade city. Dodge barriers, thread gaps, and hit ramps to jump over obstacles. Stay in the center lane to build your multiplier in this pure score attack game. How far can you go?

This is a WIP.

name: Lighthouse Rescue
creator: WanesWorld
description: In Lighthouse Rescue, guide ships through treacherous reefs to safety using a sweeping lighthouse beam. Rescue vessels to earn rewards and upgrade your beam and lighthouse. Navigate through increasingly challenging conditions, including dense reefs and faster ships, in this single-player 2D game.

name: Links Quest
creator: Austingra7x
description: A faithful Legend of Zelda clone with an original story. You stand at the edge gazing out at the vast ancient ruins and dense forests. The wind whispers secrets in your ear as you grasp the hilt of your trusty sword, ready to embark on a legendary quest. Explore a sprawling overworld discovering hidden secrets and battling fearsome enemies & venture into dungeons to unlock the secrets of this ancient land.

name: Link's Quest - The Dark Land
creator: Austingra7x
description: Embark on a legendary quest through a dark world. Explore a sprawling overworld, discovering hidden secrets and battling fearsome enemies. Venture into dungeons to unlock the secrets of this ancient land. Customize your character with various items and upgrades, and master magical swords & spells in this faithful homeage to a classic Legendary series.

name: Little Chomper
creator: XandriaHeart
description: Care for Little Chomper in a customizable terrarium. Feed it by collecting worms, crickets, beetles, grubs, fruits, candies, mushrooms, and hot peppers in mini-games. Balance needs like Water, Light & Attention. Clean the terrarium every few days to keep it sparkling! As you play, Little Chomper grows, unlocking new experiences. Enjoy humorous messages from your pet & explore a lush garden with day & night terrariums. Chomper's Garden now features a Sanctuary where your grown pets can retire, and a store with new seed types like Forest, Cosmic, and Magma. Unlock rare seeds by achieving milestones and give your new pets legacy perks. Play Chomper Catch, a rhythm game where you tap to snap bugs flying across Little Chomper's mouth at the right time to feed it. Forage on the ground for beetles, grubs and worms.

name: Little House Friend
creator: monkeyJerker79
description: Welcome to Dollhouse Companion, a heartwarming social simulation game. Customize a person and their dog, then watch them thrive in a charming three-story dollhouse. Guide them through daily routines, care for their needs, and nurture your relationship in a relaxing space.

creator: daddy26764
description: You sit down at a sleek card table, facing the dealer. Play Texas Hold'em with a mix of automated and manual controls. Start with 10,000 chips and compete against the dealer.

name: Long Jump
creator: Scott (Trashbyrd)
description: How far can you long jump? Swipe rapidly up and down to build your momentum, let go to pick your jump angle and tap to jump.

name: Loogie Launch
creator: 13_Chris
description: You stand on a high-rise rooftop ledge, gazing down at the bustling city streets below. The skyscraper's facade drops away sharply, giving you a thrilling sense of height. You peer down, taking aim at targets moving across the street. As you charge up your loogie, your cheeks puff out, then snap back on release. Launch the loogie straight up from your mouth, and it travels far into the distance, earning points for direct hits. Manage your saliva meter and power-ups while building combos.

name: Word Search Puzzle
creator: thickumsest93
description: You step into a cozy Fall Harvest world where words hide among falling leaves. As you explore, find hidden words using clean text clues. Swipe across letters to form words, and check them off in a cute panel. Earn scores based on speed and accuracy, and challenge yourself on multiple levels. Unlock new themes like Halloween, Animals, and Space as you progress.

name: Los Angeles Loft 🌴
creator: RexRod
description: A modern Los Angeles loft and a social hangout world with your friends. Featuring a view of downtown LA. Pool area, games, music player, hot tub, 3 private social spaces, 6 seating area and a area to DJ.

name: Lost in Abduction - PhoneFiction
creator: creativeCharm
description: Explore a mysterious phone, Uncover quirky familiar? contacts, parody projects, and social life from a mysterious lost phone. But an incoming text reveals the device's owner's been possibly abducted....

name: Lotters
creator: Clique_Waylon
description: Join Otto the Lotter on a quest to save his friends! A strong current has swept his friends downstream, and he needs your help to find them. To rescue them, you must find the secret words in each level. But watch out, this isn't your average word game! You have to find the secret words by deducing their alphabetical position! Each word you type will give you more info about whether your guess is before or after the secret word alphabetically! HOW TO PLAY: 1️⃣ Get a Category: You will get a category like "SNACK FOODS". 2️⃣ Make a Guess: Type any word. The game tells you if your guess comes "BEFORE" (like "APPLE") or "AFTER" (like "ZEBRA") the secret word. 3️⃣ Narrow the Gap: Your guesses are sorted into lists. Use them to get closer! 4️⃣ The "Aha!" Moment: When your "Before" and "After" guesses get close enough (like "CANAL" and "CANOE"), the game reveals the shared letters ("CAN") for you!

name: LOU'S KITCHEN
creator: Blacqdiamone
description: You step into a vibrant urban restaurant, where the kitchen's rhythm pulses through every second. Customers flood in, each with a craving that must be satisfied. Tap ingredients, fire up the grill, assemble dishes with lightning speed, and serve them up before patience wears thin. The kitchen's urban vibe immerses you in the action. As you juggle orders, a diverse cast of chefs and customers fuels the energy. Correct orders chime in with a bright arcade success sound, while wrong ones cut short with a harsh buzzer. Can you keep the pace and become the ultimate Restaurant Rush champion? The game gets progressively harder, with increasing order complexity and faster customer patience drain. Leaderboards track your progress: All Time, This Month, Most Visits, Fastest Order completion times, and Daily Challenge scores. Earn tips by serving customers quickly and correctly, and get a bonus when the daily challenge mode is completed. Upbeat background music now plays throughout the game, adding to the energetic atmosphere. Customer reactions bring the restaurant to life, with speech bubbles cheering on correct orders and expressing frustration on wrong ones.

name: Luau Solitaire Tripeaks
creator: thickumsest93
description: You find yourself stranded on a mysterious enchanted island with 100 shores. The only way to escape is by solving TriPeaks solitaire puzzles, collecting magical seashells, defeating island creatures, and unlocking beachside huts that lead deeper into the adventure. Combine classic Solitaire strategy with escape-room puzzles, adventure progression, collectible treasures, and tropical environments. You round the corner and stumble upon a grand hut with a Solitaire card board in the center. The cards are laid out in a TriPeaks formation, with some face down and covered by others. One active card is displayed at the bottom of the screen, and you can select any uncovered face-up card exactly one rank higher or lower than the active card, regardless of suit. As you clear cards, the covered ones underneath are revealed. Your goal is to clear all required cards and complete the shore objective. With each completed shore, you unlock a mysterious hut that opens to reveal the next beach. But beware, certain island shores contain creatures, and clearing cards damages them. Successfully completing the Solitaire objective defeats the creature. Every 10th shore introduces a more challenging boss with special puzzle mechanics. Will you be able to escape the island?

name: Lucky Diamond Bingo
creator: Blacqdiamone
description: Step into the vibrant world of Diamond Jazz Bingo, where smooth jazz rhythms meet the lively charm of Louisiana. Explore cities like New Orleans, Baton Rouge, and Lafayette, collecting landmark, food, and festivity cards to complete your album. Tap numbers on your 5x5 bingo card to mark them as they're called, or unlock auto-select with boosters. Win multiple bingos per round with changing patterns like diamond, crown, and straight lines. With crisp caller chimes and satisfying sound effects, Diamond Jazz Bingo is the perfect blend of fun and culture. Experience the magic of jazz and the excitement of bingo in this unique world.

name: Lucky Speakeasy Slots
creator: Heaz_D2S
description: Step into the opulent world of Speakeasy Slots, where the glamour of a 1920s speakeasy meets the thrill of a classic slot machine. You find yourself standing in front of a stunning Art Deco slot machine, its reels gleaming with gold accents and emerald green panels. The air is filled with the smooth sounds of jazz music and the soft clinking of coins. As you play, track your coins with the in-game HUD and compete with other players on the HIGH ROLLERS leaderboard. Will you hit the jackpot or will the house win? The slot machine game features a center-row payout system rewarding wins. Enjoy an immersive 1920s-themed experience. Where Fortune Favors the Bold

name: Lucky Spins
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: Spin the reels in Lucky Slots! You start with 100 coins and hit the big "SPIN" button to set three reels in motion, featuring lucky symbols like clovers, cherries, and stars. Match these symbols to win coins, with rare matches paying out big! The game features a vibrant, flashy aesthetic with glowing neon lights, anime-style symbols, and an upbeat jazzy soundtrack that immerses you in the excitement of a casino floor. Check the payout table by tapping the PAYTABLE button to see the winning combinations and prize amounts. As you spin, the anticipation builds with satisfying reel spin sounds, coin jingles on wins, and a grand jackpot fanfare for the ultimate win. Your goal is to keep spinning until you run out of coins, then restart and beat your high score. Lucky Slots also tracks the top 10 highest scores, so you can see how you rank against other players. Will you be the lucky one to hit the jackpot in Lucky Slots?

name: Lucky Star Craps
creator: WanesWorld
description: Roll dice, complete challenges, and beat AI rivals in this exciting 2D single-player arcade dice adventure. Explore a galaxy of 10 worlds with 200+ levels, each with unique objectives, AI characters, and rewards. Enjoy 8 game modes, including Classic Point Challenge, Dice Blitz, and Cosmic Combo Rush. Unlock 50+ dice designs, 30 star companions, and 200+ achievements. Earn rewards with fair, independent dice rolls and no wagering or financial features.

name: Lucky Stars Blackjack
creator: WanesWorld
description: A template for building a 2D game from scratch.

name: Lucky Stars Roulette
creator: WanesWorld
description: Get ready for a cosmic adventure like no other in Lucky Spin Showdown! 🎲 Test your prediction skills and compete in a variety of challenges to earn rewards and unlock customization options. Explore a galaxy of excitement with a beautifully animated spinning wheel, interactive predictions, and meaningful progression. With 10 unlockable worlds, 200+ achievements, and a daily retention system, you'll be hooked from the start. Can you build the longest streak and become the ultimate Lucky Spin champion? 🏆

name: Lucky Stars Slots
creator: WanesWorld
description: A template for building a 2D game from scratch.

name: Lucky Stars Texas Holdem
creator: WanesWorld
description: Uncover the secrets of ancient, glowing cards in a mystical library. Delve into their mysteries and shape your own journey through enigmatic puzzles and narratives. Explore the library, create unique experiences, and unravel the mysteries of the cards.

name: Lumberjack Tycoon 2
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Grab your axe and get ready to chop your way to the top! In Lumberjack Tycoon 2, build your logging empire from a single stump to a bustling lumberyard filled with workers, cute birds, and massive profits. Gather wood, unlock colorful new areas, upgrade your gear, automate your operations, and team up with friends to expand faster than ever before. Explore vibrant cartoon forests, encounter mystical creatures, and manage your growing crew of cheerful lumberjacks and feathery friends. Whether you're swinging your first axe or commanding a full-scale operation, there's always a new adventure waiting in this fun and cooperative tycoon experience. Are you ready to build the biggest lumber empire the world has ever seen?

name: Lunar Lander
creator: voytek.lorenc (metacrafters)
description: Safely land on the moon. Good luck!

name: Lyra's Descent
creator: Celugia
description: You play as Lyra, The Last Ember, a brave hero on a perilous quest to bring light back to a dark gothic fantasy realm. Explore eerie landscapes that shift and twist every 5 levels, from moonlit graveyards to haunted castles, demon catacombs, and abyssal voids. Master a range of macabre weapons, and summon twisted mini companions to aid you in battle. With the help of her friends and companions, Lyra overcomes darkness and emerges victorious in Lyra's Descent.

name: Ma's: Memory and Stamina
creator: Yoda G.
description: Play Ma's: Memory Stamina, a vibrant candy-pop themed memory game! Flip cards to match colorful symbols like stars, candy, and balloons. Earn points for each pair, but be quick as your stamina drains with every mismatch. Compete for the top spot on the global leaderboard and save your progress to resume later. Experience a thrilling campaign mode with a storyline and illustrated panels.

name: MAGIC VS MONSTERS
creator: LevelRiftLabs
description: Cast spells and defeat monsters. Gather Gold and Upgrade!

name: Magnet Dream
creator: emorgul
description: Relax and play with magnets in this cozy physics-based puzzle game. Don't forget to pet the kitty! (Credits: Artwork by Julz Creative. Programming by Ink Overflow. Production by HabitXr)

name: Mahjong Daydream
creator: Bambipie
description: Play Mahjong Daydream in a serene Japanese garden. Match tiles, earn rewards, and complete Daily Quests. Enjoy a soothing puzzle game with a cute cat avatar, customizable boards, and calming music. Your goal: clear boards to complete quests and earn bonus coins! In Mahjong Bliss, lift and dim tiles to tell free and blocked ones apart, and enjoy daily rewards and achievements.

name: Maine's BigKicks World
creator: Yoda G.
description: You step into a neon-lit kickball stadium at night. The dark turf glows with cyan lane lines as you kick the ball. Run to hot pink bases, outscore your rival, and upgrade gear in the shop. Customize with shoes, gloves, outfits, and lucky charms.

name: Maine’s King Me! Challenge
creator: Yoda G.
description: Step into Maine's CheckerPool, where vibrant jewel tones pop against a deep midnight-blue background. Play turn-based checkers on a glossy crimson-red and cream 8x8 board against an AI opponent. Earn coins, upgrade board styles, chips, music & city backdrops in the shop. Compete in daily & weekly challenges & climb the global leaderboard. Tap to select, swipe to move! Your progress saves between sessions, with a HUD badge tracking your lifetime wins.

name: MAKE IT RAIN
creator: hyperjoule
description: It’s raining cats, dogs, Santa and all sorts of chaos! Squish em all and keep the city streets clean! V5

name: Mall Rush
creator: Virgile
description: Race through Granny's mall, grab as many products as you can, and smash into other players to steal their loot. When the Golden Product appears, everything turns wild: make sure to grab it first!

name: Mansion Zombie Rush
creator: NamasteVibes
description: You sprint through a haunted mansion, dodging zombies and collecting loot. Grab treasure chests, diamonds, and crowns within time limits to score points. When zombies drain your health, transform into a giant spectator and wait for a revive.

name: Maple Mayhem
creator: 8bitvapor
description: You stand in a charming Canadian town, surrounded by rolling snowy hills and towering skyscrapers decked out in maple leaf decor. The winter skybox glows above, and the sound of folk-fiddle music drifts through the air. Look at a turkey, and it highlights green. Click on it, and it disappears in a comedic pop/splat sound, earning you points and loot like health-restoring maple crosses, shielding maple-leaf icons, and coins featuring the loonie sprite. Gaze and Click Mayhem is a test of your aim and speed - will you dominate the leaderboards in Timed Mode, or survive as long as possible in Endless Mode?

name: Maple's Dairy Rush
creator: Fechin
description: You help Maple run her dairy, routing flavored milk through chunky pipes to fill bottles and pack orders before patience runs out. As shifts get busier, juggle flavors and stations while keeping spills—and Maple's stress—under control in this colorful puzzle simulation game.

name: Marble Challengers
creator: Balthazar | InnerspaceVR
description: Experience the ultimate multiplayer marble race in fast-paced, one-minute showdowns! Strategy is key: choose the right consumable Gear for the track to master dynamic jumps, slopes, and hazards. Discover and collect dozens of unique Marbles, from fierce Sharks to futuristic Robots. Compete with friends, climb the Trophy Road, and become a Marble Challenger!

name: Marble Grow & Fight
creator: MapSeagull
description: Become the largest marble by finding shards, quickly striking into smaller marbles. Can you survive to ascension?

name: Marvin's Wordcraft
creator: Yoda G.
description: Play word games on a classic 15x15 Scrabble board with bonus squares. Pick up 7 tiles, build words, and earn points. Use the shuffle button, submit button, and pause feature to enhance your gameplay. Compete for high scores and complete daily quests like playing 5 words for a 50-point reward. Your goal is to beat your friends and family by achieving the highest score.

name: Massage Master
creator: creativeCharm
description: Master real massage techniques using intuitive mobile touchscreen gestures. Choose from 7 unique back types and unlock 6 scientifically-backed techniques. Earn MassageCoin for each successful gesture and track your progress in a calming spa atmosphere. As you progress, earn more coins for complex gestures and unlock a Massage Master certificate. Your journey starts now - can you master the power of touch?

name: Master Match - Art Detective
creator: metacrafters
description: Match famous paintings with the artists who created them! From Picasso to Monet, put your art knowledge to the test!

name: Match & Bloom
creator: Bambipie
description: You step into the serene Bloomhaven garden, surrounded by a vibrant collection of 20 unique plants. As you nurture them, solving match-3 puzzles unlocks new scenes and customizes a sparkling fountain. Earn rewards, clear debris, and revive gardens with every success. Discover new levels, interact with charming characters, and enjoy captivating gameplay in this relaxing mobile experience. Your journey culminates in breathtaking finale plants: Stormcloud Hydrangea, Hollow Willowbloom, Hearthrose, and the luminous Moonbloom. The game features leaderboards for total stars, plants collected, and levels completed, allowing you to compete with others. With a beautiful greenhouse setting and engaging gameplay, Match & Bloom Garden is a delightful experience.

name: Match-3 Remixable World
creator: Person11
description: A fully functional base Remixable world for creating Match-3 style games. Features a customizable board and all the features you know and love in your match-3 games. Great starting off point to learn from or to create your own amazing version of a match-3 game. Guide Included.

name: Math Gacha Quest
creator: HOVO
description:
Answer math questions to earn gems, then spend them on anime chibi character gacha pulls. Collect and view your favorite characters in the roster.

Earn gems by solving math problems on the Quiz screen, then use those gems to pull new characters on the Gacha screen. Unlock and collect characters, each with their own unique portrait and description. Track your progress and stats, including questions answered, accuracy, and best streak.

Play 'Math Idol Quest' now and start your journey to become a math master and anime aficionado!

name: Math Trixle
creator: metabigchief
description: Swipe through glossy number and operator tiles to build an equation that hits the target! Correct trails burst and the board cascades with new tiles. 2,000 levels across 10 worlds, a Daily Trail everyone shares, 60-second Trail Rush, relaxing Endless mode, daily rewards and a free spin, themes to collect and leaderboards.

name: Maze Duel Showdown
creator: PixiFox
description: You engage in turn-based strategy duels on a 9x9 grid! Outmaneuver opponents with smooth animations and a polished interface. Play against adjustable-difficulty AI or a friend in pass-and-play mode.

name: Maze Rush
creator: Appnori
description:
📢 Update Notice
❄️ Map Theme Update
- The Winter Map has been replaced with a traditional Maze-style map.
- Explore the maze with a brand new atmosphere!
🪨 Cave Environmental Trap
- In the central cave area, you can now drop stalactites to damage monsters.
- Use timing and positioning to your advantage.
♟️ Chess Piece Bombs
- You can now pick up chess pieces and throw them at monsters.
- They explode like bombs and deal damage on impact.
💡 Try out new strategies and enjoy the updated maze experience!
🎮 Maze Rush — Survive the Labyrinth!
Escape from a maze that's never the same twice!
Maze Rush is an action-adventure FPS where each session features a newly generated maze filled with traps and monsters.
Once the challenge begins, the maze remains fixed—only your skill and strategy can guide you to the exit.
🎯 Key Features
- Procedurally Generated Mazes: A new layout every session.
- Intense Combat: Battle monsters and survive deadly traps.
- Smart Item Use: Potions and path-finding gadgets help you survive.
- Varied Modes: Choose from Solo, Co-op, Mentor, or Versus for a different challenge each run!
🏆 Compete with friends and family to see who can escape the fastest!
Can you find the exit and escape the labyrinth in time?

name: Mecha Missile Survival
creator: NullValuePoint
description: In the Mecha Storm Arena, you control a sleek fighting robot auto-firing thin beams with light aim assist. Collect powerups like speed boosts, shields, and the rare Nova Bomb to survive 10 waves of escalating missile fire. Can you emerge victorious?

name: Memory Match Zoo
creator: daddy26764
description: Flip cards and find all the matching pairs! Study the board for 10 seconds, then race to match animals before your 5 hearts run out. 7 levels of increasing difficulty — can you become a Memory Master?

name: Mercury Mailroom
creator: Jacob G
description: Run a clockwork mailroom one move at a time. Toggle two conveyor switches, hold letters clear of timed drops, and press Step to deliver each numbered envelope. Solve eight handcrafted scheduling puzzles, undo a move when plans change, and beat each level's par to improve your session score. No timer pressure: plan, experiment, and try again.

name: Merge Defense: Zombiez!
creator: Kawaii.Creator
description: Maddy Scientist has unleashed a wave of cute-but-deadly zombies, and it’s your job to stop them! Upgrade your defenses, merge powerful cannons, and survive waves to earn trophies and climb the leaderboard in a fast, fun mobile-only experience.

name: Merge Donuts
creator: Kawaii.Creator
description:
Furry Friends Update!! Dive into this suika-style dropper game featuring 11 unique themed boxes of donuts! Merge your way through a hand drawn lineup of 130+ donuts inspired by Kawaii worlds and the cutest contest creations, while climbing a 25-level path where every drop feels magical.

Version History:
5/4/26: Added Furry Friends Pet Contest Box
11/6/25: Added 3 new donut boxes themed to Merge Kitties, Merge Defense and Foodie Friend-zy. Bug fixes and rebalancing. Redesigned game over screen.
7/20/25: GLAZED TO PROGRESSION Update!
- All new 24-level progression system
- Unlockable dropper skins
- 4 new donut boxes
- Full UI overhaul
- New SFX
- Bug fixes and balancing tweaks

6/24/25: Initial early access launch!

name: Merge Fantasy Cars
creator: Arestame
description:
Merge two identical cars and watch them turn into something wilder! Start with a humble little racer and work your way up through 42 fantasy cars: a cupcake on wheels, a pumpkin cruiser, a dragon, a submarine, a unicorn and many more surprises.

Send your cars onto the track and every lap earns you coins. Tap a car on the road for a burst of speed, use the coins to buy more cars, and keep merging to discover the next one. Every new car arrives with its own reveal.

There's always something to do:

Free boxes drop into your garage, and golden ones hide better cars.
A UFO lands now and then: tap it for golden boxes or Earnings x5.
Spin the prize wheel for gems, speed boosts and piles of coins.
Daily missions and achievements give extra rewards.
Upgrades make your cars cheaper, faster and more profitable.
The car shop sells any car you've already discovered.
Speed x2 doubles the pace of everything on the track.
Rankings show how your lifetime coins compare with other players.

Merge, race, discover. How far can you go?

name: Merge Sushi
creator: Bambipie
description: You play a cozy, fast-paced merge puzzle game called Sushi Dream. Drop cute kawaii sushi into a bento tray and merge matching pieces to grow them through nine tiers. Keep the stack below the danger line or it's game over. Fill customer orders, complete daily challenges, and earn coins and chef XP. Trigger Fever mode for bonus points, and use bomb and wasabi power-ups when the tray gets tight. Collect every sushi type in your Sushi Book, unlock new themes in the shop, and grow your restaurant from the Cozy Sushi Counter all the way to the Legendary Sushi Palace with 35 upgrades to earn. Easy to learn, hard to stop stacking. Beat your best score and compete on the global leaderboard. Enjoy soothing visuals and J-pop jazz music.

name: Met Museum Heist
creator: metaversepaige
description: Explore the Met Museum's grand halls, filled with artifacts from around the world. You will encounter Egyptian sarcophagi, Greek vases, Aztec sculptures, and European masterpieces like Madame X, Portrait of Juan de Pareja, and The Death of Socrates. Your choices will impact your moral alignment, influencing whether you become The Opportunist, The Traditionalist, The Cultural Champion, The Ethical Curator, or The Pragmatist. A score counter tracks your restitution choices, rewarding correct decisions. Can you be a champion of cultural heritage or a collector of treasures?

name: META FEUD Live
creator: seemebro
description: Meta feud

name: Meta Feud ✅ Mobile
creator: seemebro
description:
2 Teams Who Compete to Answer The Most Questions in order to Win.

join the Facebook Group: META FEUD
