creator: Gortiva
description: Update 12/17/24 *Starting Stats Adjusted *Level Sounds Fixed *Enamy drop rate

name: metaMates
creator: hyperjoule
description: metaMates is where friendship levels up! Every day is a chance to laugh, share, and grow closer with your companion. Earn Care Coins, pick the perfect gifts, and grow your bond with each metaMate. Explore a lively town full of secrets and collect adorable stickers that celebrate your journey together. From coffee chats to fortune readings, every moment glows with connection. Build friendships, share laughs, and see who you vibe with most in the world of metaMates!

name: Metamon (Pokemon Inspired Game)
creator: Runtime_Renegade
description:
Early Beta Access - Experience Pokémon Style turn-based combat built for Mobile.

2nd Area Added - Vexerian Coast

3rd Area Added - Emberclaw Outpost

Use Code 133700 at the Kiosk inside the Metacenter for a Embermaw!

(Fixed AI Avatar NPC Outfits (Hopefully))

name: Metatris
creator: fakemovement
description: "Metatris" is a super fun game where you stack colorful blocks to make full rows and score points! Move, spin, and drop the pieces before the grid fills up. Play fast and see how many rows you can clear – the more you clear, the faster it gets! Can you beat your high score?

name: Metavila Fashion Halloweek
creator: Metavila
description: Halloween themed store for avatar clothing in the open air. First world of Metavila in Horizon Worlds. Buy a new outfit for Halloween! Don't forget to hit the "like" button to show some love!

name: Micro Empire
creator: Jacob G
description: Build a settlement one tile at a time. Place buildings, gather resources and manage your growing grid. Start with a Lumber Camp, watch production increase your stock, and use Harvest for immediate resource feedback. Plan your next construction as you expand your Micro Empire.

name: MIGHTY TINY!
creator: failedtorender
description: Hide and seek with a twist! With each game, a fresh map unfolds, accommodating up to 14 players in a heart-pounding contest of wit and agility. Whether you're evading or chasing, the thrill of the microscopic hunt promises a vast universe of fun! LEVELS: 8-Bit / Laboratory / Movie Theater / Haunted Hotel / Rendered Beef.

name: Mile High Kitchen
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Take your cooking skills to 30,000 feet in Mile High Kitchen! ✈️🍔 Serve hungry passengers, build meals in the right order, manage busy kitchen stations, and keep up as flights get faster and more demanding. Travel to colorful destinations, unlock new recipes and mechanics, earn coins, collect stars, customize your experience, and prove you have what it takes to become a Mile High Master. Fast, colorful, and easy to pick up, every flight is a new cooking challenge!

name: Military Weapons Range
creator: gausroth
description: Can you master the range?

name: Milkshake Masters
creator: guyfierichan
description: You make milkshakes in a dreamy watercolor kitchen. Tap ingredients to add them to the blender, blend, and pour into a cup. Get recipes right to earn points and avoid strikes. As orders get complex, your skills are put to the test. Dive in and shake things up in Milkshake Masters! Try to get to 35 orders completed!

name: Mimic Vault
creator: WanesWorld
description: Explore a magical vault, observe enemy attack patterns, and copy them in real-time combat. Master 5 mimic abilities and defeat 5 types of enemies in a 5-level progression.

name: Mine Maniac
creator: Awkeye
description: 💎 YOUR PICKAXE. YOUR QUARRY. YOUR RULES. 💎 ✨ NEW UPDATE ✨ Mine Maniac just got faster, smoother, and more rewarding. Jump in with quicker progression, supercharged resource collection, and an improved onboarding experience that gets you into the action straight away. Early mining feels powerful, pickups feel generous, and every run delivers momentum from the very start. ⚡ Faster starts & quicker rewards 🎒 Supercharged backpack collection ⛏️ More satisfying mining 🚀 Improved onboarding flow 🔧 Gameplay and audio quality improvements Grab your pickaxe and feel the difference.

name: Miner Colony
creator: kelly
description: ⛏️ Welcome to Miner Colony 💎 Dig deep, sail far, and build your underground empire! Mine precious ores, set sail on epic adventures, explore hidden maps, and strike it rich—or strike a deal in the mysterious Black Market. 📖 How to Play • Dig to uncover hidden ores and treasures ⛏️ • Sell your finds for shiny coins 💰 • Upgrade with powerful pickaxes and sleek boats ⛏️🛶 • Explore new lands and uncover rare secrets 🗺️✨ ✨ Features ✔️ 50+ unique pickaxes to unlock and master ⛏️ ✔️ Diverse maps, biomes, and hidden secrets 🌍🧭 ✔️ Boat travel across vast oceans 🌊🛶 ✔️ Limited-time Black Market with rare, cross-server items 🕶️

Mine coal, iron, and other valuable ores, then sell them for cash. Use your earnings to buy powerful upgrades and unlock amazing new mines. Hire skilled miners to automate your operation and watch your empire grow! Your miners work tirelessly to produce valuable minerals even while you explore new opportunities. UPGRADE YOUR PORTAL. Didn't think it would be that easy!? Upgrade each mine, unlock the portal, then buy the second mine for WAY more money!! Use the drink machine to stay refreshed while you play. 🏆COMPETE🏆 Battle rivals to steal their profits and gain extra cash with push mechanics! Join the daily competition and climb the leaderboard for personal glory and huge rewards. 🪙 Welcome to the Money Tree Update 🪙 Visit the Money Tree and claim free prizes every day — plus spend your hard-earned cash every day for even more cool rewards. New: Tutorial! New: Sale Auto Miner Temp Boost! New: New Ranking Paint! NEW: New Mini Games! NEW: All New Trade!

name: Mingle Madness
creator: mommy26764
description: Recruit AI contestants into exact group sizes and race to enter rooms before time runs out in this fast-paced 2D top-down survival party game. Navigate a large circular arena with a rotating carousel and 50 rooms. Tap or use a RECRUIT button to gather contestants, then guide them into rooms. Survive 5 rounds and outlast AI opponents.

name: Mining Quest: Monsters Unleashed
creator: MadamMischief
description: Play On Mobile for 2x XP!! Mining Quest: Monsters Unleashed is a fantasy RPG adventure where players mine crystals, upgrade gear, and battle cave monsters. Explore underground caves filled with crystals, rock golems, and other powerful enemies. Mine crystal to earn upgrades from the Master Blacksmith. Fight solo or team up with friends as you face increasingly dangerous monsters, leading to an epic dragon boss battle hidden deep within the caves. Progression, combat, and exploration combine to create a fast-paced RPG experience.

name: Missing Exit
creator: Clique_Waylon
description: You've been locked inside the old manor and the only way out is to escape the maze before the creature prowling the halls finds you. Explore the corridors, collect the missing gems that power your exit, and stay one step ahead of something that never stops hunting. The longer it takes to escape, the more dangerous the halls become. The exit may be open, and your only hope is a race through the maze, fighting through hostile creatures as you move across the fog-shrouded ruins of an ancient civilization. Only the fastest will make it out alive.

name: Mobile Kombat
creator: izukingz
description: Mobile Kombat is a fast-paced fantasy fighting game where magical warriors battle across enchanted realms using powerful abilities and dynamic, mobile-friendly combat.

name: Mochi Match
creator: 13_Chris
description: Welcome to Mochi Masters, a vibrant match-3 puzzle world! Swap adjacent mochis to create combos, trigger cascades that auto-chain for bonus points, and unlock special mochis as you progress through 100 levels with escalating goals. Pick up to 2 boosters before each level, including Extra Moves, Hammer, and Color Bomb. Manage your lives, earn daily login rewards, compete in the weekly tournament, and climb the global leaderboard by earning stars. Your progress is always saved!

name: Monster Girl University: Battle League
creator: Fechin
description: You step into the role of a coach in a tactical digital collectible card battler. Recruit students from five unique universities - AnthroU, DemonU, FaerieU, UndeadU, and DracoU - each with its own playstyle and roster of monster girls. Combine duplicates of your recruits to unlock new powers, design your game-day lineup, and outmaneuver rival coaches on the campus quad. Climb the league ladder, earn rewards, and showcase your skills against AI-controlled rival schools in a game that blends the excitement of sports-season drama with the thrill of monster-girl collection. Customize your experience with settings for sound and music, and dive into the action now!

name: Monster Mash
creator: illylilly.2022
description: Get ready for a spooktacular challenge! You find yourself standing in a spooky cartoon graveyard, surrounded by crooked tombstones, dead trees, and pumpkins under a moonlit purple sky. As you start the game, monsters begin to appear – ghosts float up from graves, zombies pop up behind tombstones, and skeletons peek in from the sides of the screen. Tap them to earn points and make them disappear with a quick hit animation. The game gets progressively faster, with monsters spawning more frequently and staying visible for less time. If a monster disappears without being hit, you lose a life. You start with three lives, and the game ends when all lives are lost. Earn points to unlock new levels and face off against unique bosses, each with its own strengths and challenges. Defeat the boss to advance to the next level and earn bonus points. Compete on the global leaderboard and beat your high score! Monster Mash Mayhem features a soft, eerie blue/green glow around ghosts, randomly varied monster sizes for depth, and occasional soft jump scares. As you play, a wispy fog rises from the ground, adding to the spooky atmosphere. Will you emerge victorious and unlock the next level?

name: Monster Mayhem City
creator: Pickwick
description: You smash cities as a monster across four cities: New York, Tokyo, Paris, and Las Vegas. Battle Yeti, Moth, Gargoyle, and Neon Sign Monster bosses. Unlock Laser Eyes, Double Jump, Sonic Roar, and Damaging Dash abilities. Compete for top scores on the leaderboard, and keep your powers across runs to replay easier. Experience bonus rounds in each city, including New York's Statue of Liberty, Tokyo's Sensoji Temple, Paris' Eiffel Tower, and Las Vegas' Luxor Pyramid. Every day, face a fresh start with a 'DAY X' screen, and only your lives carry over to the next day. Up to 2 Military Tanks will roam the streets at a time, firing their cannons every 4-6 seconds when pointed at you. Days end with a dramatic transition: buildings fall to the ground, you freeze and become invincible, then the screen fades to black and shows the next day's card, unless it's a boss fight and you are granted a power, with a delay. You start in New York on Day 1 with no powers, and the game gets progressively tougher.

name: Monster Pinball Smash
creator: MikeyAce
description: 🎮 Welcome to Monster Pinball Smash! ⚡ Fast-paced pinball action meets monster-bashing chaos! 🕹️ This is definitely not your grandfather's pinball game. ☠️ Smash skeletons, battle monsters, and ricochet your pinball through action-packed levels! 🧱 And for you retro fans? Brick Breaker is here! 🎯 It's pinball mixed with arcade classics, monster battles, and nonstop fun! 🏆 Think you're good? Chase your high score, defeat the bosses, unlock every level, and keep coming back for new challenges! 🔥 Monster Pinball Smash. Play it today, only in Horizon Studio!

name: MonsterGirl Brigade
creator: Fechin
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure as a MonsterGirl Commander! Explore a vast, scrollable 2D map with a winding road and lush green-grass base, dotted with villages and encounter zones. Visit villages with unique buildings and NPCs, including a guild leader who offers quests and a mini-game gamble. Build your dream team of monster girls by unlocking new characters at special terminals in each village. Battle enemy squads on a 7×7 isometric grid and earn coins to strengthen your team. Your roster is always visible on the overworld, showing which girls are currently unlocked. Unlock new girls at the guild terminal and test your team in battle. Start with three girls unlocked and earn the rest through quests and battles. Navigate around decorative objects, interact with NPCs, and make choices that impact your adventure in MonsterGirl Questmaster.

name: MonsterGirl Waifu Harem Battler
creator: Fechin
description: In MGWHB, build your dream team of monster girls! Choose from 8 unique characters, each with their own stats, passive abilities, and special moves. Browse the squad builder, view each girl's illustration in a themed background, and battle enemy squads on a 7×7 isometric grid. Your girls gain XP and level up, with progress persisting between sessions up to level 20. Select cards, view their stats, and build your squad with Monster Squad Builder. Start your adventure with a stylish title screen featuring all 8 girls posed together dramatically, then dive into the action.

name: Mouse Trap Showdown
creator: Ag
description: Roll into a cozy, classic Christmas living room where Mouse Trap comes to life! Build a crazy trap, outsmart foes, and Trap Master the competition. Explore, interact, and trigger the chain reaction in action! Can you top the Mouse Trap High Scores leaderboard on the TV?

name: Movie Theatre Mystery
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Handle tasks as a movie theater worker and figure out who the imposter is

name: Mr. J.C.'s: Reel Rift
creator: Yoda G.
description: In Mr. J.C.'s: Reel Rift, go on roguelike fishing runs. Cast your line, catch species, and face a boss fish - your run ends when it escapes. Explore randomized lakes, unlock gear, and track your catches in a species journal. Earn coins to upgrade equipment and take on challenges. Will you land the biggest catch and earn Mr. J.C.'s legendary title?

name: Mr. J.C.'s Legendary Reel Tournament
creator: Yoda G.
description: You play **Mr. J.C.'s Legendary Reel Tournament**, a realistic 3D fishing adventure. Start at Peaceful Lake with Old Gus, then move to Mountain River, Coastal Bay, and Deep Ocean. Master a hybrid gameplay loop of calm moments and intense battles. Unlock new gear and locations as you progress through the story campaign. Earn coins to upgrade your equipment and take on challenges. The journey begins at Peaceful Lake, where Old Gus teaches you the basics in Chapter 1. Then, head to Mountain River,

name: Mr. J.C.'s : SaltwaterSmudge
creator: Yoda G.
description: Dive into Mr. J.C.'s : SaltwaterSmudge, where you fish in a serene lake, managing bait, tackle, and stamina to collect six realistic fish species. Upgrade gear at the fishing shop and compete in a weekly tournament with a global leaderboard and rewards for top players. Customize with music tracks, scenery backgrounds, and more.

name: Mr1000Tracks Adventure The Game
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Help Mr1000tracks escape FrogMan's Swamp, where ancient secrets await. Customize your character, master combat skills, and defeat powerful bosses. Explore the swamp, collect rewards, and unravel mysteries. Hunt small animals to restore health and face the Master Frog Boss to save the king! Discover hidden side quests, including The Lost Merchant and Clear the Camp. Equip yourself with items from enemy loot drops and treasure chests, and manage your inventory with a 24-slot grid. As you progress, experience a thrilling adventure with cinematic visuals, complete with bloom and vignette effects. Your journey culminates in a final showdown with the Master Frog Boss, and upon victory, you'll be greeted with a triumphant victory screen in the castle, surrounded by the king and queen.

name: Murder Mystery
creator: ⚡Lgzr
description: Alpha: October 31st, 2025 Beta: December 31st, 2025 Stable: March 1st, 2026

name: Murder VR - A Virtual Vendetta
creator: WanesWorld
description: "Murder VR" immerses players in a high-stakes virtual environment where they must navigate a suspenseful game of deception and strategy. Within this immersive world, three distinct roles emerge: the Killer, the Detective, and the Bystanders. The Killer, shrouded in stealth and cunning, prowls the digital landscape, seeking out unsuspecting victims to eliminate. Meanwhile, the Detective employs keen observation and deductive reasoning to uncover the identity of the murderer before it's too late. Caught in the crossfire, the Bystanders walk a tightrope, desperate to find the elusive weapon hidden within the game world to turn the tables on the killer and secure their own survival. As tension mounts and suspicions rise, players must rely on wit, strategy, and teamwork to outmaneuver their opponents and emerge triumphant in this thrilling game of survival.

name: My Alien Pet
creator: AbductM3
description: Care for a quirky alien pet! Choose from 5 pets - Glorp, Zyx, Moofa, Krebb, and a secret 5th pet, Voidling, unlockable after surviving 10 days. Customize their habitat with 3 themed rooms. Keep your pet alive by managing Hunger, Cleanliness, Happiness, and Potty Urgency stats through fun mini-games. Earn coins and shop for pet accessories and room decor. Compete with others to survive the longest and top the leaderboard! Complete daily quests for bonus coins.

name: My Jewellery Empire
creator: Parth Borda
description: Build and grow your jewelry empire where customers line up for your dazzling creations. Compete with rivals as every shop gets a fair share of eager buyers!

name: my Quest
creator: Austingra7x
description: Explore a 32-bit retro pixel art world! From Town Hub to Grasslands, battle foes and collect treasures. Master magical abilities and customize your hero with various tunic styles. Navigate through seamless overworld zones and encounter Green Slimes roaming the grassland. Unleash a powerful beam sword with sound effects, and run with a floating analog joystick or 8-directional D-pad. Discover hidden areas and take on quests, like finding the Haunted Mansion in the Misty Forest.

name: Endless City Ride
creator: kory2000pr
description: Speed through city streets on a racing superbike, dodging traffic and obstacles in an endless arcade challenge. You steer with a touch joystick while the bike accelerates automatically — focus is pure navigation. As you ride, the streets blur by and the challenges get tougher - faster cars, tighter gaps, and unexpected surprises. Your goal is simple: keep riding, beat your best time, and see how long you can survive. The city stretches out before you, a winding path of asphalt and adventure.

name: Mysterious Sites and the Ancient Astronaut Theory
creator: Gortiva
description: Walk through and discover some of the mysterious sites from around the world and thoughts on what the ancient astronaut theory suggests may have happened.

name: Witchy Cafe: Merge, Match & Brew
creator: XandriaHeart
description: Brew drinks to fill orders in a cozy witch's café! Merge ingredients to create drinks, then match them to score. Unlock power-ups and progress through levels with star ratings. Can you become the ultimate barista?

name: Mystic Catch
creator: Yoda G.
description: Welcome to Mystic Waters Bay, where the tranquility of a serene island meets the thrill of fishing. Explore three unique biomes: Tropical Reef, Frozen Tundra, and Misty Swamp. Cast your line, wait for a bite, and reel in a variety of fantastical fish, each with its own behaviors and challenges. As you catch fish, upgrade your island resort with tokens earned from your fishing adventures. Compete in daily timed challenges to test your skills against others and climb the leaderboard.

name: Mystic Tarot Reader
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Experience a mystical tarot card reading app. Select from various spread layouts like Celtic Cross, Three-Card Past/Present/Future, or Single Card daily draw. Each card shuffles independently; tap to stop and reveal. The full 78-card deck features unique artwork and descriptions. Cards can land upright or reversed, with a full reading summary combining all card meanings. Enjoy ambient mystical music, shuffle sounds, and satisfying card placement effects. Mystic Tarot Reader offers a rich, immersive experience for tarot enthusiasts.

name: Natufian Life
creator: metaversepaige
description: You build a thriving life with your loyal dog in an Natufian settlement at El-Wad cave on Mount Carmel. As the seasons change, you tend wild cereals, hunt for food, and repair your home. Complete tasks to fill the 'Life Built' meter and grow your bond with the dog. The elders share real Natufian knowledge daily. The settlement evolves across four seasons: Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter. Your daily contributions and dog's bond progression add to the experience. In this world, you don't just survive - you thrive. Each activity adds meaning to your life, from knapping flint to make your settlement safer, to hunting to feed your community. As you progress, your dog grows from a cautious companion to a loyal friend. With a dynamic day-night cycle and rare night events, every day is a new opportunity to build a life that will last. El Wad Life is where you cultivate a rich life.

name: Nebula Lander
creator: jimrif
description: Nebula Lander is a mobile-first, arcade-style game where you pilot a drone through a colorful nebula. Using a single tap, you apply thrust to fight gravity and land safely on platforms while collecting Stars and Points. Each level is handcrafted and filled with hazards: drifting asteroids, force zones that push and pull, and landing pads that demand a soft landing. Compete with friends and climb to the top of the custom leaderboards, which track the top 50 players per level. In addition to the core levels, Endless Dodge Mode offers a never-ending challenge where every run is different and survival is the only goal. Survive as long as you can while dodging asteroids and collecting fuel.

name: Neon Air Hockey
creator: AbductM3
description: Play air hockey in a futuristic neon-lit arena! Compete against a challenging bot on a dark midnight blue surface with electric purple accents. Use bright blue neon paddles to outmaneuver the bot and score 5 goals first. Your current level is displayed prominently at the top of the screen. Tap the frosted glass 'PLAY' button to start the game and show off your skills in Violet Strike!

name: Neon Beat Rhythm
creator: seemebro
description: Play beats

name: Neon Blaster
creator: PrometheusGMP.TM.CR
description: A fast-paced 60-second tap-to-shoot arcade game. Blast bouncing sci-fi drones before the timer runs out — the higher your score, the better your rank on the leaderboard. Watch for the warm hit burst when you connect and the cool cyan streak on a near miss!

name: Neon Dash
creator: 13_Chris
description: Dash through a neon-lit world of bold arcade challenges. You speed on a bright yellow floor across a deep navy background, dodging red spikes, orange moving walls, and magenta rotating hazards. Collect daily rewards and compete for the top spot on the leaderboard. Can you outrun the competition and become the ultimate champion? Experience the thrill of dual-pass platforms, where you can choose to jump over or run under obstacles.

name: Neon Drop
creator: 13_Chris
description: Tap to drop floors into a tower, aiming for perfect center hits in this flashy Vegas-themed one-tap arcade game. Unlock new tiers like the Casino Floor and Rooftop Pool as you progress. Swing speed increases and fireworks explode every 25 floors. Can you beat your high score in Highrise Hit?

name: Neon Nostalgia
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Step into Neon Nostalgia, a vibrant 90s arcade where you can play classic mini-games, earn tickets, and win awesome prizes. Explore a large indoor hall filled with 24 playable units, including 20 arcade cabinets and 4 big attractions like Bowling and Hoops. Enjoy food and drinks at the food court, lounge on couches, and dance to the beat on the color-cycling dance floor. Interact with 12 NPC regulars who live their own daily lives in the arcade. Every 10 minutes, experience a 2-minute Happy Hour where all ticket payouts are doubled. With its iconic 90s arcade carpet, neon lights, and retro sounds, Neon Nostalgia is the perfect place to relive the nostalgia of a bygone era.

name: Neon Paddle
creator: B_a_r_t
description: Bounce, break and build your combo through twelve handcrafted boards in four neon zones. Slide the cyan paddle, catch a temporary WIDE boost and keep the ball alive through changing brick patterns. Earn an extra life at each new zone and practise unlocked boards. An original soundtrack, glowing arcade effects and quick retries fill a portrait screen.

name: Neon Ring Tap
creator: ViciousVixenn
description: In Neon Ring Tap, tap the glowing circle when the closing ring meets its edge in this neon-drenched rhythm game. Earn points and build combos as the speed increases. Challenge your timing in a dreamy synthwave world with satisfying sound effects. You can track your score, combos, and lives as you play, and compete to achieve the highest score. Neon Ring Tap features a vibrant, glowing circle at the center of the screen with a pulsing ring that closes in. Simple, one-touch gameplay. Tap at the right moment = "PERFECT!" in glowing text; Miss = combo breaks, lose a life. Score combo multiplier, speed ramps up over time.

name: Neon Streets
creator: daddy26764
description: You play as a chibi tourist in Times Square at night, navigating through crowds and taxis to collect glowing souvenirs like I❤️NY hats, pretzels, and cameras. Use the left and right arrow buttons to move instantly. Your goal is to score points by collecting items while avoiding damage from taxis and crowds. Explore the vibrant streets of New York City, complete with neon-lit billboards and lively sound effects. Neon Run offers a fun, upbeat experience with jazzy/city BGM.

name: Neon Streets 3D
creator: daddy26764
description: In Neon Streets 3D, you navigate glowing neon streets, gather scattered objects, and dodge fast-moving cars and pedestrians. The camera follows you from behind, giving you a clear view of the streets ahead and incoming threats. The aesthetic is dark streets lit by electric blues, pinks, and cyans—immersive and arcade-like. Neon Streets 3D is a third-person cyberpunk collection game.

name: Neon Tap Frenzy
creator: NamasteVibes
description: In Neon Tap Frenzy, you memorize & replay dazzling sequences of neon tiles in a 4x4 grid, progressing through 12 levels of increasing challenge. Tap tiles in the exact order, with 3 lives per level. Unlock fireworks & leaderboard glory! Can you master the rhythm & beat level 12?

name: Neon Territory Wars
creator: AbductM3
description: Compete in a vibrant arena, drawing trails to claim territory while outsmarting opponents. Connect your trail back to your territory to fill in new land, but beware - exposed trails can get you eliminated. Outmaneuver bots and other players to claim 100% of the map. Enjoy fast, competitive gameplay with glowing particle effects and electronic sound effects. Play Territory Showdown now and dominate the arena!

name: NERF WARS
creator: TanzerVR
description: Foam Dart War with slingshots, guns, cannons, Target practice

name: Never Let Go
creator: creativeCharm
description: Swing, sensei!

name: Night Flight
creator: Malkavious
description: You navigate a dark city as a vampire, choosing from four characters with unique abilities. Explore the city, overcome challenges, and embrace the night. The environment shifts every three stages, from dark alleyways to metro/downtown, waterfront, and urban residential areas. Collect power-ups to permanently increase your speed. Your abilities are highlighted with a glowing outline when ready to use. Aerial enemies have been replaced with animated Second Inquisition quadcopter drones. Play as Alexia, Mal, Tristan, or Victoria, each with their own stride style and 8-frame run animations.

name: Nightfall Ludo Showdown
creator: Chinnaaa.2023
description: In Nightfall Ludo Showdown, you play a spooky-fun portrait-first 2D Ludo game against three bots on a glowing neon Halloween board. Choose from eight chilling horror characters: Hollow Mask, Night Butcher, Miss Nevermore, Lake Warden, Dream Burner, Porcelain Widow, Harvest Jack, and Grave Nurse. Roll the dice, move your pawns strategically, and capture your opponents' pawns to win. Enjoy custom animations, sound effects, and a thrilling gameplay experience in Nightfall Ludo Showdown.

name: NightmareMaze 2.5D Retro Shooter
creator: 8bitvapor
description: A Horizon Studio game, I pushed the 2D generator to make a 2.5D fake 3D game similar to games on the Super Nintendo FX chip

name: Nimbal's Rat Trap
creator: TheRealMadCat
description: Explore the four levels, game board, kitchen, garden and the spooky cheese cellar maze, outsmart mischievous rats, and solve puzzles to catch them. Navigate a large 24x22 board grid and a maze with branching paths, avoid ghosts, cats, sticky jam, mud, and collect trap pieces to set the trap. Earn cheese, candy corn, strawberries, and compete on the leaderboard. Use power-ups like broomsticks, and make strategic choices at junctions to outsmart the rats. Can you escape the haunted cheese cellar and the other levels, get through the mouse hole first and claim victory? In this digital board & mini puzzle game, you will guide Nimbal the mouse to victory and trap all of the rats!

name: Nine Lives Till Midnight
creator: Cruxian
description: A survivors-like bullet heaven. Control a magical cat evolving into a cyborg hybrid, dodging enemies and collecting experience to upgrade powers. Choose from six original abilities, each with five levels, and combine them to defeat a challenging mini-boss. Explore a large, dynamic world from a top-down perspective, focusing on movement and strategy. As you level up, your cat transforms with new mutations. Master your skills and take down the boss in Cyborg Cat Rampage.

name: No Beef - A Conflict Resolution Game
creator: creativeCharm
description: When conflict arises, how well do you simmer your emotional embers. Will you let it slide or do something about it? Your path to peaceful relationships starts now!

name: No Visitors After Dark
creator: creativeCharm
description: Tap any open window, guess if the tenant is home orif it's a visitor. You have 60 seconds to solve the mystery.

name: Nokita Snake Garage
creator: 𝓙𝓸𝓻𝓭𝓪𝓷𝓑0101
description: You're sitting cross-legged on a giant snake, like a throne, with multiple neon snakes in the background, casting a teal and gold glow. You hold a custom Nokita phone, with a lime-green LCD play area set against a dark frame. The game unfolds as you start playing, with a dark atmospheric neon design with NOKITA glow, pixel stars, and a grid showcasing in the top portion of the background. Your avatar character stands at the bottom, holding their phone with a giant pixel snake beside them.

name: Not So Secret Meta Santa
creator: creativeCharm
description: Earn holiday coin as you enjoy gifting , playing games and enjoying the holiday season with other Meta Santas and get something special for another Santa in the metaverse!

name: Zipah DeeDue
creator: Yoda G.
description: Run, jump, and stomp to earn high scores in this fast-paced challenge. Compare your progress on the Global and This device tabs, and compete to beat your personal best.

name: NOVA STRIKE
creator: 8bitvapor
description: In Asteroid Blast, you pilot a ship through a 3D starfield, avoiding and destroying tumbling asteroids. The game features a virtual joystick for control, a wave system that increases asteroid speed and number over time, and a leaderboard to track your high scores. Enjoy retro-modern PSX-style graphics and immersive audio.

name: Nuggy Rush: A Golden Trail Adventure
creator: Varun
description: A mining game where you play as a frontier miner named Eugene "Nuggy" Smith who is trying to keep an impossible promise to his Ma — building her a house of gold!

name: Catch or Dodge
creator: Kiss
description: Tap to move a catcher at the bottom of the screen, catching glowing coins, gems, and stars while dodging bombs, spikes, and hazards. Earn points and streaks, and survive as long as possible with 3 lives. Difficulty ramps up every 10 seconds, with faster objects and more dangers. Can you beat your high score in Catch or Dodge?

name: NYC.Apartment 🌃
creator: Deleted User
description: Hangout and relax in NYC.

name: Obby Core Lab: Remixable
creator: jimrif
description:
Play it. Remix it. Build your own obby.

Obby Core Lab: Remixable is both an obby to play and a flexible foundation to build on. Test your skills with classic obby mechanics. Then take it further — remix the world to design new stages, customize mechanics, and create your own unique obby. Whether you're here to play or craft the next great course, Obby Core Lab: Remixable is where it all begins.

name: Obby Pop
creator: 13_Chris
description: Conquer 50 thrilling obstacle levels and test your skills against the course. Perfect your runs, hit every checkpoint, and go for the clean finish! Join the discord! https://bit.ly/Join13VrCreations Follow me on my Socials 13_Chris or 13_Chris.VR

name: OBN Hotel VR
creator: obeymynuts
description: Welcome to OBN VR Hotel — the ultimate virtual party & roleplay spot! Check in, earn loyalty points, decorate your room, climb the leaderboards, and hang with friends. Daily events, VIP rooms, and free avatar swag. Up to 12 players — join the fun now! (Mobile + VR)

name: Ocean View Bingo Trimesh
creator: T̷H̷3̷_̷S̷A̷N̷D̷_̷M̷A̷N̷
description:
Step aboard Ocean View Bingo, where the excitement of bingo meets the luxury of life at sea. Set on a stunning super yacht surrounded by breath taking ocean views, this is more than just a game—it's a social destination.

Gather with friends, meet new players from around the world, and enjoy a lively atmosphere filled with laughter, great conversations, and unforgettable bingo sessions. Feel the anticipation build as every number is called while relaxing on the deck of a beautiful yacht designed for fun and community.

Join us throughout the year for monthly themed events, seasonal celebrations, holiday parties, and special community nights that keep every visit fresh and exciting.

Whether you're here to play, socialize, or simply enjoy the relaxing ocean atmosphere, Ocean View Bingo is the perfect place to unwind and make lasting memories.

🌊 Set Sail. Socialize. Play. Experience Ocean View Bingo.
Your next adventure starts here.

name: Goblin Excuse Engine
creator: hyperjoule
description: You round the corner and find yourself in a crazy office as a tiny green goblin, making up wild excuses for wacky workplace mishaps. Spell words from letter tiles to fill in the blanks and survive absurd performance reviews. Can you keep your job? In LexiBlame, face accusations like 'Why is the printer full of bees?' and come up with creative excuses. With handmade office supply collage art and sharp, absurd humor, play on a single portrait screen with 45-second rounds. Your goal is to find as many different words as possible before time runs out, then face the boss's rubber-stamp verdict. V3

name: One More Box!
creator: Kiss
description: Sort packages on a conveyor belt by tapping or swiping left or right. Simple, fast, and replayable, with a modern aesthetic and electronic beats. Beat your high score and challenge yourself to just one more round! In **One More Box**, you'll experience the thrill of quick sorts, with increasing speed and attention required. Can you keep your streak going and beat your high score?

name: Oopsie Jumpsie: Multiplayer
creator: Mikolaj
description: Oopsie Jumpsie is a fast and cheerful hop-and-dash game inspired by Crossy Road and Frogger. Jump forward across moving rides, drifting boats and quirky theme-park lanes - timing every step to stay alive. It's simple: ✅ Tap to hop ✅ Dodge everything ✅ Go as far as you can The further you go, the wilder it gets. How long can you survive the pastel chaos? 🎪💦 Jump in - and don't look back!

name: Operation Toybox
creator: 8bitvapor
description: You find yourself in a festive snowy village, where Santa's toybox has burst open and toys are scattered everywhere. Your mission is to round up these runaway toys by gazing at them, tapping the big red WRAP button, and watching them pop into gift boxes with a 'WRAPPED!' popup. Earn points, build a streak, and compete for the best scores in Timed, Endless, and Toy Rush modes.

name: Oracle's Gambit: Horizon Chess Club
creator: SeeingBlue
description: Play Chess against your friends or AI! Rank up after each win and join the chess club! Chess Club Community: https://blunet.studio/chess

name: Orb Frenzy
creator: Pickwick
description: You tap your way to glory in Rhythm Rush! You start with a 3-second countdown, and then orbs burst onto the screen in timed waves. Tap in rhythm to build combos and rack up points. With a larger tap area and longer orb display time, you can focus on the fun. See how high you can score in this neon-lit reflex challenge! Rhythm Rush is all about timing and precision, so get ready to immerse yourself in the beat and beat the clock!

name: Orb Heist
creator: WanesWorld
description: In the dimly lit alleys of a pixelated underworld, a mysterious heist unfolds. You collect abstract orbs with rarity-based colors, from gray to rainbow, and watch them generate passive income on pedestals in your base. Upgrade your conveyor, defenses, and speed to outsmart rival gangs and raid their vaults for the rarest orbs. As your 'grudge' level escalates, so does the challenge - but with daily login rewards, Vault Rush events, and a collection gallery to drive your pursuit of the ultimate Secret creature, the thrill of the heist never fades. Will you balance defense and growth, or take risks for greater rewards? The endless tycoon journey awaits in Orb Heist.

name: ORIX - Rope Rush & Sky Obby
creator: 𝓙𝓸𝓻𝓭𝓪𝓷𝓑0101
description: Welcome to Orix, the ultimate space challenge! Jump across glowing laser ropes, conquer epic sky obbies, and test your courage on fragile glass bridges. Each level pushes your skills to the limit as you race to reach checkpoints and climb your way to victory. One wrong move... and it's a long fall back. Please be respectful to other players and remember this game is all about having fun. Let's keep it positive and enjoy the adventure together!

name: Overgrown Mutant Ninja Lizards
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Play as Leon, Mitch, Ralph, or Drew, four unique mutant ninja lizards. Master your virtual joystick, ATTACK button, and JUMP ability to take down enemies and battle epic bosses. Explore five stages, from a burning building to sewers, rooftops, laboratories, and a final lair. Earn a 'YOU WIN!' celebration and unlock an ending slideshow. Experience an intro slideshow that sets the stage for your adventure. Your AI teammate lizard fights alongside you automatically. Mutant Ninja Frenzy awaits - are you ready to join the battle in Lizard Ninja Frenzy?

name: Overgrown! Lawn Cutter Simulator
creator: AbductM3
description: Mow overgrown lawns, collect clippings, and upgrade your mower in this casual simulation game. Explore a large, grassy field and customize your mower. Unlock new areas and compete for best mowing times. Shop for upgrades like engine speed, cutting deck width, and clippings bag capacity. Earn coins, level up, and prestige to boost your earnings in Lawn Masters.

name: Ms. Woman
creator: Yoda G.
description: You navigate Ms.Woman through a maze, chomping pellets and ghosts to earn Pac-Stars. Unlock skins, extra lives, and power-ups with your stars. Leaderboards track your high score, and daily quests challenge you to eat 200 pellets for bonus points. Will you top the charts?

name: Pac-Man Frenzy
creator: PrometheusGMP.TM.CR
description: Get ready to navigate a classic arcade maze in Pac-Man Frenzy! You control Pac-Man as he moves through bright, retro-colored corridors, collecting pellets while avoiding four ghosts patrolling with mixed behavior. Chomping power pellets gives you a temporary edge to turn the tables on your ghostly pursuers. Your goal? Collect all the pellets to win! With a vibrant, top-down view and responsive touch controls, can you outsmart the ghosts and emerge victorious?

name: Paddle Mayhem!
creator: LimTaEu
description: Paddle your physics-based boat through a chaotic obstacle course as you clumsily compete or ram into your enemies!

name: Pancake Catcher
creator: OdiseaJ
description: You play a game where pancakes fall from the sky in three columns. Your goal is to catch pancakes of the same color as your plate using left and right arrow buttons. If you catch a wrong-color pancake or a hazardous item like orange juice, a 'Wrong Color!' or 'Wrong Item!' message appears, and your plate shudders. Catching the right pancake makes a success sound and creates a sparkle burst. Can you beat your high score in Pancake Frenzy?

name: Panda Bridge Quest
creator: AbductM3
description: You play as a kawaii panda, building bridges with bamboo sticks to cross widening gaps between forest platforms. Grow a stick by holding down, release to drop it. Reach the top in this serene forest with cozy background music and satisfying sound effects. Compete with others in the Top Pandas leaderboard, accessible from the title screen

name: Pandoku
creator: WanesWorld
description: In Pandoku 🐼, you place pandas in a grid divided into colored regions. Each region gets one panda. No two pandas can share a row, column, or touch each other. You start with 3 lives and one free panda placed. Wrong placements cost one life. Enjoy relaxing music and cute sound effects as you unwind with this logic puzzle game. Play on a 5x5 grid in Easy mode, with bigger grids for harder difficulties. Advance through 5 levels, each with a unique puzzle, and celebrate your victories along the way! Finish all 5 levels to unlock a special trophy celebration!

name: PANERAI BACKGAMMON
creator: 𝓙𝓸𝓻𝓭𝓪𝓷𝓑0101
description: Play premium-quality 2D Backgammon on mobile. Choose from three AI difficulties or play with a friend. Enjoy smooth animations, intuitive touch controls, and a luxurious dark design in Panerai Backgammon.

name: PANERAI MATCH BOX
creator: 𝓙𝓸𝓻𝓭𝓪𝓷𝓑0101
description: Rotate 3D cubes, memorize hidden symbols, and find matching pairs in a sleek, minimalist environment. Progress through levels with increasing difficulty, unlock cosmetic rewards, and compete for the best scores.

name: PANERAI POKER
creator: JordanB0101
description: Step into the high-stakes world of Panerai Poker Showdown! You enter a luxurious virtual poker room and take a seat at a stunning 2D oval felt table in landscape 16:9 orientation. Compete against five AI opponents with different play styles, all playing by legal poker rules without seeing your hidden cards. Master the game, claim daily rewards, and track your progress in this immersive poker experience with a fresh new look - everything is bigger and better in landscape mode!

name: Paper Peak
creator: Jacob G
description: Stack paper shapes on a mountain pedestal. Choose left, center, or right placement, with a center-of-mass indicator. Play 12 challenges in 3 chapters, with level selection, unlocks, and optional medals. No networking or purchases.

name: Paranormal Evidence Hunter
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: v1.23 - Updated Menu Layouts - Haptic Feedbacks Added - XP Reward System - Updated Reward System - New Spirit Radio Scanner Mini Game Added Paranormal Evidence Hunter is a supernatural investigation game where every shadow could be evidence and every mistake could make the haunting stronger. Study case clues, track moving spirits through your Spectral Evidence Camera, and identify the correct entity before it disappears. Capture clear photographs of facial manifestations, spectral cores, and rare paranormal anomalies to earn evidence points and unlock more dangerous investigations. But choose carefully. Photographing the wrong spirit creates a false positive, while escaped entities increase the paranormal activity surrounding the case. Master each investigation, complete your Spirit Dossier, and prove that you have what it takes to document what lurks beyond the veil.

name: Parry Storm
creator: WanesWorld
description: In the heart of a circular arena, a storm orb hurtles towards you, its red glow signaling an imminent impact. Timing is everything – press parry to deflect it and survive. With each successful deflection, the orb accelerates, increasing the challenge. Miss the parry and lose a heart. Earn shards to unlock abilities like Dash, Shield, and Slow-Mo, and progress through waves. The Storm Parry Gauntlet awaits your reflexes and strategy.

name: Party House Fun
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Explore a colorful kawaii party house, chat with AI guests, and play no-fail mini-games. The party never stops, with guests dancing, snacking, and playing whether you join or watch. Enjoy quick sessions of fun, judgment-free gameplay.

name: Party Kingdom
creator: Lena
description:
🎉Join the chaos🤪! Multiple games in one crazy 🥳Party Kingdom🎊!
🙌Earn frenzy points!
🤼Score higher than your friends!
🧁Magic brawls!
🪜Obby!
🚦Red light Green light!
🎈Balloon popper!
🔨Nail the boards!
🔥Keep the fire burning!
📋And so much more!
🥳Created with chaos by Kluge games🥳

name: Patina
creator: NickteaVR
description: Restore famous paintings by cleaning grime with magical brushes in a vibrant artist's studio. Earn rewards, unlock levels, and show off skills in this puzzle game.

name: Pawn Shop Empire
creator: mommy26764
description:
👑 PAWN SHOP EMPIRE 💰
Buy Low. Sell High. Build Your Empire!
Welcome to Pawn Shop Empire, where every customer brings a new opportunity, every deal is a gamble, and hidden treasures could make you rich!
Start with a small pawn shop and work your way up to becoming the ultimate pawn shop tycoon!
💵 BUY & NEGOTIATE – Customers bring in everything from everyday electronics to rare antiques, valuable jewelry, collectibles, and priceless treasures. Negotiate the best deals and maximize your profits!
💎 DISCOVER HIDDEN TREASURES – Take chances on mysterious items that could be worth a fortune... or practically nothing!
🔍 WATCH FOR COUNTERFEITS – Not everything that glitters is gold! Inspect suspicious merchandise and avoid expensive mistakes!
🏆 LEVEL UP YOUR EMPIRE – Unlock 100 different items across five progression levels, from Beginner Pawn Shop to Pawn Shop Empire!
🛍️ UPGRADE YOUR SHOP – Invest in improvements, sharpen your appraisal skills, and attract customers with increasingly valuable merchandise!
📈 BUILD YOUR FORTUNE – Buy low, sell high, track your profits, grow your net worth, and turn your humble shop into a thriving business!
🎯 THE CHALLENGE: Can you spot a hidden fortune, outsmart tough negotiators, avoid costly fakes, and build the ultimate Pawn Shop Empire?
Every item has a story. Every deal has a risk. Every fortune starts somewhere!
👑 PAWN SHOP EMPIRE — THE DEAL IS YOURS!

name: Peaceful Forest
creator: Nekerv2017
description: You step onto a serene Pacific Northwest old-growth forest trail, surrounded by towering trees. As you walk, over 150 white-tailed deer roam or graze in clearings, their static models creating a peaceful atmosphere. Small creatures like squirrels and rabbits dart through the underbrush. As you approach, some wildlife startles and flees, while larger ones watch warily before staying calm. The mix of wildlife and their behaviors creates a dynamic forest experience. Nearby, a mud-spattered Can-Am Outlander ATV is parked, ready for you to drive through the forest. Grab the joystick to steer and use the jump button to exit back to on-foot.

name: Peglite
creator: Cyklone
description: Peglite is a casual puzzle game where players must shoot out a ball that bounces on pegs which increase score and with combos and special abilities the player must reach a certain score threshold to get to the next level. Be careful though as with limited amount of shots per round you must aim carefully.

name: Pet Agility(FINAL)
creator: wallmasterr (Alastair Low)
description: Pick your pet and get it through the course in the quickets time. Licence CC-BY

name: Pet Pals Tycoon
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Welcome to Pet Pals Tycoon, the cutest animal care adventure! Adopt, train, and care for adorable pets - puppies, kittens, bunnies, and more. Build, expand, and upgrade your dream pet facility with toys, pools, and attractions. Spin the daily wheel for exciting rewards, and compete in adrenaline-pumping pet races! Will you become the ultimate Pet Pals billionaire?

name: Petes Revenge Pinball
creator: Pickwick
description: Step up to Pete's Revenge Pinball, shoot some pool, and change the channel... it IS his living room after all. Go to the top of the leaderboard and win your bragging rights. When Pete's not around, you're home free! Let's Play! 🎮

name: Phrase Code
creator: MetaNewby
description: Crack the code, reveal the phrase! PHRASE CODE is a word-puzzle adventure in a crystal nebula: a hidden phrase's letters are numbered, every clue answer uses those same letters, and one right letter lights up everywhere. Take on 80 puzzles across Sports, Literature, History and Pop Culture. Earn rank, spend hints wisely, chase the fastest clean solve on the leaderboards, and learn the story behind every phrase. A guided tutorial starts you off, and your progress saves automatically.

name: PICK OF THE PATCH 2024
creator: TanzerVR
description: Jack-o-lanterns made by the community. Pick your favorite to be made the heads of the scarecrows for 2024. This year we have 3 categories: SPOOKIEST, CREATIVITY, AND MOST FUN

name: Pick Your Poison
creator: Nekerv2017
description: Teamwork is the key to this world! The world can be played with 2-8 players (1 player possible but not recommended). You are stuck in a curious hotel created by the mysterious Astaroth, where you'll have to survive his game and reach the last room. To succeed, you'll need to maintain your sanity AND eat right. Pay attention to your effects... this world is full of surprises.

name: PICNIC PUNDERLAND
creator: TanzerVR
description: Throughout the world are fun food characters with PUNny names. Your job is to match the names with each character!

name: Picture Perfect
creator: 𝓙𝓸𝓻𝓭𝓪𝓷𝓑0101
description: 🧩 Picture Perfect: Puzzle World Explore a world of beautiful puzzles! Choose your favorite pictures from stunning homes, nature, cities, space, and more. Select your difficulty, drag and match the pieces, and complete the picture as fast as you can! Beat the clock, earn stars, and challenge yourself with exciting puzzles for all skill levels.

name: Pie In the Face!
creator: TanzerVR
description: Its Game Night. Try not to get creamed in this new take on a family fun favorite!

name: Pie In The Sky Tycoon
creator: natashagubernov
description:
12/12 UPDATE!
BUY CHRISTMAS THEMED ITEMS
bugz fix: plots wouldn't clean up when players left
It's the sweetest most customizable restaurant tycoon game in the sky!

name: Pier Pressure
creator: WanesWorld
description: You settle into the Pier Pressure, rod in hand, as the bioluminescent fish swim by. Your new fisher character, the Classic Hooded Angler, stands patiently beside you, rod on shoulder. The dynamic tension meter fills as you wait for a bite, with daily weather events and legendary windows flashing on the horizon. Catch over 100 species, display your rarest catches in an aquarium, and experience a full coin economy with rod, bait, and upgrade purchases. Dive into the mystery of the deep, where every catch could be a treasure. At Pier Pressure, you can explore a variety of fishing mechanics, including Perfect/Good/Missed strike grading, scaling wait times by zone and bait type, and a bestiary with 100 slots. You can also experience a full coin economy, with fish sell values, rod/bait/upgrade prices, login streak rewards, and event coin bonuses.

name: Pigeon Picnic Heist
creator: B_a_r_t
description: Play as a cheeky pigeon on a 60-second mission to steal picnic food in a vibrant park. Explore, collect crumbs, sandwiches, and pastries while avoiding hazards. Earn combo bonuses and manage your 3 hearts with invulnerability periods. Choose from Relaxed, Standard, and Spicy modes. Cartoon Capers music plays quietly in the background.

name: Pinball Wizard
creator: daddy26764
description: Play a classic pinball machine with a retro arcade vibe! Launch the ball, use flipper timing to keep it in play, and chase high scores through combo multipliers and ramp chains. The table features ramps, bumpers, spinners, and multiball mode, all wrapped in a bright neon 1980s aesthetic. Your goal is to reach the highest score possible in this pure pinball mastery experience.

name: Pink Doll House Remixed
creator: tmwheeler1
description: Remix to make this house your own.

name: Pirate Peril
creator: emorgul
description: Jump into this unique action-puzzle game, where you and your friends race for gold while avoiding cannon balls from the pirate hunters.

name: Pirates Cove
creator: Captain.Jack.Sparrow
description: Battle players, shoot birds, find the mermaid, collect gold, grapple around the map and earn your status as a pirate to get personal weapons

name: Pitfall Jungle Run
creator: Yoda G.
description: Run through the jungle, dodging pits, logs, scorpions, and snakes while collecting distance points. Control your character with a virtual joystick and jump button. Compare your skills with others on the global leaderboard.

name: Pixel Arcade
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Step into a retro arcade with PIXEL ARCADE 4-IN-1! Choose from basketball, soccer, football, and hockey, each with 4-minute matches against the CPU. Enjoy chunky pixel art, sport-specific controls, and leaderboards for each game. Easily switch between sports and exit back to the arcade. Your progress is saved with player-persistent variables, so you can pick up where you left off.

name: Pixel Maze Runner
creator: spiritual_kokopelli
description:
Run through the vibrant maze with your friends🤝, collect pixels🟦, and escape from the glitches!🎉

Players can enjoy two different ways to play:
🏃: Runner: Your goal is to collect all the pixels on the stage while escaping from the glitches. Acquire power pixels to turn the tide!
👾: Glitch: Your objective is to catch the runners.

Enjoy this 3D maze adventure that reinterprets the charm of dot-collecting games by collecting items and unlocking special helmets!

Join The Community: https://discord.gg/8WXfjzxegF

name: Pixel Pioneer
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: Explore ancient ruins through three levels: Jungle, Lava Temple, and Flooded Ruins. Swing across gaps, avoid foes like the Stone Golem, and navigate rising water. Unlock new levels and discover more challenges. The explorer character has walk, run, jump, and fall animations. You can choose which level to play from the title screen. A HUD shows your best score and total gems collected.

name: Pixel Pioneers
creator: Yoda G.
description: Pixel Pioneers is a classic 2D side-scrolling platformer where you run, jump, and navigate through a vibrant pixelated world. Collect coins, discover hidden power-ups, and avoid obstacles as you make your way to the end of each level in this nostalgic, fast-paced adventure.

name: Pixel Quest
creator: WanesWorld
description: You find yourself standing at the edge of a grand, castle-topped hill, with lush green terrain rolling out before you. The sky above is a brilliant blue, dotted with big, fluffy clouds. As you look out, you see that the landscape stretches out into the distance, with floating islands and sparkling coins waiting to be collected. Your adventure begins here, in a world of endless possibility.

name: Pixel Quest
creator: Austingra7x
description: You launch GameForge and find yourself in the 'Create Your Game' screen, where you choose a game type to get started. Pick Platformer, Shooter, Puzzle, or Runner, and your concept description appears at the top of the level editor as a reminder while you build. Dive into the world of game creation with a user-friendly editor, chiptune music, and customizable player characters. Explore demo levels, enemies, coins, and goal flags, and compete for the best time with a 300-second timer.

name: PixelLand VR
creator: 😈𝒢𝒾𝑔𝑔𝓁𝑒𝓈_86😈
description:
Welcome to Pixelland VR!

Step into a bright and colorful pixel world full of fun! Pixelland VR is a happy, adventure-packed obby game where you can jump, climb, and explore exciting pixel-themed levels made just for fun. Each level is filled with cool obstacles, silly challenges, and fun quests to complete.

What you'll find in Pixelland VR:
Colorful pixel worlds to explore
Fun and easy-to-play obby levels
Quests that unlock cool rewards
A playful VR adventure for everyone

More fun coming soon!
New levels and themes are being built right now. The first level is finished and ready to play, so jump in and start your adventure today!

Have fun, explore, and enjoy the magic of Pixelland VR!

name: Pixi The Fox: Parkour
creator: PixiFox
description: Run, jump, and slide through a spooky haunted mansion! Collect coins, bounce off springs, and time your jumps to clear tricky gaps while avoiding ghost patrols and crumbling platforms. Explore a decaying Victorian mansion at night, with a stormy sky, dark mansion silhouette, and graveyard foreground. Can you make it to the finish?

name: Planet Droblet
creator: Gortiva
description: Explore the lost unexplored Planet Droblet and find all the local alien friends. :)

name: Plants!
creator: Habitor
description:
Plants! is a cozy cooperative game about growing plants, catching bugs, and relaxing in a beautiful greenhouse environment.

- Grow and sell plants to earn Seed Money, which you can then use to unlock new plants!
- Search the greenhouse for critters to earn Bug Points and become the top Entomologist!
- Seek out the elusive Orchid Mantis. You'll need to grow a special plant to attract them to the greenhouse...
- Level up to unlock awesome bonus plants!

Produced by HabitXr

Game Design/Lead Dev: Habitor
Lead 3d Artist: SpaceGlitterUnicorn
3d Artist: MKE_TheGuru
Mobile Optimization: PigeonNo12

name: Plate Patrol
creator: Briandoesit
description: Speed through Harbor Night district in your police cruiser, weaving through traffic. Encounter various cars, respond to emergencies, and customize your cruiser. Earn money, level up, and tackle challenging cases. Experience a dynamic music system and adaptive challenges with a dynamic music system.

name: Platformin Adventure
creator: Austingra7x
description: Embark on a vibrant journey through 8 themed worlds, from lush grasslands to scorching deserts and treacherous dungeons. Master the art of platforming with intuitive mobile controls, and challenge yourself to overcome increasingly difficult levels. Collect coins, defeat enemies, and reach the goal flag to progress. Will you become the ultimate Pixel Pioneer?

name: Plunderfall
creator: WanesWorld
description: Plunderfall, a solo plinko-roguelike board game. Drop marbles through a peg-filled board, collecting Doubloons and upgrading your chute and pegs. Spin the board to steer your marbles towards the highest payouts. Compete for daily high scores and collect rare marbles to unlock new perks.

name: Pocket Flood
creator: Jacob G
description: Drain a tile to score its water, but each move raises neighboring tiles. Watch the rising water and prevent overflows across a 5x5 board. You have three lives and 45 seconds to chase a higher score. Retry and rethink your next drain.

name: Pocket RC Cars
creator: Pastew [Pocket RC Cars]
description: Arcade-style RC racing. Master each track to climb the leaderboard!

name: Pocket RC Cars / RC Playground
creator: Pastew [Pocket RC Cars]
description: RC car, plane, drone, easy to customize, create your own gameplay!

name: Pocket Weather
creator: Jacob G
description: Guide rain through three small weather puzzles. Place a cloud, choose the wind and forecast to water every crop while keeping the campfire dry. Match the turbine direction, plan around roofs, and use Undo or Restart to refine your solution. Beat each puzzle with forecasts to spare.

name: Pool
creator: SeeingBlue
description: Play a relaxed game of 8-ball against the computer or a friend on the same device. Choose from three difficulty levels, sharpen your shots in practice, and tackle 12 skill challenges to unlock new table and cue colors.

name: Poptopia
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: You tap into a vibrant 90's inspired bubble popping game. Colorful bubbles float up from the bottom of the screen - tap them to pop and earn points! As you play, combos give you a multiplier up to 5x, and the game gets harder every 15 seconds. Keep an eye on your score (top left) and 3 heart lives (top right). When the game ends, see your final score, high score, and restart. The game features bubbly background music, silly pop sounds, and fun sound effects. Poptopia is the perfect blend of fun and nostalgia.

name: Humans And Portals 2.0 AI (18+)
creator: Gortiva
description: Play humans and portals with some Ai Alien Friends!

name: Portalz: Into the Metaverse
creator: joshkap510
description:
🚨Content Update #1 is now live!🚨

This progression packed update introduces daily rewards, a player inventory, expanded shop options, collectible power up cards, overhauled checkpoints, a post level reward cutscene, and so much more!

Portalz: Into the Metaverse is a single player mobile platformer with 20 chaotic levels full of traps, collectibles, and mind-bending obstacles. One player. Twenty worlds. Can you handle the madness?

name: Poster Quiz
creator: voytek.lorenc (metacrafters)
description: How many movie posters can you guess?

name: POTION LEGENDS: Voss & Voss
creator: mixlab
description:
CURRENTLY PLAYTESTING! FEEDBACK WELCOME!

Explore the rich history of Valon in Valyn, on the planet Yarra. Join Sati and Pati, Mira Voss' great grandparents (in their prime), as they perfect their craft, a family tradition that will continue for centuries!

🌿Collect Ingredients!🌿
🫖Craft Potions!🫖
⚔️Defend the village from the Armies of Amadox!⚔️

...
It was a thousand years ago,
In the land of Valyn!
A kingdom of magic and splendor therein.

Yarra, the planet,
An extraordinary sphere,
Enchantment, and magic,
Every day of every year.
A world of life and wonder,
It is said that the water here,
On every pier,
Runs crystal clear,
And brings good cheer!

They also say that the atmosphere,
Shines with all of the colors,
Through the mist!
And that only in Valyn,
Are things that nowhere else exist!

Even the roads hold ancient secrets
With every winding twist.
Like a canvas of starlight,
By ancient magic kissed.

Aye that was me own eye,
That looked upon that view.
For I have been there too.
I tell you,
The stories they tell are true!

The light from the suns on Arra,
Heals all!
And grants long life!
Magical mist that floats along the plains,
So thick you could cut it with a knife!

There are trees with leaves,
Of a silvery sheen,
Which whisper ancient secrets
To creatures unseen.
They shower blossoms upon you,
If you are of good,
And do everything that you know,
That you should!

Now our story begins,
On the outermost edge,
Of Valyn...

-Excerpt from "The Origin of Amadox"

name: Potion Panic
creator: AndrewMoney10
description: You stand behind the counter of your cozy potion shop, surrounded by jars of colorful ingredients and bubbling cauldrons. As customers arrive, they impatiently wait for their themed potions - love potions, courage potions, and more. Drag ingredients in just the right order to brew each potion before the customers' patience runs out. With each level, the challenge grows and the customers get more demanding. Can you keep up and become the ultimate Apprentice Alchemist? Potion Panic is your chance to find out.

name: POWER FIT
creator: MetaJorgen
description: Update 1/9/ Duck Squats Added! known issue with Audio skipping, we are working on a fix. New Songs Added! Punch your way together to fitness! The new multiplayer beta is out. JULY 24 UPDATE: Added 3 stations. Each operates individually so you can exercise at your own pace. New spectator stations: Cheer for your friends and reward them extra points! Brutal mode: 4 minute long exercise with rapid fire punches. New leaderboard: Lifetime high score! Every time you play, you get more points! Super puncher: Look out for these shiny punchers and smash them hard for tons of extra points! COMING SOON Title displays for players! New gloves! New workout modes! CURRENT KNOWN ISSUES Please report any bugs you experience so we can improve your experience! Ducking bars are currently in timeout due to a Horizon crouching bug. Will return as soon as this is fixed by Meta.

name: Price Guesser
creator: ViciousVixenn
description: Guess the price! See if you’re right!

name: Price Master!
creator: MsRoxxz
description: Guess prices of everyday items and jewelry to become the Master Price Leader! Play 5 rounds to guess the prices of randomly selected items from a pool of 24 products, including sneakers, headphones, coffee makers, and more. Earn points for accurate guesses and compete to top the leaderboard. If you reach a high score, unlock a bonus jewelry round with items like diamond rings, gold necklaces, and luxury watches. Will you be the ultimate Price Mastermind?

name: PRISON ESCAPE (OBBY RUN)
creator: ANIL
description: 🏃‍♂️💨 PRISON ESCAPE is a fast, kid-friendly obby! Jump, dodge, and speed through tricky traps, lasers, and moving platforms. Grab the 🔑, hit the ✅ checkpoints, and outrun the goofy wooden cop 👮🪵 with his baton! Easy controls, quick runs, no scary stuff—just pure fun! Can you reach the gate and break free? 🔓🚪

name: Project Orb
creator: Heaz_D2S
description: You charge into the arena, ready to take on the opponent. The landscape arena stretches out before you, with a fixed camera and a flat, two-dimensional combat area. Your goal is to charge and fire Orbs at the stationary opponent, while avoiding obstacles and using your teleport ability strategically. Can you master the Orb Charge and take down the opponent?

name: Psychedelic Dreams 2.
creator: T̷H̷3̷_̷S̷A̷N̷D̷_̷M̷A̷N̷
description: CAN YOU SURVIVE THE DREAM

name: Puff on the Run
creator: metacrafters
description: You're a cute floating "Puff" - creature in a vibrant amusement park, hiding from hunters who chase when they spot you. Survive the timer by hiding behind game booths, rides, and food stalls. As you win rounds, the hunters get faster and smarter, forcing you to adapt your evasion tactics. Explore multiple connected zones, from carnival games to scenic areas, and master the art of clever hiding. Will you outsmart the hunters and become the ultimate hide-and-seek champion in Hideaway?

name: Pulse Rush
creator: Poppa_Hoppa
description: Tap glowing neon rings to score points in this vibrant arcade game! You have 60 seconds to achieve the highest score possible. Climb the leaderboard!

name: PUMP IT UP
creator: Clovdy Withavee
description:
PUMP IT UP
💣 Bomb Roulette 🏆
Grab a card, lock in your guess, and pray the blast leaves you standing!
🎰 Predict the bomb's blast radius.
🃏 Choose your card wisely.
📈 Risk it all — or play smart. May luck be on your side!
💣 Warning: this game is as unpredictable as it gets — sometimes the bomb has other plans. Play at your own risk! 😈

name: Pumpkin Blast
creator: AI Voyager🍀
description: Ride a festive roller coaster, blasting pumpkin targets in a cheerful Halloween carnival. Enjoy a smooth, winding track with gentle hills and curves, set amidst a colorful 3D environment filled with candy decorations, glowing lanterns, and friendly ghosts. Shoot magic orbs at static, spinning, bouncing, and drifting pumpkin targets, earning points and celebrating milestones with confetti and music. The ride lasts about 1-2 minutes, with a simple, intuitive control scheme and no scary elements.

name: Pumpkin Harvest
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Explore a vast autumn world with rolling hills, open meadows, and a scenic coastline. Search for pumpkins, collect loot, and replenish your health, thirst, and hunger. Enjoy the warm amber lighting and seasonal atmosphere.

name: Spellbound
creator: tmwheeler1
description: Embark on a word-finding adventure through the seasons in Seasonal WordQuest! Explore a spooky Halloween grid, a festive Christmas landscape, and a vibrant Spring scene, each with 10 hidden words to discover. Tap into the magic, tracing words through themed grids, and claim your victory! With a seasonal selector, you can play through your favorite holidays and experiences, from eerie Halloween nights to cheerful Spring mornings. Unleash your inner word wizard and solve the puzzle before time runs out!

name: Pumpkin Launch 🎃
creator: Zee (Meta)
description: In Harvest Havoc, you launch pumpkins at targets in a spooky Halloween field! Rotate your catapult with a joystick and fire with a big button. Hit scarecrows, hay bales, and roaming farm animals for points - moving targets are worth more! Power-ups like giant pumpkins, multi-shot, and explosive pumpkins randomly appear. Shoot them to activate their abilities and boost your score!

name: Punkin Chuckin 3D
creator: mommy26764
description:
READY... AIM... CHUCK! 💥

Step up to the catapult and put your pumpkin-launching skills to the ultimate test in this exciting 3D fall-themed arcade game!

🍂 Take aim across a beautiful autumn landscape filled with challenging targets, stacked crates, and pumpkins just waiting to be smashed!

🎯 HOW TO PLAY:

🎃 You get 10 pumpkins per round!
🎯 Adjust your direction, angle, and launching power.
💥 Score points by hitting targets and knocking things down!
⚠️ Watch those near misses! They can cost you valuable points!
🏆 Rack up the highest score possible and compete for a spot on the Top 10 Leaderboard!
🔁 Play again and beat your personal best!

🍁 Think you've got what it takes to become the ultimate Pumpkin Chuckin' Champion?

LOAD IT. LAUNCH IT. SMASH IT! 🎃💥

🏆 LET THE PUNKIN CHUCKIN BEGIN!

name: Punkin Chunkin
creator: mommy26764
description: CHUNK - IT - UP! 🎃 Are you ready to CHUNK some pumpkins?! 🌟 Step up and test your aim! Choose your power, pick your angle, and LAUNCH your pumpkin as far as you can! 🎃💪 Perfect your technique, chase high scores, and show off your pumpkin chunkin' skills! How far can you send it flying? 💥🎃🍂 READY... SET... CHUNK! 🏆

name: Purple Planet
creator: tmwheeler1
description: Remix a purple planet into your own creation.

name: Purrfect Placement
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: You place cat icons on a 6x6 board, earning Fish and unlocking new cat appearances. A reactive cat companion animates with cute reactions. Compete on leaderboards and customize your feline friends with soft background music.

name: Putt Putt Paradise
creator: Yoda G.
description: Play a game of golf on 9 unique holes with increasing complexity. Use slingshot-style controls to aim and power your shots. Compete with others on the leaderboard to get the fewest strokes. View your score and progress on the 9-hole scorecard. Learn how to play with the built-in instructions. In Paradise Putt, you can enjoy a fun and entertaining golfing experience with friends.

name: Puzzle Breakers – ScrewOut 3D
creator: Chandu_Flyingcaps
description: Puzzle Breakers – ScrewOut 3D is a fun and strategic 3D puzzle game where players unscrew complex objects to free trapped vehicles. Each level challenges your logic and timing with rotating models, colorful screws, and interactive boosters. Explore unique worlds and master the art of smart disassembly.

name: Puzzle Paradise
creator: MetaJorgen
description: 🦘Outback Update🌏 Ready for the Australia Day long weekend!! We've updated our BRAND NEW Outback theme with MORE golden sand, NEW players, and hidden gems. We update regurarly. Let's meet above in Puzzle Paradise... Where jigsaw is an extreme sport! Piece together puzzles with friends in a relaxed vibe. Puzzle Paradise is a world built for jigsaw enthusiasts. More layouts and themes to come. Submit puzzle ideas on our discord. If you want to submit a puzzle to Puzzle Paradise, head over to our Discord and join the Puzzle Paradise Community! (images must be 2731x2048px). This includes your own artwork and music. Don't forget to include credits.

name: Puzzle Sliders
creator: Poppa_Hoppa
description: Slide, solve, and satisfy your brain. Puzzle Sliders is a relaxing yet addictive mobile puzzle game where every move counts. Rearrange scrambled image tiles by sliding them into place, turning chaos into a perfectly completed picture.

name: Race the Shark
creator: Pickwick
description: You find yourself standing on a warm golden sandy beach, surrounded by swaying palm trees and rocky outcroppings. The sky above is a brilliant tropical paradise blue, with warm midday sunlight casting a gentle glow over the scene. As you look around, you notice the sound of waves gently lapping at the shore and the rustle of beach grass in the breeze. Your mission is clear: rescue swimmers from a shark's deadly attacks on this sunny tropical beach! A red arrow on your HUD points toward the shark, and a countdown timer ticks away. Explore this serene beach scene, soak up the tropical vibes, and show off your rescue skills in Shark Rescue Bay! When you save a swimmer, you're instantly teleported back to the center of the island to rescue more.

name: Rain Drop Rush
creator: Dirtdig
description: Dash through vibrant levels, blocking raindrops with your trusty umbrella! As you progress, the challenge intensifies. Can you keep dodging and blocking to beat the levels and unlock new ones? You find yourself standing in a colorful, stormy arena. The sound of raindrops hitting the ground and the wind rushing through fills the air. A bright, bold umbrella appears above you, ready to shield you from the impending downpour. In this game, you'll move left and right, using your umbrella to block raindrops of the active color. After blocking a few raindrops, the umbrella will randomly switch to a different color, and you'll need to adapt quickly. If you block raindrops of the wrong color, you'll lose one of your three lives. Your goal is to complete each level by blocking a set number of raindrops in each color. The game features 10 predefined levels with escalating difficulty, each with its own set of challenges and quotas. You'll encounter different colored raindrops, including red, blue, yellow, and green. Rainbow Rush is a game of quick reflexes and strategic thinking - will you be able to master Rainbow Rush?

name: Rainbow Rooftop Climb
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Climb 4 vibrant, rainbow-colored rooftops, solving puzzles and timing jumps to reach the top! Choose from easy and hard paths, and watch AI play for a seamless recording. Explore 4 levels: Rainbow Rooftop, Speed Run, Night Climb, and Chaos Mode, each with unique twists and challenges.

name: Rainbow Voxel Voyager
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Explore an endless rainbow voxel world that generates itself around you! Discover varied terrain, from flat plains to towering mountains and valleys. Walk, sprint, jump, super-jump, and fly through the vibrant landscape. Find and enter procedurally generated cottages, towers, bridges, and more. Enjoy a psychedelic skybox that cycles through rainbow gradients and soft ambient light.

name: Random Obby Up - FREE SHIRT REWARD!!
creator: 13_Chris
description: Dive into the festive frenzy of Random Obby Up, the latest thrill in the Up Parkours series! This holiday-themed parkour adventure generates a completely unique obstacle course every visit...think twinkling snow platforms, gingerbread jumps, and candy cane swings that shift with seasonal magic. Test your reflexes where no two runs are the same. Perfect for quick holiday hops or epic endurance challenges!

name: Ravenswood Manor
creator: tmwheeler1
description: A manor filled with ambiance, peace, quiet, ghostly apparitions, eerie fog, and seemingly harmless residents.

name: Reactor Rush
creator: 𝓙𝓸𝓻𝓭𝓪𝓷𝓑0101
description: In Reactor Rush, a mobile puzzle game, swap energy cores to match reactor colors. Navigate levels, earning coins and unlocking new levels. Use strategic thinking to solve increasingly complex puzzles in Reactor Rush.

name: Read My Lips
creator: creativeCharm
description: You tap a category tab on the title screen, then try to lip-read animated lips forming words from that category. Choose from four options to guess the word. Earn points for correct guesses and compete for top scores across categories like greetings, animals, food, and more. See how well you can read lips in this fun, interactive game! Lip Sync Challenge is a fun challenge that tests your lip-reading skills.

name: Reap What You Soul
creator: Scott (Trashbyrd)
description: In Soulbound Rush, you navigate a hauntingly beautiful gothic castle courtyard, collecting wandering souls while avoiding Heavenly Fire. As you progress, your power grows with each soul collected, but so do the dangers. Explore the graveyard, collect souls, and ascend the ranks. Compete against others to collect the most souls on the all-time and daily leaderboards. Your Souls label and counter appear in the upper-left corner of your HUD, guiding you through the experience. A 10% opaque black layer adds depth to the gothic atmosphere. Soulbound Rush offers a thrilling experience where you can test your skills and climb the leaderboards.

name: Reaper's Ascent
creator: Fechin
description: In Reaper's Domain, you play as a tiny grim reaper in a chaotic afterlife. Explore a procedurally generated haunted stage, fighting ghostly monsters and collecting souls. Evolve through three forms, each granting new jump distances and abilities. With each 3-minute round, the stage randomizes, challenging you to adapt and survive. Spend your soul pool to unlock powers or buy charges for your abilities. Choose from difficulty settings: Drowsy, On the Clock, or Two Hours Late, affecting health drain rate. A first-time tutorial guides you through the basics on your initial playthrough. As you progress, you'll encounter various ghost styles and shackled ghosts, each with its own challenges. Your goal is to accumulate souls and time, tracked on the leaderboard, while navigating the ever-changing stage. Customize your experience with Music and Sound Effects toggles in the Settings menu. Dive into daily runs and claim your place among the top reapers! Reaper's Domain offers a unique blend of action, adventure, and strategy, with a focus on survival and progression.

name: Red Flags & Power Moves
creator: metaversepaige
description: You navigate 11 boss archetypes, each with unique challenges and red flags. Master 22 power moves to counter them, with two moves required to defeat each boss. Explore diverse office and home office environments, complete with empowering posters and groovy bluesy jazz music. As you progress, use your wits to overcome obstacles and defeat the bosses. Get paid increasing amounts after each boss, and ultimately become the boss yourself in a satisfying victory ending.

name: Red Light Green Light KILLERBEAT
creator: TanzerVR
