description: Powerups, traps, and KillerBeats to jam to, Just dont let the music distract you!

name: Red Panda Brawler
creator: Fechin
description: You play as a red panda in a gritty 80s comic-style beat-em-up game. Punch and kick enemies through four zones: Streets, The Docks, Warehouse, and Rooftop. Rescue the cat girl, Lucy from her bully, Amanda. Enjoy 80s synth music, satisfying hit sounds, and a variety of sprites and animations. The game features a bold art style with vibrant colors and chunky outlines.

name: Reel Legends
creator: Jacob G
description: Pilot your boat, find a fish, and make the catch. Hold CAST to charge, release to throw, then tap when the fish bites to reel it in. Explore four waters, discover over 100 fish, and track your collection in the Trophy Case. Keep your catch or sell it for coins toward boat upgrades and scuba access. Clear first-catch guidance helps you learn, and a missed fish lets you cast again immediately. Progress lasts for the current play session.

name: Regal Soccer Shoot-Out
creator: metabigchief
description:
🏟️ Welcome to Regal City Stadium, the beating heart of competitive soccer drama. The crowd roars, the lights blaze, and the tension is electric—because this isn't just a match. It's Regal Soccer Shootout, the ultimate showdown of skill, pride, and glory.
⚔️ Face off against your fiercest rivals, Blackheart United, in high-stakes head-to-head battles. You'll take on dual roles—kicker and goalie—in fast-paced shootout duels against cunning NPCs. Every save, every goal, every clutch moment earns you XP and Regal Coins, unlocking exclusive gear and upgrades in our in-game shop.
🏆 Climb through five competitive leagues, each crowned with its own championship trophy. Rack up stats and claim four elite achievement trophies that mark your rise from rookie to legend.
🔥 This is more than a game. It's your legacy in the making.
Welcome to Regal Soccer Shootout. Your destiny awaits.

name: Relax Synapse
creator: Dr. Fun
description: Connect the dots in a mesmerizing world of neural connections! Navigate a near-black deep space background with a deep indigo-purple center glow and twinkling stars. Customize your experience with various logo styles and win screen backgrounds. The grid features pure white numbers centered within dark backing discs and outlines for visibility, set against brighter grid lines for clarity. As you connect vivid neon synapse-colored path ribbons, the glow intensifies with a flash burst, culminating in a cosmic starburst/nebula bloom. Solve the puzzle and unlock the secrets! Synapse Nexus Glow is a calming and creative experience that challenges your problem-solving skills.

name: Relic Quest
creator: Raffaella71
description:
Dust in the air.
Stone under your hands.
Something ancient waiting to be found.

In Relic Quest, you're not watching archaeology — you're doing it.

Chisel, strike, scrape, lift.
Every movement is physical, every tool responds, every discovery hits back through immersive haptics. You feel the stone crack, the relic emerge, the weight of history in your hands.

Uncover skeletons, amphorae, helmets, sculptures, forgotten artifacts.
This isn't about looting — it's about excavating, shaping, revealing.

No cutscenes. No shortcuts.
Just tools, ruins, and that moment when the past finally gives in.

History is buried.
You're the one who digs it up.

name: Remix Reef
creator: metaversepaige
description: Remix Reef is a living, ever-changing coral world created by the community. Dive in, remix, and make it your own — add coral, creatures, sounds, colors, or entire underwater realms. Every creation becomes part of a collective digital reef that grows with every visitor. Remix Reef is part of the Coral Collective, an initiative of the Better World Museum, inviting everyone to co-create a more connected, imaginative, and thriving world — one remix at a time.

name: Remote Robotics Lab XR – Mobile Edition V3.5
creator: kory2000pr
description:
Remote Robotics Lab XR – Mobile Edition V2 began as a technical experiment in mobile robotics control and evolved into an interactive XR experience. Added Quests! Robotic Arm Under Repair! In world Items added.

What started as a phone-based controller became a guided robotics adventure—where players explore, learn, and experiment inside a virtual lab.

Using simple touch controls and immersive XR space, players learn the fundamentals of robot movement, coordination, and cause-and-effect—no hardware or prior experience required. The experience is built for portrait mode and tap-based interaction, so users can learn the basics of robot kinematics without needing any prior technical background.

name: Resonance
creator: Null.Gamer
description: In Resonance: Into the Void, explore a mysterious void where silence is shattered by the whispers of the past. Use echolocation to navigate through levels, solving puzzles and uncovering hidden platforms. As you progress, sound-hunting enemies emerge, challenging your stealth and strategy. Compete for completion times and evade the lurking shadows in this atmospheric puzzle-platformer.

name: RETRO ARCADE OS
creator: LevelRiftLabs
description:
Step back in time with Retro Arcade OS! 🕹️

Play 100+ games in one retro desktop! Enjoy classic-style arcade games, puzzles, card games, and more. Discover your favorites, beat high scores, and experience nostalgic gaming.

100+ games. Free to play. Endless fun!

name: Retro Pong Showdown
creator: Yoda G.
description: Retro Pong Showdown is a modern, fast-paced take on the classic arcade paddle game. It transforms the timeless gameplay into an exciting experience where you can face off against adaptive AI opponents or challenge a friend in local multiplayer. The game features smooth controls, nostalgic charm, and exciting power-ups that shift the momentum of every match.

name: Retro Quest
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Get ready to relive the thrill of classic gaming in **Retro Quest**! Explore a multi-room kingdom, battling dragons and collecting treasures. Use a virtual joystick to navigate, and tap to wield your sword. Face off against Yorgle, Grundle, and Rhindle - three fierce dragons with unique speeds. Unlock castle gates with keys and aim to return the golden chalice to the gold castle. Will you emerge victorious?

name: Uncle Vernon's Taxi Run
creator: Yoda G.
description: You hit the road in a pixel-art taxi, navigating through a scrolling neon city. Your goal is to pick up passengers and deliver them safely while avoiding traffic and managing your fuel and vehicle wear. As you complete fares, you earn money to spend on upgrades and unlock new areas of the city, each with its own unique road art and challenges.

name: Ricochet Showdown
creator: mfStarboy_
description:
Pull back, aim, and cut the ropes to save the hostages in Ricochet Showdown!

Embark on a thrilling 2D ricochet adventure across 36 levels, divided into 6 distinct areas: Dusty Gulch, Gold Rush Boomtown, Iron Horse Railroad, Devil's Canyon, Ghost Town, and Outlaw's Fortress. Earn stars for completing levels with fewer shots and unlock new areas as you progress. Navigate through notorious outlaws like Big Earl, Slim Pete, and The Twins, and overcome challenges like moving train car walls, gap geometry, and more. Master the ricochet system and claim your spot as the ultimate ricochet champion in Ricochet Showdown.

name: Rift Runner
creator: WanesWorld
description: In Rift Runner, you control a sprinter hurtling through a neon-lit rift, dashing through glowing gates to score and boost your combo multiplier. Miss a gate or hit a dark one, and you lose a shield pip. Collect rift shards as currency to upgrade your runner's speed and abilities. Progress through 5 speed classes, from Sprinter to Phantom, and unlock permanent combo tiers with each Phase rebirth. Compete in daily seeded sprints, earn milestone chests, and maintain your streak for rewards. With a guided tutorial and minimal HUD, Rift Runner offers a thrilling, action-packed experience that's easy to pick up and hard to put down.

name: Rizz Frenzy
creator: heyitsbcs
description: Play as the Skibidi Rizzler, dodging bizarre Ohio Phantoms and collecting Rizz Points in a vibrant, anime-inspired world. Navigate through chaos, outrun the Tax Collector boss, and rack up the highest score. Quick reflexes and cunning help you dominate the leaderboards in this wild ride of speed and strategy.

name: Robo Dash
creator: AI Voyager 🍀
description: Run as a cute robot through a neon cyberpunk city. Avoid security bots, laser gates, and drones while collecting energy cells and AI data chips. Jump and slide with responsive controls. Compete for the highest score.

name: Robot Mayhem
creator: Jairo
description: Robot Mayhem is a fast-paced 3D platformer built for mobile and VR, where players must scale massive sci-fi structures, outsmart deadly traps, and launch giant missiles to stop a rampaging robot.

name: Rock Monster Rush
creator: heyitsbcs
description: A Rock'N'Role-Playing Game for 1-4 players. Now with all new card battling gameplay!

name: Rock, Paper, Rumble!
creator: xX_Jazzie_Xx
description: ✊✋✌️ Think you can beat them all? 😂 Challenge a lineup of crazy opponents, build your win streak, and see how far you can go! 🔥 One throw can change EVERYTHING! 🎮

name: Rocket Ball
creator: NathisGreen
description: Rocket Ball delivers fast, high-energy 4v4 arcade soccer where every player is strapped into a giant rolling ball. It's all momentum, teamwork, and pure arcade fun. Glide across the pitch, set up sharp passes, and fire in match-winning shots. Rocket Ball is still early in development, and the core experience is growing fast. Community feedback is a big part of shaping where it goes next — new features, balance tweaks, and quality-of-life ideas are all welcome. Features High-energy 4v4 online matches Responsive, physics-based rolling movement Easy to learn, plenty of depth when you push it Quick 5 Minute games Active development with open feedback

name: Rooftop Hopper
creator: AndrewMoney10
description: Hop across drying rooftop puddles as a green origami frog, aiming jumps to refill your wetness meter and catch flies for score boosts. Survive on a constantly evaporating rooftop, with a local high score saved across runs.

name: Room For More
creator: WanesWorld
description: Guide a growing black hole, swallowing objects to increase its size and unlock new worlds. Explore multiple environments, collect rare golden objects, and upgrade your hole's abilities. Experience chaotic and satisfying gameplay with simple controls.

name: Room Rush
creator: Ryan Canuel (Petricore)
description: Room Rush is the newest house building TV show where players are split up into teams and compete to design, furnish, and decorate individual rooms in a matter of minutes. Compete on the main stage, and coordinate with your teammates to make a room that really stands out from the bunch. The culmination of every team's rooms will form together in the end to make a fully finished house.

name: RotatingSelfie – Halloween edition
creator: Raffaella71
description: 🌟 RotatingSelfie – Spin, Share, Shine! Step into RotatingSelfie, the playful experience where your creativity doesn’t stop at the game. Here, every move you make can be shared, celebrated, and turned into points. 🎮 Play with your rotating selfie and discover endless challenges. 📲 Share your creations across Meta Horizons to grow your influence. ✨ Shine as your community engages with your style, your spin, your performance. This is not just a game. It’s a stage where fun meets visibility, and where your creativity becomes your power. 👉 Are you ready to spin your world and see how far your influence can go?

name: Roxy | The Squirrel Influencer
creator: voytek.lorenc (metacrafters)
description: Play as Roxy, a squirrel influencer! Forage, craft, and create videos to grow your following. Unlock collab videos with celebrities and branded videos with local forest entrepreneurs. Pressure comes from needing to post each video within an allotted time: post on time and your following grows; miss the deadline and it shrinks.

name: Realm Ascent - An Rpg Boardgame
creator: Gortiva
description: Embark on a thrilling RPG adventure in Realm Ascent, a dynamic boardgame experience. Explore mystical realms, master powerful abilities, and battle formidable enemies. Collect treasures, uncover ancient secrets, and customize your hero with a variety of skills and upgrades. Play solo or with friends on mobile! The game features 15 characters, 5 RPG classes, 66 upgrades, and 20 enemies across 10 themed battle worlds.

name: Rune Cat: Draw to Defend
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Unlock magical runes, defeat enemies, and explore six unique chapters in this enchanting world. Customize your experience with five new animated cat skins, each with its own aura color and style. Test your skills in a variety of encounters and optional mastery objectives.

name: Rune Rumble
creator: Yoda G.
description: Uncover hidden pairs of glowing, nature-inspired runes in a mystical forest! Tap to flip cards, matching symbols to keep them. Watch out for Spirit cards that shake up the game! Peek at hidden cards or shuffle the grid to outsmart your opponents. Collect the most pairs to win! Play in a serene, anime-inspired forest clearing under the stars. Can you master the runes and claim victory? Dive into Runewood Glen now!

name: RUNNER RELOAD
creator: HISOKAN
description: Run nonstop, jump obstacles, and recharge your energy and health while competing with other players in this adrenaline-packed autorun. ⚡🏃💥 🔹 Key Features: 🏃 Runs automatically; you just jump. ⚡❤️ Recharge energy and health with Energy Reloads. 🗺️ Explore levels full of challenges. 🧩 Find and collect items on the map. 🎁 Claim hourly rewards. 📜 Complete quests for extra rewards. 🏆 Compete in global leaderboards. 🛒 Upgrade and customize your character in the shop.

name: Rush Hour
creator: izukingz
description: Rush Hour is a life simulation game set in the bustling city of BayField, where every minute counts. Start as a food delivery worker and hustle your way up — buy new clothes, upgrade your ride, or even run your own food truck. Balance your rent, jobs, and ambitions as you race to build a better life in the city that never slows down.

name: Rush To Zero!
creator: PChef.Sami
description: A fast-paced, suspense-driven game with a central goal of being the last one standing. Either chase or be chased in a race against the clock to save yourself! Good Luck & Have Fun!

name: Rusty's Ascent
creator: Yoda G.
description: You find yourself standing at the base of a vibrant construction site, the sounds of industry and progress filling the air.

name: Rusty's Revenge!
creator: Yoda G.
description: In Rusty Rampage, you guide Rusty through randomized construction sites, dodging hazards like rolling rivets and rogue drones. Collect blueprints for bonus points and power-ups like the Golden Hard Hat. With each run, earn permanent upgrades that unlock harder floors to reach, pushing your skills to the limit. You have a few lives per run before it resets. Face off against The Glitch in a thrilling final showdown in Rusty Rampage.

name: Saber Academy
creator: emorgul
description: Deflect laser blasts and avoid drones in a frantic battle for survival. Collect all the saber colors and become a true master.

name: Sand Tetris
creator: emorgul
description: Sand! Sand everywhere!

name: Sandglass Escape
creator: B_a_r_t
description: Escape through nine rooms across an ancient observatory, a moonlit aqueduct and a dawn sanctum. Run, jump and duck past traps, open gates with gold plates and find the golden doors before each chapter's sand runs out. Room checkpoints, unlocked chapter replays and bronze-to-gold medals reward a cleaner escape. An original soundtrack accompanies full-screen portrait play.

name: Sandwich Signal
creator: Jacob G
description: In SANDWICH SIGNAL, assemble customer orders by deciphering symbol clues in this 3-round portrait game. Tap ingredients to craft the perfect sandwich, with a forgiving system for mistakes. Earn points for correct orders and track your personal best score. The game features a warm, flat cartoon art style, responsive touch input, and a replayable gameplay experience. Can you become the ultimate sandwich champion?

name: Santa's Spiral Climb
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Climb a spiral parkour course through a festive Santa village, using three types of jumps to reach the summit. Collect treats, outrun AI partners, and compete on leaderboards. Experience a Christmas-themed obstacle course with high-resolution textures and glowing edges.

name: Santa's Workshop
creator: daddy26764
description: Explore Santa's magical workshop in this Christmas adventure! Navigate 5 themed rooms, solve puzzles, dodge obstacles, and collect 15 gifts to deliver and win. Play as a cheerful elf, gathering Toy Boxes, Candy Canes, Golden Ornaments, and Stockings while enjoying twinkling lights, festive decorations, and cheerful Christmas music.

name: Sasquatch Slopes
creator: Bambipie
description: Speed down snowy hills on crazy vehicles, dodging obstacles like pine trees, rocks, snowmen, snow tubers, crashed skiers, moving skiers, deer, rolling snowballs, and a Sasquatch chasing you. Unlock new rides and customize your character for a goofy, endless downhill arcade experience with haptic button clicks, winter sound effects, and fun messages popping up during gameplay.

name: Saturday Night Boxing
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Customize your boxer with 8 face options and 6 body builds. Throw punches, including hooks and uppercuts, and feel the impact with realistic effects. Train in Story Mode with speed bag, combo drills, and reflex exercises to boost your stats before each fight. Compete with a live commentator calling out fight events — intro, round starts/ends, power punches, knockdowns, and KOs.

name: Scary Movie Simulator
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: 6v2 spooky pvp survivors look for car parts or change for the phone to escape killers search and destroy, dont let any survivors escape

name: ScienceTrixle
creator: metabigchief
description: Experiment. Discover. Master Science! Join Spark the robot and solve 60 hands-on experiments in the Motion, Energy and Matter labs. Roll balls down ramps, wire circuits, melt ice and build density towers, all powered by real simulations. Earn Science Stars, collect badges, fill your Science Journal and try a new Daily Experiment every day. Life, Earth and Space labs are coming soon!

name: Scissorhands - Ice Sculpting
creator: creativeCharm
description: IYKYK. Carved beautiful sculptures made of ice while maintaining quality and completeness .

name: Scooter Dash
creator: 13_Chris
description: Dive into an adrenaline-pumping endless runner adventure across stunning themed worlds! Start in the bustling normal city streets, then zoom through vibrant Asian markets, before dashing past ancient Egyptian pyramids and sandy dunes—with more worlds waiting to be unlocked—on your customizable scooter. Dodge obstacles like traffic cones, potholes, oncoming vehicles, market stalls, camels, and dragons. Collect power-ups and coins to unlock new scooters, rider outfits, and upgrades. Challenge your friends on global leaderboards, complete daily missions for rewards, and explore themed events that introduce wild new environments and challenges. Whether you're aiming for the longest run or building daily visit streaks for bonus rewards, the fast-paced action keeps you coming back for more thrills!

name: Scrap Swarm
creator: WanesWorld
description: You play as Pip, a tiny magnet robot, exploring colorful abandoned factories. Collect scrap into a growing train, combine powerful gadgets, rescue robots, and escape with your haul to rebuild a lively robot town. Navigate through 12 hand-crafted factory layouts, each with conveyor belts, crushers, scrap piles, and neon lighting. As you progress, you'll encounter various enemies and have the chance to upgrade your gadgets and restore the town. The game features charming cartoon robots, bright colors, smooth movement, and satisfying magnetic pickups.

name: See by Feeling Game
creator: creativeCharm
description: Navigate a space blindly using touch and intuition. Define the correct object in front of you.

name: Serve 'Em Tennis
creator: metabigchief
description: 🎾 Serve 'Em Tennis – Serve Big. Play Hard. Become a Champion! Step onto the court and experience fast-paced tennis action in Serve 'Em Tennis! Take on 10 increasingly challenging opponents across unique courts as you master powerful serves, precision shots, and perfectly timed returns. With intuitive mobile controls, vibrant 3D environments, and exciting rallies, every match tests your reflexes, timing, and strategy. Outsmart your rivals, sharpen your skills, and fight your way to the top.

name: The Lavender Lounge
creator: ♡♡❤~ℳ𝒾𝓏𝓏ℒ𝒶𝒹𝓎𝟹𝟿~❤♡♡
description: Welcome to my take on "Sexy Lavender Lounge" world from VR Chat!

name: Shadow Path Warrior
creator: Austingra7x
description: You run through the Shadow Realmd with your katana flashes in the dim light as you strike down demons. The air is thick with tension as you approach the Demon Fortress, but you're driven by a singular goal: to reach Paradise. As you near the end of your journey, the music shifts from dark battle rhythms to ethereal heavenly loops. Finally, you reach the glowing paradise gate, and with a triumphant cry, you've reached PARADISE!

name: Shameless Darts
creator: Shameless
description: Compete in a modern sports bar with realistic dart throwing mechanics. Choose from 501, 301, and American Cricket game modes. Upgrade your darts and master the art of dart throwing in a cozy atmosphere. Will you beat the AI and become the ultimate Dart Master?

name: Shameless Says
creator: Shameless
description: Test your memory in a vibrant, themed world! Watch and repeat increasingly long sequences of light patterns on four colored pads. Each successful round adds one more light, and playback speed increases. But beware - one mistake ends the game! Random surprise rounds require you to tap the pads in reverse order. Immerse yourself in this interactive challenge with sound effects, score display, and a themed world. Earn coins and unlock new skins, including the classic Simon says skin.

name: Shameless Sudoku X
creator: Shameless
description: Step into a 9x9 grid with a thrilling twist: both main diagonals must contain numbers 1-9 without repeats. Choose from three difficulty levels, each with multiple puzzles to solve. As you place numbers, real-time validation highlights conflicts in red, and subtle diagonal shading helps you track the extra constraint. Unlock the next level by completing all puzzles in the current one, and enjoy a calm ambient soundtrack that reacts to your progress.

name: Sharp Line Barbershop
creator: DGreatusDGod
description: In Sharp Line Barbershop, you play as a barber tasked with rebuilding a classic urban barbershop. Provide haircuts, beard trims, and shaves to clients, earning cash and reputation. Compete in the National Barber Battle to become the city's sharpest barbershop.

name: SHATTERSTEP
creator: mommy26764
description: You step onto the Shatterstep bridge, a treacherous expanse of glass panels suspended high over a dark void. Tap the glass panels to choose which one to step on next. Will you make it to the top, or will you fall through the glass? Play with friends in this tense multiplayer game, where one misstep can spell disaster for everyone. The bridge's safe and breakable panels are randomly determined for each round, so you'll need to rely on luck and quick reflexes to succeed in Shatterstep. As you ascend, the glass panels shatter and reform, testing your skills and strategy. Reach the finish line and claim your place among the winners, or spectate from the sidelines as others take on the challenge. Shatterstep features a round timer, and the round ends when all players have finished or been eliminated, or when the timer runs out. The first player to reach the finish line wins, and their name is displayed proudly.

name: Shell Shock
creator: AndrewMoney10
description: You find yourself at a vibrant table, three cups shuffling around with a ball hidden beneath one. Tap the cup you think hides the ball, and if you're right, the cup lifts to reveal the ball, accompanied by a satisfying ding and a burst of sparkles. Each correct guess speeds up the shuffle and adds more moves, challenging you to keep up. The cups wobble and bounce, adding to the excitement. Will you beat your high score in Shell Shock?

name: SHIFT: On Duty
creator: Kiss
description: Step into a bustling hospital as a nurse, managing patient care, time, and decisions to earn a perfect score and unlock career progression. Navigate a 3D medical-surgical unit, interact with patients and medical staff, and prioritize tasks to deliver top-notch care.

name: Shikaku
creator: island_ascetic
description: Shikaku is a calm logic puzzle. Each grid holds a few numbers. Draw rectangles so every one holds exactly one number equal to its size, and the grid is solved. Three difficulties, a new shared grid every day, and a leaderboard. No timer.

name: Ship It!
creator: MKE_TheGuru
description:
Ship It! is a box-packing, truck-loading, quick-thinking game where ship happens. Deliver accurate orders and rise the ranks of the package delivery world!

Built for the Mobile Innovation 3.0 Competition

name: SHOCKWAVE
creator: thickumsest93
description: Embark on a cosmic adventure as a retro-styled astronaut, navigating through increasingly challenging levels filled with moving electric bars and customizable suits. Explore a variety of levels, from wide gaps and slow bars to tricky patterns and demanding timing. Collect coins, level skips, and compete on the leaderboard. Personalize your astronaut with different colored suits and platform styles in the in-game shop. With arcade music and a dynamic walk cycle, experience the thrill of space exploration in this action-packed puzzle game.

name: Shovel Up!
creator: Eric Morrill (Meta)
description:
DIG • COLLECT • UPGRADE • EXPLORE
Join The Community: https://discord.gg/shovelup
Grab your shovel, dig with friends and discover the treasures of every island to upgrade your shovels and uncover the rarest artifacts!
💎 DIG through unique biomes with friends.
🗺️ COLLECT and hunt for items to complete your catalog.
🔧 UPGRADE your shovels to unlock bigger, better rewards.
🌴 EXPLORE vibrant islands teeming with quests, secrets and loot to be found.

name: Sim | Life
creator: Vashspike2000
description:
Looking for a place to unplug and just be? Welcome to Sim Life. This minimalist loft is designed as a sanctuary for the Horizon community. Leave the chaos behind and step into a sleek, modern space built for genuine connection.
Listen: High-fidelity music to set the mood.
Talk: Comfortable seating zones designed for open discussion.
Vibe: A clean, distraction-free aesthetic for ultimate relaxation.
Whether you're hosting a meetup or just need a quiet spot to hang out with friends, Sim Life is your home in the metaverse.

name: Sir Chop-a-Lot
creator: Emporium of Wonders
description: Tap to unleash absurd skills as Sir Chop-a-Lot auto-battles through 6 biomes of medieval mayhem. Hurl coconuts, drop holy cows, and shout "I FART IN YOUR DIRECTION!" across 15 discoverable skills, each upgradable to Lv5. Stack 7 blessings, manage your Ye Olde Sippy Cup, and face 6 bosses with ever-escalating HP. Die and choose: pay gold to revive, or lose a limb. Five limbs, five lives — how deep can your bumbling knight chop before the final fall?

name: Siren Song
creator: Kyle (PRELOADED)
description:
Unleash the captivating power of your voice! 🧜♀️🌊
Can they resist your deadly call? Dive into the abyss as a mesmerising Siren, luring unsuspecting sailors to their doom. Collect their souls, unlock ancient melodies, and transform your hidden cove into a glittering sanctuary.
🎶 HAUNTING MELODIES: Lure sailors with your enchanting and deadly songs.
💀 COLLECT SOULS: Gather their souls to unlock new, more powerful melodies and abilities.
💎 CUSTOMISE YOUR COVE: Adorn your hidden lair with glittering treasures and forgotten relics.
🌟 BECOME LEGENDARY: Climb the leaderboards and reign as the most feared Siren of the seas!
Created by PRELOADED.

name: Sista's Spin to Win
creator: Yoda G.
description: Get ready to spin the wheel and solve puzzles in this high-energy game show! Will you bank a fortune or go home empty-handed? The suspense builds as you navigate through four puzzle rounds, each with its own challenges and rewards. The game culminates in a thrilling bonus round, where the accumulated jackpot is on the line. With its vibrant purple, gold, and teal lighting, Spin to Fortune is an immersive experience that's equal parts excitement and entertainment.

name: Sisyphus Trivia Quest
creator: Celugia
description: Test knowledge on Trivia Hill! Choose categories, answer questions correctly to push the boulder up the hill, and beat the 10-second timer. Enjoy papyrus sketch art, fun sound effects, and exciting gameplay!

name: Skate 360
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Shred the streets in Skate District! Master fluid controls and authentic skateboarding mechanics in a vibrant suburban city. Explore a huge half-pipe, ollie over houses, and kickflip through a bustling neighborhood. Customize your skater with a variety of colors, style, and board designs. Compete in Time Attack or Free Skate modes.

name: Sketch That Mesh!
creator: creativeCharm
description: You see the name and silhouette of a mesh, then draw it freehand to bring it to life. A 70% likeness score is required to create a 3D model you can custom paint with your finger. Take on daily challenges to turn everyday objects into 3D models, from a fish to a baseball, and even a heart. As you play, climb the ranks on our MagicSketch leaderboard, earning 1 point for each player's transformation. With a sleek UI and a how-am-I-doing meter that gauges your drawings in real-time, you'll be hooked. Explore a free-range deck of 25 meshes to bring to life and become the ultimate Sketch Master in Sketch That Mesh.

name: Ski Jump Master
creator: voytek.lorenc (metacrafters)
description: You stand at the top of a snowy ski slope, with the sleek Modern Steel Lattice tower looming behind you. Tap to launch down the gentle, curving ramp, feeling the smooth transition from ease to speed. As you pick up momentum, the camera zooms out to reveal the colorful, cheerful 2D landscape stretching before you. Your goal is to time your jump perfectly and land as far as possible on the hill below. Master the simple three-tap control system and compete for perfect, great, and good jumps. The Modern Steel Lattice tower, with its industrial steel framework and glass observation deck, adds an edgy touch to your ski jump experience. You can choose from different tower styles, including Classic Wooden Scaffold, Futuristic Sleek Tower, and Rustic Alpine Lodge. The camera dynamically adjusts its zoom as you descend the ramp, starting at 3x zoom while you're waiting at the top and smoothly reaching 1x zoom at takeoff. Your skier scales with the camera zoom, ensuring a consistent and immersive experience. The terrain and snow particles also scale with zoom, maintaining a visually stunning environment throughout your jump. The optimal takeoff moment has been adjusted to give you more variety and opportunities for improvement, with a smooth cosine falloff that rewards precise timing. A perfect tap can now launch you up to 215 meters, while a mistimed tap might leave you at 30 meters. The landing hill has been extended to accommodate the full distance range.

name: SkiFree
creator: 13_Chris
description:
Inspired by the timeless downhill classic, this modern mobile remake brings smooth carving and endless distance chasing to Horizon Worlds.
Drag to carve the slope.
Swipe up to bunny hop.
Dodge, collect, survive.
Glide downhill while weaving through obstacles and stacking tokens along the way. The further you go, the faster the mountain pushes back. Designed entirely for mobile, this experience focuses on fluid controls, momentum, and that "just one more run" feeling.
No complicated mechanics.
No long setup.
Just you and the slope.
The mountain never stops.
How long can you stay ahead of it?
👉 Join the community:
https://bit.ly/Join13VrCreations

name: Sky Chef
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: You play as a chef in a chaotic airline kitchen, juggling recipes for hungry passengers while navigating turbulence and equipment malfunctions. Customize your kitchen, unlock new recipes, and compete in daily and weekly challenges to prove your culinary skills under pressure.

name: SKYFALL WARDEN
creator: JordanB0101
description: In SKYFALL WARDEN, you play as a superhero who must fight aliens with electric power in a dark, nighttime world. Your character has a glowing light that follows them and can switch to close combat. Earn points by killing orbs and aliens, with combo multipliers. The game features 10 escalating waves, a main menu with settings and tutorial, and a leaderboard to compete with others.

name: SkyHop Adventures
creator: YGMackillaVR
description: Winner for best camera API- Welcome and please enjoy SkyHop Adventures! Race your friends and collect all the apples and coins that you can before your friends do! Enjoy this platformer/parkour/collect and race party today! Updates: Fixed problems with trigger respawns and spring issues.

name: Slap Arena
creator: Clique_Waylon
description: BUILD POWER | COLLECT GLOVES | SLAP EVERYTHING — Slap to unlock the craziest gloves and destroy your enemies until no one is left in your way. Become the Slap Arena Champion!

name: Slap Boxing Showdown
creator: Yoda G.
description: You face off against a formidable AI opponent in a best-of-three slap boxing match. Choose from four fighter styles: Big Sal, Quick Rico, The Contender, or Veteran King. As you clash, the crowd cheers on your every move, and the atmosphere is electric. Earn points for winning rounds, precise slaps, dodges, and more. Your goal is to claim the Golden Hand Trophy by emerging victorious. Will you rise to the top and become the ultimate slap boxing champion?

name: Slasher - Hunt and Survive
creator: md5nake
description: Be the slasher and hunt down players one by one! Survivors must work together and find equipment to stay alive. Immersive experience for up to 32 players. Spooky horror game with intense hide and seek gameplay and parkour.

name: Slay Them Fighters!
creator: LauraMona
description:
⚡SPEED WEEK⚡FIGHT 🥊 TRAIN 🏋️ BECOME STRONGER 💪
👉 Join the Community: https://discord.gg/dKaKpuphaN
Play during the event = 2× SPEED 💎
Gain more SPEED ⚡ Equip FASTER⚡ Win MORE🏆
⏱️ Limited time only, don't miss it!
⚡ Unleash your inner energy to dominate the Arena! ⚡
Train hard, push your limits and crush your opponents in intense fights. 🥊💥
🏋️💨 Feel the adrenalin as you lift, sprint and propel yourself to the top of the leaderboard!

name: Sleigh Snatch
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Dodge Santa's hazards and collect presents in this Christmas endless chase game. Play as the Grinch, auto-running below Santa's flying sleigh, as it speeds up and gets harder. Grab presents, avoid coal and ornaments, and fill the Catch Meter to grab the sleigh for a bonus round. Unlock 5 themed levels, including Snowy Village, Pine Forest, and North Pole Approach. Compete on leaderboards for the highest score and longest chase distance.

name: Slide Puzzle Playground
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: Play sliding puzzles in 11 fun themes! Solve puzzles in Easy, Medium, or Hard mode. Enjoy cozy music and haptic feedback when you solve a puzzle. Challenge yourself to beat your move count and compete for the best scores!

name: Slime Deliveries
creator: AndrewMoney10
description: In Moss Mail, you draw a single stroke to guide a garden snail through a whimsical world. Collect dew drops to refill your slime tank, avoid patrolling beetles, and deliver mail to all sprouts in one go! Linear levels ramp up the challenge with more beetles, tighter paths, and sparce resources. With a cozy, hand-illustrated 2D art style and soothing garden sounds, can you master the slime trail and become the ultimate snail mail hero? Dive in and find out!

name: Slime Lab! [Idle Tycoon]
creator: AbductM3
description:
COMING SOON!! *** EGG UPDATE ***
Hatch Eggs and Collect the RAREST Slime!
AUTO TAPPER [UPGRADE]
Build your slime empire! In Slime Lab Tycoon, you control the ultimate scientific experiment. Start small, upgrade your gear, and become the richest scientist on the server!
🧪 SQUISH & EARN: Tap your slime to generate research points. The more you squish, the richer you get!
🤖 AUTOMATE: Buy Auto Tappers to generate points while you hang out with friends, and boost your Power Upgrades to make every click count.
🧬 EVOLVE YOUR SLIME: Unlock 6 unique slime tiers—Basic, Toxic, Radioactive, Crystal, Galactic, and the legendary GOD Slime. Watch them glow with custom VFX!
♻️ REBIRTH SYSTEM: Reached the top? Rebirth to reset your progress in exchange for a massive, permanent multiplier to your earnings.
🏆 CLIMB THE RANKS: Check the live Server Leaderboard to see how you stack up against the competition. Will you have the most slimes or the highest rebirths?
Grab a station, start tapping, and show the world your ultimate Slime Lab!

name: Sluggerz
creator: metabigchief
description:
⚾ Step up to the plate — it’s time to swing for glory! 🏟️🔥
Sluggerz Baseball is a skill- and timing-based game built around one simple move — hold and swipe! 👆💥
Pick your challenge — go big in Home Run Challenge 💣 and see how many you can smash in 20 pitches...
or test your rhythm in Slugger Train 🚂⚾ and keep your streak alive for as long as you can! ⏱️💪
🎮 Easy to play. 🎯 Hard to master. 🔥 Addictively fun.
Sluggerz Baseball — how long can you stay in the zone? 🧢⚾💨

name: Slumberland
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: Explore a vibrant world filled with giant toys, wind-up creatures, and hidden secrets. You find yourself shrunk down to the size of a toy, standing in a colorful landscape with giant toy houses, chunky toy blocks, and wind-up toy train carriages. Use the powerful Iron Boar to scatter clockwork enemies and break through barriers to collect keys and unlock new areas. Discover hidden rewards and navigate through levels with a redesigned mobile control scheme. In Toybox Tales Unleashed, you can mount the Iron Boar and charge through destructible surfaces, scatter enemies, and destroy barriers.

name: Smack Attack
creator: king_of_Miami
description: You tap running moles to smack them before they escape into randomly placed holes on a vibrant, changing background! Play through escalating rounds with increasing mole speeds and counts. Earn points, lose hearts, and compete for the highest score in this fast-paced 2D game.

name: SMASHTEROID!
creator: Kyle (PRELOADED)
description: SMASH • UNLOCK • UPGRADE • COMPETE In SMASHTEROID you control a destructive ball of chaos that crash lands on planet Earth and wreaks havoc. The goal is simple: smash as much stuff as possible to rack up a high score! 💥 Smash through a fully destructive landscape! ✨ Unlock new props to build out the world and earn more points! ⬆️ Upgrade your SMASHTEROID abilities to cause more carnage! 🏆 Compete against other players and aim for a high score! Created by PRELOADED.

name: Snack Attack - Sleeping Edition
creator: creativeCharm
description: Flick snacks at sleepers mouths like grandma, grandpa, uncle and the bear without waking them up! Select a snack, aim, and flick it in before they wake up! Land a snack cleanly for points or earn bonus points if the sleeper chews and returns to sleep. Unlock better snacks in the in-game shoppe and become the ultimate snack-thrower master in Snack Frenzy! Yumyum..zzzzzz

name: Snailed It!
creator: L_in_the_Meta
description: Survive 20 escalating waves in this top-down 2D arena roguelite, defending your world from invading foes as you collect materials, upgrade, and fight to the end!

name: Sniper Tag 🎯 NEW
creator: seemebro
description: A sniper is passed from player to player. 🔫 You get the rifle, you shoot someone. 🎯 You don't, you explode. 💥 Outplay, outlast, and pass the sniper before time runs out. Win rounds, earn coins, unlock skins for your gun and death effects.

name: Soccer Showdown
creator: creativeCharm
description: You step onto the vibrant soccer field, the crowd is cheering in the background. Tap to select a player, swipe to kick the ball, and double-tap to dash forward and chase the ball or headbutt it in mid-air for a bonus kick. Customize your team and earn rewards as you play against an AI team with adjustable difficulty.

name: Social Media Tycoon
creator: Fechin
description: Dive into your Creator's Hub office, a space tailored to your chosen platform - streamer, YouTuber, short-form creator, or social personality. The room reflects your style, from RGB dual monitors and gaming PC for streaming, to a DSLR on a tripod and ring light for YouTube. Your journey begins here, where every decision shapes your content, audience, and growth. Choose your path, customize your workspace, create content, engage with your audience, and make tough business decisions to succeed. Dive into the 'Log' to track your last 14 pieces of content, with metrics on fans gained and revenue. Will you make it to the top? Explore your office, plan your content, and see your influence grow in Social Media Mogul Empire. The game now includes a staff roster view, active deals display, equipment level display, audio features, platform-specific day-end animations, a random events system, cross-platform synergy, a content history viewer, a first-time tutorial, and a save/load system. Fixing critical bugs and implementing staff skill effects, the game offers a comprehensive social media tycoon experience. You can also view your ranking on the leaderboard, choose from difficulty settings, and specialize your staff skills. The daily timeline system lets you plan your content strategically across 8 time slots, balancing slot costs, energy, and content quality.

name: SocialVr
creator: Ilina3🤍
description: The Social Spot since 2022! +18 only spot to socialize, meet new people and play games! Themed Social Events 5 nights a week! If you want to control the music in the world, join our discord( toocool.com/socialvr )and you'll be able to add songs - as long as they exist on spotify - Our other events are now moved to the Events World - Improv, Trivia, Graze (cooking show) and Cupid's PlayGround. Play a variety of games: WinePong, Suika (coin game), Four in a Row, Basketball, Spin the Bottle, Never Have I Ever, Would you rather and more coming. Not for the faint of heart: throwing people around is now also available on top of carrying them on your shoulders.

name: Solitaire (Solitaire: One More Hand)
creator: SeeingBlue
description: Enjoy classic Solitaire at your own pace. Choose draw-one or draw-three, tackle daily challenges, and unlock new card styles—one satisfying move at a time.

name: Solitaire: Dungeon Escape
creator: thickumsest93
description: An escape room powered by Solitaire! Wield the powers of the elements as you descend the dungeon's ominous halls. Descend through increasingly perilous floors, where each challenge pits you against the very essence of the dungeon itself. Solve the final challenge and escape the grasp of the Dungeon Lord.

name: Sort it 3D
creator: Simo
description: 🧩 Sort It 3D - a fun and relaxing sorting game where you organize colorful balls and items into the right containers! ✨ Simple to play, hard to master — clear tricky levels, unlock new challenges, and level up your sorting skills! 🎉 With tons of levels, daily rewards, and satisfying puzzles, Sort It 3D is perfect for players who love brain teasers and casual fun. ▶️ Play now — only on Meta Horizon!

name: Sorter
creator: 13_Chris
description: Junk in, treasure out. Items slide down the pipe and it's your call: shelf the valuables, box the junk, contain the hazardous waste, trash the rest. Sort fast, build your streak, and don't let the pile overflow. How many can you sort before it buries you?

name: SoulShift - Action Rougelite
creator: Junyuh
description: Battle through a shattered spirit world in this 2D action roguelite. Switch between the Flame Samurai, Void Reaper, and Storm Monk, combining their unique powers to defeat dangerous enemies and towering bosses. Choose your path, collect powerful relics, and forge permanent upgrades. Every defeat fuels your next attempt—and every victory unlocks greater challenges.

name: Space Mission [Early Access]
creator: natashagubernov
description: Adventure with obstacles on the space station, uncover hidden artifacts, and complete your mission among the stars! - Launch the rocket and get Dance Blaster! *only on mobile

name: Space Obby
creator: Meta.Jesus [illuminated]
description: 🌌 Space Obby is the ultimate parkour adventure! 🚀 Jump, climb, and dash through floating platforms, zero-gravity zones, and cosmic challenges. 🌟 Unlock new worlds, collect stars, and race your friends to the top of the leaderboard. 🛸 Whether you're a beginner or a pro, every jump is a chance to prove your skills in this out-of-this-world obby experience! 🌠

name: Space Station Tycoon
creator: Thoth
description: Operate your own wing of a space station! Build stores, landing pads, turrets, and more. Serve visitors, complete random events, buy upgrades, and customize your station!

name: Spaced Out
creator: Domeoc
description: Get ready to launch into an epic adventure through outer space in Spaced Out! Your job is to save Terra: travel to exotic planets, craft new gear, build up your base and help the scientists on your journey. Launch from your base, explore space, gather data samples, discover the crashed ship, craft new technology, and fight for survival among strange alien creatures. This space saga has it all: exploration, crafting, combat, and beyond!

name: Spartan Protocol
creator: 8bitvapor
description: You stand tall as Master Chief, your green Mjolnir armor a beacon of hope on a vast, rocky Halo ring-world. The camera pans across the 3200x3200 scrolling map, revealing alien architecture, Covenant structures, and crates for cover. Your virtual joystick guides Master Chief through the terrain as you aim and shoot with precision. Waves of Grunts, Jackals, and Elites patrol and chase, their AI behaviors challenging your combat skills. Your Assault Rifle fires rapidly, and you can pick up a Plasma Pistol from fallen Grunts. The Halo-inspired HUD displays your shield bar, health, ammo, and motion tracker radar, immersing you in the battle. Clear the level by defeating all enemies and bask in the glory of victory, or face the sting of defeat. Experience the thrill of Ring Warrior, where strategy and action collide in a retro-modern Halo-style top-down shooter.

name: Speed Duel
creator: Terrell K
description: Race to the finish line with Speed Duel! This fast-paced racing game lets you compete in exciting races against the clock and other players. Build a strategy around your car's distinctive abilities and upgrades collected over time to dominate each track. Get a head start with the turbo button or slow down time with the time slow for a strategic advantage. From its gripping game modes to its unique upgrade system, Speed Duel is the perfect game for all speed enthusiasts. Put the pedal to the metal and leave your opponents in the dust!

name: Spell Sword
creator: proto_xr
description:
Wield your words as weapons against waves of monsters. Defeat numerous foes, gather loot, upgrade your gear, and complete daily quests as you push deeper into battle in this turn-based RPG experience.
🏆 Winner in the 2025 Mobile Innovation Competition! 🏆

name: SPELLING SPRINT
creator: NamasteVibes
description: Race against the clock to spell words correctly, earn points, and rise through the ranks in this thrilling mobile world — SPELLING SPRINT!!! Join friends, challenge rivals, and compete in adrenaline-fueled spelling battles. Strategize, spell fast, and dominate the leaderboard!!!

name: Spin to Reel Fish
creator: voytek.lorenc (metacrafters)
description: In Reel In The Catch, play a one-thumb arcade fishing game. Circle your thumb around the massive 260 px reel dial at the bottom center of the screen to pull fish up from the deep blue waters before a 90-second timer runs out. Manage tension to avoid snapping the line. Earn points, trigger Lucky Streaks, and climb the leaderboard. Will you catch the big one and become the ultimate fishing master? Dive into the fun in Reel In The Catch!

name: Spooky Connect 4
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: In the dead of night, a haunted Connect 4 board carved into a giant tombstone beckons you to play. Drop pieces into the spooky grid, outsmarting a ghost AI that now looks 3 moves ahead... most of the time. Enjoy a dark Halloween graveyard scene with cracked earth, glowing energy cracks, and crumbling tombstones. The game features comic book art, haptic feedback, and eerie sounds. Your goal: connect four pieces in a row before the game ends in a draw. In Tombstone Showdown, every move counts.

name: Spooky Flick Goal
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Step into Spooky Flick Goal, where a nightmarish glowing soccer ball has been unleashed on a cursed arena! Players participate in a hair-raising Halloween-themed world with 20 unique silly and scary enemies. In the shadowy depths of this game, each click of the mouse killed various creepy creatures who are standing between you and the goal! Players must reach 500 points to win.

name: Springfield Sprint
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: You sprint through Springfield, navigating levels in a purple tracksuit. Control your flight with precision using a joystick and red cartoon rocket jetpack in Level 3. Explore different levels with continuous ground for run-only movement or take to the skies. The game features fast-paced and thrilling experiences, with challenges that have been fine-tuned for the perfect balance of excitement and playability.

name: Sprout Tycoon
creator: WanesWorld
description: In Sprout Tycoon, you build a cozy single-player idle garden game from scratch. Start with 6 plots and 50 coins, buying seeds, planting, watering, and harvesting crops to sell for coins. Invest in better seeds, upgrade your watering can, and expand your garden to 24 plots. Discover random weather events like rain showers and meteor strikes that can mutate your crops, selling for 10-100x their normal price. As you progress, unlock adorable pet companions to help with watering, and experience a rebirth system that grants permanent bonuses. Enjoy offline crop growth, daily login rewards, and weekly Meteor Shower events. With a painted/watercolor art style and friendly UI, Sprout Tycoon offers a relaxing and engaging experience.

name: Spud Games: Potato Olympics
creator: TheRealMadCat
description: UPDATE: New Spooky Character Sets in the New Shop! Earn Spud Coins to give your spud a makeover. Step into the quirky world of Spud Games: Potato Olympics, where you compete in hilarious sports tournaments with your ultimate spud! Creator your own Spud character in the Spud Builder! Master mechanics in each sport, from tapping to battle, dodge and quick reactions. Try new sports and climb the ranks to become the champion! Each sport has its own unique gameplay and challenges. Your spud will battle an opponent, with AI difficulty scaling per round. As you progress, the opponent gets harder and faster! Will you win Bronze, Silver or Gold in the Olympic Ceremony?

name: Squishy Dumpling Merge!
creator: AbductM3
description: 🥟 Squish. Merge. Evolve! ✨ Dive into a deliciously squishy world of dumplings! Merge matching dumplings to create bigger, cuter, and crazier ones. 😋💥 Unlock adorable new recipes, build your ultimate dumpling collection, and chase the rarest dumpling of them all How far can you merge? 👀🥟

name: Stack & Score
creator: blanktarget
description: In Stack & Score, you're on a mission to clear lines and score points in a Tetris-style puzzle game. Pieces fall from the sky, and your goal is to stack them just right to clear lines before they pile up. Each piece type has a point value, and clearing multiple lines at once scores big. Hit score thresholds to unlock special modifiers that shake up the game, like a heavy block that crashes through everything or a piece that drops a part into a gap. Progress through levels as the game speeds up and challenges get tougher. Can you keep stacking and beat your high score? In Stack & Score, you'll find a retro sci-fi title screen, chill synth music, and mobile controls for a fun gaming experience.

name: Stack & Snack
creator: RadAdz
description: Make sandwiches, burgers, baguettes and coffee. Serve snacks and cold drinks. Build up your score and keep your customers happy. New updates coming soon!

name: Stack Escape
creator: Null.Gamer
description: Dodge falling blocks in this frantic puzzle game! Choose between swipe and D-pad controls, and feel the thrill with haptic feedback on block placement. In Campaign mode, Level 1 serves as a tutorial, guiding you through controls and gameplay mechanics with a 3-2-1-GO! countdown and 8-bit music. Customize your experience with music and SFX volume toggles. Centered level complete screen, single-step and hard drop buttons, and a pause menu with resume, settings, and exit options enhance gameplay. Play on a full-screen canvas, free from distractions. The leaderboard now draws above the pause menu with an opaque backdrop. The title 'Stack Escape' is now a retro pixel-art logo made of colored Tetris-style blocks.

name: Star Fighter Wars: Galactic Tides
creator: Ag
description: Pilot a Star Wars-style fighter in a fast-paced space shooter. Destroy waves of enemies, upgrade your ship, and unlock powerful perks and lethal equipment. Engage in free-for-all combat with increasingly difficult enemy ships, from Scout Fighters to Heavy Gunships.

name: Starlight Serenade
creator: April_Renee
description: You step into Duchess's Dream, follow my baton — when a note of light reaches the ring, tap it right on the beat, and the whole island will sing with you.' Glowing star notes float down a light lane toward you and into a glowing hit-zone ring. Tap them in time with the music, and the desert ruins come alive with light, music, and celebration.

name: Starline Defender
creator: B_a_r_t
description: One finger. Nine waves. Three neon sectors. Steer your cyan starfighter through changing drone formations while auto-fire does the blasting. Chain kills, repair your hull between waves and unlock new sectors. Return for a campaign score chase or practise an unlocked sector, with an original soundtrack and punchy arcade effects. Built for portrait play.

name: Gorilla Tag (Real Locomotion!)
creator: PG13park
description: Play all sorts of mini games in VR with mobile players as your host. Featuring Gorilla Tag locomotion!

name: STATION-15
creator: Clovdy Withavee
description: <<< STATION-15 >>> A dark sci-fi puzzle corridor where every room is a new test of your mind. No instructions. No hand-holding. Just you, your instincts, and a series of immersive challenges designed to push your memory, logic, timing, and patience to the limit. Navigate through mysterious rooms—each with its own custom puzzle, ambient soundscape, and mechanical twist. Each room presents a distinct, instruction-free challenge that puts your instincts and intuition to the test. With dynamic puzzle solutions, no two playthroughs feel the same—every visit offers something new to uncover. Remix-friendly. Built entirely in Codeblocks for easy learning, modular scripting, and total creative flexibility. Think you've got what it takes to solve them all? An original game by: <<< Clovdy Withavee >>> Brought to you by: <<< STVDIO WITHAVEE >>>

name: Steal a BrainRot
creator: Ilina3🤍
description: Update 11/27 Free Jammies! take the turkey or the pie to the oven to unlock Update 11/06 Spinning Wheel Update 📜 Update 10/31 Happy HALLOWEEN! 🎃 Update 10/28 ✨NEW✨ Collection Room 🎉 🧠 NEW: Steal A BrainRot in VR! 🧠 🎉 🏆 Hit "LIKE" and "Follow" - for more updates and to support the developer! 👍 👍 👍 .. You can also try "Steal A BrainRot 2"! 🚀 🥇 🥇 How to Play: Make Money 💸 Collect rare BrainRots 🧠 Steal the BrainRots 😈 Lock Your Base 🔒 Steal A Rot 👩‍💻 🎯 🎯 You're officially the BEST!!! 777 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ 🤔Like The Word You can also visit and discover all the amazing things in my other incredible worlds: My 1st Viral World! 🍋‍🟩 "Fashion Fusion" ✨ Elevate Your Style! Fashion Fusion 🕵️‍♂️ Murder Mystery Game!👮‍♀️🔎 🧟‍♂️Try to SURVIVE!!! 🔨 BrainRot Creator--

name: Steal A Snack
creator: WanesWorld
description: In Steal A Snack, you run a snack shop, collecting and upgrading tasty treats from a conveyor belt. Compete against Delicious, the sneaky AI opponent, by stealing snacks from their shop or defending your own. Earn coins, upgrade your shop, and outsmart Delicious to win. Will you be the ultimate snack champion? Play in a split-screen layout, with Delicious's shop on the bottom and your shop on top. Tap the STEAL button to grab snacks from Delicious's shop, but beware - Delicious can block your steals and steal back from you! Use the LOCKDOWN button to protect your snacks. The game ends after 3 minutes, and the player with the most coins wins.

name: Stellara
creator: Slay
description: Explore a vast galaxy, claim distant planets, discover ancient relics, and upgrade and customize your spaceship as you venture deeper into the unknown

name: Stillpoint - Cube Flow
creator: MetaNewby
description: In Stillpoint: Cube Flow, tap to remove cubes and swipe to rotate a 3D structure made of directional cubes, clearing a path through increasing puzzle difficulty. With a premium minimalist aesthetic and soothing audio, this mobile puzzle game offers a relaxing, tactile experience.

name: Stoics Rest
creator: Matlo.3D
description: Stoics Rest is a peaceful virtual sanctuary filled with over 300+ Stoic quotes & teachings to inspire reflection and resilience. Surrounded by colorful trees, gentle streams, and calming ambience, it's the perfect place to unwind, learn, and share moments with others on the same path.

name: Dungeon of the Cursed Forge WIP
creator: joshkap510
description: This is a Work In Progress Descend into the depths of the Dungeon of the Cursed Forge — a VR dungeon crawler where ancient dwarven forges burn with dark magic, goblins lurk in shadows, and cursed spirits haunt every corner. Explore hand-crafted labyrinths, solve deadly puzzles, and face fearsome monsters as you uncover a forgotten curse that threatens to consume all. Are you brave enough to survive the forge's fiery wrath?

name: Streetlight Kids: 90s Kid Tycoon
creator: WackyWiggles
description: Remember saving up allowance for that ONE thing? 90s Kid Tycoon lets you live that childhood dream - do chores, earn Kid Cash, and fill your room with lava lamps, boomboxes, and everything you begged your parents for. 🛝 Quick mobile sessions | 👨‍👩‍👧 AI Mom & Dad | 🏠 Claim your room | 🎵 Nostalgic 90s audio Best with friends. Sibling rivalry included.

name: Stretch Buddy
creator: creativeCharm
description: Stretch Buddy Workout offers a unique way to stay active and flexible using your phone. use caution when stretching and reaching for your device. Happy stretching!

name: Strike Racer 2D
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Drive down a scrolling 2D lane, steer between three lanes to aim your shots, tap to fire bowling balls at pin racks, and race the clock to the finish line. Pins knocked down by your ball score points; pins hit by your car cost points and slow you down. Collect power-ups like Heavy Ball, Triple Ball, and Turbo Boost to boost your score and speed. Compete for the best score and fastest time on six tracks of rising difficulty.

name: String King
creator: Fechin
description: Test your musical skills in this interactive game! Choose from mandolin, guitar, or ukulele and play along with dynamic notes. Compete in Time Trial, Endless Practice, and Perfect Player modes, and track your best scores.

name: Stroop Effect - Color Clash Quiz
creator: creativeCharm
description: Tap the shape that matches the label! Earn points for correct answers and badges for milestones. The countdown timer ticks down - Play now in QuizUp Showdown and test your skills!

name: Struggle Tiles
creator: DGreatusDGod
description: You find yourself in the midst of a vibrant match-3 puzzle game where swapping adjacent tiles clears them and earns you points. As you begin, you notice special tiles like bombs, stars, and power-ups that can help or hinder your progress. Your goal is to match three or more tiles of the same type to make them disappear. Watch out for bombs that blast a 5x5 area around them and stars that wipe every single tile of that type off the entire board at once. You navigate through levels with unique backgrounds, such as an alien planet, spaceship, or underwater city, each with its own story and animations. You can merge diamonds to create larger crystals that conduct electricity to destroy tiles between them. With each level, the game becomes more challenging and exciting. You can purchase power-ups to help you out. To start the game, you must first like and save the world. Once you've done that, the start button unlocks with a pulsing glow animation. Dive into Crystal Storm Showdown and experience the thrill of puzzle-solving!

name: Sudoku Challenge 🧩
creator: fakemovement
description:
The only Sudoku you need!
Place numbers 1-9 in every row, column, and box!
Daily puzzles, 4 difficulties, streaks, achievements, and infinite number of puzzles.
How long can you keep your streak?

name: Sudoku Puzzle Extreme
creator: thickumsest93
description: Solve Sudoku puzzles on a virtual chalkboard. Enjoy expert-level challenges, daily puzzles, and a classroom-themed interface. Track your progress and compete on leaderboards.

name: Suitcase Scramble - an AI experiment
creator: Habitor
description: When Meta released their AI Mesh generation tool I wanted to challenge myself to build something using those tools in under 6 hours. Using just the AI mesh tools and some basic shapes here and there I made this simple arcade style game about sorting suitcases in an airport in about 5.5 hours overall. Only about 1.5 hours was spent on art. The thumbnail was created by taking a picure of myself behind some real suitcases and then processed with AI before importing.

name: Sumonsters
creator: Tatsuya Horikoshi
description: This is a competitive game where players ride on a sumo wrestler and vie to see who can grow theirs the largest. By eating the food scattered throughout stages set in Japan, your sumo wrestler will continuously grow. However, be cautious of inedible items. You can also attack and defeat opponent sumo wrestlers. Aim to become number one in the size rankings!

name: Sunny Lake Fishing
creator: tmwheeler1
description: Cast your line and reel in the big ones in Sunny Lake Fishing! You'll play as a chibi-style young adult in jeans and flannel shirt, fishing on a sunny lake with a grassy bank and sparkling blue water. Catch 5 colorful fish - red, orange, yellow, teal, and purple - each worth points. Use the Cast & Reel In buttons to catch fish before the 60-second timer runs out. Will you beat your high score?

name: DrillBots ⛏️💎 Idle Mining
creator: GameDevBear
description:
Get your pickaxes ready and charge up those mining bots, because it's time to dig your way to financial independence!
Come try out this snazzy new incremental idle mining game, full of bots, boosts and buttons.

name: Super Meta stage maker
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Design and compete in retro-style platformer levels with Super Meta Stage Maker! Navigate through various themed stages like Classic Platformer, Spike Gauntlet, and Water World. Create your own stages with a 40x20 tile grid, platforms, hazards, and collectibles. Compete with a countdown timer, earning bonus points for finishing with time to spare. Your stages come to life with retro pixel art sprites and immersive play mode behavior. Share and save your creations with the community! Enjoy upbeat chiptune music, sound effects for jump, coin collect, and more, and choose from six selectable backgrounds for your stages, including Sky, Night Sky, Underground Cave, Underwater Ocean, Lava Cave, and Sunset. Try demo stages like Water World and showcase your skills on the leaderboard.

name: Super Money Grind Adventures
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Get ready to groove in Rhythm Kingdom Adventures! You step into a vibrant world where music and rhythm collide. Explore kingdoms like Piano Kingdom, with its black and white piano-key stairs, and Bass Drop Realm, pulsating with energetic beats. Master triple jumps, wall kicks, and emotes to progress through levels. Discover power-ups like Float Boost, Speed Boost, and Super Stomp to aid your quest. Face themed enemies and overcome challenges in kingdoms like Chill Beats Peak, Beatbox City, and Cloud Harmony. With classic NES-style controls, including a big red jump button, and a variety of music tracks, you're ready to take on the final DJ boss and put an end to the discord. Can you save the music and claim victory in Rhythm Kingdom Adventures?

name: Superhuman Academy
creator: MistaWavy
description: Navigate a transformative year as a teenage superhuman at Ashford Academy, balancing academics, relationships, and power growth. Make choices that impact your GPA, friendships, romantic relationships, and ultimate goal: advancing to Sophomore year. Explore a campus with unique locations, interact with dynamic NPCs, and make decisions that steer your story. Will you balance your life together or fail and repeat the grade again? Your choices matter in this immersive TTRPG experience.

name: Swap Drop Poker [Early Access]
creator: Jason (Pixel Dash Studios)
description: Try your hand at Swap Drop Poker! A game that combines the addictive fun of match-3 with the skill and luck of poker. Race the clock to create two, three or four of a kind matches for quick points, or bide your time to put together straights and flushes for big score multipliers! Play Hot Hands, complete quests, and use power ups to achieve high scores and work your way to the top of the leaderboards!

name: Swap Drop Words [Early Access]
creator: Jason (Pixel Dash Studios)
description: Race against the clock as you swap letters to create words and earn points in this fast-paced magical mystical puzzle game. Complete quests, form combos, and use power ups to outscore your friends on the leaderboards!

name: Swarmfall
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: You dash through hordes of goblins in a frantic bid for survival. Explore multiple arenas, each with unique challenges. Unlock achievements, earn coins for upgrades, and experience daily challenges. Face Brutes and Elites with visible health bars, making combat strategic. Tap the right side of the screen to dash through goblins and become the ultimate goblin slayer. With every run, you'll see how close you were to your next achievement and how many coins you earned. The game gets tougher with NORMAL, VETERAN, and NIGHTMARE modes, and a red notification badge in the ACHIEVE tab lets you know when you've unlocked new achievements mid-run. Your progress is tracked on separate leaderboards for NORMAL, VETERAN, and NIGHTMARE difficulties.

name: Swipe Heroes
creator: Tong Liang
description: SWIPE QUICKLY, BUILD UP YOUR COMBAT FEVER! Strange beings have started to appear all over the metaverse. Swipe in the right direction within a timed window to parry and attack the enemy! 23/01/2026 - Updated camera angle - Updated Environment - UI/UX Polishes - Game Re-balancing 20/01/2026 - Skippable Interactive Tutorial Added 18/01/2026 - added fever mode: build up your combo to unleash devstating swiping sequence against the boss 15/01/2026 Updates - Shop has been updated with two new weapons - Reward after each enemy killed - UI Updates

name: Switchback Courier
creator: Jacob G
description: Tap junctions to redirect a courier through three changing street layouts. Keep the one-way route connected and guide every delivery to its mailbox. A wrong turn can send you into a wall or a loop. Learn the roads, retry, and complete all three deliveries.

name: SyncShift
creator: Null.Gamer
description: You sprint through a vibrant, electronic world, shifting gravity and navigating neon obstacles in sync with the beat. Run, jump, and flip through 20 stages of increasing complexity. As you progress, obstacles get closer together and more challenging, requiring you to stay on beat to succeed. Your journey takes you through a futuristic neon world with a stage select menu, boost pads, rings for points, and a menu button to return to stage select anytime. With increasingly restrictive obstacles and tighter spacing between challenges, you'll need to master the rhythm and complete the level! Experience the thrill of a lean-forward sprint, acrobatic jumps, and a vaporize death effect with a shock sound. The world features a dynamic atmosphere, with near-black walls, vertical neon wall strips, a floor grid, and neon archway frames. Obstacles are designed to test your skills, from glowing neon barriers to laser walls and dynamic atmospheres. Feel the rush of speed and music as you play Rhythm Rift, with a score display at the top that increments as you jump over obstacles, earning 100 points each. Collect floating rotating neon stars for extra points – 10 points for blue stars and 25 points for pink stars. Pressing down now spins the character in a 360° forward somersault roll, adding a new level of excitement to your run. Swipe up to jump, swipe down to roll, swipe left and right to shift gravity. Navigate through 3 lanes on the floor, walls, and ceiling, swiping left or right at the bottom of the screen to shift lanes.

name: Synthetic Photography & Art Museum
creator: mrasdf9876
description: An amazing gallery of human art (and music) and funny AI generated images, set on an asteroid between Earth and Mars. Art, music, hangouts, activities, exploration, and beautiful space scenery.

name: Taco Party🌮
creator: MikeyAce
description: "Taco Party" is a fun role-playing restaurant adventure set on a gorgeous tropical island. Players make realistic tacos and then deliver them in an awesome way: launching tacos out of cannons to customers on rafts in the ocean, with dolphins jumping around. By making and delivering tacos and doing other fun tasks, players earn in-world "Ace Bucks" to spend on tacos, soda, ice cream, and water rides. Every Tuesday, we have "Taco Tuesday," with a special sunset theme, fireworks, party games, music, boat rides, and more.

name: Taco Terror
creator: 13_Chris
description: Taco Terror is a chaotic cooking horror game where up to 5 players run their own haunted kitchen. Collect ingredients, chop vegetables, cook meats, and assemble tacos to serve a growing horde of undead customers before time runs out. But beware... demons stalk the kitchen, disrupting your work and draining your lives if you fail to keep up. Each player progresses through 30 escalating phases, where orders grow harder, the timer gets tighter, and the kitchen becomes more dangerous. 🌮 Gather ingredients 🔪 Chop and cook fast 👹 Avoid demons 💀 Serve the undead How long can you survive the Taco Terror? 👉 Join the community: https://bit.ly/Join13VrCreations

name: Taffy Trot
creator: FlexedTie
description: Welcome To Taffy Trot! Make your way up the chaotic Taffy Trot trail to sweet sweet victory in this 8-bit styled candy coated game world!

name: Tam's Hangman Quest
creator: Yoda G.
description: Get ready to unleash your inner Hangman Champion! You browse through categories like Animals, Movies, and Countries, each with its own set of themed characters that build up with every wrong guess. As you win rounds, you unlock new categories and face tougher challenges with fewer guesses allowed. Save your progress mid-campaign and compete with others on a global leaderboard, ranking by your longest win streak.

name: Tap A Groove
creator: izukingz
description: Get ready to groove! You step into a vibrant dance world where rhythm meets challenge. Tap along to the beat, swiping in the direction of arrows for bonus points. As you progress, the beat sequence changes and the challenge gets harder. Can you keep the rhythm going and achieve the highest score? Master the dance floor and show off your skills in Tap A Groove!

name: Tap and Flap
creator: daddy26764
description: Tap to flap a bird through scrolling green pipes in a bright sky-blue world. Gravity pulls down, but with quick reflexes, you can avoid hitting pipes and keep flying. The game ends if you hit a pipe or the ground. Your high score will be displayed for all to see. Tap and Flap is a Flappy Bird-style endless flier with a determined golden bird.

name: tap tap brew
creator: blanktarget
description: Tap the glowing cauldron to brew potions, earn Arcane Essence, and spend it on upgrades, ingredients, and undead minions in this cozy witch game. Earn Brew Points, upgrade your cauldron and minions, and sell brews for gold. Idle gameplay with satisfying music, animations, and UI. Compete on leaderboards and save your progress in Mystic Brews.

name: Tap Tap Frenzy
creator: metabigchief
description: Tap Tap Showdown is a fast-paced rhythm game with two electrifying modes: Time Attack and Freestyle. In Time Attack, tap a glowing target that moves to a new random position with each successful hit, aiming to complete 30 taps in the lowest time. In Freestyle, strive for the shortest intervals between taps. Earn personal bests, track your progress on a stylish interface, and climb the global leaderboards to become the ultimate tapping master. With a neon art look and consistent design across all screens, Tap Tap Showdown is the perfect game for those who love music and rhythm. Play Tap Tap Showdown now and show off your skills!

name: TapDrop
creator: Elastic_Plastic
description: Master the art of precision in TapDrop! With each failed attempt, they shrink in size, requiring even greater accuracy to successfully place them. Don't worry about dropping them on the floor - just focus on getting better with every try!

name: TAPFLOW
creator: AustinTheWise
description: In TAPFLOW, tap and swipe in perfect sync to a playlist of catchy tunes! Notes flash on screen with shrinking approach rings, hit them for a Perfect grade, or get a Good grade for a slightly off timing. Miss a note and the combo resets. See how high your combo multiplier can go and earn points towards your final score!

name: TARNEEB SHOWDOWN - 2v2 Card Game
creator: TFX
description: You and an AI partner play 2v2 Tarneeb against two AI opponents. Bid on tricks, play cards strategically, and outmaneuver opponents to reach 41 points. Customize your table with Green, Blue, Yellow, or Red felt. Preview now and master the game!

name: TCG Card Store Simulator
creator: NickteaVR
description: Run a bustling monster card shop! Restock shelves, serve customers, and collect rare cards to display. Earn coins to upgrade your shop and manage escalating customer spawns. Explore a binder of 40 unique monster cards in watercolor anime style, with new cards to collect and display. Unlock upgrades and experience Collector Days with special rewards. As you prepare for the day, tap the pause button to freeze time and plan your next move.

name: Teal Duck Hunt
creator: Yoda G.
description: You play a duck hunting game where ducks fly across the screen in wavy paths. Tap anywhere to fire, with crosshair feedback on screen. The game has escalating rounds - every 5 ducks cleared speeds things up and adds more ducks at once. You score +100 per duck, up to a 5x combo multiplier for quick shots.

name: Technoir: Cybercity Nights
creator: FrostyBrownShoe
description: Free-roam the Cybercity and see what you find, or hang out in Technoir and dance the night away.

name: Tether
creator: 13_Chris
description: You swing on a glowing tether around anchor nodes in a dark cosmic environment. Tap anywhere to launch into an arc and latch onto the next node's orbit ring. Achieve the highest link count in endless run mode or within timed sessions. Face a difficulty ramp with widening gaps and drifting nodes as your score climbs. Compete with others on the LINKS, TIME, and VISITS leaderboards, accessible from the menu. Customize your experience with music and SFX mute buttons. Enjoy the neon glow visual style with parallax stars and particle effects. Play in Orbit Frenzy and test your skills!

name: Thanksgiving Feast Hall
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Join a lively Canadian Thanksgiving celebration in a grand castle dining hall! Interact with friendly characters, enjoy a feast with physics-enabled food and drinks, and engage in LLM conversations. But beware: punching a guest will start a playful fight, deducting points from your Thanksgiving Harmony Score. Explore the decorated hall, complete with furniture, silverware, and delicious treats. Will you be a Gracious Guest or a Feast Wrecker? Dive in and find out!

name: The Aethereal Zen Island
creator: Drew @ AetherealStudios
description: The Aethereal Zen Island is a relaxing incremental experience where you gather and refine the four natural elements to create balance and harmony. Sync with nature, transform energy into Luminite, and let the island evolve with your calm.

name: The Battle Arena
creator: creativeCharm
description: Let's battle to the death!

name: The Big Fish: Eat or Be Eaten
creator: fakemovement
description:
Eat smaller fish, avoid bigger ones, and grow into the ocean's apex predator. Simple to play and very addictive underwater adventure!

The goal is simple, in this game, you are a fish that eat to grow! The more fish and food you eat the more you grow!
Collect points to purchase Fish Avatar (over 80 fishes to collect)!!

name: The Big Little Show
creator: Rafael Barbosa
description:
Welcome to the #TheBigLittleShow, a reality-TV-inspired experience where tv show meets chaotic minigames.

:sunny: In this colorful social competition, you and your friends dress to impress and dive into absurd challenges designed to test your speed, wits, and knowledge. The arena? A dazzling game show stage where the cameras are always rolling and everyone's a star (or a disaster).

Join matches and be minified to compete on the center stage in up to 15 different minigames for the win!

Built for VR, desktop, and mobile, The Big Little Show is silly, stylish... and sneakily competitive.

You'll pose. You'll panic. And spoiler alert: someone always steals the spotlight. :microphone:

:tools:UPDATES:
* Removed Halloween Update

name: The Colony - Ants vs Termites
creator: Sammyosa
description:
The Colony — Grow, Defend, Invade!
Beta testing
A fast-paced ant-strategy sandbox where survival becomes a battle for dominance.
Choose your side — lead the ants or command the termites, and fight for control of a living battlefield.
Collect Usu for the colony (Scout points look nice too!). Grow your colony by catching bugs and growing crops.
Defend your colony's resources and eliminate rival colonies.
🔧 Build:

* Deploy defensive cannons, traps, and walls to protect your colony's crops and resources.
