* Upgrade unit combat units with unique weapons and shields — build your ultimate army!

💡 Please remember: this is a Beta Test — our world is eager to get your feedback, suggestions, and ideas, and shape this world into a better version.
Please drop all feedback in our feedback form located in The Colony Discord or at the Feedback Box in the world lobby.

🐜 Buildings:
* Primary buildings include houses and farms: raise your production rate and expand your territory.
* Construct the Cookie Jar to unlock the defender system and recruit restless defenders.

⚔️ Multiplayer:
* Up to 15 players can join with their own independent colonies.
* Team up or fight for dominance in the ultimate colony showdown.

name: The EpiCenter sub focus Christmas movie theme
creator: MR Bruce Arthur Wayne

name: The Final Alibi
creator: mommy26764
description:
🏰 ONE MANSION. SIX SUSPECTS. ONE KILLER.
A murder has shaken a grand Victorian mansion, and everyone has something to hide!
Step into the shoes of a detective and uncover the truth behind a deadly mystery.
Explore the mansion, search for hidden evidence, question six suspicious characters, and record your discoveries in your Detective Notebook.
But pay attention! Not everyone is telling the truth.
🔍 HOW TO PLAY
🕵️ EXPLORE: Move your detective through the mansion and investigate its rooms.
🔍 FIND CLUES: Search for six hidden pieces of evidence. Tap to inspect anything suspicious.
🗣️ QUESTION SUSPECTS: Approach the six suspects and tap to hear their statements.
📓 USE YOUR NOTEBOOK: Review evidence, read testimonies, and eliminate suspects, weapons, and rooms.
❌ CROSS OFF POSSIBILITIES: Tap notebook entries to eliminate them from your investigation.
⚖️ SOLVE THE MYSTERY: When you're ready, select MAKE ACCUSATION and identify the killer, murder weapon, and crime scene.
The truth is waiting to be discovered!

name: The Forgotten Floor
creator: mommy26764
description: Explore The Vanishing Hallway on Floor 7 of The Forgotten Floor. Memorize door sequences and escape before becoming trapped. Discover a mysterious hotel with a rich history, solving puzzles and collecting treasures across multiple floors. You can explore Floor 7, The Vanishing Hallway, and other floors in this 2D mystery adventure game.

name: The Green Door: Comedy Club
creator: CtrlAltTr0ll
description: Come enjoy a laughter filled escape at 'The Green Door'... We are an 18+ comedy club where jokes can be dirty, jokes can be clean or jokes can be anywhere in between.

name: The Hardy World Spades
creator: Hardy World
description:
Pull up a chair. The Hardy World Spades is classic Black Spades (Big Joker, Little Joker, Deuce, Deuce) played the way it's played at the family cookout.
Bid smart, count your books, watch your bags. Earn XP every hand, level up from Newcomer to Legend of the Table, and climb the weekly and all-time leaderboards. Big, easy-to-read cards and text, a How to Play guide, and smooth R&B at the table.

name: The Haunting at Blackthorn Manor
creator: 🩵 LadyMo218 🩵
description: Stay the night at the historical Blackthorn Manor and uncover its ghostly secrets...

name: The Last Exit
creator: marcin
description:
Welcome to The Last Exit!
Dash through rooms filled with deadly traps and puzzles. Choose your door wisely: one leads forward, the others mean instant death.
The clock is ticking and the chaos grows with every step.
——————————————————
💬 Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/y6hAsdDHbj
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lastexitgame/

name: The Last Lantern
creator: PixiFox
description: Navigate a shifting maze with an AI companion, collecting keys and avoiding Shadow Stalkers to escape. Your lantern lights the path ahead as you progress through three stages: claim your key, assist your partner, and both reach the exit. The labyrinth can be unforgiving, but with teamwork, will you find your way out?

name: The Last Laugh
creator: unemployed_alcoholic
description: Mobile-only laugh battle. Applaud or heckle your friends, win chuckle nuggets, and provoke savage comebacks. Fast rounds, zero ads—will you have The Last Laugh?

name: The Lobby
creator: TaKo1513
description: The first custom import world made with all the educational workshops and tutorials in MHCP that elevated my knowledge. A world of examples from mesh shapes to custom made imports from outside Horizon Worlds, brought in to fully customize worlds. Come back for updates.

name: The Lone rangers bowling arcade
creator: Yoda G.
description: Play The Lone Rangers Bowling Arcade, a cosmic neon bowling alley where you tilt to aim, tap to power, and chase high scores! Strike pins in a dazzling display of combos and particle effects. Unlock glowing balls, lane themes, and cosmetics as you play. Compare your skills on the leaderboard, tracking your top 10 scores and highest combos in Strike Frenzy.

name: THE MATCHING SMITH-SAN
creator: Chik Smith
description:
SMITH intel drops HERE → https://www.tiktok.com/@the_matching_smith_san
Real Smiths gather HERE → https://discord.gg/9ndFqwu67m
Yo, Smith.
You got pulled into this world too, huh?
What’s that?
You’re not a Smith??
Pffft—come on, what are you talking about, Smith?
There are over 4 million Smiths in the world, y’know?
You, me—we’re all Smiths.
This place? It’s where only the truest of Smiths come to play.
Every day, a random pair of Smiths team up to take on wild games and grow stronger.
Why?
Beats me. I didn’t sign up for this either.
I’m just another Smith who got called here outta nowhere.
...Oh. Looks like it’s time.
I hope I get matched with you out there.
Until then...
3... 2... 1...
LET’S MATCH, SMIIIIITH!!

name: The Merchant
creator: Slay
description:
A cozy fantasy shopkeeping experience ✨
Craft items. Sell them to customers. Hire workers. Customize your shop. Become The Merchant ⚔️👑

name: The Negotiator
creator: Nekerv2017
description: You step into the shoes of a skilled negotiator, tasked with resolving critical situations. Your goal is to navigate through negotiation screens, making crucial decisions that impact the outcome. Immerse yourself in the game's world. Earn high scores and compete with others on the leaderboard, ranking by resolution rate. Will you rise to the top as a master negotiator?

name: The Pit! - Free For All
creator: HISOKAN
description:
🔥 Are you ready? 🔥
Grab your weapon ⚔️ and your backpack 🎒, The Pit is waiting for you! Don’t wait any longer... JUMP! 🤸💥
🏆 Compete with other players to be #1
💎 Collect the cores before anyone steals them
💰 Earn the most coins and show off your wealth.
📊 Can you be the best on the Leaderboards?
⚔️ Choose your favorite weapon... they’re FREE!
🎒 Equip a cool backpack with everything you earn.

name: The Tenth Passage
creator: Null.Gamer
description: You find yourself standing in a decrepit underground hallway of an abandoned asylum. The air is thick with decay and corruption, and a sickly yellow-green glow emanates from flickering ceiling lights. Steel support columns line the walls, and you encounter a humanoid figure with a grotesque parasitic mass on its head limping towards you. The eerie atmosphere and unsettling visuals draw you deeper into the mysteries of Abandoned Asylum Corridor.

name: The Vigilance [Tap to Attack]
creator: GameDevBear
description: You are aboard the vigilance, on an expedition into unknown waters. Defend the ship against the terrors of the sea. Upgrade and bolster your forces to get further into the deep!

name: The Village of Roberson Tycoon's
creator: Yoda G.
description: Manage a village, balancing budgets, citizen happiness, and growth while navigating random disasters. Customize villagers and service buildings like the town clinic, schoolhouse, and community services. Save progress and unlock new building types as your village prospers. Experience seasonal changes and set financial goals. In Roberson Tycoons Village, you build a village from the ground up, managing resources and citizen needs.

name: The Welch's: BATTLE OF THE ANSWERS
creator: Yoda G.
description: You step into 'The Welch's: Battle of the Answers', a single-player trivia game where you match survey responses to earn points. Playing through 3 levels of escalating difficulty, you'll face themed questions from Sports, Food & Dining, Pop Culture, Entertainment, Lifestyle, and General Knowledge. As you progress, the game gets tougher: Level 1 is a warm-up with 3 strikes and easy questions

name: They Talk in Code
creator: creativeCharm
description: Decode number combinations from character dialogue and input them into a tactile combination dial on a vault. Solve puzzles quickly to earn rewards and climb the leaderboard!

name: Thieves & Warlocks
creator: emorgul
description: Race across the enchanted tiles to claim your treasure and become the Warlock.

name: Thornhaven 3D
creator: GausRoth
description: Thornhaven is a grid-based, first-person dungeon crawler for mobile. Descend into a new procedurally generated dungeon every run. Explore room by room, open doors and chests, and fight in turn-based combat where every step and swing costs Action Points. Enemies roam their halls and hunt you once they spot you. Beat Morvhal the Bone Lord to win, or retreat to town with your loot before it's too late. Fall, and you lose half the gold you found on that run.

name: Threads of Wonder
creator: April_Renee
description: Lady Sophia, floats beside you, radiating warmth and encouragement. As you explore, you discover three puzzles that connect threads of light to awaken the island... unlock the secrets of the island, guided by Lady Sophia's gentle voice and the magic of the glowing threads.

name: ThumbBEATz
creator: thickumsest93
description: Get ready to groove in Rhythm Rush! Play a vibrant rhythm game where you tap, hold, swipe, and alternate between thumbs to hit notes in sync with the beat. Earn combos, multipliers, and stars across 4 difficulties, with daily challenges and a futuristic visual style complete with neon effects, colorful backgrounds, and particles. The game features a stunning splash screen, a menu screen, and all UI elements. Hit notes with precision and rhythm to achieve high scores in Rhythm Rush!

name: Tic Tac Bee
creator: voytek.lorenc (metacrafters)
description: Play tic tac toe with a bee

name: Tic Tac Toe Mobile Mix
creator: jimrif
description: Enjoy the classic game of Tic Tac Toe on your mobile device in Horizon Worlds. Play solo against difficulty-adjustable opponents or challenge a friend on the same device. Choose your style with multiple visual themes found in the Settings menu: Neon • Sky • Colorful • Underwater • Cats & Dogs • Pixel The game is available in portrait mode on a mobile device or landscape mode on the web. Rules: Tic Tac Toe is a classic two-player game where one player is X and the other is O. The board is a 3×3 grid with nine spaces. Players take turns placing their mark in any empty space. A win is achieved by getting three of your marks in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line. Players alternate roles each game, and X always goes first. In single-player mode, you can adjust the computer's difficulty from a forgiving Beginner to an Expert that should never lose.

name: Tideglass
creator: Jacob G
description: Turn the channels. Guide the tide. Rescue every garden before your moves run out, and keep the lighthouse dry. Solve three branching water puzzles, advance the tide when your route is ready, and replay to finish with more moves left.

name: Tidy up!
creator: Bambipie
description: Tidy Up! is a cozy sorting puzzler about making messy spaces feel calm again. Sort desk clutter, pack lunchboxes, match shoes, fold laundry, scrub the bathroom sink and more across 41 relaxing levels. Each one has its own little twist: sort by category, follow a rule, find what doesn't belong, or dig through hidden piles. Every tidy room earns you coins and up to 3 stars. Spend your coins decorating My Space, your own bedroom, with beds, lamps, plants, plushies and dozens of cute pieces you can drag anywhere you like. Collect stars to unlock special decor you can't buy! Come back every day for a new Daily Jigsaw. Keep your daily streak going for bonus rewards! No timers, no stress. Just you, a messy room, and that satisfying feeling when everything's in its place. 💕

name: Tik Tac Fade
creator: Yoda G.
description: Play Tic-Tac-Fade, a twist on classic Tic-Tac-Toe with a fading twist. You play on a 3x3 grid, placing marks that fade away after four are placed. Win by getting three in a row, column, or diagonal. Challenge the computer on easy or hard modes, or play against a friend. The scoreboard keeps track of your progress across rounds.

name: Tile Rush
creator: thickumsest93
description: Explore a grand stone temple with puzzle-carved walls and ornate tile floors. Customize your experience with a jungle-themed home screen and daily challenges. Solve puzzles, collect rewards, and compete on the leaderboard for the fastest completion time. Music plays continuously throughout gameplay.

name: Timbervale Tycoon [Early Access]
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: 🌲 Welcome home to Timbervale. Start with nothing but an axe… and build your way into a thriving village. Chop trees, collect resources, and turn your small campsite into a cozy town filled with life, upgrades, and rewards. Unlock new islands, discover rare materials, and grow your village faster than ever. 💰 Earn coins 🏡 Build and expand 🌍 Explore new zones ✨ Upgrade everything Whether you're playing solo or with friends, there's always something new to build. Just one more tree… 🌲

name: Tinder Tarot PokerBond Deck
creator: creativeCharm
description: 18+. Play Tinder Tarot with a potential date or match. Win hands to buy gifts and practice wooing your date — but beware, their vibes might surprise you. Explore the gift shop, send love notes, and make unforgettable memories. In Tinder Tarot, you play for one date at a time, customizing their look and name before dealing the cards. The game features bigger card text for better readability, shows only the winning hand cards in the reading, and lets you buy gifts like love notes, movie tickets, drinks at the bar, or a couple cruise. Youringame purchases are saved in your play history, so you can see what you've bought for who with what you've earned. Tinder Tarot offers a fun, interactive experience where you can test your tarot-reading skills and build connections with your date. KNOWN ISSUE: TEXT FORMATTING. FIX COMING SOON!

name: Tiny Food Tycoon
creator: WanesWorld
description: You step into the bustling world of Tiny Food Tycoon, where you're the maestro of a vibrant restaurant empire! You start at Tokyo Flame, your fiery starting restaurant, serving up dishes with precision and speed. As you grow, unlock Roll Dynasty, your sleek sushi bar, and Pasta Palace, your cozy Italian haven. Manage your kitchen with finesse, unlocking new chefs and upgrades to keep customers happy and coming back for more. Earn coins and XP by serving dishes just right, and use boosters to supercharge your earnings. In this fast-paced restaurant simulation, every second counts - will you become the ultimate Tiny Food Tycoon?

name: Tiny Poltergeist
creator: hyperjoule
description: This room is haunted. By you. Don’t touch it’s things.

name: Tiny Tribunal
creator: Jacob G
description: A template for building a 2D game from scratch.

name: Tomato Face
creator: emorgul
description: Exercise your First Amendment rights while you still can.

name: Tombstone Valley
creator: Mr1000tracks
description: Wild Wild West on mobile! Protect the towns watch out for ambushes, tame horses, and scavenge the land 🔥🐎 (still improving)

name: Top Hat
creator: Torturas
description: ✊🖐️✌️Throw hands. Grow hats. Rule the room. 🎁Chase and tag your friends in a race to find hidden presents. 🤝Win rock, paper, scissors battles to flex the tallest hat. 👑Style your hat to stand out from the crowd. 🎩Biggest hat wins. No cap.

name: Tower Guardians
creator: Greasy.Gaming
description: Defend a vibrant fantasy castle from enemy hordes and dragons in this epic tower defense game! Collect Dragon Souls to claim victory. Gather your party, build towers, and progress through levels to unlock more items. Maybe a Camel, Ostrich or even a Unicorn. As you approach, an orange camp tents they let you recruit party members to join your quest. Select your hero from a grid of 5 characters, each with unique abilities. Will you protect your castle and emerge victorious?!?

name: Tower of Zen OBBY!
creator: Matthiaos
description: How quickly can YOU climb the Tower? Speedrun your way through the multiplayer platformer where levels change as you play!

name: Towers of Kwatz
creator: emorgul
description: Tower Defense meets Yahtzee. Roll your dice to crush the invading goblins, and lock in combos to build powerful towers. Upgrade your dice and towers to survive waves of tougher enemies. It's unique, delightful, and really really fun.

name: Toxic Amoeba Survival
creator: Dragonkind
description: Play as an amoeba in a toxic wasteland. Move with a virtual joystick, auto-attack nearby waste blobs, and collect power-ups like Bigger Aura and Speed Boost. As waves escalate, blobs get faster and spawn more often. Can you survive?

name: Trash Dash
creator: Ag
description: You step into the role of a highway cleanup hero, navigating a vibrant highway environment. Move left and right to collect litter, scrap metal, jewelry, and valuables. As you fill your bag, civilian cars and government trucks drive by, tossing you rewards for your good deeds. When your bag is full, dash to one of the parked collection trucks on the roadside and tap to deposit your haul, earning coins and seeing your progress. Upgrade your gear at the shop between rounds to boost your bag capacity, speed, and magnet range. Can you become the ultimate trash collector on this bustling highway?

name: Trashbyrd's Decathlon
creator: Scott (Trashbyrd)
description: Compete against the AI and other players in this 10 event spectacular of timing and skill.

name: Treasure Hunter
creator: Thoth
description: Work alongside Dr. Murphy to solve puzzles and find ancient treasures.

name: Treasure Map
creator: voytek.lorenc (metacrafters)
description: Strategize how to get to the treasure.

name: Treasure Tomb Tiles
creator: TheRealMadCat
description: Step into an ancient Egyptian pyramid tomb, the tiled grid lies before you like a map of hidden treasures. With your trusty torch in hand, you tap to reveal Egyptian stone slabs, each potentially hiding treasure or curses. Tap tiles to determine what you'll find, and decide whether to push your luck or escape with your haul. The game's vibrant art style and Egyptian ambient soundtrack immerse you in the experience. Try your luck with extra mini-games. Will you collect enough treasure to climb the Leaderboard and become the ultimate tomb raider, or will the curse of The Pharoah catch up with you? Play Treasure Tomb Tiles to find out!

name: Trick or Treat CHAOS!
creator: xX_Jazzie_Xx
description: Hand out candy to every trick-or-treater — but dodge the pranksters, deflect the eggs, and survive the blackouts!

name: Trickster's TriPeaks
creator: Blacqdiamone
description: Blast cards off the tower with a Wildcard Joker! Play a spooky Halloween TriPeaks game with 4 unique levels, animated card backs, and a Daily Challenge mode. Earn a Pumpkin Bomb at a 10-card streak and compete on two leaderboards. Tap the hint button, a glowing crystal ball, to highlight a playable card. Experience full spooky audio and landscape orientation with big, easy-to-tap cards. Joker's Wild TriPeaks features 4 animated card backs, a Wildcard Joker, and a Daily Challenge mode. Can you beat the top scores?

name: Trinketeers
creator: Runtime_Renegade
description:
Trinketeers is a cozy backpack auto-battler. Choose a pal, like Tumble the tortoise, and fill the space on its back with trinkets from Old Thimble's stall: slings, honey pots, pinecone shields and more. Where each one sits decides how it fights.

Set out across the map and your pal battles rivals on its own. Trinkets knock loose, crack and heal. Beat the Guardians, choose your path at every fork and become champion of the Lantern Fair.

Come back each day for Daily Wishes, walk the Lantern Path and earn Merit Badges. Spend the Glimmer you earn on hats, scarves, skins and sparkling effects for your pal.

name: Trivia Blitz - Video Game Edition
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: Test your knowledge of video games.

name: Trivia Blitz Arcade - Horror Edition
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: In Trivia Blitz Arcade, you play a retro-style video game trivia challenge. Answer questions about horror movies across three levels.

name: Trivia Frenzy!
creator: WanesWorld
description: Get ready for Trivia Frenzy! - a mobile-friendly 2D trivia game where you answer 5,000 fact-checked questions across 100 categories. Earn points, coins, and XP, and climb the ranks to become the ultimate Trivia Legend!

name: Tropical Sunset Links
creator: Yoda G.
description: Play a 9-hole tropical golf game with dynamic obstacles and ambient details! Track scores, unlock ball colors, and compete with friends or solo on leaderboards. Explore a vibrant lobby hub, warm up on the practice green, and enjoy a looping ocean ambience bed and tropical ukulele background track. Meet Birdie the caddie, Chip the rival, and the Course Starter.

name: TRUMPED
creator: mommy26764
description:
Think you've got what it takes to rule the table? PROVE IT!

Shuffle up, call your trump, and get ready for some serious Euchre action! Team up with your computer partner and take on two clever opponents in this classic card game with a competitive twist!

♠ Master the trump suit and rule with the bowers!

♥ Choose your challenge: Easy, Medium, or Hard!

♦ Go ALONE for a shot at BIG points!

♣ Outsmart your opponents and avoid getting EUCHRED!

🏆 Climb the global leaderboard and become a Euchre legend!

🎯 First team to 10 points takes the crown!

Whether you're a seasoned Euchre pro or just learning the ropes, there's a seat waiting for you at the table!

Got the cards? Got the guts? CALL IT!

👑 TRUMPED! — Where every hand is a gamble and bragging rights are EVERYTHING! 🃏🔥

name: Turf.io
creator: 𝓚𝓪𝓲𝓒𝓮𝓹𝓱𝓾𝓼
description:
**60 SECONDS. CLAIM YOUR TURF!**

Draw lines, capture territory, and outsmart your rivals in TURF.io! Expand your turf, cut off opponents, and dominate the arena before time runs out.

**How much turf can YOU claim in 60 seconds?**

name: Turret X Halloween
creator: Lan(SerenityLel)
description: You blast ghosts, werewolves, vampires, and evil pumpkins with a floating jack-o'-lantern hot air balloon turret that fires candy corn! Move with one joystick and aim with another, firing only when active. Survive escalating rounds, upgrading your turret's speed, damage, or effects between waves. Explore a spooky graveyard with tombstones, haunted forests, and ruins, all in a spooky grey, green, and dark color palette. Choose from various balloon designs and health potion styles to customize your experience. Glowing health potions appear randomly to help you survive. Face off against a giant Cracked Glowing Golem boss in Round 4, and experience a global leaderboard that tracks your progress against other players. Your turret health resets to 100% each round. Turrent Terror is the ultimate Halloween-themed shooter - join in now! In Turrent Terror Halloween, you can enjoy the gameplay with 20 enemies in round 3 and enemies do 25% less damage to the turret.

name: TUTORIAL OBBY PARKOUR
creator: XWDFr
description: This world is an interactive tutorial to help you start building your own Obby Parkour in Meta Horizon. You can use it as it is, customize it, or take it as a base to create your own course. With plenty of assets already included, you have everything you need to unleash your creativity!

name: Twilight Quest
creator: April_Renee
description: Duchess guides and encourages you. Collect star fragments, match symbols, and connect threads of light to unlock enchanting transformations.

name: Tyranny of Rockets
creator: Fechin
description: A rocket based game designed to teach the fundamentals of calculus in a fun and interesting way.

name: Ultimate Ninja Obby
creator: TakaTado
description:
In Ultimate Ninja Obby, you are not a ninja… yet.

Take on a brutal training course filled with spinning shurikens, wind turbines, moving platforms, and precision parkour challenges. Every obstacle is designed to test your timing, skill, and focus.

Only those who reach the end can claim the legendary sword and become a true ninja.

Do you have what it takes?

name: Umai Words
creator: Umlo.
description: Swipe, spell, and watch it all cascade. Trace paths across letter tiles to form words — watch them shatter, chain react, and tumble as new letters fall into place. Discover special tiles that shake up the board, unlock boards that change shape as you progress, and master combos that build on each other. Hundreds of levels, each one a new challenge. Easy to pick up, hard to put down. A word puzzle with more going on than you'd expect.

name: Umi Pop
creator: supermangofive
description: Umi Pop reinvents the knight sim with a playful, pet-driven twist! Train, care for, and joust with your Umi, an adorable mount with a big personality. Rise through the ranks and become the Monarch of the Aerial Islands!

name: UNDERWORLD Costume Party
creator: TanzerVR
description: 135+ FREE Costumes to wear! Throw your own Costume Dance Party in the Underworld across the River Styx. Customize your own playlist from 400 music tracks! 10 dance moves when visited on mobile.

name: Canasta Champions
creator: Dooley
description: Play Canasta against 3 chibi bots on a vibrant green felt table in Canasta Frenzy Showdown! Tap cards to select them, then tap buttons to draw, discard, or meld. Your goal is to be the first team to reach 3000 points. Your partner, Nana Rosie, occasionally plays brilliantly by accident. Your opponents are Chad, a cocky teenager, and Timmy, a nervous beginner. Relaxed jazzy music and satisfying meld chimes keep you engaged. Melds show as a fan of mini-cards with stack depth and labels; Cards show rank + suit symbol, color-coded; Canastas get a gold or silver border plus a label; Tap targets on meld stacks are preserved. Discarding a wild card freezes the pile - you'll need 2 natural cards of the same rank to pick it up. Your full hand now shows after picking up the pile — cards compress to fit, and if there are too many, you can swipe left/right to scroll through them.

name: Up Rising Parkour Obby
creator: 13_Chris
description:
🌍 Start at the Core. Rise Beyond the Stars.
Welcome to the sixth and most advanced world in the Up Parkour series — Up Rising Parkour Obby. This time, you're not just running levels...
You're climbing through the layers of Earth all the way to outer space.

🔥 25 unique levels — from magma chambers and crystal caverns to low-gravity spacewalks in orbit.

🌀 What's New:
📱 Fully Enhanced Mobile Optimization
✨ Double Jump always enabled
📏 New Player Scaling Tech — shrink to ¼ size in the 1v1 race
🚀 Boost Pads, Gravity Shifts, Ice Traps, and Speed Zones
🏁 Modes: Free Run, 1v1 Duel Arena, Global Time Trials
🔄 Viewport Switching (Mobile) + Hold-to-Lobby (All Platforms)
👫 Try the Low-Gravity Ring Game!
Requires 2+ players and rewards skillful flight through a gravity-defying course — perfect for co-op chaos and competitive fun.

All of this is set along a vertical path from the Earth's molten core to a futuristic starbound obby.

💥 Race your friends. Beat the clock. Prove yourself.
This is Up Rising Parkour Obby — where gravity is optional and only the best make it to the stars.

📸 Follow on IG: [@13_Chris.VR]
💬 Join the Discord: https://bit.ly/Join13VrCreations

name: Urban Foraging
creator: metaversepaige
description: Tap to identify plants in vibrant environments! Explore 8 levels, from Community Garden to Urban Forest Edge. Each level has unique plants and challenges. Correctly identify plants to earn points and level up. Beat your best score and track progress on the Game Over screen. Up to 3 plants appear at once, and you have 15 seconds to tap each one before it disappears. Can you master urban foraging and become a top scorer in Urban Harvester?

name: Van Gogh's Cozy Café
creator: metacrafters
description: You run a cozy café on a spring stormy day, surrounded by Van Gogh's vibrant art. Hatch eggs to get creatures inspired by his paintings, like Sunny from Sunflowers and Starry from Starry Night. Serve them drinks and take a painting quiz with chibi versions of famous works like Irises and Café Terrace at Night. Earn coins, unlock rare eggs, and enjoy the whimsical atmosphere. The café features a day system, with 90-second days and coins carrying over. Game Over at 0 hearts. The quiz cycles through 6 paintings, including The Sower and Irises. Discover new creatures like Irisy, Terracy, and Sowy, each with their own favorite drink. Paintings will be added weekly!

name: Vector Storm
creator: OvenRoasted
description: In the depths of a neon-lit void, you pilot a sleek Angular Fighter through Storm Mode, Waves Mode, and Evade Mode. Master twin-stick controls to blast geometric enemies, collect power-ups like Surge and Phase Shield, and outrun the competition in a hypnotic dance of light and sound. The dynamic grid pulses with energy, responding to your every move as you chase high scores and challenge your reflexes.

name: Vector Vortex
creator: PrometheusGMP.TM.CR
description: VECTOR VORTEX: RIM BLASTER is a Tempest-style neon vector rim shooter. Ride the rim, blast climbers before they reach you. Play 10 levels, each a board shape: circle, square, triangle, star, clover and more. Every board lasts at least a minute, and score and lives carry across levels. Clear all 10 to win! Face Flippers, Tankers and Spikers, and use the SuperZapper in tight spots. Collect coins, visit the shop, try Daily Challenge, earn badges, chase high scores and join the autumn event.

name: Las Vegas Monopoly Hot Pursuit
creator: DGreatusDGod
description: Viva Las Vegas stye Monopoly rules. multi players, and casino fun.

name: Velvet Chair Beauty Salon
creator: DGreatusDGod
description: You step into your bustling beauty studio, ready to serve the day's clients. You see Nia sitting in the chair, requesting box braids with gold cuffs. As you work, Imani and Aisha wait for their facials, while Tanya and Vivienne prepare for makeup sessions. The atmosphere is lively, with clients chatting and laughing. Your goal is to master different styles, serve diverse clients, and earn rewards. Grow your studio from a single chair to the most famous beauty destination in the city. Compete with other players to earn the highest score, attract the most visitors, and spend the most time perfecting your craft. Will you become the ultimate Beauty Studio Boss?

name: Velvet Vault
creator: Jacob G
description: A template for building a 2D game from scratch.

name: Vermin At The Venue
creator: AceTheBass
description: The comedy club is packed... with pests! Collect Laughs and defend your venue with rubber chickens, banana peels, boxing gloves, and more. Master 20 shows, unlock nine outrageous defenses, and outsmart a cast of unruly critters. Then Go On Tour for endless, ever-changing challenges. Earn stars, climb the leaderboard, and keep the laughs coming!

name: Video Game Crossword
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: Play a crossword puzzle game all about video games! Tap a cell to select a word, toggle ACROSS/DOWN on double-tap, and fill in letters. Correct words lock green, wrong answers flash red. Earn a score and play again! Video Game Crosswords features a 13x11 grid with 14 video game words, a title screen with pixel-art icons, an on-screen QWERTY keyboard, chiptune music, and a How to Play rules overlay. Mute the game with a single tap on the speaker icon.

name: Villager
creator: DryCoast
description: Update #94 - September 28th 2026, Fishing Updates - More to come. Villager is updated very frequently with new features both big and small. This is a growing world and constantly evolving game. Player input is taken seriously and implemented regularly when possible. Send feedback to DryCoast and join our community chat to stay up to date. Build your fantasy merchant life in Villager [Season Two]! Grow a medieval marketplace with magical generators, collect goods, sell them for Gold, and upgrade your way from humble trader to legendary tycoon. Customize your house, unlock decorations, design your flag, go fishing, brew potions, complete quests, and earn rewards through daily play. Season Two brings more reasons to explore and hang out: timed world events, treasure hunts, flower blooms, social goals, live market bonuses, and cozy village activities for quick sessions or longer adventures with friends. Claim your home, build your fortune, and become one of the richest villagers in the realm.

name: Virus Hunter
creator: mrphilipjoel
description: Virus Hunter is a fast-paced multiplayer sci-fi game where players race against time to stop a rogue AI spreading through a space station. Search rooms, collect key items, and avoid corrupted zones as the virus fights back—shutting down areas and targeting players. Work together or go solo, but only one can shut down the virus before it's too late.

name: Volt Ride
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Ride an electric scooter through a vibrant outdoor skatepark at sunset. Perform tricks, collect stars, and compete in score attack mode. Unlock new scooter colors and a golden scooter by collecting stars.

name: VR & Apps Exhibit of the Virtual Worlds Museum™
creator: KEYFRAME
description: Learn about selected virtual world platforms and www.VirtualWorlds.museum

name: Wait, where's my chair?!
creator: LoneWolfPiazza
description: Get sucked into a surreal candy world with your dad! Platform through 5 sweet levels, dodging gummy bears and cupcakes. Collect power-ups like invincibility and speed boosts. Face off against the Cracked Swirl Bruiser boss in a thrilling finale! You play as the bewildered dad, using hover wings to navigate and paintballs to stun enemies. Your trusty pet companion, a pastel pink & mint winged gumdrop, follows you around, giving stat bonuses and cheering you on. This demo will grow. Player feedbk.

name: Walking Trail
creator: Nekerv2017
description: You round the bend in the morning run trail and stumble upon a secluded campsite, tucked away in the forest. Take a moment to unwind in this peaceful clearing, surrounded by nature.

name: WarriorZ
creator: Austingra7x
description: A classic 2D retro fighting game bringing Dragon Ball Z into the Metaverse.

name: Whack A Rot
creator: seemebro
description: a classic arcade game where players use a mallet to hit toy moles that randomly pop up from holes in a board

name: Whale of Fortune
creator: Christian
description: Race through a giant whale's belly, dodging danger and rising stomach acid! Grab weapons, sabotage rivals, and escape first. Outsmart, outpace, and prove who's the fastest among your friends!

name: What happened to your phone?
creator: creativeCharm
description: You find yourself holding a futuristic phone, staring at a sleek screen that says 'NUFQ' in bold letters. Below it, a small red badge pulses with the warning 'NOT FOR HUMANOID USE'. Your goal is to unlock this phone and explore the content.

name: Catch Me If You Can!
creator: Bambipie
description: Master thief Vesper Vane is stealing the world’s greatest treasures, from the Statue of Liberty’s torch to Big Ben’s chimes. Question witnesses, decode clues and race across 20 cities to catch her crew before she vanishes again. Catch me if you can, detective.

name: Where's Wally?
creator: creativeCharm
description: You play as Wally's dog, searching a crowded 3D party room for Wally. Use the joystick to move around and double-tap NPCs to guess if they're Wally, Wendy or Wuffy. A proximity meter guides you closer to Wally. As you progress you play as Wendy and Wuffy!

name: Whispering Woods
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Explore a mystical forest at dusk, collecting 8 handwritten notes to uncover the story of the Tall Watcher, a shy forest guardian. Navigate through a 300x300m forest with varied trees, a cozy cabin, and drifting fireflies. The Tall Watcher will appear more frequently as you collect his letters, sharing gentle thoughts. Your goal is to find all notes and meet the Watcher at the cabin for a sunrise cinematic ending.

name: Whispers of Dawn
creator: April_Renee
description: Explore a mystical floating island in a twilight sky, guided by a faury Collect star fragments, match them to symbols, and connect threads of light to transform the island solo or co-op.

name: Wilderness 13 Ordeal
creator: Yoda G.
description: The Haunted Wilds of the Wilderness 13: You wake up alone in the Wilderness 13. Confront your fears in this haunting adventure as you solve 13 cryptic riddles, and traverse treacherous terrain to escape your minds prison. Each riddle will lead you deeper in with cryptic directions, hidden sewers, deadly falls, and supernatural encounters. Precision and focus needed as you'll need to d

name: Wireframe Strike 2D
creator: 8bitvapor
description: Run, jump, and shoot through glowing 2D wireframe levels. Bounce back from gaps and hits without game-overs. Explore 4 worlds, each with 3 levels and a boss. Collect power-ups and energy cells to boost your score.

name: Wishie
creator: creativeCharm
description: Tap your wishy to climb through vibrant, galaxy-like worlds, leaving a trail of progress behind.

name: Wishy Washy
creator: Domeoc
description: Wishy Washy is a fast-paced vertical climbing game where players clean filthy skyscraper windows while scaling higher and higher above the city. Tap to climb, scrub windows clean, and survive the rising pressure, speed, and dizzying heights.

name: Wizard Cottage
creator: emorgul
description: A cozy cottage with great music, magical minigames, and immaculate vibes. And now, you can even get your personalized Tarot Card reading from Madame Mysst. Music by Adam Griffith (licensed through FB Sound).

name: Wizards Tower Defense
creator: leo
description: Choose from three powerful wizards - Mystic Wizard, Battle Mage, or Classic Wizard - each with three upgrade tiers. Tap a green tile to open the wizard selection panel, then swipe a glowing rune symbol with a countdown timer bar to place your wizard. Defend against goblin waves that get harder each round Earn gold, upgrade your wizards, and sell them for 50% gold back by dragging them to the dungeon portal. Will you be able to protect your realm from the goblin invasion?

name: Wolfenspace
creator: daddy26764
description: The world space station has been taken over by AI robots. You have been hired by the federal government to clear the Space Station of all AI robots. Once you clear each floor be sure to check the map for any missed ammo or health packs then follow the line to the elevator to go to the next level. Be careful out there.

name: Wonderland
creator: Studio Soup
description:
Welcome to Wonderland
A world beyond imagination, where reality bends and adventure awaits. Explore the Whispering Forest, uncover the Inverted Palace, and defy time in the Timeless Garden. Play with friends, unlock secret missions, and collect Wondercoins to shape your journey.
A place where dreams come true and truths become dreams.
Are you ready to step inside?

name: WOOFLE
creator: Tom Sharpe (Gossamer)
description: Put your fetch skills to the test in WOOFLE! Throw your favorite woofle ball to clear all the orange pegs in this playful arcade puzzle game. A cast of colorful canines cheer you on and lend a paw with their special abilities. Clear all 60 levels on your adventure through the ultimate dog lover’s dream.

name: Word Association Solitaire
creator: Dooley
description: You find yourself in a cozy, enchanted reading nook, surrounded by stacks of books and whispering pages. Your goal is to master the art of Solitaire Associations, a word-building game.

name: Word Kingdom
creator: Scott (Trashbyrd)
description: In Word Kingdom, solve word puzzles to grow your 3D castle. Watch as turrets and towers rise from the earth as you solve! Unlock new castles, structures, and background art as you play each day.

name: Word Loopers
creator: metabigchief
description: Word Loopers is a relaxing word puzzle on a classic chalkboard. Swipe the letter wheel to spell words and fill the crossword! Play 2,000 levels that grow from easy to brain-teasing, then keep going in endless play. Solve a new Daily Puzzle every day, claim daily rewards, spin the prize wheel, and complete quests for coins. Find bonus words for free hints, collect 34 colorful palettes, and climb the leaderboards.

name: Word Sleuth
creator: tmwheeler1
description: Play a hangman-style spelling game with 20 words across 4 difficulty tiers. Each word has a unique clue to help you guess the letters. Use a full A–Z QWERTY keyboard to fill in the blanks, and lose hearts for wrong guesses. As you progress, the words get longer and trickier. Earn points for completing words and bonus points for remaining hearts.

name: Words (Portrait Mobile Only) Game!
creator: king_of_Miami
description: Beta Testing NEW Portait Style Mobile Only Game! 6 chances to guess the correct 5 letter word.

name: World Trivia
creator: xX_Jazzie_Xx
description: Test your knowledge! Pick a country, answer questions, and come back every day for a fresh challenge!

name: Wrong Door
creator: Kiss
description: Tap to play a tense, fast-paced game of quick decision-making! Three doors appear, and you must choose the correct one based on a short clue before time runs out. Gain points for correct choices and increase your streak. Lose lives for wrong choices and try to beat your high score in Door Dash. Will you make it to the next round?

name: Wrong Wire!
creator: OdiseaJ
description: Watch closely as three brown shells swap and slide across a table — one hides a glowing ball. When they settle, each shell reveals a colored wire (blue, red, or black). Tap the wire matching the shell that hid the ball before it was shuffled away! As you progress, the swaps get faster and the challenge grows. Will you become the ultimate Wire Wizard and defuse the most bombs?

name: Yandere Escape - Hide & Seek
creator: michaelgregoryii
description:
In "Yandere Escape Hide & Seek," find yourself trapped in a dark, ominous school haunted by the obsessive Yandere.

To escape, you must uncover six hidden photos scattered throughout the mansion, each revealing a clue to unlock the way out.

As you navigate through eerie rooms and hide in the lockers to not be seen by Yandere, you'll always need to stay one step ahead of Yandere, who lurks in the shadows, eager to capture anyone who gets too close.

Can they outwit her obsession and find freedom before it's too late?

name: Yarn Unravel
creator: Sampson Crooks
description: Navigate a vibrant teal yarn ball through increasingly complex tangles, collecting strands while avoiding hazards like scissors and cats. Extend your length, earn points, and unravel the ball without losing your trail. Compete on the Unravel High Scores leaderboard for top spots. This puzzle game challenges you through 6 levels of increasing difficulty, with moving scissors, chasing cats, and strict timers.

name: Yeet Yourself
creator: emorgul
description: Yeet Yourself is a fast-paced launcher game where you slingshot through a multiverse of realms to earn upgrades and fly even farther. Crash, collect, and customize your way to ultimate yeet greatness. Co-created by Sawhorse Productions and Emorgul.

name: Carl's Chaos
creator: Yoda G.
description: You pilot your ship through endless waves of asteroids in a tense survival run. Your hull degrades over time due to time pressure, and you must collect repair pickups dropped by destroyed asteroids to slow the drain. Navigate through a 2D retro pixel-art environment, and compete for the longest survival time on the leaderboard in Galactic Wavefront. The game features immersive audio effects, a virtual joystick, and a challenging experience that will put your skills to the test.

name: YGs Galactic Showdown
creator: Yoda G.
description: You pilot your Anime Fighter left and right at the bottom of the screen to destroy waves of swooping alien invaders in Galactic Rift! Face off against the Boss Galaga and use a tractor beam to capture your ship - destroy that boss later to rescue your ship and combine them into a powerful side-by-side Dual Fighter. Every 4th level, bonus target stages appear where you aim to shoot down swirling formations of aliens for bonus points without firing back.

name: Yoda G.'s : Spadeline
creator: Yoda G.
description: Yoda G.’s Spadeline ,you play a solo Spades campaign against AI opponents in a futuristic setting. Bid tricks, play strategically, and face progressively tougher AI as you win. Track your score, win streak, and difficulty level in this immersive card game experience. Your journey begins with a clean and intuitive UI, featuring a 13-card hand at the bottom, bid summary, trick area in the center, and campaign progress always visible.

name: Yoda G.'s Pet Rescue
creator: Yoda G.
description: Run Yoda's Pet Rescue! Serve customers, restock supplies, and decorate your shop to keep pets happy and healthy. You earn more for rescuing stray pets and nursing them back to health. Unlock new items and improvements to make your shop the best it can be.

name: YodaCross
creator: Yoda G.
description: Ride a motocross bike through increasingly tough races. Earn currency to unlock bikes, upgrades, and cosmetics. Compete on mixed terrain tracks with simple touch controls and side-view camera. Customize bikes and rider with a shop for upgrades and cosmetics. Play in portrait or landscape mode with auto-rotation support. Compete on the global leaderboard for the fastest times.

name: YodaMaine's BMXWorld
creator: Yoda G.
description: You ride into a vibrant BMX park, surrounded by ramps and graffiti. Unlock new tricks, bikes, and gear as you progress through missions. Compete on the leaderboard and shop for upgrades in a full-service BMX shop with bikes, parts, gear, and clothing. Explore multiple parks and cities, each with unique obstacles and challenges.

name: YodaMaine's Skateworld
creator: Yoda G.
description: Hit the streets in Skateworld! Play solo or grab your crew, skate a variety of iconic spots, pull off kickflips, board slides, manuals, grabs, power-ups, and upgrades across 8 districts. You can customize your skater with different styles and boards, and earn coi

name: YodaMaine's SurfWorld
creator: Yoda G.
description: Surf Sunny Cove, Sunset Bowl Break, Downtown Pier, or Neon Night Reef. Unlock new surf maneuvers, boards & style items as you progress through 32 missions. Customize your surfer, earn rewards & purchase new surfing cities like Pipeline, Hawaii or Bondi Beach, Australia. Ride the waves in this action-packed surfing adventure!

name: You call that a stroke'?!
creator: LoneWolfPiazza
description: Explore a fantastical mini golf course, navigating through challenges and mythological creatures that guard the holes. Unlock upgrades and secrets, including a chaotic first run mode with unpredictable abilities. Compete for the top spot on the scoreboard and face off against formidable bosses. In this world, you can choose from various ball shapes, including the Trapped Rune Planet, Cube Ball, Star Ball, Void Orb, and Chaos Fragment. The course features 12 unique hole layouts, including Act 1: The Asteroid Fields, Act 2: The Mythological Ruins, and Act 3: The Void Beyond. You can jump by tapping the screen or using the jump button, and aim your shots by dragging your finger. The game also features sound effects, ambient music, and a narrator that provides commentary throughout your journey. Play through 12 holes, each with its own challenges and obstacles, and try to get the best score possible.

name: You Otter Make Something V2
creator: UtterOtter
description: Join Wren in her cozy Maker workshop! Start with the Electronics Bench and build your first circuit. Connect a battery, LED, and resistor to light up the LED. Earn your first Maker skill badge and unlock more projects as you progress. Explore, create, and learn in this playful, creative world! Your workshop is part of your new home in a welcoming neighborhood. Meet your friendly neighbor, Mira, and help her light up her welcome sign. Record your discoveries and creations in your Maker journal. In Wren's Workshop, you'll discover the joy of making things, learning new skills, and meeting new people. Wren's Workshop is in a new neighborhood, meet Nora, she loves sewing and fixing things with fabric. Help Nora fix her tote bag and learn how to sew. Discover new skills, make new friends, and find your place in the neighborhood!

name: Zabble
creator: 𝓚𝓪𝓲𝓒𝓮𝓹𝓱𝓾𝓼
description: SWIPE TO SPELL. RACE THE CLOCK! Think fast, swipe faster, and put your word skills to the test in ZABBLE! You've got 7 letters and just 60 seconds to find as many words as possible. Swipe between letters, rack up points, and see how high you can climb the global leaderboard! Every second counts, every word matters, and there's always another high score to beat. How many words can YOU find before time runs out? Think you've got what it takes? Let's ZABBLE!

name: Zectoro's: Adv: Companion Quest
creator: Tay_NewNerd
description: In Mech Runner: Companion Quest, navigate a futuristic mech hangar with your flying robot companion. Customize with various blades, upgrade in the Armory Shop, and discover vibrant environments. Experience Street Fighter-style character selection and Versus Fight mode with HP attacks and POV.

name: Zectros Adv
creator: Tay_NewNerd
description: Play in Neon Showdown HQ, a colorful 2D side-scroller with parallax graphics and ambient effects. Explore 8 environments, from Jungle and City to Space Station and Overgrown Ruins. Collect coins, earn rewards, and upgrade in the Armory Shop. Choose from Easy, Normal, or Hard mode, and play in Doom, Surfer, Stealth, Low Gravity, Endless, Time Attack, and more! Now with a SHOP button in the HUD and an in-game shop with cyberpunk flair. Experience the rush of 3 camera views: Normal, Close-Up, and Dynamic. Try N64 Doom-style modes: NIGHTMARE, DEATHMATCH, SURVIVAL, and BERSERKER.

name: ZenZ
creator: TheRealMadCat
description: Enter ZenZ, Enter Calm. You choose from eight brushes, seven color palettes, and seven music tracks to craft your unique mandalas. As you place them, they fade in with a musical note. Explore kaleidoscope mode for symmetric patterns and save your designs to a personal gallery with up to 10 slots. A thoughtful message sets the tone: 'Like life, the soundscape of this mandala contains moments of perfect harmony and moments of tension. Practice staying present through both.' With each tap, you embrace imperfection and find serenity. Hit the eye icon to hide controls for full-screen mode, and use S, M, L buttons to change brush sizes. Tap the eraser button to clear the canvas. Enjoy ambient tracks, including Sea Soundscape, Night Forest, and Storm. Zen Mandalas is a space where you can express yourself and unwind to find your inner calm.

name: Zombie Crasherz
creator: un1v3rsedragon
description: Zombie Crasherz is pure vehicular slaughter on a countdown. You’re behind the wheel of a battered machine tearing through abandoned city streets as the undead swarm the asphalt. Every zombie you smear across your hood is a point. The road fills thicker the longer you survive. You have exactly three minutes to rack up a kill count that clears the stage minimum—or you watch the city stay lost. Toxic zombies are the real threat. Hit one and your car takes visible damage, the health bar drops, and a red haze bleeds across the edges of your vision. Dodge them. Or risk a one-shot gun pickup you’ve scavenged along the way and make the bullet count. Miss and you’re back to pure steel and speed. The stages escalate. Early runs are open-road carnage. Starting at stage five, the streets turn vicious: concrete barriers, sudden cracks, and bombs you have to thread at full speed while the horde thickens around you. Clear a stage and it’s permanently unlocked—come back anytime and chase a higher score. Clear it by fifty or more over the minimum and steering wheels start appearing. Collect them to unlock new cars (fifteen color options once unlocked, five to start) and load extra ammo into future gun pickups. At the end of every successful run, an epic cutscene shows the city brightening, streets clearing, light returning. Fail—whether your car is torn apart or the timer runs out—and the opposite plays: zombies swarm the vehicle, climbing the hood, tearing at the doors, overtaking everything as the screen goes dark. On-screen you always see the essentials: car health, total steering wheels collected, current zombie kills versus the minimum needed, and the three-minute timer counting down. Leaderboards track highest points, most stages cleared, and the names of the drivers who refused to stop. One city at a time. One red-hazed run at a time. Hit them all before the clock dies. Zombie Crasherz — the road never stays clear for long.

name: Zombie Gorilla vs Man
creator: JCredez
description: 1 Gorilla Vs 100 Men!! Who would win?

name: Zombie Rush Defense
creator: michaelgregoryii
description: Survive zombie hordes in a desperate city. Customize your loadout, upgrade weapons, and track progress on the leaderboard. Compete to survive longer and top the ranks! The game features 6 zombie types, 7 weapons, and 3 support modules.

name: Zombie Tea Shop
creator: metacrafters
description: You find yourself in a quaint zombie tea shop & cafe filled with cute zombies, eager to get a steaming cup tea or boba tea -a side of friendly banter is included. Explore the cozy shop and discover the secrets behind their charming smiles. Customize your experience with a variety of backgrounds and decorations. Interact with the adorable zombies and enjoy the spooky-cute atmosphere. In Zombie Boba Cafe, you can hang out with friends, serve boba tea, and have fun in a unique and quirky setting. The cafe features a moonlit witch's tea shop interior with warm candlelight, boba cups, and spooky-cute decor. Your zombie cafe awaits, so come on in and 'Open Shop!'

name: The Infected - Survival
creator: AbductM3
description: You find yourself at the edge of a contaminated zone. Defend a 60m survivalist compound with a tall metal fence and functional gate from hordes of infected. Earn points, upgrade gear, and progress through waves. Will you survive the outbreak?

name: ZombieRun
creator: illylilly.2022
description: 🧟 Meet Zed, a goofy zombie on a big adventure! Climb through five spooky zones, collect brains to power up your Super Jump, and dodge ghosts, bats, spikes, and rising ooze! Meet quirky characters, discover hidden secrets, and unlock exciting power-ups. Challenge the leaderboards, beat your best escape time, and uncover the mysteries waiting at the top. Can you survive the climb? Chapter 1 is just the beginning! More chapters, characters, and adventures are coming!

name: Zone Wars: Battle for Steel City
creator: RJ_The_Creator
description: Battle for Steel City: Zone Wars is a fast-paced, competitive 5v5 multiplayer shooter set in the gritty, cyberpunk-inspired lower districts of Steel City. Players choose between two rival factions—NFF (Neo Freedom Fighters) or BZF (Bottom Zone Fighters)—and engage in strategic battles to dominate the battlefield. The game features symmetrical maps with three key paths, providing balanced opportunities for both teams to outmaneuver and outthink their opponents. Players utilize a versatile three-weapon load-out (pistol, shotgun, and rifle) to adapt to close, mid, or long-range combat, encouraging tactical decision-making and teamwork. Victory depends on coordination, accuracy, and seizing critical high points on the map. An in-depth ranking system, unlock-able weapon skins, and wearable cosmetics keep players engaged as they climb the leaderboard. Whether teaming up with friends or competing against them, Zone Wars offers intense, immersive gameplay that blends fast action with strategic depth, delivering endless replay-ability in the heart of Steel City's war-torn zones. Key Features: Team-Based Gameplay: 5v5 matches with two opposing factions battling for control. Symmetrical Maps: Balanced layouts with three distinct paths and strategic high points. Tactical Load-outs: Players equip a pistol, shotgun, and rifle to suit their play-style and tactical needs. Progression and Customization: Unlock new weapon skins, wearables, and rank up as you dominate the competition. Immersive Setting: Set in the dark, futuristic world of Steel City, where war rages between factions over scarce resources.

name: Zookeeper Blast!
creator: ishii_kite
description: Zookeeper Blast! is a world where players can enjoy a casual and easy-to-play puzzle game. Each puzzle session is simple and can be completed in as little as one minute. The game offers two play modes: VS and Co-op. In VS Mode, three players compete to clear puzzles as quickly as possible (time attack). In Co-op Mode, up to four players work together to defeat a boss (Group vs Enemy). By earning Rank Points through puzzle play, players can unlock over 22 types of animals as achievement rewards. Animals can accompany players as buddies and can be switched freely. Aim to complete your Animal Encyclopedia collection! (Build Version 36)

name: ✨Elite Volleyball 🏐
creator: xX_Jazzie_Xx
description: 🏐 Spike, Serve, and Dominate! Jump into fast-paced volleyball action with exciting rallies, powerful spikes, and competitive matches. Master your controls, outplay your opponents, and fight for every point in this fun, action-packed mobile volleyball game!

name: ✨Pixel Football 🏈
creator: xX_Jazzie_Xx
description: ✨Fast paced 2D pixel arcade football game where you run, pass and dodge defenders!Two training modes keep things fresh - Passing drill and Field Goal practice. Light up the scoreboard in Pixel Football! 🏈

name: ⭐Rockstar University⭐
creator: MikeyAce
description: Rockstar University encompasses all genres of music. In different classrooms, you can learn to play piano, guitar, drums, and other instruments; take classes in a recording studio featuring singing lessons, karaoke, and hip-hop tracks; and produce music videos with different backdrops, props, and set pieces. Finally, you and your band can take the main stage and rock out with fireworks and special effects. Now showcasing students' final projects in VR in a dedicated art gallery from the 8-week "Intro to Blender" course I taught. This trimesh world is in beta, with lots of exciting new interactive features to come. I would love any feedback. At Rockstar University, everyone is a rockstar!

name: 🥊 Fighters of the Horizon 👊
creator: Runtime_Renegade
description: Get ready to rumble in Fighters of the Horizon! A Horizon Create Exclusive Title! Pick from 14 hand-drawn fighters, each with their own specials, EX moves and supers, and battle in fast 2.5D one-on-one fights built for your phone. Tap SPECIAL for easy special moves or master classic stick motions, and swipe for EX attacks, throws and supers. Climb the Arcade ladder, train your combos, or queue up Online VS to take on real players in smooth rollback-netcode matches.

name: 🧟 ZOMBIE RAID - DEAD FARM 🧟
creator: LittleCreator
description:
🧟 Welcome to ZOMBIE RAID - DEAD FARM! 🧟
🌊 Endless waves of zombies - Face waves of zombies that become stronger and stronger.
👥 Solo or co-op - Play alone or with your friends to push back the invasion together.
🏆 Leaderboards progression - Climb the leaderboard of the best survivors.
💲 Earn cash by surviving - Buy better weapons to survive!
⚠️ One goal: survive - Stay alive as long as possible...
🔄 Regular Updates - The game is frequently updated with new content.
👉 Are you ready to face the zombie apocalypse? 🧟🔥
⭐ Favorite & Like the Game ❤️ - Don't forget to add the game to your favorites and leave a like to support the development and help the game grow!
*UPDATE LOGS*

-14/01 = Earn cash with zombies kills

-18/12 = Increased amount of ammo on new gamestart.
-18/12 = Reduced zombies increasing stats from 1.1 to 1.05.

name: HELLBREACH
creator: 8bitvapor
description: HELLBREACH is a retro raycasting FPS in the spirit of the '90s classics. Fight through themed zones swarming with 13 original monsters, from shambling horrors to hulking brutes. Every wall, floor and doorway is dressed in rich Freedoom textures for that authentic pixel-dungeon feel. You get 3 hearts and no fail state, just pure run-and-gun fun: explore, blast the swarm, and clear every zone. Single-player, built for quick sessions, big scores and repeat runs. Enter the breach, if you dare today.

name: Trivia Quest 2 The one with a Pause button.
creator: LoneWolfPiazza
